edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: Blessed is the man who has not walked by the counsel of the wicked, stood on the path of sinners, or sat in the seat of scoffers;
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָלַךְ בַּעֲצַת רְשָׁעִים וּבְדֶרֶךְ חַטָּאִים לֹא עָמָד וּבְמוֹשַׁב לֵצִים לֹא יָשָׁב׃

verses.english: but his delight is in YHWH’s law, and on His law he meditates day and night.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם בְּתוֹרַת יְהוָה חֶפְצוֹ וּבְתוֹרָתוֹ יֶהְגֶּה יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה׃

verses.english: He will be like a tree planted beside channels of water, which gives its fruit in its season, and whose leaf does not wither; and everything he does will prosper.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּעֵץ שָׁתוּל עַל־פַּלְגֵי מָיִם אֲשֶׁר פִּרְיוֹ יִתֵּן בְּעִתּוֹ וְעָלֵהוּ לֹא־יִבּוֹל וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂה יַצְלִיחַ׃

verses.english: Not so the wicked, but like chaff which the wind drives away.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־כֵן הָרְשָׁעִים כִּי אִם־כַּמֹּץ אֲ‍שֶׁר־תִּדְּפֶנּוּ רוּחַ׃

verses.english: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous;
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן לֹא־יָקֻמוּ רְשָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְחַטָּאִים בַּעֲדַת צַדִּיקִים׃

verses.english: for YHWH knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יוֹדֵעַ יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ צַדִּיקִים וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד׃

verses.english: Why have nations been in uproar, and peoples meditated on emptiness?
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה רָגְשׁוּ גוֹיִם וּלְאֻמִּים יֶהְגּוּ־רִיק׃

verses.english: The kings of the earth take their stand, and rulers conspire together, against YHWH and against His anointed:
verses.hebrew: יִתְיַצְּבוּ מַלְכֵי־אֶרֶץ וְרוֹזְנִים נוֹסְדוּ־יָחַד עַל־יְהוָה וְעַל־מְשִׁיחוֹ׃

verses.english: “Let us tear apart their bonds and throw their cords away from us.”
verses.hebrew: נְנַתְּקָה אֶת־מוֹסְרוֹתֵימוֹ וְנַשְׁלִיכָה מִמֶּנּוּ עֲבֹתֵימוֹ׃

verses.english: The One seated in heaven laughs; the Lord mocks them.
verses.hebrew: יוֹשֵׁב בַּשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׂחָק אֲדֹנָי יִלְעַג־לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: Then He will speak to them in His anger and terrify them in His burning wrath:
verses.hebrew: אָז יְדַבֵּר אֵלֵימוֹ בְאַפּוֹ וּבַחֲרוֹנוֹ יְבַהֲלֵמוֹ׃

verses.english: “But I have installed My king on Zion, My holy mountain.”
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי נָסַכְתִּי מַלְכִּי עַל־צִיּוֹן הַר־קָדְשִׁי׃

verses.english: I will recount the decree: YHWH said to me, “You are My son; today I have begotten you.
verses.hebrew: אֲסַפְּרָה אֶל חֹק יְהוָה אָמַר אֵלַי בְּנִי אַתָּה אֲנִי הַיּוֹם יְלִדְתִּיךָ׃

verses.english: Ask of Me, and I will give nations as your inheritance, and the ends of the earth as your possession.
verses.hebrew: שְׁאַל מִמֶּנִּי וְאֶתְּנָה גוֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶךָ וַאֲחֻזָּתְךָ אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: You will break them with an iron rod; you will shatter them like a potter’s vessel.”
verses.hebrew: תְּרֹעֵם בְּשֵׁבֶט בַּרְזֶל כִּכְלִי יוֹצֵר תְּנַפְּצֵם׃

verses.english: And now, kings, act wisely; be instructed, judges of the earth.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מְלָכִים הַשְׂכִּילוּ הִוָּסְרוּ שֹׁפְטֵי אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Serve YHWH with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.hebrew: עִבְדוּ אֶת־יְהוָה בְּיִרְאָה וְגִילוּ בִּרְעָדָה׃

verses.english: Equip yourselves with purity, lest He become angry and you perish on the way, for His anger will soon burn. Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.
verses.hebrew: נַשְּׁקוּ־בַר פֶּן־יֶאֱנַף וְתֹאבְדוּ דֶרֶךְ כִּי־יִבְעַר כִּמְעַט אַפּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי כָּל־חוֹסֵי בוֹ׃

verses.english: A psalm of David, when he fled from the presence of Absalom his son.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד בְּבָרְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּנוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH, how many are my adversaries! Many rise against me.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מָה־רַבּוּ צָרָי רַבִּים קָמִים עָלָי׃

verses.english: Many say concerning my soul, “There is no salvation for him in God.” Selah.
verses.hebrew: רַבִּים אֹמְרִים לְנַפְשִׁי אֵין יְשׁוּעָתָה לּוֹ בֵאלֹהִים סֶלָה׃

verses.english: But You, YHWH, are a shield around me, my glory and the One who lifts my head.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה מָגֵן בַּעֲדִי כְּבוֹדִי וּמֵרִים רֹאשִׁי׃

verses.english: With my voice I call to YHWH, and He answered me from His holy mountain. Selah.
verses.hebrew: קוֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָה אֶקְרָא וַיַּעֲנֵנִי מֵהַר קָדְשׁוֹ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: I lay down and slept; I awoke, for YHWH sustains me.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי שָׁכַבְתִּי וָאִישָׁנָה הֱקִיצוֹתִי כִּי יְהוָה יִסְמְכֵנִי׃

verses.english: I will not fear tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me all around.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־אִירָא מֵרִבְבוֹת עָם אֲשֶׁר סָבִיב שָׁתוּ עָלָי׃

verses.english: Rise, YHWH! Save me, my God! For You have struck all my enemies on the cheek; You have broken the teeth of the wicked.
verses.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי אֱלֹהַי כִּי־הִכִּיתָ אֶת־כָּל־אֹיְבַי לֶחִי שִׁנֵּי רְשָׁעִים שִׁבַּרְתָּ׃

verses.english: Salvation belongs to YHWH; Your blessing is upon Your people. Selah.
verses.hebrew: לַיהוָה הַיְשׁוּעָה עַל־עַמְּךָ בִרְכָתֶךָ סֶּלָה׃

verses.english: For the director, with stringed instruments. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינוֹת מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: When I call, answer me, God of my righteousness! In distress You made room for me. Be gracious to me, and hear my prayer.
verses.hebrew: בְּקָרְאִי עֲנֵנִי אֱלֹהֵי צִדְקִי בַּצָּר הִרְחַבְתָּ לִּי חָנֵּנִי וּשְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתִי׃

verses.english: Sons of men, how long will my glory be put to shame? Will you love emptiness and seek falsehood? Selah.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי אִישׁ עַד־מֶה כְבוֹדִי לִכְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָבוּן רִיק תְּבַקְשׁוּ כָזָב סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Know that YHWH has set apart a faithful one for Himself; YHWH will hear when I call to Him.
verses.hebrew: וּדְעוּ כִּי־הִפְלָה יְהוָה חָסִיד לוֹ יְהוָה יִשְׁמַע בְּקָרְאִי אֵלָיו׃

verses.english: Tremble, and do not sin; speak in your hearts upon your beds, and be still. Selah.
verses.hebrew: רִגְזוּ וְאַל־תֶּחֱטָאוּ אִמְרוּ בִלְבַבְכֶם עַל־מִשְׁכַּבְכֶם וְדֹמּוּ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Offer righteous sacrifices, and trust in YHWH.
verses.hebrew: זִבְחוּ זִבְחֵי־צֶדֶק וּבִטְחוּ אֶל־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Many say, “Who will show us good?” Lift up over us the light of Your face, YHWH!
verses.hebrew: רַבִּים אֹמְרִים מִי־יַרְאֵנוּ טוֹב נְסָה־עָלֵינוּ אוֹר פָּנֶיךָ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and new wine abounded.
verses.hebrew: נָתַתָּה שִׂמְחָה בְלִבִּי מֵעֵת דְּגָנָם וְתִירוֹשָׁם רָבּוּ׃

verses.english: In peace I will both lie down and sleep, for You, YHWH, alone make me dwell in safety.
verses.hebrew: בְּשָׁלוֹם יַחְדָּו אֶשְׁכְּבָה וְאִישָׁן כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה לְבָדָד לָבֶטַח תּוֹשִׁיבֵנִי׃

verses.english: For the director, for the Nehiloth. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אֶל־הַנְּחִילוֹת מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: Give ear to my words, YHWH; understand my murmuring.
verses.hebrew: אֲמָרַי הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה בִּינָה הֲגִיגִי׃

verses.english: Attend to the voice of my cry for help, my King and my God, for to You I pray.
verses.hebrew: הַקְשִׁיבָה לְקוֹל שַׁוְעִי מַלְכִּי וֵאלֹהָי כִּי־אֵלֶיךָ אֶתְפַּלָּל׃

verses.english: YHWH, in the morning You will hear my voice; in the morning I will set things before You and watch.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בֹּקֶר תִּשְׁמַע קוֹלִי בֹּקֶר אֶעֱרָךְ־לְךָ וַאֲצַפֶּה׃

verses.english: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; evil will not sojourn with You.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא אֵל־חָפֵץ רֶשַׁע אָתָּה לֹא יְגֻרְךָ רָע׃

verses.english: The boastful will not take their stand before Your eyes; You hate all who work iniquity.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִתְיַצְּבוּ הוֹלְלִים לְנֶגֶד עֵינֶיךָ שָׂנֵאתָ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃

verses.english: You destroy those who speak falsehood; YHWH abhors a man of bloodshed and deceit.
verses.hebrew: תְּאַבֵּד דֹּבְרֵי כָזָב אִישׁ־דָּמִים וּמִרְמָה יְתָעֵב יְהוָה׃

verses.english: But I, through the abundance of Your steadfast love, will enter Your house; I will bow toward Your holy temple in fear of You.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ אָבוֹא בֵיתֶךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל־הֵיכַל־קָדְשְׁךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: YHWH, guide me in Your righteousness because of those who watch me; make Your way straight before me.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה נְחֵנִי בְצִדְקָתֶךָ לְמַעַן שׁוֹרְרָי הושר [הַיְשַׁר] לְפָנַי דַּרְכֶּךָ׃

verses.english: For there is nothing trustworthy in his mouth; their inward part is destruction. Their throat is an open grave; they smooth their tongue.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵין בְּפִיהוּ נְכוֹנָה קִרְבָּם הַוּוֹת קֶבֶר־פָּתוּחַ גְּרוֹנָם לְשׁוֹנָם יַחֲלִיקוּן׃

verses.english: Hold them guilty, God! Let them fall through their counsels. In the multitude of their transgressions, cast them out, for they have rebelled against You.
verses.hebrew: הַאֲשִׁימֵם אֱ‍לֹהִים יִפְּלוּ מִמֹּעֲצוֹתֵיהֶם בְּרֹב פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם הַדִּיחֵמוֹ כִּי־מָרוּ בָךְ׃

verses.english: Let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them sing for joy forever, and spread shelter over them. Let those who love Your name exult in You.
verses.hebrew: וְיִשְׂמְחוּ כָל־חוֹסֵי בָךְ לְעוֹלָם יְרַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵךְ עָלֵימוֹ וְיַעְלְצוּ בְךָ אֹהֲבֵי שְׁמֶךָ׃

verses.english: For You bless the righteous one, YHWH; with favor You surround him as with a shield.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה תְּבָרֵךְ צַדִּיק יְהוָה כַּצִּנָּה רָצוֹן תַּעְטְרֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: For the director, with stringed instruments, upon the eighth. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינוֹת עַל־הַשְּׁמִינִית מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: YHWH, do not rebuke me in Your anger, and do not discipline me in Your fury.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אַל־בְּאַפְּךָ תוֹכִיחֵנִי וְאַל־בַּחֲמָתְךָ תְיַסְּרֵנִי׃

verses.english: Be gracious to me, YHWH, for I am languishing; heal me, YHWH, for my bones are terrified.
verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי יְהוָה כִּי אֻמְלַל אָנִי רְפָאֵנִי יְהוָה כִּי נִבְהֲלוּ עֲצָמָי׃

verses.english: My soul is greatly terrified; and You, YHWH—how long?
verses.hebrew: וְנַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָה מְאֹד ואת [וְאַתָּה] יְהוָה עַד־מָתָי׃

verses.english: Return, YHWH; deliver my soul. Save me for the sake of Your steadfast love.
verses.hebrew: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה חַלְּצָה נַפְשִׁי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי לְמַעַן חַסְדֶּךָ׃

verses.english: For in death there is no remembrance of You; in Sheol, who will give You thanks?
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵין בַּמָּוֶת זִכְרֶךָ בִּשְׁאוֹל מִי יוֹדֶה־לָּךְ׃

verses.english: I am weary with my groaning; every night I make my bed swim, with my tears I dissolve my couch.
verses.hebrew: יָגַעְתִּי בְּאַנְחָתִי אַשְׂחֶה בְכָל־לַיְלָה מִטָּתִי בְּדִמְעָתִי עַרְשִׂי אַמְסֶה׃

verses.english: My eye has wasted away from grief; it has grown old because of all my adversaries.
verses.hebrew: עָשְׁשָׁה מִכַּעַס עֵינִי עָתְקָה בְּכָל־צוֹרְרָי׃

verses.english: Depart from me, all who work iniquity, for YHWH has heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.hebrew: סוּרוּ מִמֶּנִּי כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן כִּי־שָׁמַע יְהוָה קוֹל בִּכְיִי׃

verses.english: YHWH has heard my supplication; YHWH will receive my prayer.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמַע יְהוָה תְּחִנָּתִי יְהוָה תְּפִלָּתִי יִקָּח׃

verses.english: Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly terrified; let them turn back and be ashamed in a moment.
verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲלוּ מְאֹד כָּל־אֹיְבָי יָשֻׁבוּ יֵבֹשׁוּ רָגַע׃

verses.english: A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to YHWH concerning the words of Cush, a Benjaminite.
verses.hebrew: שִׁגָּיוֹן לְדָוִד אֲשֶׁר־שָׁר לַיהוָה עַל־דִּבְרֵי־כוּשׁ בֶּן־יְמִינִי׃

verses.english: YHWH my God, in You I have taken refuge. Save me from all who pursue me, and deliver me,
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי בְּךָ חָסִיתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִכָּל־רֹדְפַי וְהַצִּילֵנִי׃

verses.english: lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it with no one to deliver.
verses.hebrew: פֶּן־יִטְרֹף כְּאַרְיֵה נַפְשִׁי פֹּרֵק וְאֵין מַצִּיל׃

verses.english: YHWH my God, if I have done this, if there is wrong in my hands,
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי אִם־עָשִׂיתִי זֹאת אִם־יֶשׁ־עָוֶל בְּכַפָּי׃

verses.english: if I repaid evil to one who repaid me, and stripped my adversary bare,
verses.hebrew: אִם־גָּמַלְתִּי שׁוֹלְמִי רָע וָאֲחַלְּצָה צוֹרְרִי רֵיקָם׃

verses.english: let an enemy pursue my soul and overtake it, trample my life to the earth, and make my glory dwell in the dust. Selah.
verses.hebrew: יִרַדֹּף אוֹיֵב נַפְשִׁי וְיַשֵּׂג וְיִרְמֹס לָאָרֶץ חַיָּי וּכְבוֹדִי לֶעָפָר יַשְׁכֵּן סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Rise, YHWH, in Your anger; lift Yourself up against the raging of my adversaries. Awake for me; You have commanded judgment.
verses.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה בְּאַפֶּךָ הִנָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְרוֹת צוֹרְרָי וְעוּרָה אֵלַי מִשְׁפָּט צִוִּיתָ׃

verses.english: Let the congregation of peoples surround You; return above it to the height.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲדַת לְאֻמִּים תְּסוֹבְבֶךָּ וְעָלֶיהָ לַמָּרוֹם שׁוּבָה׃

verses.english: YHWH judges peoples. Judge me, YHWH, according to my righteousness and according to my integrity upon me.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יָדִין עַמִּים שָׁפְטֵנִי יְהוָה כְּצִדְקִי וּכְתֻמִּי עָלָי׃

verses.english: Let the evil of the wicked come to an end, and establish the righteous one, You who test hearts and kidneys, righteous God.
verses.hebrew: יִגְמָר־נָא רַע רְשָׁעִים וּתְכוֹנֵן צַדִּיק וּבֹחֵן לִבּוֹת וּכְלָיוֹת אֱלֹהִים צַדִּיק׃

verses.english: My shield rests with God, who saves the upright in heart.
verses.hebrew: מָגִנִּי עַל־אֱלֹהִים מוֹשִׁיעַ יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃

verses.english: God is a righteous judge, and a God who is indignant every day.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים שׁוֹפֵט צַדִּיק וְאֵל זֹעֵם בְּכָל־יוֹם׃

verses.english: If he does not return, He will sharpen His sword; He has bent His bow and made it ready.
verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא יָשׁוּב חַרְבּוֹ יִלְטוֹשׁ קַשְׁתּוֹ דָרַךְ וַיְכוֹנְנֶהָ׃

verses.english: For him He has prepared instruments of death; He makes His arrows for the pursuers.
verses.hebrew: וְלוֹ הֵכִין כְּלֵי־מָוֶת חִצָּיו לְדֹלְקִים יִפְעָל׃

verses.english: Look, he travails with iniquity; he conceived trouble and gave birth to falsehood.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יְחַבֶּל־אָוֶן וְהָרָה עָמָל וְיָלַד שָׁקֶר׃

verses.english: He dug a pit and hollowed it out, and fell into the ditch he made.
verses.hebrew: בּוֹר כָּרָה וַיַּחְפְּרֵהוּ וַיִּפֹּל בְּשַׁחַת יִפְעָל׃

verses.english: His trouble will return upon his head, and his violence will descend upon his crown.
verses.hebrew: יָשׁוּב עֲמָלוֹ בְרֹאשׁוֹ וְעַל קָדְקֳדוֹ חֲמָסוֹ יֵרֵד׃

verses.english: I will give thanks to YHWH according to His righteousness, and sing praise to the name of YHWH Most High.
verses.hebrew: אוֹדֶה יְהוָה כְּצִדְקוֹ וַאֲזַמְּרָה שֵׁם־יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן׃

verses.english: For the director, upon the Gittith. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־הַגִּתִּית מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: YHWH our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth, You who have set Your splendor above the heavens!
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֲדֹנֵינוּ מָה־אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תְּנָה הוֹדְךָ עַל־הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: From the mouth of infants and nursing children You established strength, because of Your adversaries, to still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.hebrew: מִפִּי עוֹלְלִים וְיֹנְקִים יִסַּדְתָּ עֹז לְמַעַן צוֹרְרֶיךָ לְהַשְׁבִּית אוֹיֵב וּמִתְנַקֵּם׃

verses.english: When I see Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and stars which You established,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֶרְאֶה שָׁמֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂי אֶצְבְּעֹתֶיךָ יָרֵחַ וְכוֹכָבִים אֲשֶׁר כּוֹנָנְתָּה׃

verses.english: what is a human being, that You remember him, and a son of man, that You attend to him?
verses.hebrew: מָה־אֱנוֹשׁ כִּי־תִזְכְּרֶנּוּ וּבֶן־אָדָם כִּי תִפְקְדֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: You made him a little lower than God, and crowned him with glory and splendor.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּחַסְּרֵהוּ מְּעַט מֵאֱלֹהִים וְכָבוֹד וְהָדָר תְּעַטְּרֵהוּ׃

verses.english: You make him rule over the works of Your hands; You placed everything beneath his feet:
verses.hebrew: תַּמְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ כֹּל שַׁתָּה תַחַת־רַגְלָיו׃

verses.english: sheep and cattle, all of them, and also the animals of the field,
verses.hebrew: צֹנֶה וַאֲלָפִים כֻּלָּם וְגַם בַּהֲמוֹת שָׂדָי׃

verses.english: birds of the sky and fish of the sea, whatever passes along the paths of seas.
verses.hebrew: צִפּוֹר שָׁמַיִם וּדְגֵי הַיָּם עֹבֵר אָרְחוֹת יַמִּים׃

verses.english: YHWH our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֲדֹנֵינוּ מָה־אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: For the director. Almuth-labben. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַלְמוּת לַבֵּן מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: I will give thanks, YHWH, with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.
verses.hebrew: אוֹדֶה יְהוָה בְּכָל־לִבִּי אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: I will rejoice and exult in You; I will sing praise to Your name, Most High.
verses.hebrew: אֶשְׂמְחָה וְאֶעֶלְצָה בָךְ אֲזַמְּרָה שִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן׃

verses.english: When my enemies turn back, they will stumble and perish before You,
verses.hebrew: בְּשׁוּב־אוֹיְבַי אָחוֹר יִכָּשְׁלוּ וְיֹאבְדוּ מִפָּנֶיךָ׃

verses.english: for You have upheld my judgment and my cause; You sat on the throne, judging righteously.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִי וְדִינִי יָשַׁבְתָּ לְכִסֵּא שׁוֹפֵט צֶדֶק׃

verses.english: You rebuked nations; You destroyed the wicked one; You erased their name forever and ever.
verses.hebrew: גָּעַרְתָּ גוֹיִם אִבַּדְתָּ רָשָׁע שְׁמָם מָחִיתָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃

verses.english: The enemy is finished—in ruins forever; You uprooted cities; their very memory has perished.
verses.hebrew: הָאוֹיֵב תַּמּוּ חֳרָבוֹת לָנֶצַח וְעָרִים נָתַשְׁתָּ אָבַד זִכְרָם הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: But YHWH sits enthroned forever; He has established His throne for judgment.
verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה לְעוֹלָם יֵשֵׁב כּוֹנֵן לַמִּשְׁפָּט כִּסְאוֹ׃

verses.english: He will judge the world in righteousness; He will judge peoples with equity.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק יָדִין לְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃

verses.english: May YHWH be a stronghold for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of distress.
verses.hebrew: וִיהִי יְהוָה מִשְׂגָּב לַדָּךְ מִשְׂגָּב לְעִתּוֹת בַּצָּרָה׃

verses.english: Those who know Your name will trust in You, for You have not forsaken those who seek You, YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְיִבְטְחוּ בְךָ יוֹדְעֵי שְׁמֶךָ כִּי לֹא־עָזַבְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁיךָ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Sing praise to YHWH, who dwells in Zion; declare His deeds among the peoples.
verses.hebrew: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה יֹשֵׁב צִיּוֹן הַגִּידוּ בָעַמִּים עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: For the One who calls bloodshed to account remembers them; He has not forgotten the cry of the afflicted.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־דֹרֵשׁ דָּמִים אוֹתָם זָכָר לֹא־שָׁכַח צַעֲקַת עניים [עֲנָוִים׃]

verses.english: Be gracious to me, YHWH; see my affliction from those who hate me, You who raise me from the gates of death,
verses.hebrew: חָנְנֵנִי יְהוָה רְאֵה עָנְיִי מִשֹּׂנְאָי מְרוֹמְמִי מִשַּׁעֲרֵי מָוֶת׃

verses.english: so that I may recount all Your praises in the gates of daughter Zion; I will rejoice in Your salvation.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֶיךָ בְּשַׁעֲרֵי בַת־צִיּוֹן אָגִילָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Nations sank into the pit they made; in the net they concealed, their foot was caught.
verses.hebrew: טָבְעוּ גוֹיִם בְּשַׁחַת עָשׂוּ בְּרֶשֶׁת־זוּ טָמָנוּ נִלְכְּדָה רַגְלָם׃

verses.english: YHWH has made Himself known; He has executed judgment; the wicked one is ensnared by the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
verses.hebrew: נוֹדַע יְהוָה מִשְׁפָּט עָשָׂה בְּפֹעַל כַּפָּיו נוֹקֵשׁ רָשָׁע הִגָּיוֹן סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Let the wicked return to Sheol, all nations that forget God.
verses.hebrew: יָשׁוּבוּ רְשָׁעִים לִשְׁאוֹלָה כָּל־גּוֹיִם שְׁכֵחֵי אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: For the needy will not be forgotten forever, nor will the hope of the afflicted perish for all time.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא לָנֶצַח יִשָּׁכַח אֶבְיוֹן תִּקְוַת ענוים [עֲנִיִּים] תֹּאבַד לָעַד׃

verses.english: Arise, YHWH; do not let mortal man prevail; let nations be judged before You.
verses.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה אַל־יָעֹז אֱנוֹשׁ יִשָּׁפְטוּ גוֹיִם עַל־פָּנֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Set fear upon them, YHWH; let nations know that they are mortal. Selah.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיתָה יְהוָה מוֹרָה לָהֶם יֵדְעוּ גוֹיִם אֱנוֹשׁ הֵמָּה סֶּלָה׃

verses.english: Why, YHWH, do You stand far away, hiding Yourself in times of distress?
verses.hebrew: לָמָה יְהוָה תַּעֲמֹד בְּרָחוֹק תַּעְלִים לְעִתּוֹת בַּצָּרָה׃

verses.english: In the wicked man’s pride, the afflicted burns; may they be caught in the schemes they devised.
verses.hebrew: בְּגַאֲוַת רָשָׁע יִדְלַק עָנִי יִתָּפְשׂוּ בִּמְזִמּוֹת זוּ חָשָׁבוּ׃

verses.english: For the wicked boasts of his soul’s desire; the greedy man blesses and spurns YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִלֵּל רָשָׁע עַל־תַּאֲוַת נַפְשׁוֹ וּבֹצֵעַ בֵּרֵךְ נִאֵץ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The wicked, with his nose held high, does not seek; “There is no God”—that is all his scheming.
verses.hebrew: רָשָׁע כְּגֹבַהּ אַפּוֹ בַּל־יִדְרֹשׁ אֵין אֱלֹהִים כָּל־מְזִמּוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: His ways prosper at all times; Your judgments are high above, beyond his sight; as for all his adversaries, he snorts at them.
verses.hebrew: יָחִילוּ דרכו [דְרָכָיו ] בְּכָל־עֵת מָרוֹם מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ מִנֶּגְדּוֹ כָּל־צוֹרְרָיו יָפִיחַ בָּהֶם׃

verses.english: He says in his heart, “I will not be shaken; through generation after generation I will meet no adversity.”
verses.hebrew: אָמַר בְּלִבּוֹ בַּל־אֶמּוֹט לְדֹר וָדֹר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־בְרָע׃

verses.english: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression; under his tongue are trouble and wickedness.
verses.hebrew: אָלָה פִּיהוּ מָלֵא וּמִרְמוֹת וָתֹךְ תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנוֹ עָמָל וָאָוֶן׃

verses.english: He sits in ambush near villages; in hiding places he kills the innocent; his eyes secretly watch for the helpless.
verses.hebrew: יֵשֵׁב בְּמַאְרַב חֲצֵרִים בַּמִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹג נָקִי עֵינָיו לְחֵלְכָה יִצְפֹּנוּ׃

verses.english: He lurks in hiding like a lion in its thicket; he lurks to snatch the afflicted; he snatches the afflicted, drawing him into his net.
verses.hebrew: יֶאֱרֹב בַּמִּסְתָּר כְּאַרְיֵה בְסֻכֹּה יֶאֱרֹב לַחֲטוֹף עָנִי יַחְטֹף עָנִי בְּמָשְׁכוֹ בְרִשְׁתּוֹ׃

verses.english: He crouches, bows down, and the helpless fall by his strong ones.
verses.hebrew: ודכה [יִדְכֶּה] יָשֹׁחַ וְנָפַל בַּעֲצוּמָיו חלכאים [חֵיל] [כָּאִים׃]

verses.english: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten; He has hidden His face; He will never see.”
verses.hebrew: אָמַר בְּלִבּוֹ שָׁכַח אֵל הִסְתִּיר פָּנָיו בַּל־רָאָה לָנֶצַח׃

verses.english: Arise, YHWH! God, lift up Your hand; do not forget the afflicted.
verses.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה אֵל נְשָׂא יָדֶךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח עניים [עֲנָוִים׃]

verses.english: Why has the wicked spurned God, saying in his heart, “You will not call to account”?
verses.hebrew: עַל־מֶה נִאֵץ רָשָׁע אֱלֹהִים אָמַר בְּלִבּוֹ לֹא תִּדְרֹשׁ׃

verses.english: You have seen, for You observe trouble and vexation, to take them into Your hand. To You the helpless entrusts himself; You have been a helper to the orphan.
verses.hebrew: רָאִתָה כִּי־אַתָּה עָמָל וָכַעַס תַּבִּיט לָתֵת בְּיָדֶךָ עָלֶיךָ יַעֲזֹב חֵלֶכָה יָתוֹם אַתָּה הָיִיתָ עוֹזֵר׃

verses.english: Break the arm of the wicked and evil man; call his wickedness to account until You find none.
verses.hebrew: שְׁבֹר זְרוֹעַ רָשָׁע וָרָע תִּדְרוֹשׁ־רִשְׁעוֹ בַל־תִּמְצָא׃

verses.english: YHWH is King forever and ever; nations have perished from His land.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מֶלֶךְ עוֹלָם וָעֶד אָבְדוּ גוֹיִם מֵאַרְצוֹ׃

verses.english: You have heard the desire of the humble, YHWH; You will establish their heart; Your ear will attend,
verses.hebrew: תַּאֲוַת עֲנָוִים שָׁמַעְתָּ יְהוָה תָּכִין לִבָּם תַּקְשִׁיב אָזְנֶךָ׃

verses.english: to judge for the orphan and the oppressed, so that mortal man from the earth may terrify no more.
verses.hebrew: לִשְׁפֹּט יָתוֹם וָדָךְ בַּל־יוֹסִיף עוֹד לַעֲרֹץ אֱנוֹשׁ מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: For the director. Of David. In YHWH I have taken refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee to your mountain, bird”?
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד בַּיהוָה חָסִיתִי אֵיךְ תֹּאמְרוּ לְנַפְשִׁי נודו [נוּדִי] הַרְכֶם צִפּוֹר׃

verses.english: For look, the wicked bend the bow; they set their arrow on the string, to shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הִנֵּה הָרְשָׁעִים יִדְרְכוּן קֶשֶׁת כּוֹנְנוּ חִצָּם עַל־יֶתֶר לִירוֹת בְּמוֹ־אֹפֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃

verses.english: For the foundations are being torn down; what has the righteous person done?
verses.hebrew: כִּי הַשָּׁתוֹת יֵהָרֵסוּן צַדִּיק מַה־פָּעָל׃

verses.english: YHWH is in His holy temple; YHWH—His throne is in heaven. His eyes behold; His eyelids examine the sons of humankind.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּהֵיכַל קָדְשׁוֹ יְהוָה בַּשָּׁמַיִם כִּסְאוֹ עֵינָיו יֶחֱזוּ עַפְעַפָּיו יִבְחֲנוּ בְּנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: YHWH examines the righteous, but His soul hates the wicked and the lover of violence.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה צַדִּיק יִבְחָן וְרָשָׁע וְאֹהֵב חָמָס שָׂנְאָה נַפְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: He will rain snares upon the wicked; fire, sulfur, and a scorching wind are the portion of their cup.
verses.hebrew: יַמְטֵר עַל־רְשָׁעִים פַּחִים אֵשׁ וְגָפְרִית וְרוּחַ זִלְעָפוֹת מְנָת כּוֹסָם׃

verses.english: For YHWH is righteous; He loves righteous deeds; their faces behold what is upright.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־צַדִּיק יְהוָה צְדָקוֹת אָהֵב יָשָׁר יֶחֱזוּ פָנֵימוֹ׃

verses.english: For the director. On the eighth. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־הַשְּׁמִינִית מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: Save, YHWH, for the faithful one has ceased; for the trustworthy have vanished from the sons of humankind.
verses.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעָה יְהוָה כִּי־גָמַר חָסִיד כִּי־פַסּוּ אֱמוּנִים מִבְּנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: They speak emptiness, each to his neighbor; with smooth lips and a double heart they speak.
verses.hebrew: שָׁוְא יְדַבְּרוּ אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ שְׂפַת חֲלָקוֹת בְּלֵב וָלֵב יְדַבֵּרוּ׃

verses.english: May YHWH cut off every smooth lip, the tongue that speaks great things,
verses.hebrew: יַכְרֵת יְהוָה כָּל־שִׂפְתֵי חֲלָקוֹת לָשׁוֹן מְדַבֶּרֶת גְּדֹלוֹת׃

verses.english: those who say, “With our tongue we will prevail; our lips are with us; who is lord over us?”
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ לִלְשֹׁנֵנוּ נַגְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵינוּ אִתָּנוּ מִי אָדוֹן לָנוּ׃

verses.english: “Because of the devastation of the afflicted, because of the groaning of the needy, now I will arise,” says YHWH. “I will set him in safety; he pants for it.”
verses.hebrew: מִשֹּׁד עֲנִיִּים מֵאַנְקַת אֶבְיוֹנִים עַתָּה אָקוּם יֹאמַר יְהוָה אָשִׁית בְּיֵשַׁע יָפִיחַ לוֹ׃

verses.english: The words of YHWH are pure words, silver refined in a furnace in the earth, purified seven times.
verses.hebrew: אִמֲרוֹת יְהוָה אֲמָרוֹת טְהֹרוֹת כֶּסֶף צָרוּף בַּעֲלִיל לָאָרֶץ מְזֻקָּק שִׁבְעָתָיִם׃

verses.english: You, YHWH, will keep them; You will guard him from this generation forever.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה־יְהוָה תִּשְׁמְרֵם תִּצְּרֶנּוּ מִן־הַדּוֹר זוּ לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: The wicked walk about on every side, when vileness is exalted among the sons of humankind.
verses.hebrew: סָבִיב רְשָׁעִים יִתְהַלָּכוּן כְּרֻם זֻלּוּת לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: For the director. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: How long, YHWH? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
verses.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה יְהוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵנִי נֶצַח עַד־אָנָה תַּסְתִּיר אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: How long must I lay plans within my soul, with grief in my heart by day? How long will my enemy rise above me?
verses.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה אָשִׁית עֵצוֹת בְּנַפְשִׁי יָגוֹן בִּלְבָבִי יוֹמָם עַד־אָנָה יָרוּם אֹיְבִי עָלָי׃

verses.english: Look; answer me, YHWH my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
verses.hebrew: הַבִּיטָה עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי הָאִירָה עֵינַי פֶּן־אִישַׁן הַמָּוֶת׃

verses.english: lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,” and my adversaries rejoice because I am shaken.
verses.hebrew: פֶּן־יֹאמַר אֹיְבִי יְכָלְתִּיו צָרַי יָגִילוּ כִּי אֶמּוֹט׃

verses.english: But I have trusted in Your steadfast love; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation. I will sing to YHWH, for He has dealt bountifully with me.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בְּחַסְדְּךָ בָטַחְתִּי יָגֵל לִבִּי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ אָשִׁירָה לַיהוָה כִּי גָמַל עָלָי׃

verses.english: For the director. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They have acted corruptly; they have made their deeds abominable; there is no one who does good.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד אָמַר נָבָל בְּלִבּוֹ אֵין אֱלֹהִים הִשְׁחִיתוּ הִתְעִיבוּ עֲלִילָה אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב׃

verses.english: YHWH looked down from heaven upon the sons of humankind, to see whether there is anyone who understands, anyone who seeks God.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁקִיף עַל־בְּנֵי־אָדָם לִרְאוֹת הֲיֵשׁ מַשְׂכִּיל דֹּרֵשׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: All have turned aside; together they have become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
verses.hebrew: הַכֹּל סָר יַחְדָּו נֶאֱלָחוּ אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב אֵין גַּם־אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Do all the workers of wickedness not know, those who devour my people as they eat bread, and do not call upon YHWH?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא יָדְעוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן אֹכְלֵי עַמִּי אָכְלוּ לֶחֶם יְהוָה לֹא קָרָאוּ׃

verses.english: There they were seized with dread, for God is with the righteous generation.
verses.hebrew: שָׁם פָּחֲדוּ פָחַד כִּי־אֱלֹהִים בְּדוֹר צַדִּיק׃

verses.english: You put the afflicted person’s counsel to shame, but YHWH is his refuge.
verses.hebrew: עֲצַת־עָנִי תָבִישׁוּ כִּי יְהוָה מַחְסֵהוּ׃

verses.english: O that Israel’s salvation would come from Zion! When YHWH restores the fortunes of His people, Jacob will rejoice; Israel will be glad.
verses.hebrew: מִי יִתֵּן מִצִּיּוֹן יְשׁוּעַת יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשׁוּב יְהוָה שְׁבוּת עַמּוֹ יָגֵל יַעֲקֹב יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: A psalm of David. YHWH, who may sojourn in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהֹוָה מִי־יָגוּר בְּאָהֳלֶךָ מִי־יִשְׁכֹּן בְּהַר קָדְשֶׁךָ׃

verses.english: One who walks blamelessly and does righteousness, and speaks truth in his heart;
verses.hebrew: הוֹלֵךְ תָּמִים וּפֹעֵל צֶדֶק וְדֹבֵר אֱמֶת בִּלְבָבוֹ׃

verses.english: who does not slander with his tongue, does no evil to his neighbor, and takes up no reproach against one close to him;
verses.hebrew: לֹא־רָגַל עַל־לְשֹׁנוֹ לֹא־עָשָׂה לְרֵעֵהוּ רָעָה וְחֶרְפָּה לֹא־נָשָׂא עַל־קְרֹבוֹ׃

verses.english: in whose eyes a rejected person is despised, but who honors those who fear YHWH; who swears to his own hurt and does not change;
verses.hebrew: נִבְזֶה בְּעֵינָיו נִמְאָס וְאֶת־יִרְאֵי יְהוָה יְכַבֵּד נִשְׁבַּע לְהָרַע וְלֹא יָמִר׃

verses.english: who does not lend his silver at interest, and takes no bribe against the innocent. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.
verses.hebrew: כַּסְפּוֹ לֹא־נָתַן בְּנֶשֶׁךְ וְשֹׁחַד עַל־נָקִי לֹא לָקָח עֹשֵׂה־אֵלֶּה לֹא יִמּוֹט לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: A Miktam of David. Keep me, God, for I have taken refuge in You.
verses.hebrew: מִכְתָּם לְדָוִד שָׁמְרֵנִי אֵל כִּי־חָסִיתִי בָךְ׃

verses.english: You have said to YHWH, “You are my Lord; my good is no obligation upon You.”
verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתְּ לַיהוָה אֲדֹנָי אָתָּה טוֹבָתִי בַּל־עָלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: As for the holy ones who are in the land, they are the majestic ones; all my delight is in them.
verses.hebrew: לִקְדוֹשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־בָּאָרֶץ הֵמָּה וְאַדִּירֵי כָּל־חֶפְצִי־בָם׃

verses.english: Their sorrows multiply, those who hasten after another; I will not pour out their drink offerings of blood, nor take their names upon my lips.
verses.hebrew: יִרְבּוּ עַצְּבוֹתָם אַחֵר מָהָרוּ בַּל־אַסִּיךְ נִסְכֵּיהֶם מִדָּם וּבַל־אֶשָּׂא אֶת־שְׁמוֹתָם עַל־שְׂפָתָי׃

verses.english: YHWH is my allotted portion and my cup; You uphold my lot.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מְנָת־חֶלְקִי וְכוֹסִי אַתָּה תּוֹמִיךְ גּוֹרָלִי׃

verses.english: The measuring lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; indeed, my inheritance is beautiful to me.
verses.hebrew: חֲבָלִים נָפְלוּ־לִי בַּנְּעִמִים אַף־נַחֲלָת שָׁפְרָה עָלָי׃

verses.english: I will bless YHWH, who counseled me; even at night my kidneys instruct me.
verses.hebrew: אֲבָרֵךְ אֶת־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר יְעָצָנִי אַף־לֵילוֹת יִסְּרוּנִי כִלְיוֹתָי׃

verses.english: I have set YHWH before me always; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
verses.hebrew: שִׁוִּיתִי יְהוָה לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד כִּי מִימִינִי בַּל־אֶמּוֹט׃

verses.english: Therefore my heart rejoiced, and my glory exulted; even my flesh will dwell securely,
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן שָׂמַח לִבִּי וַיָּגֶל כְּבוֹדִי אַף־בְּשָׂרִי יִשְׁכֹּן לָבֶטַח׃

verses.english: for You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor let Your faithful one see the pit.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־תַעֲזֹב נַפְשִׁי לִשְׁאוֹל לֹא־תִתֵּן חֲסִידְךָ לִרְאוֹת שָׁחַת׃

verses.english: You will make known to me a path of life; fullness of joys is in Your presence; pleasures are at Your right hand forever.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹדִיעֵנִי אֹרַח חַיִּים שֹׂבַע שְׂמָחוֹת אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ נְעִמוֹת בִּימִינְךָ נֶצַח׃

verses.english: A prayer of David. Hear what is right, YHWH; attend to my cry; give ear to my prayer from lips without deceit.
verses.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לְדָוִד שִׁמְעָה יְהוָה צֶדֶק הַקְשִׁיבָה רִנָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה תְפִלָּתִי בְּלֹא שִׂפְתֵי מִרְמָה׃

verses.english: Let my judgment come forth from Your presence; let Your eyes behold equity.
verses.hebrew: מִלְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִי יֵצֵא עֵינֶיךָ תֶּחֱזֶינָה מֵישָׁרִים׃

verses.english: You tested my heart; You visited by night; You refined me; You will find nothing. I have resolved that my mouth will not transgress.
verses.hebrew: בָּחַנְתָּ לִבִּי פָּקַדְתָּ לַּיְלָה צְרַפְתַּנִי בַל־תִּמְצָא זַמֹּתִי בַּל־יַעֲבָר־פִּי׃

verses.english: As for human deeds, by the word of Your lips I have guarded against the paths of the violent person.
verses.hebrew: לִפְעֻלּוֹת אָדָם בִּדְבַר שְׂפָתֶיךָ אֲנִי שָׁמַרְתִּי אָרְחוֹת פָּרִיץ׃

verses.english: My steps have held fast to Your tracks; my footsteps have not slipped.
verses.hebrew: תָּמֹךְ אֲשֻׁרַי בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתֶיךָ בַּל־נָמוֹטּוּ פְעָמָי׃

verses.english: I have called upon You, for You will answer me, God; incline Your ear to me; hear my utterance.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי־קְרָאתִיךָ כִי־תַעֲנֵנִי אֵל הַט־אָזְנְךָ לִי שְׁמַע אִמְרָתִי׃

verses.english: Show Your steadfast love wondrously, You who save those taking refuge, by Your right hand, from those who rise against them.
verses.hebrew: הַפְלֵה חֲסָדֶיךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ חוֹסִים מִמִּתְקוֹמְמִים בִּימִינֶךָ׃

verses.english: Keep me as the pupil of the eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings,
verses.hebrew: שָׁמְרֵנִי כְּאִישׁוֹן בַּת־עָיִן בְּצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵנִי׃

verses.english: from the wicked who have devastated me, my deadly enemies who surround me.
verses.hebrew: מִפְּנֵי רְשָׁעִים זוּ שַׁדּוּנִי אֹיְבַי בְּנֶפֶשׁ יַקִּיפוּ עָלָי׃

verses.english: They have closed up their fat; with their mouth they speak arrogantly.
verses.hebrew: חֶלְבָּמוֹ סָּגְרוּ פִּימוֹ דִּבְּרוּ בְגֵאוּת׃

verses.english: At our steps they have now surrounded us; they set their eyes to bend us down to the earth.
verses.hebrew: אַשֻּׁרֵינוּ עַתָּה סבבוני [סְבָבוּנוּ] עֵינֵיהֶם יָשִׁיתוּ לִנְטוֹת בָּאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: He is like a lion longing to tear prey, like a young lion sitting in hiding places.
verses.hebrew: דִּמְיֹנוֹ כְּאַרְיֵה יִכְסוֹף לִטְרוֹף וְכִכְפִיר יֹשֵׁב בְּמִסְתָּרִים׃

verses.english: Arise, YHWH; confront him; bring him down; rescue my soul from the wicked by Your sword,
verses.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה קַדְּמָה פָנָיו הַכְרִיעֵהוּ פַּלְּטָה נַפְשִׁי מֵרָשָׁע חַרְבֶּךָ׃

verses.english: from men by Your hand, YHWH, from men of the world whose portion is in this life. You fill their belly with what You have stored; they are satisfied with sons and leave their surplus to their little ones.
verses.hebrew: מִמְתִים יָדְךָ יְהוָה מִמְתִים מֵחֶלֶד חֶלְקָם בַּחַיִּים וצפינך [וּצְפוּנְךָ] תְּמַלֵּא בִטְנָם יִשְׂבְּעוּ בָנִים וְהִנִּיחוּ יִתְרָם לְעוֹלְלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: As for me, in righteousness I will behold Your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with Your likeness.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי בְּצֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶה פָנֶיךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָה בְהָקִיץ תְּמוּנָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: For the director. Of YHWH’s servant David, who spoke the words of this song to YHWH on the day YHWH delivered him from the grasp of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְעֶבֶד יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לַיהוָה אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בְּיוֹם הִצִּיל־יְהוָה אוֹתוֹ מִכַּף כָּל־אֹיְבָיו וּמִיַּד שָׁאוּל׃

verses.english: He said: I love You, YHWH, my strength.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר אֶרְחָמְךָ יְהוָה חִזְקִי׃

verses.english: YHWH is my crag, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי אֵלִי צוּרִי אֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ מָגִנִּי וְקֶרֶן־יִשְׁעִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי׃

verses.english: I call upon YHWH, who is worthy of praise, and I am saved from my enemies.
verses.hebrew: מְהֻלָּל אֶקְרָא יְהוָה וּמִן־אֹיְבַי אִוָּשֵׁעַ׃

verses.english: The cords of death surrounded me; torrents of destruction terrified me.
verses.hebrew: אֲפָפוּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָוֶת וְנַחֲלֵי בְלִיַּעַל יְבַעֲתוּנִי׃

verses.english: The cords of Sheol encircled me; the snares of death confronted me.
verses.hebrew: חֶבְלֵי שְׁאוֹל סְבָבוּנִי קִדְּמוּנִי מוֹקְשֵׁי מָוֶת׃

verses.english: In my distress I called upon YHWH and cried for help to my God. He heard my voice from His temple; my cry before Him came into His ears.
verses.hebrew: בַּצַּר־לִי אֶקְרָא יְהוָה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַי אֲשַׁוֵּעַ יִשְׁמַע מֵהֵיכָלוֹ קוֹלִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי לְפָנָיו תָּבוֹא בְאָזְנָיו׃

verses.english: Then the earth shook and quaked; the foundations of the mountains trembled and shook because He was angry.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּגְעַשׁ וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵי הָרִים יִרְגָּזוּ וַיִּתְגָּעֲשׁוּ כִּי־חָרָה לוֹ׃

verses.english: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and fire from His mouth devoured; coals blazed from Him.
verses.hebrew: עָלָה עָשָׁן בְּאַפּוֹ וְאֵשׁ־מִפִּיו תֹּאכֵל גֶּחָלִים בָּעֲרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: He bent the heavens and came down, with thick darkness beneath His feet.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּט שָׁמַיִם וַיֵּרַד וַעֲרָפֶל תַּחַת רַגְלָיו׃

verses.english: He rode upon a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְכַּב עַל־כְּרוּב וַיָּעֹף וַיֵּדֶא עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רוּחַ׃

verses.english: He made darkness His hiding place, His shelter around Him: dark waters, dense clouds of the skies.
verses.hebrew: יָשֶׁת חֹשֶׁךְ סִתְרוֹ סְבִיבוֹתָיו סֻכָּתוֹ חֶשְׁכַת־מַיִם עָבֵי שְׁחָקִים׃

verses.english: From the brightness before Him, His clouds passed— hail and coals of fire.
verses.hebrew: מִנֹּגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ עָבָיו עָבְרוּ בָּרָד וְגַחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ׃

verses.english: YHWH thundered in the heavens, and the Most High gave His voice— hail and coals of fire.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְעֵם בַּשָּׁמַיִם יְהוָה וְעֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּן קֹלוֹ בָּרָד וְגַחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ׃

verses.english: He sent His arrows and scattered them; He multiplied lightning flashes and threw them into confusion.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִצָּיו וַיְפִיצֵם וּבְרָקִים רָב וַיְהֻמֵּם׃

verses.english: The channels of waters appeared, and the foundations of the world were uncovered at Your rebuke, YHWH, at the blast of breath from Your nostrils.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָאוּ אֲפִיקֵי מַיִם וַיִּגָּלוּ מוֹסְדוֹת תֵּבֵל מִגַּעֲרָתְךָ יְהוָה מִנִּשְׁמַת רוּחַ אַפֶּךָ׃

verses.english: He sent from on high and took me; He drew me out of many waters.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח מִמָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵנִי יַמְשֵׁנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּים׃

verses.english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were stronger than I.
verses.hebrew: יַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבִי עָז וּמִשֹּׂנְאַי כִּי־אָמְצוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: They confronted me in the day of my calamity, but YHWH became my support.
verses.hebrew: יְקַדְּמוּנִי בְיוֹם־אֵידִי וַיְהִי־יְהוָה לְמִשְׁעָן לִי׃

verses.english: He brought me out into a broad place; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִיאֵנִי לַמֶּרְחָב יְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי חָפֵץ בִּי׃

verses.english: YHWH repaid me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands He rewarded me,
verses.hebrew: יִגְמְלֵנִי יְהוָה כְּצִדְקִי כְּבֹר יָדַי יָשִׁיב לִי׃

verses.english: for I kept the ways of YHWH and did not wickedly turn away from my God.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־שָׁמַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵי יְהוָה וְלֹא־רָשַׁעְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָי׃

verses.english: For all His judgments were before me, and I did not put His statutes away from me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כָל־מִשְׁפָּטָיו לְנֶגְדִּי וְחֻקֹּתָיו לֹא־אָסִיר מֶנִּי׃

verses.english: I was blameless with Him and guarded myself from my iniquity.
verses.hebrew: וָאֱהִי תָמִים עִמּוֹ וָאֶשְׁתַּמֵּר מֵעֲוֺנִי׃

verses.english: YHWH repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands before His eyes.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב־יְהוָה לִי כְצִדְקִי כְּבֹר יָדַי לְנֶגֶד עֵינָיו׃

verses.english: With the faithful You show Yourself faithful; with a blameless man You show Yourself blameless.
verses.hebrew: עִם־חָסִיד תִּתְחַסָּד עִם־גְּבַר תָּמִים תִּתַּמָּם׃

verses.english: With the pure You show Yourself pure, and with the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
verses.hebrew: עִם־נָבָר תִּתְבָּרָר וְעִם־עִקֵּשׁ תִּתְפַּתָּל׃

verses.english: For You save an afflicted people, but You bring down haughty eyes.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה עַם־עָנִי תוֹשִׁיעַ וְעֵינַיִם רָמוֹת תַּשְׁפִּיל׃

verses.english: For You light my lamp; YHWH my God makes my darkness bright.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה תָּאִיר נֵרִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי יַגִּיהַּ חָשְׁכִּי׃

verses.english: For by You I run against a troop, and by my God I leap over a wall.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־בְךָ אָרֻץ גְּדוּד וּבֵאלֹהַי אֲדַלֶּג־שׁוּר׃

verses.english: God—His way is blameless; the word of YHWH is refined; He is a shield for all who take refuge in Him.
verses.hebrew: הָאֵל תָּמִים דַּרְכּוֹ אִמְרַת־יְהוָה צְרוּפָה מָגֵן הוּא לְכֹל הַחֹסִים בּוֹ׃

verses.english: For who is God apart from YHWH? And who is a rock except our God?
verses.hebrew: כִּי מִי אֱלוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְהוָה וּמִי צוּר זוּלָתִי אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

verses.english: God girds me with strength and makes my way blameless.
verses.hebrew: הָאֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵנִי חָיִל וַיִּתֵּן תָּמִים דַּרְכִּי׃

verses.english: He makes my feet like those of deer and sets me upon my high places.
verses.hebrew: מְשַׁוֶּה רַגְלַי כָּאַיָּלוֹת וְעַל בָּמֹתַי יַעֲמִידֵנִי׃

verses.english: He trains my hands for battle, and a bronze bow is bent by my arms.
verses.hebrew: מְלַמֵּד יָדַי לַמִּלְחָמָה וְנִחֲתָה קֶשֶׁת־נְחוּשָׁה זְרוֹעֹתָי׃

verses.english: You gave me the shield of Your salvation; Your right hand sustained me, and Your gentleness made me great.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּתֶּן־לִי מָגֵן יִשְׁעֶךָ וִימִינְךָ תִסְעָדֵנִי וְעַנְוַתְךָ תַרְבֵּנִי׃

verses.english: You widened my steps beneath me, and my ankles did not slip.
verses.hebrew: תַּרְחִיב צַעֲדִי תַחְתָּי וְלֹא מָעֲדוּ קַרְסֻלָּי׃

verses.english: I pursue my enemies and overtake them; I do not return until they are finished.
verses.hebrew: אֶרְדּוֹף אוֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵם וְלֹא־אָשׁוּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָם׃

verses.english: I crush them so that they cannot rise; they fall beneath my feet.
verses.hebrew: אֶמְחָצֵם וְלֹא־יֻכְלוּ קוּם יִפְּלוּ תַּחַת רַגְלָי׃

verses.english: You girded me with strength for battle; You brought those who rose against me down beneath me.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּאַזְּרֵנִי חַיִל לַמִּלְחָמָה תַּכְרִיעַ קָמַי תַּחְתָּי׃

verses.english: You made my enemies turn their backs to me, and I destroyed those who hated me.
verses.hebrew: וְאֹיְבַי נָתַתָּה לִּי עֹרֶף וּמְשַׂנְאַי אַצְמִיתֵם׃

verses.english: They cried for help, but there was no savior; they cried to YHWH, but He did not answer them.
verses.hebrew: יְשַׁוְּעוּ וְאֵין־מוֹשִׁיעַ עַל־יְהוָה וְלֹא עָנָם׃

verses.english: I ground them like dust before the wind; I poured them out like mud in the streets.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶשְׁחָקֵם כְּעָפָר עַל־פְּנֵי־רוּחַ כְּטִיט חוּצוֹת אֲרִיקֵם׃

verses.english: You deliver me from the disputes of the people; You set me as head of nations; a people I did not know serves me.
verses.hebrew: תְּפַלְּטֵנִי מֵרִיבֵי עָם תְּשִׂימֵנִי לְרֹאשׁ גּוֹיִם עַם לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי יַעַבְדוּנִי׃

verses.english: At the mere hearing of the ear, they obey me; foreigners submit falsely to me.
verses.hebrew: לְשֵׁמַע אֹזֶן יִשָּׁמְעוּ לִי בְּנֵי־נֵכָר יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לִי׃

verses.english: Foreigners wither and come trembling out of their enclosures.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־נֵכָר יִבֹּלוּ וְיַחְרְגוּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֹתֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH lives! Blessed be my rock! Let the God of my salvation be exalted,
verses.hebrew: חַי־יְהוָה וּבָרוּךְ צוּרִי וְיָרוּם אֱלוֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי׃

verses.english: the God who gives me acts of vengeance and subdues peoples beneath me,
verses.hebrew: הָאֵל הַנּוֹתֵן נְקָמוֹת לִי וַיַּדְבֵּר עַמִּים תַּחְתָּי׃

verses.english: who delivers me from my enemies. Indeed, You lift me above those who rise against me; You rescue me from a violent man.
verses.hebrew: מְפַלְּטִי מֵאֹיְבָי אַף מִן־קָמַי תְּרוֹמְמֵנִי מֵאִישׁ חָמָס תַּצִּילֵנִי׃

verses.english: Therefore I will thank You among the nations, YHWH, and sing praise to Your name.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן אוֹדְךָ בַגּוֹיִם יְהוָה וּלְשִׁמְךָ אֲזַמֵּרָה׃

verses.english: He magnifies the salvations of His king and shows steadfast love to His anointed, to David and to his seed forever.
verses.hebrew: מגדל [מַגְדִּיל] יְשׁוּעוֹת מַלְכּוֹ וְעֹשֶׂה חֶסֶד לִמְשִׁיחוֹ לְדָוִד וּלְזַרְעוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: For the director. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: The heavens recount the glory of God, and the expanse declares the work of His hands.
verses.hebrew: הַשָּׁמַיִם מְסַפְּרִים כְּבוֹד־אֵל וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו מַגִּיד הָרָקִיעַ׃

verses.english: Day pours out speech to day, and night reveals knowledge to night.
verses.hebrew: יוֹם לְיוֹם יַבִּיעַ אֹמֶר וְלַיְלָה לְּלַיְלָה יְחַוֶּה־דָּעַת׃

verses.english: There is no speech, and there are no words; their voice is not heard.
verses.hebrew: אֵין־אֹמֶר וְאֵין דְּבָרִים בְּלִי נִשְׁמָע קוֹלָם׃

verses.english: Their line has gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them He has set a tent for the sun.
verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ יָצָא קַוָּם וּבִקְצֵה תֵבֵל מִלֵּיהֶם לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ שָׂם־אֹהֶל בָּהֶם׃

verses.english: It is like a bridegroom coming out of his canopy; it rejoices like a mighty warrior to run a course.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא כְּחָתָן יֹצֵא מֵחֻפָּתוֹ יָשִׂישׂ כְּגִבּוֹר לָרוּץ אֹרַח׃

verses.english: Its rising is from one end of the heavens, and its circuit reaches their ends; nothing is hidden from its heat.
verses.hebrew: מִקְצֵה הַשָּׁמַיִם מוֹצָאוֹ וּתְקוּפָתוֹ עַל־קְצוֹתָם וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מֵחַמָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH’s law is complete, restoring the soul; YHWH’s testimony is trustworthy, making the simple wise.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹרַת יְהוָה תְּמִימָה מְשִׁיבַת נָפֶשׁ עֵדוּת יְהוָה נֶאֱמָנָה מַחְכִּימַת פֶּתִי׃

verses.english: YHWH’s precepts are upright, rejoicing the heart; YHWH’s commandment is pure, giving light to the eyes.
verses.hebrew: פִּקּוּדֵי יְהוָה יְשָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי־לֵב מִצְוַת יְהוָה בָּרָה מְאִירַת עֵינָיִם׃

verses.english: The fear of YHWH is pure, standing forever; YHWH’s judgments are truth; they are righteous altogether,
verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה טְהוֹרָה עוֹמֶדֶת לָעַד מִשְׁפְּטֵי־יְהוָה אֱמֶת צָדְקוּ יַחְדָּו׃

verses.english: more desirable than gold, than much refined gold, and sweeter than honey and the drippings of honeycombs.
verses.hebrew: הַנֶּחֱמָדִים מִזָּהָב וּמִפַּז רָב וּמְתוּקִים מִדְּבַשׁ וְנֹפֶת צוּפִים׃

verses.english: Moreover, Your servant is warned by them; in keeping them there is great reward.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־עַבְדְּךָ נִזְהָר בָּהֶם בְּשָׁמְרָם עֵקֶב רָב׃

verses.english: Who can discern errors? Clear me of hidden faults.
verses.hebrew: שְׁגִיאוֹת מִי־יָבִין מִנִּסְתָּרוֹת נַקֵּנִי׃

verses.english: Also restrain Your servant from willful sins; do not let them rule over me. Then I will be blameless, cleared of great transgression.
verses.hebrew: גַּם מִזֵּדִים חֲשֹׂךְ עַבְדֶּךָ אַל־יִמְשְׁלוּ־בִי אָז אֵיתָם וְנִקֵּיתִי מִפֶּשַׁע רָב׃

verses.english: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, YHWH, my rock and my redeemer.
verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי־פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהוָה צוּרִי וְגֹאֲלִי׃

verses.english: For the director. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: May YHWH answer you in the day of distress; may the name of Jacob’s God set you on high.
verses.hebrew: יַעַנְךָ יְהוָה בְּיוֹם צָרָה יְשַׂגֶּבְךָ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח־עֶזְרְךָ מִקֹּדֶשׁ וּמִצִּיּוֹן יִסְעָדֶךָּ׃

verses.english: May He remember all your offerings and regard your burnt offering as rich. Selah.
verses.hebrew: יִזְכֹּר כָּל־מִנְחֹתֶךָ וְעוֹלָתְךָ יְדַשְּׁנֶה סֶלָה׃

verses.english: May He give you according to your heart and fulfill all your counsel.
verses.hebrew: יִתֶּן־לְךָ כִלְבָבֶךָ וְכָל־עֲצָתְךָ יְמַלֵּא׃

verses.english: May we shout for joy in your salvation and raise our banner in the name of our God. May YHWH fulfill all your requests.
verses.hebrew: נְרַנְּנָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ וּבְשֵׁם־אֱלֹהֵינוּ נִדְגֹּל יְמַלֵּא יְהוָה כָּל־מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Now I know that YHWH has saved His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heavens with the mighty saving acts of His right hand.
verses.hebrew: עַתָּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי הוֹשִׁיעַ יְהוָה מְשִׁיחוֹ יַעֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵי קָדְשׁוֹ בִּגְבֻרוֹת יֵשַׁע יְמִינוֹ׃

verses.english: These rely on chariots, and those on horses, but we call to mind the name of YHWH our God.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בָרֶכֶב וְאֵלֶּה בַסּוּסִים וַאֲנַחְנוּ בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נַזְכִּיר׃

verses.english: They bowed down and fell, but we rose and stood firm.
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה כָּרְעוּ וְנָפָלוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ קַּמְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָד׃

verses.english: YHWH, save! May the king answer us on the day we call.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה הוֹשִׁיעָה הַמֶּלֶךְ יַעֲנֵנוּ בְיוֹם־קָרְאֵנוּ׃

verses.english: For the director. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: YHWH, the king rejoices in Your strength; how greatly he exults in Your salvation!
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּעָזְּךָ יִשְׂמַח־מֶלֶךְ וּבִישׁוּעָתְךָ מַה־יגיל [יָּגֶל] מְאֹד׃

verses.english: You gave him his heart’s desire and did not withhold the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.hebrew: תַּאֲוַת לִבּוֹ נָתַתָּה לּוֹ וַאֲרֶשֶׁת שְׂפָתָיו בַּל־מָנַעְתָּ סֶּלָה׃

verses.english: For You meet him with good blessings; You place a crown of refined gold upon his head.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תְקַדְּמֶנּוּ בִּרְכוֹת טוֹב תָּשִׁית לְרֹאשׁוֹ עֲטֶרֶת פָּז׃

verses.english: He asked You for life; You gave it to him, length of days forever and ever.
verses.hebrew: חַיִּים שָׁאַל מִמְּךָ נָתַתָּה לּוֹ אֹרֶךְ יָמִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד׃

verses.english: His glory is great through Your salvation; You bestow splendor and majesty upon him.
verses.hebrew: גָּדוֹל כְּבוֹדוֹ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ הוֹד וְהָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּה עָלָיו׃

verses.english: For You make him blessings forever; You gladden him with joy in Your presence.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תְשִׁיתֵהוּ בְרָכוֹת לָעַד תְּחַדֵּהוּ בְשִׂמְחָה אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ׃

verses.english: For the king trusts in YHWH, and through the Most High’s steadfast love he will not be shaken.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הַמֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵחַ בַּיהוָה וּבְחֶסֶד עֶלְיוֹן בַּל־יִמּוֹט׃

verses.english: Your hand will find all your enemies; your right hand will find those who hate you.
verses.hebrew: תִּמְצָא יָדְךָ לְכָל־אֹיְבֶיךָ יְמִינְךָ תִּמְצָא שֹׂנְאֶיךָ׃

verses.english: You will make them like a fiery oven at the time of your presence; YHWH in His anger will swallow them, and fire will consume them.
verses.hebrew: תְּשִׁיתֵמוֹ כְּתַנּוּר אֵשׁ לְעֵת פָּנֶיךָ יְהוָה בְּאַפּוֹ יְבַלְּעֵם וְתֹאכְלֵם אֵשׁ׃

verses.english: You will destroy their fruit from the earth and their seed from the sons of humankind,
verses.hebrew: פִּרְיָמוֹ מֵאֶרֶץ תְּאַבֵּד וְזַרְעָם מִבְּנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: for they stretched evil against you; they devised a scheme they could not accomplish.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־נָטוּ עָלֶיךָ רָעָה חָשְׁבוּ מְזִמָּה בַּל־יוּכָלוּ׃

verses.english: For you will make them turn their backs; with your bowstrings you will aim at their faces.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תְּשִׁיתֵמוֹ שֶׁכֶם בְּמֵיתָרֶיךָ תְּכוֹנֵן עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Be exalted, YHWH, in Your strength; we will sing and make music of Your might.
verses.hebrew: רוּמָה יְהוָה בְּעֻזֶּךָ נָשִׁירָה וּנְזַמְּרָה גְּבוּרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: For the director. On the Hind of the Dawn. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־אַיֶּלֶת הַשַּׁחַר מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: My God, my God, why have You abandoned me? Far from my salvation are the words of my roaring.
verses.hebrew: אֵלִי אֵלִי לָמָה עֲזַבְתָּנִי רָחוֹק מִישׁוּעָתִי דִּבְרֵי שַׁאֲגָתִי׃

verses.english: My God, I call by day, but You do not answer, and by night, but there is no silence for me.
verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי אֶקְרָא יוֹמָם וְלֹא תַעֲנֶה וְלַיְלָה וְלֹא־דוּמִיָּה לִי׃

verses.english: Yet You are holy, enthroned upon the praises of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: In You our fathers trusted; they trusted, and You delivered them.
verses.hebrew: בְּךָ בָּטְחוּ אֲבֹתֵינוּ בָּטְחוּ וַתְּפַלְּטֵמוֹ׃

verses.english: To You they cried out and escaped; in You they trusted and were not put to shame.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶיךָ זָעֲקוּ וְנִמְלָטוּ בְּךָ בָטְחוּ וְלֹא־בוֹשׁוּ׃

verses.english: But I am a worm and not a man, a human reproach, despised by the people.
verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי תוֹלַעַת וְלֹא־אִישׁ חֶרְפַּת אָדָם וּבְזוּי עָם׃

verses.english: All who see me mock me; they open their lips and shake their heads:
verses.hebrew: כָּל־רֹאַי יַלְעִגוּ לִי יַפְטִירוּ בְשָׂפָה יָנִיעוּ רֹאשׁ׃

verses.english: “Roll your burden onto YHWH; let Him deliver him; let Him rescue him, since He delights in him.”
verses.hebrew: גֹּל אֶל־יְהוָה יְפַלְּטֵהוּ יַצִּילֵהוּ כִּי חָפֵץ בּוֹ׃

verses.english: For You drew me from the womb; You made me trust upon my mother’s breasts.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה גֹחִי מִבָּטֶן מַבְטִיחִי עַל־שְׁדֵי אִמִּי׃

verses.english: Upon You I was cast from the womb; from my mother’s belly You have been my God.
verses.hebrew: עָלֶיךָ הָשְׁלַכְתִּי מֵרָחֶם מִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי אֵלִי אָתָּה׃

verses.english: Do not be far from me, for distress is near, for there is no helper.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי כִּי־צָרָה קְרוֹבָה כִּי־אֵין עוֹזֵר׃

verses.english: Many bulls surround me; the mighty ones of Bashan encircle me.
verses.hebrew: סְבָבוּנִי פָּרִים רַבִּים אַבִּירֵי בָשָׁן כִּתְּרוּנִי׃

verses.english: They open their mouth against me, a lion tearing prey and roaring.
verses.hebrew: פָּצוּ עָלַי פִּיהֶם אַרְיֵה טֹרֵף וְשֹׁאֵג׃

verses.english: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are pulled apart. My heart has become like wax, melting within my inward parts.
verses.hebrew: כַּמַּיִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי וְהִתְפָּרְדוּ כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָי הָיָה לִבִּי כַּדּוֹנָג נָמֵס בְּתוֹךְ מֵעָי׃

verses.english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; my tongue sticks to my jaws, and You lay me in the dust of death.
verses.hebrew: יָבֵשׁ כַּחֶרֶשׂ כֹּחִי וּלְשׁוֹנִי מֻדְבָּק מַלְקוֹחָי וְלַעֲפַר־מָוֶת תִּשְׁפְּתֵנִי׃

verses.english: For dogs surround me; a company of evildoers encircles me— like a lion, my hands and my feet!
verses.hebrew: כִּי סְבָבוּנִי כְּלָבִים עֲדַת מְרֵעִים הִקִּיפוּנִי כָּאֲרִי יָדַי וְרַגְלָי׃

verses.english: I can count all my bones; they look and stare at me.
verses.hebrew: אֲסַפֵּר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָי הֵמָּה יַבִּיטוּ יִרְאוּ־בִי׃

verses.english: They divide my garments among themselves, and cast a lot for my clothing.
verses.hebrew: יְחַלְּקוּ בְגָדַי לָהֶם וְעַל־לְבוּשִׁי יַפִּילוּ גוֹרָל׃

verses.english: But You, YHWH, do not be far away; my strength, hurry to help me.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה אַל־תִּרְחָק אֱיָלוּתִי לְעֶזְרָתִי חוּשָׁה׃

verses.english: Deliver my soul from the sword, my only life from the dog’s grasp.
verses.hebrew: הַצִּילָה מֵחֶרֶב נַפְשִׁי מִיַּד־כֶּלֶב יְחִידָתִי׃

verses.english: Save me from the lion’s mouth; from the horns of wild oxen You have answered me.
verses.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִפִּי אַרְיֵה וּמִקַּרְנֵי רֵמִים עֲנִיתָנִי׃

verses.english: I will recount Your name to my brothers; in the midst of the assembly I will praise You.
verses.hebrew: אֲסַפְּרָה שִׁמְךָ לְאֶחָי בְּתוֹךְ קָהָל אֲהַלְלֶךָּ׃

verses.english: You who fear YHWH, praise Him! All Jacob’s seed, honor Him! Stand in awe of Him, all Israel’s seed!
verses.hebrew: יִרְאֵי יְהוָה הַלְלוּהוּ כָּל־זֶרַע יַעֲקֹב כַּבְּדוּהוּ וְגוּרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ כָּל־זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: for He did not despise or abhor the afflicted person’s affliction; He did not hide His face from him, and when he cried to Him for help, He heard.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־בָזָה וְלֹא שִׁקַּץ עֱנוּת עָנִי וְלֹא־הִסְתִּיר פָּנָיו מִמֶּנּוּ וּבְשַׁוְּעוֹ אֵלָיו שָׁמֵעַ׃

verses.english: From You comes my praise in the great assembly; I will pay my vows before those who fear Him.
verses.hebrew: מֵאִתְּךָ תְהִלָּתִי בְּקָהָל רָב נְדָרַי אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגֶד יְרֵאָיו׃

verses.english: The humble will eat and be satisfied; those who seek YHWH will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!
verses.hebrew: יֹאכְלוּ עֲנָוִים וְיִשְׂבָּעוּ יְהַלְלוּ יְהוָה דֹּרְשָׁיו יְחִי לְבַבְכֶם לָעַד׃

verses.english: All the ends of the earth will remember and return to YHWH; all the families of the nations will bow down before You.
verses.hebrew: יִזְכְּרוּ וְיָשֻׁבוּ אֶל־יְהוָה כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ כָּל־מִשְׁפְּחוֹת גּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: For kingship belongs to YHWH, and He rules over the nations.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לַיהוָה הַמְּלוּכָה וּמֹשֵׁל בַּגּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: All the prosperous of the earth have eaten and bowed down; before Him all who descend to dust will kneel, and he did not keep his own soul alive.
verses.hebrew: אָכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲוּוּ כָּל־דִּשְׁנֵי־אֶרֶץ לְפָנָיו יִכְרְעוּ כָּל־יוֹרְדֵי עָפָר וְנַפְשׁוֹ לֹא חִיָּה׃

verses.english: A seed will serve Him; it will be recounted of the Lord to the generation.
verses.hebrew: זֶרַע יַעַבְדֶנּוּ יְסֻפַּר לַאדֹנָי לַדּוֹר׃

verses.english: They will come and declare His righteousness to a people being born, for He has done it.
verses.hebrew: יָבֹאוּ וְיַגִּידוּ צִדְקָתוֹ לְעַם נוֹלָד כִּי עָשָׂה׃

verses.english: A psalm of David. YHWH is my shepherd; I will lack nothing.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהוָה רֹעִי לֹא אֶחְסָר׃

verses.english: He makes me lie down in grassy pastures. He leads me beside restful waters.
verses.hebrew: בִּנְאוֹת דֶּשֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵנִי עַל־מֵי מְנֻחוֹת יְנַהֲלֵנִי׃

verses.english: He restores my soul. He leads me along paths of righteousness for His name’s sake.
verses.hebrew: נַפְשִׁי יְשׁוֹבֵב יַנְחֵנִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי־צֶדֶק לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ׃

verses.english: Even when I walk through a valley of deep darkness, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff comfort me.
verses.hebrew: גַּם כִּי־אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת לֹא־אִירָא רָע כִּי־אַתָּה עִמָּדִי שִׁבְטְךָ וּמִשְׁעַנְתֶּךָ הֵמָּה יְנַחֲמֻנִי׃

verses.english: You arrange a table before me in front of my adversaries; You enrich my head with oil; my cup is overflowing.
verses.hebrew: תַּעֲרֹךְ לְפָנַי שֻׁלְחָן נֶגֶד צֹרְרָי דִּשַּׁנְתָּ בַשֶּׁמֶן רֹאשִׁי כּוֹסִי רְוָיָה׃

verses.english: Surely goodness and steadfast love will pursue me all the days of my life, and I will return to YHWH’s house for length of days.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ טוֹב וָחֶסֶד יִרְדְּפוּנִי כָּל־יְמֵי חַיָּי וְשַׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְהוָה לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים׃

verses.english: Of David. A psalm. The earth and its fullness belong to YHWH, the world and those who dwell in it.
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר לַיהוָה הָאָרֶץ וּמְלוֹאָהּ תֵּבֵל וְיֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃

verses.english: For He founded it upon seas and establishes it upon rivers.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הוּא עַל־יַמִּים יְסָדָהּ וְעַל־נְהָרוֹת יְכוֹנְנֶהָ׃

verses.english: Who may ascend YHWH’s mountain, and who may stand in His holy place?
verses.hebrew: מִי־יַעֲלֶה בְהַר־יְהוָה וּמִי־יָקוּם בִּמְקוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: One clean of hands and pure of heart, who has not lifted my soul to emptiness and has not sworn deceitfully.
verses.hebrew: נְקִי כַפַּיִם וּבַר־לֵבָב אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשָׂא לַשָּׁוְא נַפְשִׁי וְלֹא נִשְׁבַּע לְמִרְמָה׃

verses.english: He will receive blessing from YHWH and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.hebrew: יִשָּׂא בְרָכָה מֵאֵת יְהוָה וּצְדָקָה מֵאֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעוֹ׃

verses.english: This is the generation that seeks Him, those who seek Your face—Jacob. Selah.
verses.hebrew: זֶה דּוֹר דרשו [דֹּרְשָׁיו] מְבַקְשֵׁי פָנֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Lift up your heads, gates! Be lifted up, ancient doorways, so that the King of glory may enter.
verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבוֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד׃

verses.english: Who is this King of glory? YHWH, strong and mighty; YHWH, mighty in battle.
verses.hebrew: מִי זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְהוָה עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר יְהוָה גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: Lift up your heads, gates! Lift up, ancient doorways, so that the King of glory may enter.
verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד׃

verses.english: Who, then, is this King of glory? YHWH of hosts—He is the King of glory. Selah.
verses.hebrew: מִי הוּא זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת הוּא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Of David. To You, YHWH, I lift my soul.
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּׂא׃

verses.english: My God, in You I trust; do not let me be ashamed; do not let my enemies exult over me.
verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי בְּךָ בָטַחְתִּי אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה אַל־יַעַלְצוּ אֹיְבַי לִי׃

verses.english: Indeed, none who wait for You will be ashamed; let those who act treacherously without cause be ashamed.
verses.hebrew: גַּם כָּל־קֹוֶיךָ לֹא יֵבֹשׁוּ יֵבֹשׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִים רֵיקָם׃

verses.english: Make Your ways known to me, YHWH; teach me Your paths.
verses.hebrew: דְּרָכֶיךָ יְהוָה הוֹדִיעֵנִי אֹרְחוֹתֶיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃

verses.english: Lead me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; for You I wait all day.
verses.hebrew: הַדְרִיכֵנִי בַאֲמִתֶּךָ וְלַמְּדֵנִי כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי אוֹתְךָ קִוִּיתִי כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: Remember Your compassion, YHWH, and Your steadfast love, for they are from of old.
verses.hebrew: זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶיךָ יְהוָה וַחֲסָדֶיךָ כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: Do not remember the sins of my youth or my rebellions; according to Your steadfast love, remember me Yourself, for Your goodness’ sake, YHWH.
verses.hebrew: חַטֹּאות נְעוּרַי וּפְשָׁעַי אַל־תִּזְכֹּר כְּחַסְדְּךָ זְכָר־לִי־אַתָּה לְמַעַן טוּבְךָ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH is good and upright; therefore He instructs sinners in the way.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב־וְיָשָׁר יְהוָה עַל־כֵּן יוֹרֶה חַטָּאִים בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

verses.english: He guides the humble in justice and teaches the humble His way.
verses.hebrew: יַדְרֵךְ עֲנָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט וִילַמֵּד עֲנָוִים דַּרְכּוֹ׃

verses.english: All YHWH’s paths are steadfast love and truth for those who keep His covenant and His testimonies.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־אָרְחוֹת יְהוָה חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת לְנֹצְרֵי בְרִיתוֹ וְעֵדֹתָיו׃

verses.english: For Your name’s sake, YHWH, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן־שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֺנִי כִּי רַב־הוּא׃

verses.english: Who is the man who fears YHWH? He will instruct him in the way he chooses.
verses.hebrew: מִי־זֶה הָאִישׁ יְרֵא יְהוָה יוֹרֶנּוּ בְּדֶרֶךְ יִבְחָר׃

verses.english: His soul will lodge in goodness, and his seed will inherit the land.
verses.hebrew: נַפְשׁוֹ בְּטוֹב תָּלִין וְזַרְעוֹ יִירַשׁ אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: YHWH’s intimate counsel is for those who fear Him, and His covenant, to make it known to them.
verses.hebrew: סוֹד יְהוָה לִירֵאָיו וּבְרִיתוֹ לְהוֹדִיעָם׃

verses.english: My eyes are always toward YHWH, for He will bring my feet out of the net.
verses.hebrew: עֵינַי תָּמִיד אֶל־יְהוָה כִּי הוּא־יוֹצִיא מֵרֶשֶׁת רַגְלָי׃

verses.english: Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am alone and afflicted.
verses.hebrew: פְּנֵה־אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי כִּי־יָחִיד וְעָנִי אָנִי׃

verses.english: The distresses of my heart have grown wide; bring me out of my constraints.
verses.hebrew: צָרוֹת לְבָבִי הִרְחִיבוּ מִמְּצוּקוֹתַי הוֹצִיאֵנִי׃

verses.english: See my affliction and my trouble, and bear away all my sins.
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה עָנְיִי וַעֲמָלִי וְשָׂא לְכָל־חַטֹּאותָי׃

verses.english: See my enemies, for they are many; they hate me with violent hatred.
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה־אוֹיְבַי כִּי־רָבּוּ וְשִׂנְאַת חָמָס שְׂנֵאוּנִי׃

verses.english: Guard my soul and deliver me; do not let me be ashamed, for I take refuge in You.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵנִי אַל־אֵבוֹשׁ כִּי־חָסִיתִי בָךְ׃

verses.english: May integrity and uprightness guard me, for I wait for You.
verses.hebrew: תֹּם־וָיֹשֶׁר יִצְּרוּנִי כִּי קִוִּיתִיךָ׃

verses.english: Redeem Israel, God, from all its distresses.
verses.hebrew: פְּדֵה אֱלֹהִים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל צָרוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: Of David. Judge me, YHWH, for I have walked in my integrity; in YHWH I have trusted; I will not slip.
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד שָׁפְטֵנִי יְהוָה כִּי־אֲנִי בְּתֻמִּי הָלַכְתִּי וּבַיהוָה בָּטַחְתִּי לֹא אֶמְעָד׃

verses.english: Examine me, YHWH, and test me; refine my kidneys and my heart.
verses.hebrew: בְּחָנֵנִי יְהוָה וְנַסֵּנִי צרופה [צָרְפָה] כִלְיוֹתַי וְלִבִּי׃

verses.english: For Your steadfast love is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־חַסְדְּךָ לְנֶגֶד עֵינָי וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בַּאֲמִתֶּךָ׃

verses.english: I have not sat with men of emptiness, and I will not go in with those who conceal themselves.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יָשַׁבְתִּי עִם־מְתֵי־שָׁוְא וְעִם נַעֲלָמִים לֹא אָבוֹא׃

verses.english: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and I will not sit with the wicked.
verses.hebrew: שָׂנֵאתִי קְהַל מְרֵעִים וְעִם־רְשָׁעִים לֹא אֵשֵׁב׃

verses.english: I will wash my hands in innocence and go around Your altar, YHWH,
verses.hebrew: אֶרְחַץ בְּנִקָּיוֹן כַּפָּי וַאֲסֹבְבָה אֶת־מִזְבַּחֲךָ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: to make the voice of thanksgiving heard and recount all Your wonders.
verses.hebrew: לַשְׁמִעַ בְּקוֹל תּוֹדָה וּלְסַפֵּר כָּל־נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: YHWH, I love the dwelling of Your house and the place where Your glory resides.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אָהַבְתִּי מְעוֹן בֵּיתֶךָ וּמְקוֹם מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃

verses.english: Do not gather my soul with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תֶּאֱסֹף עִם־חַטָּאִים נַפְשִׁי וְעִם־אַנְשֵׁי דָמִים חַיָּי׃

verses.english: in whose hands is a wicked scheme, and whose right hand is full of bribes.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־בִּידֵיהֶם זִמָּה וִימִינָם מָלְאָה שֹּׁחַד׃

verses.english: But I will walk in my integrity; redeem me and be gracious to me.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בְּתֻמִּי אֵלֵךְ פְּדֵנִי וְחָנֵּנִי׃

verses.english: My foot stands on level ground; in assemblies I will bless YHWH.
verses.hebrew: רַגְלִי עָמְדָה בְמִישׁוֹר בְּמַקְהֵלִים אֲבָרֵךְ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Of David. YHWH is my light and my salvation; whom should I fear? YHWH is the stronghold of my life; whom should I dread?
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד יְהוָה אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי מִמִּי אִירָא יְהוָה מָעוֹז־חַיַּי מִמִּי אֶפְחָד׃

verses.english: When evildoers approached me to devour my flesh, my adversaries and enemies against me, they stumbled and fell.
verses.hebrew: בִּקְרֹב עָלַי מְרֵעִים לֶאֱכֹל אֶת־בְּשָׂרִי צָרַי וְאֹיְבַי לִי הֵמָּה כָשְׁלוּ וְנָפָלוּ׃

verses.english: Though an army camp against me, my heart will not fear; though war rise against me, in this I trust.
verses.hebrew: אִם־תַּחֲנֶה עָלַי מַחֲנֶה לֹא־יִירָא לִבִּי אִם־תָּקוּם עָלַי מִלְחָמָה בְּזֹאת אֲנִי בוֹטֵחַ׃

verses.english: One thing I asked of YHWH; this I will seek: to dwell in YHWH’s house all the days of my life, to behold YHWH’s pleasantness and inquire in His temple.
verses.hebrew: אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת־יְהוָה אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְהוָה כָּל־יְמֵי חַיַּי לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם־יְהוָה וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ׃

verses.english: For He will conceal me in His shelter in the day of trouble; He will hide me in the hiding place of His tent; He will raise me upon a rock.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִצְפְּנֵנִי בְּסֻכֹּה בְּיוֹם רָעָה יַסְתִּרֵנִי בְּסֵתֶר אָהֳלוֹ בְּצוּר יְרוֹמְמֵנִי׃

verses.english: And now my head will rise above the enemies around me; I will sacrifice in His tent sacrifices of joyful shouting; I will sing and make music to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יָרוּם רֹאשִׁי עַל אֹיְבַי סְבִיבוֹתַי וְאֶזְבְּחָה בְאָהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵי תְרוּעָה אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּרָה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: Hear my voice, YHWH, when I call; be gracious to me and answer me.
verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע־יְהוָה קוֹלִי אֶקְרָא וְחָנֵּנִי וַעֲנֵנִי׃

verses.english: On Your behalf my heart said, “Seek My face.” Your face, YHWH, I will seek.
verses.hebrew: לְךָ אָמַר לִבִּי בַּקְּשׁוּ פָנָי אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ יְהוָה אֲבַקֵּשׁ׃

verses.english: Do not hide Your face from me; do not turn Your servant away in anger. You have been my help; do not cast me off or abandon me, God of my salvation.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי אַל־תַּט־בְּאַף עַבְדֶּךָ עֶזְרָתִי הָיִיתָ אַל־תִּטְּשֵׁנִי וְאַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי׃

verses.english: For my father and my mother have abandoned me, but YHWH will gather me in.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָבִי וְאִמִּי עֲזָבוּנִי וַיהוָה יַאַסְפֵנִי׃

verses.english: Instruct me in Your way, YHWH, and lead me on a level path because of those watching me.
verses.hebrew: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ וּנְחֵנִי בְּאֹרַח מִישׁוֹר לְמַעַן שׁוֹרְרָי׃

verses.english: Do not hand me over to my adversaries’ appetite, for false witnesses have risen against me, and one who breathes violence.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתְּנֵנִי בְּנֶפֶשׁ צָרָי כִּי קָמוּ־בִי עֵדֵי־שֶׁקֶר וִיפֵחַ חָמָס׃

verses.english: Had I not believed that I would see YHWH’s goodness in the land of the living—!
verses.hebrew: לוּלֵא הֶאֱמַנְתִּי לִרְאוֹת בְּטוּב־יְהוָה בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּים׃

verses.english: Wait for YHWH; be strong, and let your heart be courageous; wait for YHWH.
verses.hebrew: קַוֵּה אֶל־יְהוָה חֲזַק וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ וְקַוֵּה אֶל־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Of David. To You, YHWH, I call; my rock, do not be deaf to me, lest You be silent toward me and I become like those descending to the pit.
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה אֶקְרָא צוּרִי אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ מִמֶּנִּי פֶּן־תֶּחֱשֶׁה מִמֶּנִּי וְנִמְשַׁלְתִּי עִם־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃

verses.english: Hear the voice of my pleas when I cry to You for help, when I lift my hands toward Your holy inner sanctuary.
verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִי אֵלֶיךָ בְּנָשְׂאִי יָדַי אֶל־דְּבִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ׃

verses.english: Do not drag me away with the wicked and the workers of iniquity, who speak peace with their neighbors while evil is in their hearts.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּמְשְׁכֵנִי עִם־רְשָׁעִים וְעִם־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן דֹּבְרֵי שָׁלוֹם עִם־רֵעֵיהֶם וְרָעָה בִּלְבָבָם׃

verses.english: Give them according to their work and according to the evil of their deeds; give them according to the work of their hands; return their recompense to them.
verses.hebrew: תֶּן־לָהֶם כְּפָעֳלָם וּכְרֹעַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶם כְּמַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיהֶם תֵּן לָהֶם הָשֵׁב גְּמוּלָם לָהֶם׃

verses.english: For they do not understand YHWH’s deeds or the work of His hands; He will tear them down and not build them up.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יָבִינוּ אֶל־פְּעֻלֹּת יְהוָה וְאֶל־מַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו יֶהֶרְסֵם וְלֹא יִבְנֵם׃

verses.english: Blessed be YHWH, for He has heard the voice of my pleas.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה כִּי־שָׁמַע קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָי׃

verses.english: YHWH is my strength and my shield; in Him my heart trusted, and I was helped. My heart exulted, and with my song I will thank Him.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה עֻזִּי וּמָגִנִּי בּוֹ בָטַח לִבִּי וְנֶעֱזָרְתִּי וַיַּעֲלֹז לִבִּי וּמִשִּׁירִי אֲהוֹדֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: YHWH is strength for them; He is the stronghold of the salvations of His anointed.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה עֹז־לָמוֹ וּמָעוֹז יְשׁוּעוֹת מְשִׁיחוֹ הוּא׃

verses.english: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.
verses.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעָה אֶת־עַמֶּךָ וּבָרֵךְ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֶךָ וּרְעֵם וְנַשְּׂאֵם עַד־הָעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: A psalm of David. Ascribe to YHWH, sons of divine beings; ascribe to YHWH glory and strength.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד הָבוּ לַיהוָה בְּנֵי אֵלִים הָבוּ לַיהוָה כָּבוֹד וָעֹז׃

verses.english: Ascribe to YHWH the glory of His name; bow down to YHWH in holy splendor.
verses.hebrew: הָבוּ לַיהוָה כְּבוֹד שְׁמוֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהוָה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: YHWH’s voice is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; YHWH is over many waters.
verses.hebrew: קוֹל יְהוָה עַל־הַמָּיִם אֵל־הַכָּבוֹד הִרְעִים יְהוָה עַל־מַיִם רַבִּים׃

verses.english: YHWH’s voice is in power; YHWH’s voice is in splendor.
verses.hebrew: קוֹל־יְהוָה בַּכֹּחַ קוֹל יְהוָה בֶּהָדָר׃

verses.english: YHWH’s voice breaks cedars; YHWH shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.hebrew: קוֹל יְהוָה שֹׁבֵר אֲרָזִים וַיְשַׁבֵּר יְהוָה אֶת־אַרְזֵי הַלְּבָנוֹן׃

verses.english: He makes them skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְקִידֵם כְּמוֹ־עֵגֶל לְבָנוֹן וְשִׂרְיֹן כְּמוֹ בֶן־רְאֵמִים׃

verses.english: YHWH’s voice hews out flames of fire.
verses.hebrew: קוֹל־יְהוָה חֹצֵב לַהֲבוֹת אֵשׁ׃

verses.english: YHWH’s voice makes the wilderness writhe; YHWH makes the wilderness of Kadesh writhe.
verses.hebrew: קוֹל יְהוָה יָחִיל מִדְבָּר יָחִיל יְהוָה מִדְבַּר קָדֵשׁ׃

verses.english: YHWH’s voice makes the does give birth and strips the forests bare; in His temple everyone says, “Glory!”
verses.hebrew: קוֹל יְהוָה יְחוֹלֵל אַיָּלוֹת וַיֶּחֱשֹׂף יְעָרוֹת וּבְהֵיכָלוֹ כֻּלּוֹ אֹמֵר כָּבוֹד׃

verses.english: YHWH sat enthroned over the flood; YHWH sits as King forever.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה לַמַּבּוּל יָשָׁב וַיֵּשֶׁב יְהוָה מֶלֶךְ לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: YHWH will give strength to His people; YHWH will bless His people with peace.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן יְהוָה יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ בַשָּׁלוֹם׃

verses.english: A psalm. A song for the dedication of the house. Of David.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר־חֲנֻכַּת הַבַּיִת לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: I will exalt You, YHWH, for You drew me up and did not let my enemies rejoice over me.
verses.hebrew: אֲרוֹמִמְךָ יְהוָה כִּי דִלִּיתָנִי וְלֹא־שִׂמַּחְתָּ אֹיְבַי לִי׃

verses.english: YHWH my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי שִׁוַּעְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ וַתִּרְפָּאֵנִי׃

verses.english: YHWH, You brought my soul up from Sheol; You kept me alive from descending to the pit.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה הֶעֱלִיתָ מִן־שְׁאוֹל נַפְשִׁי חִיִּיתַנִי מיורדי־[מִיָּרְדִי־] בוֹר׃

verses.english: Sing praise to YHWH, His faithful ones, and thank Him at the remembrance of His holiness.
verses.hebrew: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה חֲסִידָיו וְהוֹדוּ לְזֵכֶר קָדְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: For His anger is for a moment, His favor for life; weeping lodges for the evening, but joyful shouting comes in the morning.
verses.hebrew: כִּי רֶגַע בְּאַפּוֹ חַיִּים בִּרְצוֹנוֹ בָּעֶרֶב יָלִין בֶּכִי וְלַבֹּקֶר רִנָּה׃

verses.english: As for me, I said in my ease, “I will never be shaken.”
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְשַׁלְוִי בַּל־אֶמּוֹט לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: YHWH, by Your favor You made my mountain stand strong; You hid Your face, and I was terrified.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בִּרְצוֹנְךָ הֶעֱמַדְתָּה לְהַרְרִי עֹז הִסְתַּרְתָּ פָנֶיךָ הָיִיתִי נִבְהָל׃

verses.english: To You, YHWH, I call, and to the Lord I plead for favor:
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה אֶקְרָא וְאֶל־אֲדֹנָי אֶתְחַנָּן׃

verses.english: “What gain is there in my blood, in my descending to the pit? Will dust thank You? Will it declare Your truth?
verses.hebrew: מַה־בֶּצַע בְּדָמִי בְּרִדְתִּי אֶל־שָׁחַת הֲיוֹדְךָ עָפָר הֲיַגִּיד אֲמִתֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Hear, YHWH, and be gracious to me; YHWH, be my helper.”
verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע־יְהוָה וְחָנֵּנִי יְהוָה הֱ‍יֵה־עֹזֵר לִי׃

verses.english: You turned my mourning into dancing for me; You loosened my sackcloth and girded me with joy,
verses.hebrew: הָפַכְתָּ מִסְפְּדִי לְמָחוֹל לִי פִּתַּחְתָּ שַׂקִּי וַתְּאַזְּרֵנִי שִׂמְחָה׃

verses.english: so that glory may sing praise to You and not be silent. YHWH my God, I will thank You forever.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יְזַמֶּרְךָ כָבוֹד וְלֹא יִדֹּם יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי לְעוֹלָם אוֹדֶךָּ׃

verses.english: For the director. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: In You, YHWH, I take refuge; let me never be ashamed; in Your righteousness deliver me.
verses.hebrew: בְּךָ יְהוָה חָסִיתִי אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ פַלְּטֵנִי׃

verses.english: Incline Your ear to me; rescue me quickly; be for me a rock of refuge, a fortified house to save me.
verses.hebrew: הַטֵּה אֵלַי אָזְנְךָ מְהֵרָה הַצִּילֵנִי הֱיֵה לִי לְצוּר־מָעוֹז לְבֵית מְצוּדוֹת לְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃

verses.english: For You are my crag and my fortress; for Your name’s sake guide me and lead me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אָתָּה וּלְמַעַן שִׁמְךָ תַּנְחֵנִי וּתְנַהֲלֵנִי׃

verses.english: Bring me out of the net they hid for me, for You are my refuge.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹצִיאֵנִי מֵרֶשֶׁת זוּ טָמְנוּ לִי כִּי־אַתָּה מָעוּזִּי׃

verses.english: Into Your hand I entrust my spirit; You have redeemed me, YHWH, God of truth.
verses.hebrew: בְּיָדְךָ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי פָּדִיתָה אוֹתִי יְהוָה אֵל אֱמֶת׃

verses.english: I hate those who attend to empty vanities, but I trust in YHWH.
verses.hebrew: שָׂנֵאתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִים הַבְלֵי־שָׁוְא וַאֲנִי אֶל־יְהוָה בָּטָחְתִּי׃

verses.english: I will exult and rejoice in Your steadfast love, for You have seen my affliction; You have known my soul’s distresses.
verses.hebrew: אָגִילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָה בְּחַסְדֶּךָ אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתָ אֶת־עָנְיִי יָדַעְתָּ בְּצָרוֹת נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: You did not shut me into an enemy’s hand; You made my feet stand in a broad place.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הִסְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד־אוֹיֵב הֶעֱמַדְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָב רַגְלָי׃

verses.english: Be gracious to me, YHWH, for I am in distress; my eye wastes away with grief, my soul and my belly too.
verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי יְהוָה כִּי צַר־לִי עָשְׁשָׁה בְכַעַס עֵינִי נַפְשִׁי וּבִטְנִי׃

verses.english: For my life is spent in grief and my years in sighing; my strength fails through my iniquity, and my bones waste away.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כָלוּ בְיָגוֹן חַיַּי וּשְׁנוֹתַי בַּאֲנָחָה כָּשַׁל בַּעֲוֺנִי כֹחִי וַעֲצָמַי עָשֵׁשׁוּ׃

verses.english: Because of all my adversaries I have become a reproach, and especially to my neighbors, a terror to those who know me; those who see me outside flee from me.
verses.hebrew: מִכָּל־צֹרְרַי הָיִיתִי חֶרְפָּה וְלִשֲׁכֵנַי מְאֹד וּפַחַד לִמְיֻדָּעָי רֹאַי בַּחוּץ נָדְדוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃
