verses.english: I am forgotten from the heart like a dead person; I have become like a ruined vessel.
verses.hebrew: נִשְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵת מִלֵּב הָיִיתִי כִּכְלִי אֹבֵד׃

verses.english: For I hear the slander of many—terror on every side; as they conspire together against me, they plot to take my soul.
verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁמַעְתִּי דִּבַּת רַבִּים מָגוֹר מִסָּבִיב בְּהִוָּסְדָם יַחַד עָלַי לָקַחַת נַפְשִׁי זָמָמוּ׃

verses.english: But I trust in You, YHWH; I say, “You are my God.”
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי עָלֶיךָ בָטַחְתִּי יְהוָה אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהַי אָתָּה׃

verses.english: My times are in Your hand; rescue me from the hand of my enemies and my pursuers.
verses.hebrew: בְּיָדְךָ עִתֹּתָי הַצִּילֵנִי מִיַּד־אוֹיְבַי וּמֵרֹדְפָי׃

verses.english: Make Your face shine upon Your servant; save me in Your steadfast love.
verses.hebrew: הָאִירָה פָנֶיךָ עַל־עַבְדֶּךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי בְחַסְדֶּךָ׃

verses.english: YHWH, do not let me be ashamed, for I have called upon You; let the wicked be ashamed and silent in Sheol.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה כִּי קְרָאתִיךָ יֵבֹשׁוּ רְשָׁעִים יִדְּמוּ לִשְׁאוֹל׃

verses.english: Let lying lips become mute, those that speak insolence against the righteous in arrogance and contempt.
verses.hebrew: תֵּאָלַמְנָה שִׂפְתֵי שָׁקֶר הַדֹּבְרוֹת עַל־צַדִּיק עָתָק בְּגַאֲוָה וָבוּז׃

verses.english: How great is Your goodness, which You have stored for those who fear You, which You have wrought for those who take refuge in You before the sons of humankind!
verses.hebrew: מָה רַב־טוּבְךָ אֲשֶׁר־צָפַנְתָּ לִּירֵאֶיךָ פָּעַלְתָּ לַחֹסִים בָּךְ נֶגֶד בְּנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: You hide them in the hiding place of Your presence from human conspiracies; You conceal them in a shelter from the strife of tongues.
verses.hebrew: תַּסְתִּירֵם בְּסֵתֶר פָּנֶיךָ מֵרֻכְסֵי אִישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵם בְּסֻכָּה מֵרִיב לְשֹׁנוֹת׃

verses.english: Blessed be YHWH, for He has wondrously shown His steadfast love to me in a besieged city.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה כִּי הִפְלִיא חַסְדּוֹ לִי בְּעִיר מָצוֹר׃

verses.english: But I said in my alarm, “I am cut off from before Your eyes!” Yet You heard the voice of my pleas when I cried to You for help.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְחָפְזִי נִגְרַזְתִּי מִנֶּגֶד עֵינֶיךָ אָכֵן שָׁמַעְתָּ קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִי אֵלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Love YHWH, all His faithful ones! YHWH preserves the trustworthy and richly repays the one who acts arrogantly.
verses.hebrew: אֶהֱבוּ אֶת־יְהוָה כָּל־חֲסִידָיו אֱמוּנִים נֹצֵר יְהוָה וּמְשַׁלֵּם עַל־יֶתֶר עֹשֵׂה גַאֲוָה׃

verses.english: Be strong, and let your heart be courageous, all who hope in YHWH.
verses.hebrew: חִזְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵץ לְבַבְכֶם כָּל־הַמְיַחֲלִים לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: Of David. A Maskil. Blessed is the one whose rebellion is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד מַשְׂכִּיל אַשְׁרֵי נְשׂוּי־פֶּשַׁע כְּסוּי חֲטָאָה׃

verses.english: Blessed is the person to whom YHWH does not reckon iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no deceit.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם לֹא יַחְשֹׁב יְהוָה לוֹ עָוֺן וְאֵין בְּרוּחוֹ רְמִיָּה׃

verses.english: When I kept silent, my bones wore away through my roaring all day long.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הֶחֱרַשְׁתִּי בָּלוּ עֲצָמָי בְּשַׁאֲגָתִי כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: For day and night Your hand weighed heavily upon me; my moisture was changed by summer's droughts. Selah.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה תִּכְבַּד עָלַי יָדֶךָ נֶהְפַּךְ לְשַׁדִּי בְּחַרְבֹנֵי קַיִץ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: I made my sin known to You and did not cover my guilt. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to YHWH.” And You lifted away the guilt of my sin. Selah.
verses.hebrew: חַטָּאתִי אוֹדִיעֲךָ וַעֲוֺנִי לֹא־כִסִּיתִי אָמַרְתִּי אוֹדֶה עֲלֵי פְשָׁעַי לַיהוָה וְאַתָּה נָשָׂאתָ עֲוֺן חַטָּאתִי סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Therefore let every faithful one pray to You at a time of finding; surely, when many waters flood, they will not reach him.
verses.hebrew: עַל־זֹאת יִתְפַּלֵּל כָּל־חָסִיד אֵלֶיךָ לְעֵת מְצֹא רַק לְשֵׁטֶף מַיִם רַבִּים אֵלָיו לֹא יַגִּיעוּ׃

verses.english: You are a hiding place for me; You protect me from trouble; with shouts of deliverance You surround me. Selah.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה סֵתֶר לִי מִצַּר תִּצְּרֵנִי רָנֵּי פַלֵּט תְּסוֹבְבֵנִי סֶלָה׃

verses.english: I will give you insight and instruct you in the way you should go; I will counsel you, my eye upon you.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׂכִּילְךָ וְאוֹרְךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ־זוּ תֵלֵךְ אִיעֲצָה עָלֶיךָ עֵינִי׃

verses.english: Do not be like a horse or a mule without understanding; with bit and bridle its trappings must restrain it, lest it come near you.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּהְיוּ כְּסוּס כְּפֶרֶד אֵין הָבִין בְּמֶתֶג־וָרֶסֶן עֶדְיוֹ לִבְלוֹם בַּל קְרֹב אֵלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Many are the pains of the wicked, but steadfast love surrounds the one who trusts in YHWH.
verses.hebrew: רַבִּים מַכְאוֹבִים לָרָשָׁע וְהַבּוֹטֵחַ בַּיהוָה חֶסֶד יְסוֹבְבֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: Rejoice in YHWH and exult, righteous ones; shout for joy, all upright in heart.
verses.hebrew: שִׂמְחוּ בַיהוָה וְגִילוּ צַדִּיקִים וְהַרְנִינוּ כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃

verses.english: Shout for joy in YHWH, righteous ones; praise is fitting for the upright.
verses.hebrew: רַנְּנוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּיהוָה לַיְשָׁרִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּה׃

verses.english: Give thanks to YHWH with the lyre; make music to Him with a ten-stringed harp.
verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה בְּכִנּוֹר בְּנֵבֶל עָשׂוֹר זַמְּרוּ־לוֹ׃

verses.english: Sing Him a new song; play skillfully with a joyful shout.
verses.hebrew: שִׁירוּ־לוֹ שִׁיר חָדָשׁ הֵיטִיבוּ נַגֵּן בִּתְרוּעָה׃

verses.english: For YHWH's word is upright, and all His work is in faithfulness.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יָשָׁר דְּבַר־יְהוָה וְכָל־מַעֲשֵׂהוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָה׃

verses.english: He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of YHWH's steadfast love.
verses.hebrew: אֹהֵב צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט חֶסֶד יְהוָה מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: By YHWH's word the heavens were made, and by the breath of His mouth all their host.
verses.hebrew: בִּדְבַר יְהוָה שָׁמַיִם נַעֲשׂוּ וּבְרוּחַ פִּיו כָּל־צְבָאָם׃

verses.english: He gathers the sea's waters like a heap; He places the deeps in storehouses.
verses.hebrew: כֹּנֵס כַּנֵּד מֵי הַיָּם נֹתֵן בְּאֹצָרוֹת תְּהוֹמוֹת׃

verses.english: Let all the earth fear YHWH; let all who inhabit the world stand in dread of Him.
verses.hebrew: יִירְאוּ מֵיְהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ מִמֶּנּוּ יָגוּרוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל׃

verses.english: For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הוּא אָמַר וַיֶּהִי הוּא־צִוָּה וַיַּעֲמֹד׃

verses.english: YHWH frustrates the counsel of nations; He thwarts the plans of peoples.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה הֵפִיר עֲצַת־גּוֹיִם הֵנִיא מַחְשְׁבוֹת עַמִּים׃

verses.english: YHWH's counsel stands forever, the plans of His heart from generation to generation.
verses.hebrew: עֲצַת יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תַּעֲמֹד מַחְשְׁבוֹת לִבּוֹ לְדֹר וָדֹר׃

verses.english: Blessed is the nation whose God is YHWH, the people He chose as His own inheritance.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו הָעָם בָּחַר לְנַחֲלָה לוֹ׃

verses.english: From heaven YHWH looked down; He saw all the children of humankind.
verses.hebrew: מִשָּׁמַיִם הִבִּיט יְהוָה רָאָה אֶת־כָּל־בְּנֵי הָאָדָם׃

verses.english: From His established dwelling place He gazed upon all who inhabit the earth.
verses.hebrew: מִמְּכוֹן־שִׁבְתּוֹ הִשְׁגִּיחַ אֶל כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: He fashions their hearts together; He understands all their deeds.
verses.hebrew: הַיֹּצֵר יַחַד לִבָּם הַמֵּבִין אֶל־כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם׃

verses.english: A king is not saved by a great army; a mighty warrior is not delivered by great strength.
verses.hebrew: אֵין־הַמֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁע בְּרָב־חָיִל גִּבּוֹר לֹא־יִנָּצֵל בְּרָב־כֹּחַ׃

verses.english: A horse is a false hope for deliverance; with all its great might it cannot rescue.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁקֶר הַסּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָה וּבְרֹב חֵילוֹ לֹא יְמַלֵּט׃

verses.english: Look, YHWH's eye is upon those who fear Him, upon those who wait for His steadfast love,
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה עֵין יְהוָה אֶל־יְרֵאָיו לַמְיַחֲלִים לְחַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: to deliver their soul from death and keep them alive in famine.
verses.hebrew: לְהַצִּיל מִמָּוֶת נַפְשָׁם וּלְחַיּוֹתָם בָּרָעָב׃

verses.english: Our soul waits for YHWH; He is our help and our shield.
verses.hebrew: נַפְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָה לַיהוָה עֶזְרֵנוּ וּמָגִנֵּנוּ הוּא׃

verses.english: For our heart rejoices in Him, for we have trusted in His holy name.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־בוֹ יִשְׂמַח לִבֵּנוּ כִּי בְשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ בָטָחְנוּ׃

verses.english: Let Your steadfast love, YHWH, be upon us, as we have waited for You.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי־חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה עָלֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִחַלְנוּ לָךְ׃

verses.english: Of David, when he changed his discernment before Abimelech, who drove him out, and he went away.
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד בְּשַׁנּוֹתוֹ אֶת־טַעְמוֹ לִפְנֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיְגָרֲשֵׁהוּ וַיֵּלַךְ׃

verses.english: I will bless YHWH at every time; His praise is always in my mouth.
verses.hebrew: אֲבָרֲכָה אֶת־יְהוָה בְּכָל־עֵת תָּמִיד תְּהִלָּתוֹ בְּפִי׃

verses.english: My soul will boast in YHWH; let the humble hear and rejoice.
verses.hebrew: בַּיהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּל נַפְשִׁי יִשְׁמְעוּ עֲנָוִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ׃

verses.english: Magnify YHWH with me; let us exalt His name together.
verses.hebrew: גַּדְּלוּ לַיהוָה אִתִּי וּנְרוֹמְמָה שְׁמוֹ יַחְדָּו׃

verses.english: I sought YHWH, and He answered me; from all my fears He delivered me.
verses.hebrew: דָּרַשְׁתִּי אֶת־יְהוָה וְעָנָנִי וּמִכָּל־מְגוּרוֹתַי הִצִּילָנִי׃

verses.english: They looked to Him and became radiant; let their faces not be ashamed.
verses.hebrew: הִבִּיטוּ אֵלָיו וְנָהָרוּ וּפְנֵיהֶם אַל־יֶחְפָּרוּ׃

verses.english: This poor man called, and YHWH heard; from all his troubles He saved him.
verses.hebrew: זֶה עָנִי קָרָא וַיהוָה שָׁמֵעַ וּמִכָּל־צָרוֹתָיו הוֹשִׁיעוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH's angel encamps around those who fear Him and delivers them.
verses.hebrew: חֹנֶה מַלְאַךְ־יְהוָה סָבִיב לִירֵאָיו וַיְחַלְּצֵם׃

verses.english: Taste and see that YHWH is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him.
verses.hebrew: טַעֲמוּ וּרְאוּ כִּי־טוֹב יְהוָה אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר יֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ׃

verses.english: Fear YHWH, His holy ones, for those who fear Him have no lack.
verses.hebrew: יְראוּ אֶת־יְהוָה קְדֹשָׁיו כִּי־אֵין מַחְסוֹר לִירֵאָיו׃

verses.english: Young lions lack and hunger, but those who seek YHWH will lack no good thing.
verses.hebrew: כְּפִירִים רָשׁוּ וְרָעֵבוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁי יְהוָה לֹא־יַחְסְרוּ כָל־טוֹב׃

verses.english: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לְכוּ־בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִי יִרְאַת יְהוָה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶם׃

verses.english: Who is the person who desires life, who loves days in which to see good?
verses.hebrew: מִי־הָאִישׁ הֶחָפֵץ חַיִּים אֹהֵב יָמִים לִרְאוֹת טוֹב׃

verses.english: Guard your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
verses.hebrew: נְצֹר לְשׁוֹנְךָ מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה׃

verses.english: Turn from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
verses.hebrew: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב בַּקֵּשׁ שָׁלוֹם וְרָדְפֵהוּ׃

verses.english: YHWH's eyes are toward the righteous, and His ears toward their cry for help.
verses.hebrew: עֵינֵי יְהוָה אֶל־צַדִּיקִים וְאָזְנָיו אֶל־שַׁוְעָתָם׃

verses.english: YHWH's face is against evildoers, to cut off their memory from the earth.
verses.hebrew: פְּנֵי יְהוָה בְּעֹשֵׂי רָע לְהַכְרִית מֵאֶרֶץ זִכְרָם׃

verses.english: They cried, and YHWH heard; from all their troubles He delivered them.
verses.hebrew: צָעֲקוּ וַיהוָה שָׁמֵעַ וּמִכָּל־צָרוֹתָם הִצִּילָם׃

verses.english: YHWH is near to the brokenhearted, and He saves those crushed in spirit.
verses.hebrew: קָרוֹב יְהוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵב וְאֶת־דַּכְּאֵי־רוּחַ יוֹשִׁיעַ׃

verses.english: Many are the evils of the righteous person, but YHWH delivers him from them all.
verses.hebrew: רַבּוֹת רָעוֹת צַדִּיק וּמִכֻּלָּם יַצִּילֶנּוּ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: He keeps all his bones; not one of them is broken.
verses.hebrew: שֹׁמֵר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָיו אַחַת מֵהֵנָּה לֹא נִשְׁבָּרָה׃

verses.english: Evil will put the wicked person to death, and those who hate the righteous will incur guilt.
verses.hebrew: תְּמוֹתֵת רָשָׁע רָעָה וְשֹׂנְאֵי צַדִּיק יֶאְשָׁמוּ׃

verses.english: YHWH redeems the soul of His servants; none of those who take refuge in Him will incur guilt.
verses.hebrew: פּוֹדֶה יְהוָה נֶפֶשׁ עֲבָדָיו וְלֹא יֶאְשְׁמוּ כָּל־הַחֹסִים בּוֹ׃

verses.english: Of David. Contend, YHWH, with those who contend with me; fight those who fight me.
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד רִיבָה יְהוָה אֶת־יְרִיבַי לְחַם אֶת־לֹחֲמָי׃

verses.english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and rise to my aid.
verses.hebrew: הַחֲזֵק מָגֵן וְצִנָּה וְקוּמָה בְּעֶזְרָתִי׃

verses.english: Draw the spear and bar the way against my pursuers; say to my soul, “I am your salvation.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָרֵק חֲנִית וּסְגֹר לִקְרַאת רֹדְפָי אֱמֹר לְנַפְשִׁי יְשֻׁעָתֵךְ אָנִי׃

verses.english: Let those who seek my life be ashamed and disgraced; let those planning my harm retreat and be humiliated.
verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִכָּלְמוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיַחְפְּרוּ חֹשְׁבֵי רָעָתִי׃

verses.english: Let them become like chaff before the wind, with YHWH's angel driving them away.
verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ כְּמֹץ לִפְנֵי־רוּחַ וּמַלְאַךְ יְהוָה דּוֹחֶה׃

verses.english: Let their way be darkness and slippery places, with YHWH's angel pursuing them.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי־דַרְכָּם חֹשֶׁךְ וַחֲלַקְלַקּוֹת וּמַלְאַךְ יְהוָה רֹדְפָם׃

verses.english: For without cause they hid for me their net in a pit; without cause they dug for my life.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־חִנָּם טָמְנוּ־לִי שַׁחַת רִשְׁתָּם חִנָּם חָפְרוּ לְנַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: Let darkness he does not know come upon him; let the net he hid catch him; in darkness let him fall into it.
verses.hebrew: תְּבוֹאֵהוּ שׁוֹאָה לֹא־יֵדָע וְרִשְׁתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־טָמַן תִּלְכְּדוֹ בְּשׁוֹאָה יִפָּל־בָּהּ׃

verses.english: Then my soul will exult in YHWH; it will rejoice in His salvation.
verses.hebrew: וְנַפְשִׁי תָּגִיל בַּיהוָה תָּשִׂישׂ בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ׃

verses.english: All my bones will say, “YHWH, who is like You, delivering the poor from one stronger than he, and the poor and needy from his robber?”
verses.hebrew: כָּל עַצְמוֹתַי תֹּאמַרְנָה יְהוָה מִי כָמוֹךָ מַצִּיל עָנִי מֵחָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ וְעָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן מִגֹּזְלוֹ׃

verses.english: Violent witnesses rise up; they question me about what I do not know.
verses.hebrew: יְקוּמוּן עֵדֵי חָמָס אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי יִשְׁאָלוּנִי׃

verses.english: They repay me evil for good, bereavement to my soul.
verses.hebrew: יְשַׁלְּמוּנִי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה שְׁכוֹל לְנַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: But when they were ill, my clothing was sackcloth; I humbled my soul with fasting; may my prayer return to my own bosom.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בַּחֲלוֹתָם לְבוּשִׁי שָׂק עִנֵּיתִי בַצּוֹם נַפְשִׁי וּתְפִלָּתִי עַל־חֵיקִי תָשׁוּב׃

verses.english: As for my friend or brother I walked about; like one mourning a mother, I bowed down in gloom.
verses.hebrew: כְּרֵעַ־כְּאָח לִי הִתְהַלָּכְתִּי כַּאֲבֶל־אֵם קֹדֵר שַׁחוֹתִי׃

verses.english: But at my limping they rejoiced and gathered; lame people gathered against me, and I did not know; though they tore me, no blood flowed.
verses.hebrew: וּבְצַלְעִי שָׂמְחוּ וְנֶאֱסָפוּ נֶאֶסְפוּ עָלַי נֵכִים וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי קָרְעוּ וְלֹא־דָמּוּ׃

verses.english: With the flattery of those who mock for food, they gnash their teeth at me.
verses.hebrew: בְּחַנְפֵי לַעֲגֵי מָעוֹג חָרֹק עָלַי שִׁנֵּימוֹ׃

verses.english: Lord, how long will You look on? Restore my soul from their darkness, my only life from young lions.
verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי כַּמָּה תִּרְאֶה הָשִׁיבָה נַפְשִׁי מִשֹּׁאֵיהֶם מִכְּפִירִים יְחִידָתִי׃

verses.english: I will thank You in a great assembly; among a mighty people I will praise You.
verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ בְּקָהָל רָב בְּעַם עָצוּם אֲהַלְלֶךָּ׃

verses.english: Let my false enemies not rejoice over me; let those who hate me without cause not wink the eye.
verses.hebrew: אַל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִי אֹיְבַי שֶׁקֶר שֹׂנְאַי חִנָּם יִקְרְצוּ־עָיִן׃

verses.english: For they do not speak peace, and against the crushed people of the land they devise deceitful words.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא שָׁלוֹם יְדַבֵּרוּ וְעַל רִגְעֵי־אֶרֶץ דִּבְרֵי מִרְמוֹת יַחֲשֹׁבוּן׃

verses.english: They opened their mouth wide against me; they said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen!”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְחִיבוּ עָלַי פִּיהֶם אָמְרוּ הֶאָח הֶאָח רָאֲתָה עֵינֵינוּ׃

verses.english: You have seen, YHWH; do not remain silent. Lord, do not be far from me.
verses.hebrew: רָאִיתָה יְהוָה אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ אֲדֹנָי אֲל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: Stir Yourself and awaken for my judgment, my God and my Lord, for my cause.
verses.hebrew: הָעִירָה וְהָקִיצָה לְמִשְׁפָּטִי אֱלֹהַי וַאדֹנָי לְרִיבִי׃

verses.english: Judge me according to Your righteousness, YHWH my God; let them not rejoice over me.
verses.hebrew: שָׁפְטֵנִי כְצִדְקְךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי וְאַל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִי׃

verses.english: Let them not say in their heart, “Aha! Our desire!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up.”
verses.hebrew: אַל־יֹאמְרוּ בְלִבָּם הֶאָח נַפְשֵׁנוּ אַל־יֹאמְרוּ בִּלַּעֲנוּהוּ׃

verses.english: Let those rejoicing in my harm be ashamed and humiliated together; let those magnifying themselves against me wear shame and disgrace.
verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ יַחְדָּו שְׂמֵחֵי רָעָתִי יִלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹשֶׁת וּכְלִמָּה הַמַּגְדִּילִים עָלָי׃

verses.english: Let those who delight in my vindication shout and rejoice; let them always say, “May YHWH be magnified, who delights in His servant's peace.”
verses.hebrew: יָרֹנּוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ חֲפֵצֵי צִדְקִי וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יְהוָה הֶחָפֵץ שְׁלוֹם עַבְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: My tongue will meditate on Your righteousness, on Your praise all day long.
verses.hebrew: וּלְשׁוֹנִי תֶּהְגֶּה צִדְקֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃

verses.english: For the director. Of YHWH's servant, of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְעֶבֶד־יְהוָה לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: An oracle of rebellion to the wicked is within my heart: there is no dread of God before his eyes.
verses.hebrew: נְאֻם־פֶּשַׁע לָרָשָׁע בְּקֶרֶב לִבִּי אֵין־פַּחַד אֱלֹהִים לְנֶגֶד עֵינָיו׃

verses.english: For it flatters him in his own eyes, toward the finding of his iniquity and hatred.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הֶחֱלִיק אֵלָיו בְּעֵינָיו לִמְצֹא עֲוֺנוֹ לִשְׂנֹא׃

verses.english: The words of his mouth are wrongdoing and deceit; he has ceased to act wisely and do good.
verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי־פִיו אָוֶן וּמִרְמָה חָדַל לְהַשְׂכִּיל לְהֵיטִיב׃

verses.english: He devises wrongdoing upon his bed; he takes his stand on a way that is not good; he does not reject evil.
verses.hebrew: אָוֶן יַחְשֹׁב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ יִתְיַצֵּב עַל־דֶּרֶךְ לֹא־טוֹב רָע לֹא יִמְאָס׃

verses.english: YHWH, Your steadfast love is in the heavens; Your faithfulness reaches the clouds.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּהַשָּׁמַיִם חַסְדֶּךָ אֱמוּנָתְךָ עַד־שְׁחָקִים׃

verses.english: Your righteousness is like mighty mountains; Your judgment is a great deep. You save human and beast, YHWH.
verses.hebrew: צִדְקָתְךָ כְּהַרְרֵי־אֵל מִשְׁפָּטֶךָ תְּהוֹם רַבָּה אָדָם־וּבְהֵמָה תוֹשִׁיעַ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: How precious is Your steadfast love, God! Humankind takes refuge in the shadow of Your wings.
verses.hebrew: מַה־יָּקָר חַסְדְּךָ אֱלֹהִים וּבְנֵי אָדָם בְּצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ יֶחֱסָיוּן׃

verses.english: They drink their fill from the abundance of Your house; You give them drink from the stream of Your delights.
verses.hebrew: יִרְוְיֻן מִדֶּשֶׁן בֵּיתֶךָ וְנַחַל עֲדָנֶיךָ תַשְׁקֵם׃

verses.english: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עִמְּךָ מְקוֹר חַיִּים בְּאוֹרְךָ נִרְאֶה־אוֹר׃

verses.english: Extend Your steadfast love to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.hebrew: מְשֹׁךְ חַסְדְּךָ לְיֹדְעֶיךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ לְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃

verses.english: Let the foot of pride not come upon me; let the hand of the wicked not drive me away.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּבוֹאֵנִי רֶגֶל גַּאֲוָה וְיַד־רְשָׁעִים אַל־תְּנִדֵנִי׃

verses.english: There the workers of wrongdoing have fallen; they were thrust down and could not rise.
verses.hebrew: שָׁם נָפְלוּ פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן דֹּחוּ וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ קוּם׃

verses.english: Of David. Do not compete with evildoers; do not envy those who commit injustice.
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד אַל־תִּתְחַר בַּמְּרֵעִים אַל־תְּקַנֵּא בְּעֹשֵׂי עַוְלָה׃

verses.english: For like grass they will quickly be cut down, and like green vegetation they will wither.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כֶחָצִיר מְהֵרָה יִמָּלוּ וּכְיֶרֶק דֶּשֶׁא יִבּוֹלוּן׃

verses.english: Trust in YHWH and do good; dwell in the land and feed on faithfulness.
verses.hebrew: בְּטַח בַּיהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב שְׁכָן־אֶרֶץ וּרְעֵה אֱמוּנָה׃

verses.english: Delight yourself in YHWH, and He will give you the requests of your heart.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְעַנַּג עַל־יְהוָה וְיִתֶּן־לְךָ מִשְׁאֲלֹת לִבֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Roll your way upon YHWH; trust in Him, and He will act.
verses.hebrew: גּוֹל עַל־יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ וּבְטַח עָלָיו וְהוּא יַעֲשֶׂה׃

verses.english: He will bring out your righteousness like light, and your judgment like noon.
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹצִיא כָאוֹר צִדְקֶךָ וּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ כַּצָּהֳרָיִם׃

verses.english: Wait for YHWH and hope for Him; do not compete with one whose way prospers, with a man carrying out schemes.
verses.hebrew: דּוֹם לַיהוָה וְהִתְחוֹלֵל לוֹ אַל־תִּתְחַר בְּמַצְלִיחַ דַּרְכּוֹ בְּאִישׁ עֹשֶׂה מְזִמּוֹת׃

verses.english: Let go of anger and abandon wrath; do not compete, only to do evil.
verses.hebrew: הֶרֶף מֵאַף וַעֲזֹב חֵמָה אַל־תִּתְחַר אַךְ־לְהָרֵעַ׃

verses.english: For evildoers will be cut off, but those who wait for YHWH will inherit the land.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־מְרֵעִים יִכָּרֵתוּן וְקֹוֵי יְהוָה הֵמָּה יִירְשׁוּ־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: A little longer, and the wicked person is gone; you will look carefully at his place, and he is not there.
verses.hebrew: וְעוֹד מְעַט וְאֵין רָשָׁע וְהִתְבּוֹנַנְתָּ עַל־מְקוֹמוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: But the humble will inherit the land and delight themselves in abundant peace.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲנָוִים יִירְשׁוּ־אָרֶץ וְהִתְעַנְּגוּ עַל־רֹב שָׁלוֹם׃

verses.english: The wicked person plots against the righteous and gnashes his teeth at him.
verses.hebrew: זֹמֵם רָשָׁע לַצַּדִּיק וְחֹרֵק עָלָיו שִׁנָּיו׃

verses.english: The Lord laughs at him, for He sees that his day is coming.
verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי יִשְׂחַק־לוֹ כִּי־רָאָה כִּי־יָבֹא יוֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent their bow, to bring down the poor and needy, to slaughter those upright in their way.
verses.hebrew: חֶרֶב פָּתְחוּ רְשָׁעִים וְדָרְכוּ קַשְׁתָּם לְהַפִּיל עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן לִטְבוֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי־דָרֶךְ׃

verses.english: Their sword will enter their own heart, and their bows will be broken.
verses.hebrew: חַרְבָּם תָּבוֹא בְלִבָּם וְקַשְּׁתוֹתָם תִּשָּׁבַרְנָה׃

verses.english: Better is a little for the righteous than the abundance of many wicked people.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב־מְעַט לַצַּדִּיק מֵהֲמוֹן רְשָׁעִים רַבִּים׃

verses.english: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but YHWH supports the righteous.
verses.hebrew: כִּי זְרוֹעוֹת רְשָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַרְנָה וְסוֹמֵךְ צַדִּיקִים יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
verses.hebrew: יוֹדֵעַ יְהוָה יְמֵי תְמִימִם וְנַחֲלָתָם לְעוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה׃

verses.english: They will not be ashamed in an evil time, and in days of famine they will be satisfied.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יֵבֹשׁוּ בְּעֵת רָעָה וּבִימֵי רְעָבוֹן יִשְׂבָּעוּ׃

verses.english: For the wicked will perish; YHWH's enemies are like the fleeting brightness of the plains: they vanish into smoke, they vanish.
verses.hebrew: כִּי רְשָׁעִים יֹאבֵדוּ וְאֹיְבֵי יְהוָה כִּיקַר כָּרִים כָּלוּ בֶעָשָׁן כָּלוּ׃

verses.english: The wicked person borrows and does not repay, but the Righteous One is gracious and gives.
verses.hebrew: לֹוֶה רָשָׁע וְלֹא יְשַׁלֵּם וְצַדִּיק חוֹנֵן וְנוֹתֵן׃

verses.english: For those blessed by Him will inherit the land, and those cursed by Him will be cut off.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מְבֹרָכָיו יִירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ וּמְקֻלָּלָיו יִכָּרֵתוּ׃

verses.english: A man's steps are established by YHWH, and He delights in his way.
verses.hebrew: מֵיְהוָה מִצְעֲדֵי־גֶבֶר כּוֹנָנוּ וְדַרְכּוֹ יֶחְפָּץ׃

verses.english: Though he falls, he will not be cast down, for YHWH supports his hand.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יִפֹּל לֹא־יוּטָל כִּי־יְהוָה סוֹמֵךְ יָדוֹ׃

verses.english: I was young and have also grown old, yet I have not seen a righteous person abandoned or his offspring seeking bread.
verses.hebrew: נַעַר הָיִיתִי גַּם־זָקַנְתִּי וְלֹא־רָאִיתִי צַדִּיק נֶעֱזָב וְזַרְעוֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־לָחֶם׃

verses.english: All day long he is gracious and lends, and his offspring are a blessing.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַיּוֹם חוֹנֵן וּמַלְוֶה וְזַרְעוֹ לִבְרָכָה׃

verses.english: Turn from evil and do good, and dwell forever.
verses.hebrew: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב וּשְׁכֹן לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: For YHWH loves justice and will not abandon His faithful ones; they are guarded forever, but the offspring of the wicked are cut off.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יְהוָה אֹהֵב מִשְׁפָּט וְלֹא־יַעֲזֹב אֶת־חֲסִידָיו לְעוֹלָם נִשְׁמָרוּ וְזֶרַע רְשָׁעִים נִכְרָת׃

verses.english: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell upon it forever.
verses.hebrew: צַדִּיקִים יִירְשׁוּ־אָרֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנוּ לָעַד עָלֶיהָ׃

verses.english: The mouth of the righteous meditates on wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
verses.hebrew: פִּי־צַדִּיק יֶהְגֶּה חָכְמָה וּלְשׁוֹנוֹ תְּדַבֵּר מִשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: The instruction of his God is in his heart; his steps do not slip.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹרַת אֱלֹהָיו בְּלִבּוֹ לֹא תִמְעַד אֲשֻׁרָיו׃

verses.english: The wicked person watches the righteous and seeks to put him to death.
verses.hebrew: צוֹפֶה רָשָׁע לַצַּדִּיק וּמְבַקֵּשׁ לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH will not abandon him into his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה לֹא־יַעַזְבֶנּוּ בְיָדוֹ וְלֹא יַרְשִׁיעֶנּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ׃

verses.english: Wait for YHWH and keep His way; He will raise you up to inherit the land; you will see when the wicked are cut off.
verses.hebrew: קַוֵּה אֶל־יְהוָה וּשְׁמֹר דַּרְכּוֹ וִירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶשֶׁת אָרֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה׃

verses.english: I saw a ruthless wicked person, spreading himself like a luxuriant native tree.
verses.hebrew: רָאִיתִי רָשָׁע עָרִיץ וּמִתְעָרֶה כְּאֶזְרָח רַעֲנָן׃

verses.english: He passed away, and look, he was gone; I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר וְהִנֵּה אֵינֶנּוּ וָאֲבַקְשֵׁהוּ וְלֹא נִמְצָא׃

verses.english: Watch the blameless person and observe the upright, for a person of peace has a future.
verses.hebrew: שְׁמָר־תָּם וּרְאֵה יָשָׁר כִּי־אַחֲרִית לְאִישׁ שָׁלוֹם׃

verses.english: But rebels are destroyed together; the future of the wicked is cut off.
verses.hebrew: וּפֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְדוּ יַחְדָּו אַחֲרִית רְשָׁעִים נִכְרָתָה׃

verses.english: The salvation of the righteous is from YHWH, their stronghold in a time of trouble.
verses.hebrew: וּתְשׁוּעַת צַדִּיקִים מֵיְהוָה מָעוּזָּם בְּעֵת צָרָה׃

verses.english: YHWH helps them and delivers them; He delivers them from the wicked and saves them, for they have taken refuge in Him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעְזְרֵם יְהוָה וַיְפַלְּטֵם יְפַלְּטֵם מֵרְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם כִּי־חָסוּ בוֹ׃

verses.english: A psalm of David, for remembrance.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד לְהַזְכִּיר׃

verses.english: YHWH, do not rebuke me in Your indignation, nor discipline me in Your wrath.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אַל־בְּקֶצְפְּךָ תוֹכִיחֵנִי וּבַחֲמָתְךָ תְיַסְּרֵנִי׃

verses.english: For Your arrows have sunk into me, and Your hand has descended upon me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־חִצֶּיךָ נִחֲתוּ בִי וַתִּנְחַת עָלַי יָדֶךָ׃

verses.english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of Your indignation; there is no peace in my bones because of my sin.
verses.hebrew: אֵין־מְתֹם בִּבְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵי זַעְמֶךָ אֵין־שָׁלוֹם בַּעֲצָמַי מִפְּנֵי חַטָּאתִי׃

verses.english: For my iniquities have passed over my head; like a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי עֲוֺנֹתַי עָבְרוּ רֹאשִׁי כְּמַשָּׂא כָבֵד יִכְבְּדוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: My wounds stink and fester because of my folly.
verses.hebrew: הִבְאִישׁוּ נָמַקּוּ חַבּוּרֹתָי מִפְּנֵי אִוַּלְתִּי׃

verses.english: I am twisted and bowed down exceedingly; all day long I walk about in gloom.
verses.hebrew: נַעֲוֵיתִי שַׁחֹתִי עַד־מְאֹד כָּל־הַיּוֹם קֹדֵר הִלָּכְתִּי׃

verses.english: For my loins are filled with burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־כְסָלַי מָלְאוּ נִקְלֶה וְאֵין מְתֹם בִּבְשָׂרִי׃

verses.english: I am numb and crushed exceedingly; I roar from the groaning of my heart.
verses.hebrew: נְפוּגוֹתִי וְנִדְכֵּיתִי עַד־מְאֹד שָׁאַגְתִּי מִנַּהֲמַת לִבִּי׃

verses.english: Lord, all my desire is before You, and my sighing is not hidden from You.
verses.hebrew: אֲ‍דֹנָי נֶגְדְּךָ כָל־תַּאֲוָתִי וְאַנְחָתִי מִמְּךָ לֹא־נִסְתָּרָה׃

verses.english: My heart pounds; my strength has left me; even the light of my eyes is no longer with me.
verses.hebrew: לִבִּי סְחַרְחַר עֲזָבַנִי כֹחִי וְאוֹר־עֵינַי גַּם־הֵם אֵין אִתִּי׃

verses.english: My loved ones and friends stand away from my plague; my relatives stand far off.
verses.hebrew: אֹהֲבַי וְרֵעַי מִנֶּגֶד נִגְעִי יַעֲמֹדוּ וּקְרוֹבַי מֵרָחֹק עָמָדוּ׃

verses.english: Those seeking my life set snares; those seeking my harm speak destruction and meditate on deceits all day long.
verses.hebrew: וַיְנַקְשׁוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי וְדֹרְשֵׁי רָעָתִי דִּבְּרוּ הַוּוֹת וּמִרְמוֹת כָּל־הַיּוֹם יֶהְגּוּ׃

verses.english: But like a deaf person I do not hear, like a mute who does not open his mouth.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי כְחֵרֵשׁ לֹא אֶשְׁמָע וּכְאִלֵּם לֹא יִפְתַּח־פִּיו׃

verses.english: I have become like a person who does not hear, whose mouth has no rebuttals.
verses.hebrew: וָאֱהִי כְּאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שֹׁמֵעַ וְאֵין בְּפִיו תּוֹכָחוֹת׃

verses.english: For I have waited for You, YHWH; You will answer, Lord my God.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־לְךָ יְהוָה הוֹחָלְתִּי אַתָּה תַעֲנֶה אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהָי׃

verses.english: For I said, “Lest they rejoice over me!” When my foot slipped, they magnified themselves against me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמַרְתִּי פֶּן־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִי בְּמוֹט רַגְלִי עָלַי הִגְדִּילוּ׃

verses.english: For I am ready to stumble, and my pain is always before me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֲנִי לְצֶלַע נָכוֹן וּמַכְאוֹבִי נֶגְדִּי תָמִיד׃

verses.english: For I will declare my iniquity; I am anxious over my sin.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עֲוֺנִי אַגִּיד אֶדְאַג מֵחַטָּאתִי׃

verses.english: My enemies are alive and mighty, and those hating me falsely have multiplied.
verses.hebrew: וְאֹיְבַי חַיִּים עָצֵמוּ וְרַבּוּ שֹׂנְאַי שָׁקֶר׃

verses.english: Those repaying evil for good oppose me because I pursue good.
verses.hebrew: וּמְשַׁלְּמֵי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה יִשְׂטְנוּנִי תַּחַת רדופי־[רָדְפִי־] טוֹב׃

verses.english: Do not abandon me, YHWH; my God, do not be far from me.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי אַל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: Hurry to my aid, Lord, my salvation.
verses.hebrew: חוּשָׁה לְעֶזְרָתִי אֲדֹנָי תְּשׁוּעָתִי׃

verses.english: For the director. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לידיתון [לִידוּתוּן] מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: I said, “I will guard my ways from sinning with my tongue; I will keep a muzzle upon my mouth while the wicked person is before me.”
verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי אֶשְׁמְרָה דְרָכַי מֵחֲטוֹא בִלְשׁוֹנִי אֶשְׁמְרָה לְפִי מַחְסוֹם בְּעֹד רָשָׁע לְנֶגְדִּי׃

verses.english: I was mute in silence; I kept quiet even from good, and my pain was stirred up.
verses.hebrew: נֶאֱלַמְתִּי דוּמִיָּה הֶחֱשֵׁיתִי מִטּוֹב וּכְאֵבִי נֶעְכָּר׃

verses.english: My heart grew hot within me; in my musing a fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:
verses.hebrew: חַם־לִבִּי בְּקִרְבִּי בַּהֲגִיגִי תִבְעַר־אֵשׁ דִּבַּרְתִּי בִּלְשׁוֹנִי׃

verses.english: “Make known to me, YHWH, my end and the measure of my days, what it is; let me know how fleeting I am.
verses.hebrew: הוֹדִיעֵנִי יְהוָה קִצִּי וּמִדַּת יָמַי מַה־הִיא אֵדְעָה מֶה־חָדֵל אָנִי׃

verses.english: Look, You have made my days handbreadths, and my lifespan is as nothing before You. Surely every person standing is altogether a breath. Selah.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה טְפָחוֹת נָתַתָּה יָמַי וְחֶלְדִּי כְאַיִן נֶגְדֶּךָ אַךְ כָּל־הֶבֶל כָּל־אָדָם נִצָּב סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Surely a person walks about as an image; surely they bustle for a breath. He heaps up and does not know who will gather it.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־בְּצֶלֶם יִתְהַלֶּךְ־אִישׁ אַךְ־הֶבֶל יֶהֱמָיוּן יִצְבֹּר וְלֹא־יֵדַע מִי־אֹסְפָם׃

verses.english: And now, what do I wait for, Lord? My hope is in You.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מַה־קִּוִּיתִי אֲדֹנָי תּוֹחַלְתִּי לְךָ הִיא׃

verses.english: Deliver me from all my rebellions; do not make me a reproach to the fool.
verses.hebrew: מִכָּל־פְּשָׁעַי הַצִּילֵנִי חֶרְפַּת נָבָל אַל־תְּשִׂימֵנִי׃

verses.english: I am mute; I will not open my mouth, for You have acted.
verses.hebrew: נֶאֱלַמְתִּי לֹא אֶפְתַּח־פִּי כִּי אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ׃

verses.english: Remove Your stroke from me; from the assault of Your hand I am spent.
verses.hebrew: הָסֵר מֵעָלַי נִגְעֶךָ מִתִּגְרַת יָדְךָ אֲנִי כָלִיתִי׃

verses.english: With rebukes for iniquity You discipline a person and dissolve like a moth what he treasures. Surely every person is a breath. Selah.
verses.hebrew: בְּתוֹכָחוֹת עַל־עָוֺן יִסַּרְתָּ אִישׁ וַתֶּמֶס כָּעָשׁ חֲמוּדוֹ אַךְ הֶבֶל כָּל־אָדָם סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Hear my prayer, YHWH, and give ear to my cry for help; do not remain silent at my tears. For I am a sojourner with You, a resident alien like all my fathers.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעָה־תְפִלָּתִי יְהוָה וְשַׁוְעָתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֶל־דִּמְעָתִי אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ כִּי גֵר אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ תּוֹשָׁב כְּכָל־אֲבוֹתָי׃

verses.english: Look away from me, that I may brighten again, before I depart and am no more.”
verses.hebrew: הָשַׁע מִמֶּנִּי וְאַבְלִיגָה בְּטֶרֶם אֵלֵךְ וְאֵינֶנִּי׃

verses.english: For the director. Of David. A psalm.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר׃

verses.english: I waited and waited for YHWH; He inclined to me and heard my cry for help.
verses.hebrew: קַוֺּה קִוִּיתִי יְהוָה וַיֵּט אֵלַי וַיִּשְׁמַע שַׁוְעָתִי׃

verses.english: He brought me up from the roaring pit, from the mud of the mire; He set my feet upon a rock and established my steps.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלֵנִי מִבּוֹר שָׁאוֹן מִטִּיט הַיָּוֵן וַיָּקֶם עַל־סֶלַע רַגְלַי כּוֹנֵן אֲשֻׁרָי׃

verses.english: He put a new song in my mouth, praise to our God. Many will see and fear and trust in YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן בְּפִי שִׁיר חָדָשׁ תְּהִלָּה לֵאלֹהֵינוּ יִרְאוּ רַבִּים וְיִירָאוּ וְיִבְטְחוּ בַּיהוָה׃

verses.english: Blessed is the man who makes YHWH his trust and does not turn toward the arrogant or those straying into falsehood.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם יְהֹוָה מִבְטַחוֹ וְלֹא־פָנָה אֶל־רְהָבִים וְשָׂטֵי כָזָב׃

verses.english: Many things You have done, YHWH my God— Your wonders and Your plans toward us; none can be set beside You. I would declare and speak of them; they are too numerous to recount.
verses.hebrew: רַבּוֹת עָשִׂיתָ אַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי נִפְלְאֹתֶיךָ וּמַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ אֵלֵינוּ אֵין עֲרֹךְ אֵלֶיךָ אַגִּידָה וַאֲדַבֵּרָה עָצְמוּ מִסַּפֵּר׃

verses.english: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire; ears You dug for me. Burnt offering and sin offering You did not ask.
verses.hebrew: זֶבַח וּמִנְחָה לֹא־חָפַצְתָּ אָזְנַיִם כָּרִיתָ לִּי עוֹלָה וַחֲטָאָה לֹא שָׁאָלְתָּ׃

verses.english: Then I said, “Look, I have come; in the scroll of the book it is written concerning me.
verses.hebrew: אָז אָמַרְתִּי הִנֵּה־בָאתִי בִּמְגִלַּת־סֵפֶר כָּתוּב עָלָי׃

verses.english: I delight to do Your will, my God; Your instruction is within my inward parts.”
verses.hebrew: לַעֲשׂוֹת־רְצוֹנְךָ אֱלֹהַי חָפָצְתִּי וְתוֹרָתְךָ בְּתוֹךְ מֵעָי׃

verses.english: I proclaimed good news of righteousness in a great assembly; look, I do not restrain my lips; YHWH, You know.
verses.hebrew: בִּשַּׂרְתִּי צֶדֶק בְּקָהָל רָב הִנֵּה שְׂפָתַי לֹא אֶכְלָא יְהוָה אַתָּה יָדָעְתָּ׃

verses.english: I did not cover Your righteousness within my heart; I spoke of Your faithfulness and Your salvation. I did not conceal Your steadfast love and Your truth from a great assembly.
verses.hebrew: צִדְקָתְךָ לֹא־כִסִּיתִי בְּתוֹךְ לִבִּי אֱמוּנָתְךָ וּתְשׁוּעָתְךָ אָמָרְתִּי לֹא־כִחַדְתִּי חַסְדְּךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ לְקָהָל רָב׃

verses.english: You, YHWH, will not restrain Your compassion from me; Your steadfast love and Your truth will always guard me.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה יְהוָה לֹא־תִכְלָא רַחֲמֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי חַסְדְּךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ תָּמִיד יִצְּרוּנִי׃

verses.english: For evils beyond number have surrounded me; my iniquities have overtaken me, and I cannot see. They exceed the hairs of my head, and my heart has abandoned me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אָפְפוּ־עָלַי רָעוֹת עַד־אֵין מִסְפָּר הִשִּׂיגוּנִי עֲוֺנֹתַי וְלֹא־יָכֹלְתִּי לִרְאוֹת עָצְמוּ מִשַּׂעֲרוֹת רֹאשִׁי וְלִבִּי עֲזָבָנִי׃

verses.english: Be pleased, YHWH, to deliver me; YHWH, hurry to my aid.
verses.hebrew: רְצֵה יְהוָה לְהַצִּילֵנִי יְהוָה לְעֶזְרָתִי חוּשָׁה׃

verses.english: Let those seeking my life to sweep it away be ashamed and humiliated together; let those delighting in my harm retreat and be disgraced.
verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ יַחַד מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי לִסְפּוֹתָהּ יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיִכָּלְמוּ חֲפֵצֵי רָעָתִי׃

verses.english: Let those saying to me, “Aha! Aha!” be appalled as the consequence of their shame.
verses.hebrew: יָשֹׁמּוּ עַל־עֵקֶב בָּשְׁתָּם הָאֹמְרִים לִי הֶאָח הֶאָח׃

verses.english: Let all seeking You rejoice and be glad in You; let those loving Your salvation always say, “May YHWH be magnified!”
verses.hebrew: יָשִׂישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְּךָ כָּל־מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ יֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יְהוָה אֹהֲבֵי תְּשׁוּעָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my help and my deliverer; my God, do not delay.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אֲדֹנָי יַחֲשָׁב לִי עֶזְרָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי אַתָּה אֱלֹהַי אַל־תְּאַחַר׃

verses.english: For the director. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: Blessed is the one who gives thoughtful care to the weak; in an evil day YHWH will deliver him.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי מַשְׂכִּיל אֶל־דָּל בְּיוֹם רָעָה יְמַלְּטֵהוּ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH will guard him and keep him alive; he will be called blessed in the land. Do not give him over to his enemies' desire.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יִשְׁמְרֵהוּ וִיחַיֵּהוּ יאשר [וְאֻשַּׁר] בָּאָרֶץ וְאַל־תִּתְּנֵהוּ בְּנֶפֶשׁ אֹיְבָיו׃

verses.english: YHWH will sustain him on his sickbed; You have turned all his bedding in his illness.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יִסְעָדֶנּוּ עַל־עֶרֶשׂ דְּוָי כָּל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ הָפַכְתָּ בְחָלְיוֹ׃

verses.english: I said, “YHWH, be gracious to me; heal my soul, for I have sinned against You.”
verses.hebrew: אֲ‍נִי־אָמַרְתִּי יְהוָה חָנֵּנִי רְפָאָה נַפְשִׁי כִּי־חָטָאתִי לָךְ׃

verses.english: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die and his name perish?”
verses.hebrew: אוֹיְבַי יֹאמְרוּ רַע לִי מָתַי יָמוּת וְאָבַד שְׁמוֹ׃

verses.english: If someone comes to see me, he speaks falsehood; his heart gathers wrongdoing for himself; he goes outside and speaks.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בָּא לִרְאוֹת שָׁוְא יְדַבֵּר לִבּוֹ יִקְבָּץ־אָוֶן לוֹ יֵצֵא לַחוּץ יְדַבֵּר׃

verses.english: Together all who hate me whisper against me; against me they devise harm for me.
verses.hebrew: יַחַד עָלַי יִתְלַחֲשׁוּ כָּל־שֹׂנְאָי עָלַי יַחְשְׁבוּ רָעָה לִי׃

verses.english: “A ruinous thing has been poured into him; now that he lies down, he will not rise again.”
verses.hebrew: דְּבַר־בְּלִיַּעַל יָצוּק בּוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר שָׁכַב לֹא־יוֹסִיף לָקוּם׃

verses.english: Even my trusted companion, in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has lifted his heel against me.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־אִישׁ שְׁלוֹמִי אֲשֶׁר־בָּטַחְתִּי בוֹ אוֹכֵל לַחְמִי הִגְדִּיל עָלַי עָקֵב׃

verses.english: But You, YHWH, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה חָנֵּנִי וַהֲקִימֵנִי וַאֲשַׁלְּמָה לָהֶם׃

verses.english: By this I know that You delight in me: my enemy does not shout in triumph over me.
verses.hebrew: בְּזֹאת יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־חָפַצְתָּ בִּי כִּי לֹא־יָרִיעַ אֹיְבִי עָלָי׃

verses.english: As for me, You upheld me in my integrity and set me before You forever.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בְּתֻמִּי תָּמַכְתָּ בִּי וַתַּצִּיבֵנִי לְפָנֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: Blessed be YHWH, Israel's God, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and amen.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵהָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם אָמֵן וְאָמֵן׃

verses.english: For the director. A Maskil of the sons of Korah.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מַשְׂכִּיל לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח׃

verses.english: As a deer longs for channels of water, so my soul longs for You, God.
verses.hebrew: כְּאַיָּל תַּעֲרֹג עַל־אֲפִיקֵי־מָיִם כֵּן נַפְשִׁי תַעֲרֹג אֵלֶיךָ אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When will I come and appear before God's face?
verses.hebrew: צָמְאָה נַפְשִׁי לֵאלֹהִים לְאֵל חָי מָתַי אָבוֹא וְאֵרָאֶה פְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: My tears have been my bread day and night, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
verses.hebrew: הָיְתָה־לִּי דִמְעָתִי לֶחֶם יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה בֶּאֱמֹר אֵלַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

verses.english: These things I remember and pour out my soul within me: how I passed with the throng and led them to God's house, with a voice of joyful shouting and thanksgiving, a celebrating multitude.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אֶזְכְּרָה וְאֶשְׁפְּכָה עָלַי נַפְשִׁי כִּי אֶעֱבֹר בַּסָּךְ אֶדַּדֵּם עַד־בֵּית אֱלֹהִים בְּקוֹל־רִנָּה וְתוֹדָה הָמוֹן חוֹגֵג׃

verses.english: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and tumultuous within me? Wait for God, for I will yet thank Him, for the saving deeds of His face.
verses.hebrew: מַה־תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וַתֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹהִים כִּי־עוֹד אוֹדֶנּוּ יְשׁוּעוֹת פָּנָיו׃

verses.english: My God, my soul is bowed down within me; therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the Hermon heights, from Mount Mizar.
verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי עָלַי נַפְשִׁי תִשְׁתּוֹחָח עַל־כֵּן אֶזְכָּרְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ יַרְדֵּן וְחֶרְמוֹנִים מֵהַר מִצְעָר׃

verses.english: Deep calls to deep at the sound of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and Your waves have passed over me.
verses.hebrew: תְּהוֹם־אֶל־תְּהוֹם קוֹרֵא לְקוֹל צִנּוֹרֶיךָ כָּל־מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ וְגַלֶּיךָ עָלַי עָבָרוּ׃

verses.english: By day YHWH commands His steadfast love, and at night His song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.hebrew: יוֹמָם יְצַוֶּה יְהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וּבַלַּיְלָה שירה [שִׁירוֹ] עִמִּי תְּפִלָּה לְאֵל חַיָּי׃

verses.english: I will say to God my rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why do I walk in gloom under the enemy's oppression?”
verses.hebrew: אוֹמְרָה לְאֵל סַלְעִי לָמָה שְׁכַחְתָּנִי לָמָּה־קֹדֵר אֵלֵךְ בְּלַחַץ אוֹיֵב׃

verses.english: With a mortal wound in my bones my adversaries reproach me, saying to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
verses.hebrew: בְּרֶצַח בְּעַצְמוֹתַי חֵרְפוּנִי צוֹרְרָי בְּאָמְרָם אֵלַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and why tumultuous within me? Wait for God, for I will yet thank Him, the salvation of my face and my God.
verses.hebrew: מַה־תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וּמַה־תֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹהִים כִּי־עוֹד אוֹדֶנּוּ יְשׁוּעֹת פָּנַי וֵאלֹהָי׃

verses.english: Judge me, God, and plead my case against an unfaithful nation; deliver me from a person of deceit and injustice.
verses.hebrew: שָׁפְטֵנִי אֱלֹהִים וְרִיבָה רִיבִי מִגּוֹי לֹא־חָסִיד מֵאִישׁ־מִרְמָה וְעַוְלָה תְפַלְּטֵנִי׃

verses.english: For You are the God of my stronghold; why have You rejected me? Why do I walk about in gloom under the enemy's oppression?
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי מָעוּזִּי לָמָה זְנַחְתָּנִי לָמָּה־קֹדֵר אֶתְהַלֵּךְ בְּלַחַץ אוֹיֵב׃

verses.english: Send Your light and Your truth; let them lead me; let them bring me to Your holy mountain and Your dwellings.
verses.hebrew: שְׁלַח־אוֹרְךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ הֵמָּה יַנְחוּנִי יְבִיאוּנִי אֶל־הַר־קָדְשְׁךָ וְאֶל־מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Then I will come to God's altar, to God, my joy of exultation; I will thank You with the lyre, God, my God.
verses.hebrew: וְאָבוֹאָה אֶל־מִזְבַּח אֱלֹהִים אֶל־אֵל שִׂמְחַת גִּילִי וְאוֹדְךָ בְכִנּוֹר אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהָי׃

verses.english: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and why tumultuous within me? Wait for God, for I will yet thank Him, the salvation of my face and my God.
verses.hebrew: מַה־תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וּמַה־תֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹהִים כִּי־עוֹד אוֹדֶנּוּ יְשׁוּעֹת פָּנַי וֵאלֹהָי׃

verses.english: For the director. Of the sons of Korah. A Maskil.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מַשְׂכִּיל׃

verses.english: God, with our ears we have heard; our fathers recounted to us the work You did in their days, in days of old.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים בְּאָזְנֵינוּ שָׁמַעְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָנוּ פֹּעַל פָּעַלְתָּ בִימֵיהֶם בִּימֵי קֶדֶם׃

verses.english: You, with Your hand, dispossessed nations and planted our fathers; You afflicted peoples and sent them away.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה יָדְךָ גּוֹיִם הוֹרַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵם תָּרַע לְאֻמִּים וַתְּשַׁלְּחֵם׃

verses.english: For they did not inherit the land by their sword, and their arm did not save them, but Your right hand, Your arm and the light of Your face, for You favored them.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא בְחַרְבָּם יָרְשׁוּ אָרֶץ וּזְרוֹעָם לֹא־הוֹשִׁיעָה לָּמוֹ כִּי־יְמִינְךָ וּזְרוֹעֲךָ וְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ כִּי רְצִיתָם׃

verses.english: You are my King, God; command deliverances for Jacob.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה־הוּא מַלְכִּי אֱלֹהִים צַוֵּה יְשׁוּעוֹת יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: Through You we gore our adversaries; through Your name we trample those rising against us.
verses.hebrew: בְּךָ צָרֵינוּ נְנַגֵּחַ בְּשִׁמְךָ נָבוּס קָמֵינוּ׃

verses.english: For I do not trust in my bow, and my sword will not save me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא בְקַשְׁתִּי אֶבְטָח וְחַרְבִּי לֹא תוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃

verses.english: For You saved us from our adversaries and put those who hate us to shame.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הוֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִצָּרֵינוּ וּמְשַׂנְאֵינוּ הֱבִישׁוֹתָ׃

verses.english: In God we boast all day long, and Your name we will thank forever. Selah.
verses.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים הִלַּלְנוּ כָל־הַיּוֹם וְשִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם נוֹדֶה סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Even though You rejected us and disgraced us and do not go out with our armies,
verses.hebrew: אַף־זָנַחְתָּ וַתַּכְלִימֵנוּ וְלֹא־תֵצֵא בְּצִבְאוֹתֵינוּ׃

verses.english: You make us retreat before the adversary, and those who hate us plunder for themselves.
verses.hebrew: תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ אָחוֹר מִנִּי־צָר וּמְשַׂנְאֵינוּ שָׁסוּ לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: You give us like sheep for food and scatter us among the nations.
verses.hebrew: תִּתְּנֵנוּ כְּצֹאן מַאֲכָל וּבַגּוֹיִם זֵרִיתָנוּ׃

verses.english: You sell Your people for no wealth and have gained nothing from their price.
verses.hebrew: תִּמְכֹּר־עַמְּךָ בְלֹא־הוֹן וְלֹא־רִבִּיתָ בִּמְחִירֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, mockery and derision to those around us.
verses.hebrew: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ לַעַג וָקֶלֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵינוּ׃

verses.english: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.hebrew: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ מָשָׁל בַּגּוֹיִם מְנוֹד־רֹאשׁ בַּל־אֻמִּים׃

verses.english: All day long my disgrace is before me, and the shame of my face covers me,
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַיּוֹם כְּלִמָּתִי נֶגְדִּי וּבֹשֶׁת פָּנַי כִּסָּתְנִי׃

verses.english: at the voice of the taunter and reviler, at the presence of the enemy and avenger.
verses.hebrew: מִקּוֹל מְחָרֵף וּמְגַדֵּף מִפְּנֵי אוֹיֵב וּמִתְנַקֵּם׃

verses.english: All this has come upon us, yet we have not forgotten You or dealt falsely with Your covenant.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־זֹאת בָּאַתְנוּ וְלֹא שְׁכַחֲנוּךָ וְלֹא־שִׁקַּרְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Our heart has not turned backward, nor have our steps turned aside from Your path,
verses.hebrew: לֹא־נָסוֹג אָחוֹר לִבֵּנוּ וַתֵּט אֲשֻׁרֵינוּ מִנִּי אָרְחֶךָ׃

verses.english: even when You crushed us in a place of jackals and covered us with death's shadow.
verses.hebrew: כִּי דִכִּיתָנוּ בִּמְקוֹם תַּנִּים וַתְּכַס עָלֵינוּ בְצַלְמָוֶת׃

verses.english: If we had forgotten our God's name and spread our palms toward a foreign god,
verses.hebrew: אִם־שָׁכַחְנוּ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַנִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפֵּינוּ לְאֵל זָר׃

verses.english: would God not search this out? For He knows the heart's hidden things.
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא אֱלֹהִים יַחֲקָר־זֹאת כִּי־הוּא יֹדֵעַ תַּעֲלֻמוֹת לֵב׃

verses.english: For Your sake we are killed all day long; we are reckoned as sheep for slaughter.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עָלֶיךָ הֹרַגְנוּ כָל־הַיּוֹם נֶחְשַׁבְנוּ כְּצֹאן טִבְחָה׃

verses.english: Awake! Why do You sleep, Lord? Wake up; do not reject us forever.
verses.hebrew: עוּרָה לָמָּה תִישַׁן אֲדֹנָי הָקִיצָה אַל־תִּזְנַח לָנֶצַח׃

verses.english: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה־פָנֶיךָ תַסְתִּיר תִּשְׁכַּח עָנְיֵנוּ וְלַחֲצֵנוּ׃

verses.english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly clings to the earth.
verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁחָה לֶעָפָר נַפְשֵׁנוּ דָּבְקָה לָאָרֶץ בִּטְנֵנוּ׃

verses.english: Arise to help us, and redeem us for the sake of Your steadfast love.
verses.hebrew: קוּמָה עֶזְרָתָה לָּנוּ וּפְדֵנוּ לְמַעַן חַסְדֶּךָ׃

verses.english: For the director. According to Lilies. Of the sons of Korah. A Maskil. A song of loves.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שֹׁשַׁנִּים לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מַשְׂכִּיל שִׁיר יְדִידֹת׃

verses.english: My heart stirs with a good word; I speak my composition for a king; my tongue is the pen of a skilled scribe.
verses.hebrew: רָחַשׁ לִבִּי דָּבָר טוֹב אֹמֵר אָנִי מַעֲשַׂי לְמֶלֶךְ לְשׁוֹנִי עֵט סוֹפֵר מָהִיר׃

verses.english: You are more beautiful than the children of humankind; graciousness is poured upon your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
verses.hebrew: יָפְיָפִיתָ מִבְּנֵי אָדָם הוּצַק חֵן בְּשְׂפְתוֹתֶיךָ עַל־כֵּן בֵּרַכְךָ אֱלֹהִים לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: Gird your sword upon your thigh, mighty one, your majesty and your splendor.
verses.hebrew: חֲגוֹר־חַרְבְּךָ עַל־יָרֵךְ גִּבּוֹר הוֹדְךָ וַהֲדָרֶךָ׃

verses.english: In your splendor advance and ride for the sake of truth and righteous humility; let your right hand teach you awesome deeds.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲדָרְךָ צְלַח רְכַב עַל־דְּבַר־אֱמֶת וְעַנְוָה־צֶדֶק וְתוֹרְךָ נוֹרָאוֹת יְמִינֶךָ׃

verses.english: Your arrows are sharp—peoples fall beneath you— in the heart of the king's enemies.
verses.hebrew: חִצֶּיךָ שְׁנוּנִים עַמִּים תַּחְתֶּיךָ יִפְּלוּ בְּלֵב אוֹיְבֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

verses.english: Your throne, judge, is forever and ever; a scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
verses.hebrew: כִּסְאֲךָ אֱלֹהִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד שֵׁבֶט מִישֹׁר שֵׁבֶט מַלְכוּתֶךָ׃

verses.english: You loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, anointed you with the oil of joy beyond your companions.
verses.hebrew: אָהַבְתָּ צֶּדֶק וַתִּשְׂנָא רֶשַׁע עַל־כֵּן מְשָׁחֲךָ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן שָׂשׂוֹן מֵחֲבֵרֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Myrrh, aloes and cassia scent all your garments; more than ivory palaces, those from Me gladden you.
verses.hebrew: מֹר־וַאֲהָלוֹת קְצִיעוֹת כָּל־בִּגְדֹתֶיךָ מִן־הֵיכְלֵי שֵׁן מִנִּי שִׂמְּחוּךָ׃

verses.english: Kings' daughters are among your visitors; the queen stands at your right in gold of Ophir.
verses.hebrew: בְּנוֹת מְלָכִים בְּיִקְּרוֹתֶיךָ נִצְּבָה שֵׁגַל לִימִינְךָ בְּכֶתֶם אוֹפִיר׃

verses.english: Listen, daughter, look and incline your ear; forget your people and your father's house.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעִי־בַת וּרְאִי וְהַטִּי אָזְנֵךְ וְשִׁכְחִי עַמֵּךְ וּבֵית אָבִיךְ׃

verses.english: Then the king will desire your beauty, for he is your lord; bow down to him.
verses.hebrew: וְיִתְאָו הַמֶּלֶךְ יָפְיֵךְ כִּי־הוּא אֲדֹנַיִךְ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִי־לוֹ׃

verses.english: The daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; the rich of the people will seek your favor.
verses.hebrew: וּבַת־צֹר בְּמִנְחָה פָּנַיִךְ יְחַלּוּ עֲשִׁירֵי עָם׃

verses.english: All glorious is the king's daughter within; her clothing is worked with gold.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־כְּבוּדָּה בַת־מֶלֶךְ פְּנִימָה מִמִּשְׁבְּצוֹת זָהָב לְבוּשָׁהּ׃

verses.english: In embroidery she is led to the king; virgins follow her, her companions, brought to you.
verses.hebrew: לִרְקָמוֹת תּוּבַל לַמֶּלֶךְ בְּתוּלוֹת אַחֲרֶיהָ רֵעוֹתֶיהָ מוּבָאוֹת לָךְ׃

verses.english: They are led with gladness and exultation; they enter the king's palace.
verses.hebrew: תּוּבַלְנָה בִּשְׂמָחֹת וָגִיל תְּבֹאֶינָה בְּהֵיכַל מֶלֶךְ׃

verses.english: In place of your fathers will be your sons; you will set them as princes throughout the earth.
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת אֲבֹתֶיךָ יִהְיוּ בָנֶיךָ תְּשִׁיתֵמוֹ לְשָׂרִים בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: I will make your name remembered in every generation; therefore peoples will thank you forever and ever.
verses.hebrew: אַזְכִּירָה שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל־דֹּר וָדֹר עַל־כֵּן עַמִּים יְהוֹדֻךָ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד׃

verses.english: For the director. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח עַל־עֲלָמוֹת שִׁיר׃

verses.english: God is our refuge and strength, a help in troubles, abundantly found.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים לָנוּ מַחֲסֶה וָעֹז עֶזְרָה בְצָרוֹת נִמְצָא מְאֹד׃

verses.english: Therefore we will not fear when the earth changes and mountains totter into the heart of the seas,
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן לֹא־נִירָא בְּהָמִיר אָרֶץ וּבְמוֹט הָרִים בְּלֵב יַמִּים׃

verses.english: though its waters roar and foam and mountains quake at its swelling. Selah.
verses.hebrew: יֶהֱמוּ יֶחְמְרוּ מֵימָיו יִרְעֲשׁוּ־הָרִים בְּגַאֲוָתוֹ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: A river—its streams gladden God's city, the holy dwelling places of the Most High.
verses.hebrew: נָהָר פְּלָגָיו יְשַׂמְּחוּ עִיר־אֱלֹהִים קְדֹשׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵי עֶלְיוֹן׃

verses.english: God is within her; she will not totter; God will help her at the turning of morning.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ בַּל־תִּמּוֹט יַעְזְרֶהָ אֱלֹהִים לִפְנוֹת בֹּקֶר׃

verses.english: Nations roar; kingdoms totter; He gives His voice; the earth melts.
verses.hebrew: הָמוּ גוֹיִם מָטוּ מַמְלָכוֹת נָתַן בְּקוֹלוֹ תָּמוּג אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: YHWH of hosts is with us; Jacob's God is our high refuge. Selah.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ מִשְׂגָּב־לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Come, see YHWH's deeds, who has made desolations upon the earth.
verses.hebrew: לְכוּ־חֲזוּ מִפְעֲלוֹת יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם שַׁמּוֹת בָּאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth; He breaks the bow and cuts the spear apart; He burns wagons in the fire.
verses.hebrew: מַשְׁבִּית מִלְחָמוֹת עַד־קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ קֶשֶׁת יְשַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּץ חֲנִית עֲגָלוֹת יִשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ׃

verses.english: “Let go, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, exalted in the earth.”
verses.hebrew: הַרְפּוּ וּדְעוּ כִּי־אָנֹכִי אֱלֹהִים אָרוּם בַּגּוֹיִם אָרוּם בָּאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: YHWH of hosts is with us; Jacob's God is our high refuge. Selah.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ מִשְׂגָּב־לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃

verses.english: For the director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר׃

verses.english: All peoples, clap your hands; shout to God with a voice of joy.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הָעַמִּים תִּקְעוּ־כָף הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהִים בְּקוֹל רִנָּה׃

verses.english: For YHWH Most High is awe-inspiring, a great King over all the earth.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן נוֹרָא מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: He subdues peoples beneath us and nations beneath our feet.
verses.hebrew: יַדְבֵּר עַמִּים תַּחְתֵּינוּ וּלְאֻמִּים תַּחַת רַגְלֵינוּ׃

verses.english: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob whom He loves. Selah.
verses.hebrew: יִבְחַר־לָנוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֵנוּ אֶת גְּאוֹן יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר־אָהֵב סֶלָה׃

verses.english: God has ascended with a shout, YHWH with the sound of a shofar.
verses.hebrew: עָלָה אֱלֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָה יְהֹוָה בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר׃

verses.english: Make music to God, make music; make music to our King, make music.
verses.hebrew: זַמְּרוּ אֱלֹהִים זַמֵּרוּ זַמְּרוּ לְמַלְכֵּנוּ זַמֵּרוּ׃

verses.english: For God is King of all the earth; sing a Maskil.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מֶלֶךְ כָּל־הָאָרֶץ אֱלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ מַשְׂכִּיל׃

verses.english: God reigns over nations; God sits upon His holy throne.
verses.hebrew: מָלַךְ אֱלֹהִים עַל־גּוֹיִם אֱלֹהִים יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא קָדְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: The nobles of peoples gather, the people of Abraham's God; for the earth's shields belong to God; He is greatly exalted.
verses.hebrew: נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים נֶאֱסָפוּ עַם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם כִּי לֵאלֹהִים מָגִנֵּי־אֶרֶץ מְאֹד נַעֲלָה׃

verses.english: A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח׃

verses.english: Great is YHWH and greatly praised in our God's city, His holy mountain.
verses.hebrew: גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד בְּעִיר אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַר־קָדְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: Beautiful in branching, the joy of all the earth, Mount Zion, the far northern reaches, the city of the great King.
verses.hebrew: יְפֵה נוֹף מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל־הָאָרֶץ הַר־צִיּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵי צָפוֹן קִרְיַת מֶלֶךְ רָב׃

verses.english: God is known in her citadels as a high refuge.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים בְּאַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ נוֹדַע לְמִשְׂגָּב׃

verses.english: For look, the kings assembled; they passed onward together.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִנֵּה הַמְּלָכִים נוֹעֲדוּ עָבְרוּ יַחְדָּו׃

verses.english: They saw and were amazed; they were alarmed and hurried away.
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה רָאוּ כֵּן תָּמָהוּ נִבְהֲלוּ נֶחְפָּזוּ׃

verses.english: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman giving birth.
verses.hebrew: רְעָדָה אֲחָזָתַם שָׁם חִיל כַּיּוֹלֵדָה׃

verses.english: With an east wind You shatter the ships of Tarshish.
verses.hebrew: בְּרוּחַ קָדִים תְּשַׁבֵּר אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ׃

verses.english: As we heard, so we have seen in YHWH of hosts' city, in our God's city; God will establish her forever. Selah.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ כֵּן רָאִינוּ בְּעִיר־יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת בְּעִיר אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֱלֹהִים יְכוֹנְנֶהָ עַד־עוֹלָם סֶלָה׃

verses.english: We waited, God, for Your steadfast love in the midst of Your temple.
verses.hebrew: דִּמִּינוּ אֱלֹהִים חַסְדֶּךָ בְּקֶרֶב הֵיכָלֶךָ׃

verses.english: As Your name, God, so Your praise reaches the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.hebrew: כְּשִׁמְךָ אֱלֹהִים כֵּן תְּהִלָּתְךָ עַל־קַצְוֵי־אֶרֶץ צֶדֶק מָלְאָה יְמִינֶךָ׃

verses.english: Let Mount Zion rejoice; let Judah's daughters exult because of Your judgments.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמַח הַר־צִיּוֹן תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנוֹת יְהוּדָה לְמַעַן מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Walk around Zion and encircle her; count her towers.
verses.hebrew: סֹבּוּ צִיּוֹן וְהַקִּיפוּהָ סִפְרוּ מִגְדָּלֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Set your heart upon her rampart; raise her citadels, so that you may tell a later generation.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיתוּ לִבְּכֶם לְחֵילָה פַּסְּגוּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ לְמַעַן תְּסַפְּרוּ לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן׃

verses.english: For this is God, our God forever and ever; He will guide us as in youth.
verses.hebrew: כִּי זֶה אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵינוּ עוֹלָם וָעֶד הוּא יְנַהֲגֵנוּ עַל־מוּת׃

verses.english: For the director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר׃

verses.english: Hear this, all peoples; give ear, all who inhabit the world,
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ־זֹאת כָּל־הָעַמִּים הַאֲזִינוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי חָלֶד׃

verses.english: both the children of humankind and the children of men, rich and needy together.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־בְּנֵי אָדָם גַּם־בְּנֵי־אִישׁ יַחַד עָשִׁיר וְאֶבְיוֹן׃

verses.english: My mouth will speak wisdoms, and my heart's meditation will be understanding.
verses.hebrew: פִּי יְדַבֵּר חָכְמוֹת וְהָגוּת לִבִּי תְבוּנוֹת׃

verses.english: I will incline my ear to a proverb; with a lyre I will open my riddle.
verses.hebrew: אַטֶּה לְמָשָׁל אָזְנִי אֶפְתַּח בְּכִנּוֹר חִידָתִי׃

verses.english: Why should I fear in evil days? The iniquity of my heels surrounds me.
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה אִירָא בִּימֵי רָע עֲוֺן עֲקֵבַי יְסוּבֵּנִי׃

verses.english: Those who trust in their possessions and boast in the abundance of their wealth,
verses.hebrew: הַבֹּטְחִים עַל־חֵילָם וּבְרֹב עָשְׁרָם יִתְהַלָּלוּ׃

verses.english: a person cannot possibly redeem a brother or give God his ransom,
verses.hebrew: אָח לֹא־פָדֹה יִפְדֶּה אִישׁ לֹא־יִתֵּן לֵאלֹהִים כָּפְרוֹ׃

verses.english: for the ransom of their soul is too costly; it must be relinquished forever,
verses.hebrew: וְיֵקַר פִּדְיוֹן נַפְשָׁם וְחָדַל לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: that he should live on forever and not see the Pit.
verses.hebrew: וִיחִי־עוֹד לָנֶצַח לֹא יִרְאֶה הַשָּׁחַת׃

verses.english: For he sees that wise people die; the fool and the senseless perish together and leave their possessions to others.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִרְאֶה חֲכָמִים יָמוּתוּ יַחַד כְּסִיל וָבַעַר יֹאבֵדוּ וְעָזְבוּ לַאֲחֵרִים חֵילָם׃

verses.english: Their inward thought is that their houses last forever, their dwellings from generation to generation; they call lands by their own names.
verses.hebrew: קִרְבָּם בָּתֵּימוֹ לְעוֹלָם מִשְׁכְּנֹתָם לְדֹר וָדֹר קָרְאוּ בִשְׁמוֹתָם עֲלֵי אֲדָמוֹת׃

verses.english: But a person in honor does not remain; he is compared to beasts made silent.
verses.hebrew: וְאָדָם בִּיקָר בַּל־יָלִין נִמְשַׁל כַּבְּהֵמוֹת נִדְמוּ׃

verses.english: This is their way, folly belonging to them; those coming after them recount it with their mouths. Selah.
verses.hebrew: זֶה דַרְכָּם כֵּסֶל לָמוֹ וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם בְּפִיהֶם יִרְצוּ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Like sheep they are set for Sheol; death devours them. The upright will rule over them in the morning; their form will outlast Sheol as its dwelling place.
verses.hebrew: כַּצֹּאן לִשְׁאוֹל שַׁתּוּ מָוֶת יִרְעֵם וַיִּרְדּוּ בָם יְשָׁרִים לַבֹּקֶר וצירם [וְצוּרָם] לְבַלּוֹת שְׁאוֹל מִזְּבֻל לוֹ׃

verses.english: But God will redeem my soul from Sheol's hand, for He will take me. Selah.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִים יִפְדֶּה נַפְשִׁי מִיַּד־שְׁאוֹל כִּי יִקָּחֵנִי סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Do not fear when a person becomes rich, when the glory of his house increases.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּירָא כִּי־יַעֲשִׁר אִישׁ כִּי־יִרְבֶּה כְּבוֹד בֵּיתוֹ׃

verses.english: For at his death he will take nothing; his glory will not descend after him.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא בְמוֹתוֹ יִקַּח הַכֹּל לֹא־יֵרֵד אַחֲרָיו כְּבוֹדוֹ׃

verses.english: Though he blesses his soul during his lifetime, people will praise you when you do well for yourself.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־נַפְשׁוֹ בְּחַיָּיו יְבָרֵךְ וְיוֹדֻךָ כִּי־תֵיטִיב לָךְ׃

verses.english: It will come to the generation of his fathers; they will never see light.
verses.hebrew: תָּבוֹא עַד־דּוֹר אֲבוֹתָיו עַד־נֵצַח לֹא יִרְאוּ־אוֹר׃

verses.english: A person in honor who does not understand is compared to beasts made silent.
verses.hebrew: אָדָם בִּיקָר וְלֹא יָבִין נִמְשַׁל כַּבְּהֵמוֹת נִדְמוּ׃

verses.english: A psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God, YHWH, speaks and summons the earth from the sun's rising to its setting.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֵל אֱ‍לֹהִים יְהוָה דִּבֶּר וַיִּקְרָא־אָרֶץ מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד־מְבֹאוֹ׃

verses.english: From Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines forth.
verses.hebrew: מִצִּיּוֹן מִכְלַל־יֹפִי אֱלֹהִים הוֹפִיעַ׃

verses.english: May our God come and not keep silent; fire devours before Him, and around Him a storm rages fiercely.
verses.hebrew: יָבֹא אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאַל־יֶחֱרַשׁ אֵשׁ־לְפָנָיו תֹּאכֵל וּסְבִיבָיו נִשְׂעֲרָה מְאֹד׃

verses.english: He summons the heavens above and the earth, to judge His people.
verses.hebrew: יִקְרָא אֶל־הַשָּׁמַיִם מֵעָל וְאֶל־הָאָרֶץ לָדִין עַמּוֹ׃

verses.english: “Gather My faithful ones to Me, those who cut My covenant over sacrifice.”
verses.hebrew: אִסְפוּ־לִי חֲסִידָי כֹּרְתֵי בְרִיתִי עֲלֵי־זָבַח׃

verses.english: The heavens declare His righteousness, for God Himself is judge. Selah.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּידוּ שָׁמַיִם צִדְקוֹ כִּי־אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפֵט הוּא סֶלָה׃

verses.english: “Hear, My people, and I will speak; Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעָה עַמִּי וַאֲדַבֵּרָה יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָעִידָה בָּךְ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֶיךָ אָנֹכִי׃

verses.english: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices; your burnt offerings are always before Me.
verses.hebrew: לֹא עַל־זְבָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶךָ וְעוֹלֹתֶיךָ לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד׃

verses.english: I will not take a bull from your house or male goats from your pens.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־אֶקַּח מִבֵּיתְךָ פָר מִמִּכְלְאֹתֶיךָ עַתּוּדִים׃

verses.english: For every forest creature is Mine, the beasts on a thousand hills.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־לִי כָל־חַיְתוֹ־יָעַר בְּהֵמוֹת בְּהַרְרֵי־אָלֶף׃

verses.english: I know every bird of the mountains, and the moving life of the field is with Me.
verses.hebrew: יָדַעְתִּי כָּל־עוֹף הָרִים וְזִיז שָׂדַי עִמָּדִי׃

verses.english: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world and its fullness are Mine.
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶרְעַב לֹא־אֹמַר לָךְ כִּי־לִי תֵבֵל וּמְלֹאָהּ׃

verses.english: Do I eat the flesh of mighty bulls or drink the blood of male goats?
verses.hebrew: הַאוֹכַל בְּשַׂר אַבִּירִים וְדַם עַתּוּדִים אֶשְׁתֶּה׃

verses.english: Sacrifice thanksgiving to God and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
verses.hebrew: זְבַח לֵאלֹהִים תּוֹדָה וְשַׁלֵּם לְעֶלְיוֹן נְדָרֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Call on Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”
verses.hebrew: וּקְרָאֵנִי בְּיוֹם צָרָה אֲחַלֶּצְךָ וּתְכַבְּדֵנִי׃

verses.english: But to the wicked God says, “What right have you to recount My statutes and take My covenant upon your mouth?
verses.hebrew: וְלָרָשָׁע אָמַר אֱלֹהִים מַה־לְּךָ לְסַפֵּר חֻקָּי וַתִּשָּׂא בְרִיתִי עֲלֵי־פִיךָ׃

verses.english: You hate discipline and cast My words behind you.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה שָׂנֵאתָ מוּסָר וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ דְּבָרַי אַחֲרֶיךָ׃

verses.english: If you see a thief, you are pleased with him; your portion is with adulterers.
verses.hebrew: אִם־רָאִיתָ גַנָּב וַתִּרֶץ עִמּוֹ וְעִם מְנָאֲפִים חֶלְקֶךָ׃

verses.english: You release your mouth into evil, and your tongue binds deceit together.
verses.hebrew: פִּיךָ שָׁלַחְתָּ בְרָעָה וּלְשׁוֹנְךָ תַּצְמִיד מִרְמָה׃

verses.english: You sit and speak against your brother; you put a slur upon your mother's son.
verses.hebrew: תֵּשֵׁב בְּאָחִיךָ תְדַבֵּר בְּבֶן־אִמְּךָ תִּתֶּן־דֹּפִי׃

verses.english: These things you did, and I kept silent; you imagined I would be just like you. I will rebuke you and lay it out before your eyes.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה עָשִׂיתָ וְהֶחֱרַשְׁתִּי דִּמִּיתָ הֱיוֹת־אֶהְיֶה כָמוֹךָ אוֹכִיחֲךָ וְאֶעֶרְכָה לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Understand this, you who forget God, lest I tear you apart with no deliverer.
verses.hebrew: בִּינוּ־נָא זֹאת שֹׁכְחֵי אֱלוֹהַּ פֶּן־אֶטְרֹף וְאֵין מַצִּיל׃

verses.english: One who sacrifices thanksgiving honors Me; to one who orders the way I will show God's salvation.”
verses.hebrew: זֹבֵחַ תּוֹדָה יְכַבְּדָנְנִי וְשָׂם דֶּרֶךְ אַרְאֶנּוּ בְּיֵשַׁע אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: For the director. A psalm of David,
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.
verses.hebrew: בְּבוֹא־אֵלָיו נָתָן הַנָּבִיא כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֶל־בַּת־שָׁבַע׃

verses.english: Be gracious to me, God, according to Your steadfast love; according to Your abundant compassion, blot out my rebellions.
verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים כְּחַסְדֶּךָ כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ מְחֵה פְשָׁעָי׃

verses.english: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.hebrew: הרבה [הֶרֶב] כַּבְּסֵנִי מֵעֲוֺנִי וּמֵחַטָּאתִי טַהֲרֵנִי׃

verses.english: For I know my rebellions, and my sin is always before me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־פְשָׁעַי אֲנִי אֵדָע וְחַטָּאתִי נֶגְדִּי תָמִיד׃

verses.english: Against You, You alone, I sinned and did evil in Your eyes, so that You are righteous in Your word and pure when You judge.
verses.hebrew: לְךָ לְבַדְּךָ חָטָאתִי וְהָרַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי לְמַעַן תִּצְדַּק בְּדָבְרֶךָ תִּזְכֶּה בְשָׁפְטֶךָ׃

verses.english: Look, I was brought forth in iniquity, and in sin my mother conceived me.
verses.hebrew: הֵן־בְּעָווֹן חוֹלָלְתִּי וּבְחֵטְא יֶחֱמַתְנִי אִמִּי׃

verses.english: Look, You desire truth in the inward parts; in the hidden place You teach me wisdom.
verses.hebrew: הֵן־אֱמֶת חָפַצְתָּ בַטֻּחוֹת וּבְסָתֻם חָכְמָה תוֹדִיעֵנִי׃

verses.english: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
verses.hebrew: תְּחַטְּאֵנִי בְאֵזוֹב וְאֶטְהָר תְּכַבְּסֵנִי וּמִשֶּׁלֶג אַלְבִּין׃

verses.english: Let me hear joy and gladness. Let the bones You crushed rejoice.
verses.hebrew: תַּשְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה תָּגֵלְנָה עֲצָמוֹת דִּכִּיתָ׃

verses.english: Hide Your face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.
verses.hebrew: הַסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מֵחֲטָאָי וְכָל־עֲוֺנֹתַי מְחֵה׃

verses.english: God, create a clean heart for me, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.
verses.hebrew: לֵב טָהוֹר בְּרָא־לִי אֱלֹהִים וְרוּחַ נָכוֹן חַדֵּשׁ בְּקִרְבִּי׃

verses.english: Do not cast me away from Your presence, and do not take Your holy spirit from me.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְרוּחַ קָדְשְׁךָ אַל־תִּקַּח מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and let a noble spirit sustain me.
verses.hebrew: הָשִׁיבָה לִּי שְׂשׂוֹן יִשְׁעֶךָ וְרוּחַ נְדִיבָה תִסְמְכֵנִי׃

verses.english: I will teach rebels Your ways, and sinners will return to You.
verses.hebrew: אֲלַמְּדָה פֹשְׁעִים דְּרָכֶיךָ וְחַטָּאִים אֵלֶיךָ יָשׁוּבוּ׃

verses.english: Deliver me from bloodshed, God, God of my salvation; my tongue will sing aloud of Your righteousness.
verses.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי מִדָּמִים אֱ‍לֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי תְּשׁוּעָתִי תְּרַנֵּן לְשׁוֹנִי צִדְקָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃

verses.english: For You do not desire sacrifice, or I would give it; You do not delight in a burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־תַחְפֹּץ זֶבַח וְאֶתֵּנָה עוֹלָה לֹא תִרְצֶה׃

verses.english: God's sacrifices are a broken spirit; a broken and crushed heart, God, You will not despise.
verses.hebrew: זִבְחֵי אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ נִשְׁבָּרָה לֵב־נִשְׁבָּר וְנִדְכֶּה אֱלֹהִים לֹא תִבְזֶה׃

verses.english: Do good to Zion in Your favor; build Jerusalem's walls.
verses.hebrew: הֵיטִיבָה בִרְצוֹנְךָ אֶת־צִיּוֹן תִּבְנֶה חוֹמוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, burnt offering and whole offering; then bulls will be offered upon Your altar.
verses.hebrew: אָז תַּחְפֹּץ זִבְחֵי־צֶדֶק עוֹלָה וְכָלִיל אָז יַעֲלוּ עַל־מִזְבַּחֲךָ פָרִים׃

verses.english: For the director. A Maskil of David,
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: when Doeg the Edomite came and reported to Saul, and said to him, “David came to Ahimelech's house.”
verses.hebrew: בְּבוֹא דּוֹאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי וַיַּגֵּד לְשָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בָּא דָוִד אֶל־בֵּית אֲחִימֶלֶךְ׃

verses.english: Why do you boast in evil, mighty one? God's steadfast love lasts all day.
verses.hebrew: מַה־תִּתְהַלֵּל בְּרָעָה הַגִּבּוֹר חֶסֶד אֵל כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: Your tongue devises destruction, like a sharpened razor, working deceit.
verses.hebrew: הַוּוֹת תַּחְשֹׁב לְשׁוֹנֶךָ כְּתַעַר מְלֻטָּשׁ עֹשֵׂה רְמִיָּה׃

verses.english: You love evil more than good, falsehood more than speaking righteousness. Selah.
verses.hebrew: אָהַבְתָּ רָּע מִטּוֹב שֶׁקֶר מִדַּבֵּר צֶדֶק סֶלָה׃

verses.english: You love every devouring word, you deceitful tongue.
verses.hebrew: אָהַבְתָּ כָל־דִּבְרֵי־בָלַע לְשׁוֹן מִרְמָה׃

verses.english: So God will tear you down forever; He will seize you and tear you from the tent and uproot you from the land of the living. Selah.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֵל יִתָּצְךָ לָנֶצַח יַחְתְּךָ וְיִסָּחֲךָ מֵאֹהֶל וְשֵׁרֶשְׁךָ מֵאֶרֶץ חַיִּים סֶלָה׃

verses.english: The righteous will see and fear; they will laugh at him:
verses.hebrew: וְיִרְאוּ צַדִּיקִים וְיִירָאוּ וְעָלָיו יִשְׂחָקוּ׃

verses.english: “Look at the man who did not make God his stronghold, but trusted in his great wealth and made himself strong in his destruction.”
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה הַגֶּבֶר לֹא יָשִׂים אֱלֹהִים מָעוּזּוֹ וַיִּבְטַח בְּרֹב עָשְׁרוֹ יָעֹז בְּהַוָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: But I am like a flourishing olive tree in God's house; I trust in God's steadfast love forever and ever.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי כְּזַיִת רַעֲנָן בְּבֵית אֱלֹהִים בָּטַחְתִּי בְחֶסֶד־אֱלֹהִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד׃

verses.english: I will thank You forever, because You have acted; I will wait for Your name, for it is good, in the presence of Your faithful ones.
verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי עָשִׂיתָ וַאֲקַוֶּה שִׁמְךָ כִי־טוֹב נֶגֶד חֲסִידֶיךָ׃

verses.english: For the director. According to Mahalath. A Maskil of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מָחֲלַת מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt and commit abominable injustice; there is no one doing good.
verses.hebrew: אָמַר נָבָל בְּלִבּוֹ אֵין אֱלֹהִים הִשְׁחִיתוּ וְהִתְעִיבוּ עָוֶל אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב׃

verses.english: God looks down from heaven upon humankind, to see whether anyone has understanding, anyone seeks God.
verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁקִיף עַל־בְּנֵי אָדָם לִרְאוֹת הֲיֵשׁ מַשְׂכִּיל דֹּרֵשׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: All have turned aside; together they have become foul; there is no one doing good, not even one.
verses.hebrew: כֻּלּוֹ סָג יַחְדָּו נֶאֱלָחוּ אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב אֵין גַּם־אֶחָד׃

verses.english: Do the workers of wrongdoing not know, those who eat my people as they eat bread and do not call on God?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא יָדְעוּ פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן אֹכְלֵי עַמִּי אָכְלוּ לֶחֶם אֱלֹהִים לֹא קָרָאוּ׃

verses.english: There they feared greatly where there was no fear, for God scattered the bones of those encamped against you. You put them to shame, for God rejected them.
verses.hebrew: שָׁם פָּחֲדוּ־פַחַד לֹא־הָיָה פָחַד כִּי־אֱלֹהִים פִּזַּר עַצְמוֹת חֹנָךְ הֱבִשֹׁתָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מְאָסָם׃

verses.english: Who will give Israel's deliverances from Zion? When God restores His people's fortunes, let Jacob exult and Israel rejoice.
verses.hebrew: מִי יִתֵּן מִצִּיּוֹן יְשֻׁעוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשׁוּב אֱלֹהִים שְׁבוּת עַמּוֹ יָגֵל יַעֲקֹב יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: For the director. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינֹת מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: When the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Is David not hiding among us?”
verses.hebrew: בְּבוֹא הַזִּיפִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְשָׁאוּל הֲלֹא דָוִד מִסְתַּתֵּר עִמָּנוּ׃

verses.english: God, save me by Your name; avenge me by Your might.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים בְּשִׁמְךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי וּבִגְבוּרָתְךָ תְדִינֵנִי׃

verses.english: God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים שְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה לְאִמְרֵי־פִי׃

verses.english: For strangers have risen against me, and ruthless men seek my soul; they have not set God before them. Selah.
verses.hebrew: כִּי זָרִים קָמוּ עָלַי וְעָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי לֹא שָׂמוּ אֱלֹהִים לְנֶגְדָּם סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Look, God helps me; the Lord is among those sustaining my soul.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אֱלֹהִים עֹזֵר לִי אֲדֹנָי בְּסֹמְכֵי נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: He will return the evil to those watching for me; in Your faithfulness, destroy them.
verses.hebrew: ישוב [יָשִׁיב] הָרַע לְשֹׁרְרָי בַּאֲמִתְּךָ הַצְמִיתֵם׃

verses.english: I will sacrifice to You freely; I will thank Your name, YHWH, for it is good.
verses.hebrew: בִּנְדָבָה אֶזְבְּחָה־לָּךְ אוֹדֶה שִּׁמְךָ יְהוָה כִּי־טוֹב׃

verses.english: For He rescued me from every trouble, and my eye has looked upon my enemies.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מִכָּל־צָרָה הִצִּילָנִי וּבְאֹיְבַי רָאֲתָה עֵינִי׃

verses.english: For the director. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינֹת מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: Give ear, God, to my prayer, and do not hide Yourself from my plea.
verses.hebrew: הַאֲזִינָה אֱלֹהִים תְּפִלָּתִי וְאַל־תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתִי׃

verses.english: Attend to me and answer me; I lament in my complaint and moan,
verses.hebrew: הַקְשִׁיבָה לִּי וַעֲנֵנִי אָרִיד בְּשִׂיחִי וְאָהִימָה׃

verses.english: because of the enemy's voice, because of the wicked one's pressure; for they heap wrongdoing upon me and hate me in anger.
verses.hebrew: מִקּוֹל אוֹיֵב מִפְּנֵי עָקַת רָשָׁע כִּי־יָמִיטוּ עָלַי אָוֶן וּבְאַף יִשְׂטְמוּנִי׃

verses.english: My heart writhes within me, and terrors of death have fallen upon me.
verses.hebrew: לִבִּי יָחִיל בְּקִרְבִּי וְאֵימוֹת מָוֶת נָפְלוּ עָלָי׃

verses.english: Fear and trembling enter me, and horror covers me.
verses.hebrew: יִרְאָה וָרַעַד יָבֹא בִי וַתְּכַסֵּנִי פַּלָּצוּת׃

verses.english: I said, “Who will give me a wing like a dove's? I would fly away and settle down.
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר מִי־יִתֶּן־לִּי אֵבֶר כַּיּוֹנָה אָעוּפָה וְאֶשְׁכֹּנָה׃

verses.english: Look, I would wander far away; I would lodge in the wilderness. Selah.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אַרְחִיק נְדֹד אָלִין בַּמִּדְבָּר סֶלָה׃

verses.english: I would hasten to a refuge for myself from the sweeping wind, from the storm.”
verses.hebrew: אָחִישָׁה מִפְלָט לִי מֵרוּחַ סֹעָה מִסָּעַר׃

verses.english: Destroy, Lord; divide their tongue, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.hebrew: בַּלַּע אֲדֹנָי פַּלַּג לְשׁוֹנָם כִּי־רָאִיתִי חָמָס וְרִיב בָּעִיר׃

verses.english: Day and night they circle it upon its walls; wrongdoing and trouble are within it.
verses.hebrew: יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה יְסוֹבְבֻהָ עַל־חוֹמֹתֶיהָ וְאָוֶן וְעָמָל בְּקִרְבָּהּ׃

verses.english: Destruction is within it; blows and deceit do not leave its square.
verses.hebrew: הַוּוֹת בְּקִרְבָּהּ וְלֹא־יָמִישׁ מֵרְחֹבָהּ תֹּךְ וּמִרְמָה׃

verses.english: For it is no enemy who reproaches me, so that I should bear it; no hater of mine magnifies himself against me, so that I should hide from him.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־אוֹיֵב יְחָרְפֵנִי וְאֶשָּׂא לֹא־מְשַׂנְאִי עָלַי הִגְדִּיל וְאֶסָּתֵר מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: But you, a man my equal, my chief and my esteemed companion,
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אֱנוֹשׁ כְּעֶרְכִּי אַלּוּפִי וּמְיֻדָּעִי׃

verses.english: with whom we made counsel sweet together, walking in God's house among the throng!
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר יַחְדָּו נַמְתִּיק סוֹד בְּבֵית אֱלֹהִים נְהַלֵּךְ בְּרָגֶשׁ׃

verses.english: May He stir death against them; may they descend alive to Sheol, for evils are in their dwelling, within them.
verses.hebrew: ישימות [יַשִּׁי] [מָוֶת ] עָלֵימוֹ יֵרְדוּ שְׁאוֹל חַיִּים כִּי־רָעוֹת בִּמְגוּרָם בְּקִרְבָּם׃

verses.english: As for me, I will call to God, and YHWH will save me.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִים אֶקְרָא וַיהוָה יוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃

verses.english: Evening, morning and noon I will complain and moan, and He heard my voice.
verses.hebrew: עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרַיִם אָשִׂיחָה וְאֶהֱמֶה וַיִּשְׁמַע קוֹלִי׃

verses.english: He redeemed my soul in peace from the battle against me, for many were with me.
verses.hebrew: פָּדָה בְשָׁלוֹם נַפְשִׁי מִקֲּרָב־לִי כִּי־בְרַבִּים הָיוּ עִמָּדִי׃
