verses.english: May God hear and answer them, He who sits enthroned from of old. Selah. Those who have no change do not fear God.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׁמַע אֵל וְיַעֲנֵם וְיֹשֵׁב קֶדֶם סֶלָה אֲשֶׁר אֵין חֲלִיפוֹת לָמוֹ וְלֹא יָרְאוּ אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: He stretched out his hands against those at peace with him; he profaned his covenant.
verses.hebrew: שָׁלַח יָדָיו בִּשְׁלֹמָיו חִלֵּל בְּרִיתוֹ׃

verses.english: The buttery words of his mouth were smooth, but his heart was at war; his words were softer than oil, yet they were curses.
verses.hebrew: חָלְקוּ מַחְמָאֹת פִּיו וּקֲרָב־לִבּוֹ רַכּוּ דְבָרָיו מִשֶּׁמֶן וְהֵמָּה פְתִחוֹת׃

verses.english: Cast your burden upon YHWH, and He will sustain you; He will never allow the righteous to be shaken.
verses.hebrew: הַשְׁלֵךְ עַל־יְהוָה יְהָבְךָ וְהוּא יְכַלְכְּלֶךָ לֹא־יִתֵּן לְעוֹלָם מוֹט לַצַּדִּיק׃

verses.english: But You, God, will bring them down to the pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אֱלֹהִים תּוֹרִדֵם לִבְאֵר שַׁחַת אַנְשֵׁי דָמִים וּמִרְמָה לֹא־יֶחֱצוּ יְמֵיהֶם וַאֲנִי אֶבְטַח־בָּךְ׃

verses.english: For the director. According to “The mute dove far away.” Of David. A Miktam, when the Philistines seized him in Gath.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־יוֹנַת אֵלֶם רְחֹקִים לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בֶּאֱחֹז אֹתוֹ פְלִשְׁתִּים בְּגַת׃

verses.english: Be gracious to me, God, for a man pants to swallow me; all day a warrior oppresses me.
verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים כִּי־שְׁאָפַנִי אֱנוֹשׁ כָּל־הַיּוֹם לֹחֵם יִלְחָצֵנִי׃

verses.english: Those watching for me pant to swallow me all day, for many fight against me, O Most High.
verses.hebrew: שָׁאֲפוּ שׁוֹרְרַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם כִּי־רַבִּים לֹחֲמִים לִי מָרוֹם׃

verses.english: On the day I fear, I will trust in You.
verses.hebrew: יוֹם אִירָא אֲנִי אֵלֶיךָ אֶבְטָח׃

verses.english: In God I will praise His word; in God I have trusted; I will not fear. What can flesh do to me?
verses.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּל דְּבָרוֹ בֵּאלֹהִים בָּטַחְתִּי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה בָשָׂר לִי׃

verses.english: All day my words are grief; all their thoughts against me are for evil.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַיּוֹם דְּבָרַי יְעַצֵּבוּ עָלַי כָּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָם לָרָע׃

verses.english: They lodge and hide; they watch my heels, as they wait for my soul.
verses.hebrew: יָגוּרוּ יצפינו [יִצְפּוֹנוּ] הֵמָּה עֲקֵבַי יִשְׁמֹרוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר קִוּוּ נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: For wrongdoing they expect escape; in anger bring down peoples, God.
verses.hebrew: עַל־אָוֶן פַּלֶּט־לָמוֹ בְּאַף עַמִּים הוֹרֵד אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: You Yourself have counted my wanderings; put my tears in Your skin-bottle. Are they not in Your reckoning?
verses.hebrew: נֹדִי סָפַרְתָּה אָתָּה שִׂימָה דִמְעָתִי בְנֹאדֶךָ הֲלֹא בְּסִפְרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Then my enemies will turn back on the day I call. This I know: God is for me.
verses.hebrew: אָז יָשׁוּבוּ אוֹיְבַי אָחוֹר בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא זֶה־יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־אֱלֹהִים לִי׃

verses.english: In God I will praise a word; in YHWH I will praise a word.
verses.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּל דָּבָר בַּיהוָה אֲהַלֵּל דָּבָר׃

verses.english: In God I have trusted; I will not fear. What can a human being do to me?
verses.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים בָּטַחְתִּי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה אָדָם לִי׃

verses.english: God, vows to You are upon me; I will pay thank offerings to You.
verses.hebrew: עָלַי אֱלֹהִים נְדָרֶיךָ אֲשַׁלֵּם תּוֹדֹת לָךְ׃

verses.english: for You rescued my soul from death— have You not also rescued my feet from stumbling?— that I may walk before God in the light of the living.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הִצַּלְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִמָּוֶת הֲלֹא רַגְלַי מִדֶּחִי לְהִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים בְּאוֹר הַחַיִּים׃

verses.english: For the director. “Do not destroy.” Of David. A Miktam, when he fled from Saul in the cave.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בְּבָרְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי־שָׁאוּל בַּמְּעָרָה׃

verses.english: Be gracious to me, God, be gracious to me, for my soul has taken refuge in You; in the shadow of Your wings I will take refuge until destruction passes.
verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים חָנֵּנִי כִּי בְךָ חָסָיָה נַפְשִׁי וּבְצֵל־כְּנָפֶיךָ אֶחְסֶה עַד יַעֲבֹר הַוּוֹת׃

verses.english: I will call to God Most High, to God who fulfills His purpose for me.
verses.hebrew: אֶקְרָא לֵאלֹהִים עֶלְיוֹן לָאֵל גֹּמֵר עָלָי׃

verses.english: He will send from heaven and save me; He reproaches the one panting to swallow me. Selah. God will send His steadfast love and His faithfulness.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח מִשָּׁמַיִם וְיוֹשִׁיעֵנִי חֵרֵף שֹׁאֲפִי סֶלָה יִשְׁלַח אֱלֹהִים חַסְדּוֹ וַאֲמִתּוֹ׃

verses.english: My soul is among lions; I lie down among those burning with rage— human beings whose teeth are spear and arrows, and whose tongue is a sharp sword.
verses.hebrew: נַפְשִׁי בְּתוֹךְ לְבָאִם אֶשְׁכְּבָה לֹהֲטִים בְּנֵי־אָדָם שִׁנֵּיהֶם חֲנִית וְחִצִּים וּלְשׁוֹנָם חֶרֶב חַדָּה׃

verses.english: Be exalted above the heavens, God; let Your glory be above all the earth.
verses.hebrew: רוּמָה עַל־הַשָּׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים עַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃

verses.english: They prepared a net for my steps; he bowed my soul down. They dug a pit before me; they fell into it. Selah.
verses.hebrew: רֶשֶׁת הֵכִינוּ לִפְעָמַי כָּפַף נַפְשִׁי כָּרוּ לְפָנַי שִׁיחָה נָפְלוּ בְתוֹכָהּ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: My heart is steadfast, God; my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.
verses.hebrew: נָכוֹן לִבִּי אֱלֹהִים נָכוֹן לִבִּי אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמֵּרָה׃

verses.english: Awake, my glory; awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
verses.hebrew: עוּרָה כְבוֹדִי עוּרָה הַנֵּבֶל וְכִנּוֹר אָעִירָה שָּׁחַר׃

verses.english: I will thank You among peoples, Lord; I will make music to You among nations.
verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ בָעַמִּים אֲדֹנָי אֲזַמֶּרְךָ בַּל־אֻמִּים׃

verses.english: For Your steadfast love is great to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־גָדֹל עַד־שָׁמַיִם חַסְדֶּךָ וְעַד־שְׁחָקִים אֲמִתֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Be exalted above the heavens, God; let Your glory be above all the earth.
verses.hebrew: רוּמָה עַל־שָׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים עַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃

verses.english: For the director. “Do not destroy.” Of David. A Miktam.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם׃

verses.english: Is the righteousness you ought to speak indeed silenced— the upright judgments you ought to give the children of humankind?
verses.hebrew: הַאֻמְנָם אֵלֶם צֶדֶק תְּדַבֵּרוּן מֵישָׁרִים תִּשְׁפְּטוּ בְּנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: Indeed, in your heart you work injustices; on earth you weigh out the violence of your hands.
verses.hebrew: אַף־בְּלֵב עוֹלֹת תִּפְעָלוּן בָּאָרֶץ חֲמַס יְדֵיכֶם תְּפַלֵּסוּן׃

verses.english: The wicked are estranged from the womb; from the belly, speakers of falsehood go astray.
verses.hebrew: זֹרוּ רְשָׁעִים מֵרָחֶם תָּעוּ מִבֶּטֶן דֹּבְרֵי כָזָב׃

verses.english: Their venom is like a serpent's venom, like a deaf cobra that shuts its ear,
verses.hebrew: חֲמַת־לָמוֹ כִּדְמוּת חֲמַת־נָחָשׁ כְּמוֹ־פֶתֶן חֵרֵשׁ יַאְטֵם אָזְנוֹ׃

verses.english: which does not hear the voice of charmers, or the skilled caster of spells.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִשְׁמַע לְקוֹל מְלַחֲשִׁים חוֹבֵר חֲבָרִים מְחֻכָּם׃

verses.english: God, tear down their teeth in their mouth; shatter the young lions' molars, YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים הֲרָס־שִׁנֵּימוֹ בְּפִימוֹ מַלְתְּעוֹת כְּפִירִים נְתֹץ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Let them be cast away and run off like water. He will aim His arrows, and they will be cut down.
verses.hebrew: יִמָּאֲסוּ כְמוֹ־מַיִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ־לָמוֹ יִדְרֹךְ חצו [חִצָּיו] כְּמוֹ יִתְמֹלָלוּ׃

verses.english: Like a snail melting as it goes, like a stillbirth and a mole, they have not seen the sun.
verses.hebrew: כְּמוֹ שַׁבְּלוּל תֶּמֶס יַהֲלֹךְ נֵפֶל אֵשֶׁת בַּל־חָזוּ שָׁמֶשׁ׃

verses.english: Before your tender thorns know the buckthorn, with vigor and with wrath He will sweep them away.
verses.hebrew: בְּטֶרֶם יָבִינוּ סִּירֹתֵיכֶם אָטָד כְּמוֹ־חַי כְּמוֹ־חָרוֹן יִשְׂעָרֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: The righteous will rejoice when he sees vengeance; he will wash his feet in the wicked one's blood.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמַח צַדִּיק כִּי־חָזָה נָקָם פְּעָמָיו יִרְחַץ בְּדַם הָרָשָׁע׃

verses.english: A human being will say, “Surely there is fruit for the righteous; surely there is God judging on earth.”
verses.hebrew: וְיֹאמַר אָדָם אַךְ־פְּרִי לַצַּדִּיק אַךְ יֵשׁ־אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפְטִים בָּאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: For the director. “Do not destroy.” Of David. A Miktam, when Saul sent men and they watched the house to kill him.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בִּשְׁלֹחַ שָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁמְרוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃

verses.english: Rescue me from my enemies, my God; set me high above those rising against me.
verses.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבַי אֱלֹהָי מִּמִתְקוֹמְמַי תְּשַׂגְּבֵנִי׃

verses.english: Rescue me from those working wrongdoing; save me from men of bloodshed.
verses.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי מִפֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן וּמֵאַנְשֵׁי דָמִים הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃

verses.english: For look, they lie in wait for my soul; strong men lodge against me— not for my rebellion or my sin, YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הִנֵּה אָרְבוּ לְנַפְשִׁי יָגוּרוּ עָלַי עַזִים לֹא־פִשְׁעִי וְלֹא־חַטָּאתִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Without guilt of mine they run and prepare themselves. Awake to meet me, and see!
verses.hebrew: בְּלִי־עָוֺן יְרוּצוּן וְיִכּוֹנָנוּ עוּרָה לִקְרָאתִי וּרְאֵה׃

verses.english: You, YHWH, God of hosts, God of Israel, awake to visit all the nations; show no grace to any treacherous workers of wrongdoing. Selah.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה־אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָקִיצָה לִפְקֹד כָּל־הַגּוֹיִם אַל־תָּחֹן כָּל־בֹּגְדֵי אָוֶן סֶלָה׃

verses.english: They return at evening, growling like a dog, and circle the city.
verses.hebrew: יָשׁוּבוּ לָעֶרֶב יֶהֱמוּ כַכָּלֶב וִיסוֹבְבוּ עִיר׃

verses.english: Look, they pour forth with their mouths; swords are on their lips, for they say, “Who hears?”
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יַבִּיעוּן בְּפִיהֶם חֲרָבוֹת בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶם כִּי־מִי שֹׁמֵעַ׃

verses.english: But You, YHWH, laugh at them; You mock all nations.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה תִּשְׂחַק־לָמוֹ תִּלְעַג לְכָל־גּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: Because of his strength, I will watch for You, for God is my stronghold.
verses.hebrew: עֻזּוֹ אֵלֶיךָ אֶשְׁמֹרָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מִשְׂגַּבִּי׃

verses.english: The God of my steadfast love will meet me first; God will let me look upon those watching for me.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵי חסדו [חַסְדִּי] יְקַדְּמֵנִי אֱלֹהִים יַרְאֵנִי בְשֹׁרְרָי׃

verses.english: Do not kill them, lest my people forget; make them wander by Your power and bring them down, our shield, Lord.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּהַרְגֵם פֶּן־יִשְׁכְּחוּ עַמִּי הֲנִיעֵמוֹ בְחֵילְךָ וְהוֹרִידֵמוֹ מָגִנֵּנוּ אֲדֹנָי׃

verses.english: The sin of their mouth is the word of their lips; the poor are trapped through their arrogance, and through the curse and falsehood they recount.
verses.hebrew: חַטַּאת־פִּימוֹ דְּבַר־שְׂפָתֵימוֹ וְיִלָּכְדוּ בִגְאוֹנָם וּמֵאָלָה וּמִכַּחַשׁ יְסַפֵּרוּ׃

verses.english: Consume in wrath, consume until they are no more, that they may know God rules in Jacob to the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.hebrew: כַּלֵּה בְחֵמָה כַּלֵּה וְאֵינֵמוֹ וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מֹשֵׁל בְּיַעֲקֹב לְאַפְסֵי הָאָרֶץ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: They return at evening, growling like a dog, and circle the city.
verses.hebrew: וְיָשׁוּבוּ לָעֶרֶב יֶהֱמוּ כַכָּלֶב וִיסוֹבְבוּ עִיר׃

verses.english: They roam for food; if they are not satisfied, they stay the night.
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה ינועון [יְנִיעוּן] לֶאֱכֹל אִם־לֹא יִשְׂבְּעוּ וַיָּלִינוּ׃

verses.english: But I will sing of Your strength; in the morning I will shout joyfully of Your steadfast love, for You have been my stronghold and a refuge in the day of my trouble.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אָשִׁיר עֻזֶּךָ וַאֲרַנֵּן לַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ כִּי־הָיִיתָ מִשְׂגָּב לִי וּמָנוֹס בְּיוֹם צַר־לִי׃

verses.english: My strength, I will make music to You, for God is my stronghold, the God of my steadfast love.
verses.hebrew: עֻזִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֲזַמֵּרָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מִשְׂגַּבִּי אֱלֹהֵי חַסְדִּי׃

verses.english: For the director. According to “Lily of testimony.” A Miktam of David, for teaching.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שׁוּשַׁן עֵדוּת מִכְתָּם לְדָוִד לְלַמֵּד׃

verses.english: When he fought Aram-Naharaim and Aram-Zobah, and Joab returned and struck twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt.
verses.hebrew: בְּהַצּוֹתוֹ אֶת אֲרַם נַהֲרַיִם וְאֶת־אֲרַם צוֹבָה וַיָּשָׁב יוֹאָב וַיַּךְ אֶת־אֱדוֹם בְּגֵיא־מֶלַח שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אָלֶף׃

verses.english: God, You rejected us and broke through us; You were angry; restore Your favor to us.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ פְרַצְתָּנוּ אָנַפְתָּ תְּשׁוֹבֵב לָנוּ׃

verses.english: You shook the earth and split it; heal its breaches, for it totters.
verses.hebrew: הִרְעַשְׁתָּה אֶרֶץ פְּצַמְתָּהּ רְפָה שְׁבָרֶיהָ כִי־מָטָה׃

verses.english: You showed Your people hardship; You made us drink wine of bewilderment.
verses.hebrew: הִרְאִיתָה עַמְּךָ קָשָׁה הִשְׁקִיתָנוּ יַיִן תַּרְעֵלָה׃

verses.english: You gave those who fear You a trial to be tested, for the sake of beauty. Selah.
verses.hebrew: נָתַתָּה לִּירֵאֶיךָ נֵּס לְהִתְנוֹסֵס מִפְּנֵי קֹשֶׁט סֶלָה׃

verses.english: So that those You love may be rescued, save them with Your right hand and answer me.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ ועננו [וַעֲנֵנִי׃]

verses.english: God spoke in His sanctuary: I will exult; I will divide a portion, and measure the Valley of Succoth.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים דִּבֶּר בְּקָדְשׁוֹ אֶעְלֹזָה אֲחַלְּקָה שְׁכֶם וְעֵמֶק סֻכּוֹת אֲמַדֵּד׃

verses.english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the stronghold of my head; Judah is my lawgiver.
verses.hebrew: לִי גִלְעָד וְלִי מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרַיִם מָעוֹז רֹאשִׁי יְהוּדָה מְחֹקְקִי׃

verses.english: Moab is my washbasin; upon Edom I will cast my lock; Philistia, join yourself to me.
verses.hebrew: מוֹאָב סִיר רַחְצִי עַל־אֱדוֹם אַשְׁלִיךְ נַעֲלִי עָלַי פְּלֶשֶׁת הִתְרֹעָעִי׃

verses.english: Who will bring me to a fortified city? Who has led me as far as Edom?
verses.hebrew: מִי יֹבִלֵנִי עִיר מָצוֹר מִי נָחַנִי עַד־אֱדוֹם׃

verses.english: Is it not You, God, who rejected us? Yet You do not go out, God, with our armies.
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ וְלֹא־תֵצֵא אֱלֹהִים בְּצִבְאוֹתֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Give us help against the foe, for human deliverance is empty.
verses.hebrew: הָבָה־לָּנוּ עֶזְרָת מִצָּר וְשָׁוְא תְּשׁוּעַת אָדָם׃

verses.english: Through God we will act with might, and He will trample our foes.
verses.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים נַעֲשֶׂה־חָיִל וְהוּא יָבוּס צָרֵינוּ׃

verses.english: For the director. With a stringed instrument. Of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־נְגִינַת לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: Hear my cry, God; attend to my prayer.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעָה אֱלֹהִים רִנָּתִי הַקְשִׁיבָה תְּפִלָּתִי׃

verses.english: From the end of the earth I call to You when my heart grows faint; lead me upon a rock higher than I.
verses.hebrew: מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ אֵלֶיךָ אֶקְרָא בַּעֲטֹף לִבִּי בְּצוּר־יָרוּם מִמֶּנִּי תַנְחֵנִי׃

verses.english: For You have been a refuge for me, a strong tower before the enemy.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הָיִיתָ מַחְסֶה לִי מִגְדַּל־עֹז מִפְּנֵי אוֹיֵב׃

verses.english: Let me sojourn in Your tent for ages; let me take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah.
verses.hebrew: אָגוּרָה בְאָהָלְךָ עוֹלָמִים אֶחֱסֶה בְסֵתֶר כְּנָפֶיךָ סֶּלָה׃

verses.english: For You, God, have heard my vows; You gave the inheritance of those who fear Your name.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים שָׁמַעְתָּ לִנְדָרָי נָתַתָּ יְרֻשַּׁת יִרְאֵי שְׁמֶךָ׃

verses.english: Add days to the king's days; let his years be like generation upon generation.
verses.hebrew: יָמִים עַל־יְמֵי־מֶלֶךְ תּוֹסִיף שְׁנוֹתָיו כְּמוֹ־דֹר וָדֹר׃

verses.english: May he dwell forever before God; appoint steadfast love and faithfulness to guard him.
verses.hebrew: יֵשֵׁב עוֹלָם לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת מַן יִנְצְרֻהוּ׃

verses.english: So I will make music to Your name forever, fulfilling my vows day by day.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן אֲזַמְּרָה שִׁמְךָ לָעַד לְשַׁלְּמִי נְדָרַי יוֹם יוֹם׃

verses.english: For the director. According to Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־יְדוּתוּן מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: Only toward God does my soul wait in silence; from Him is my salvation.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ אֶל־אֱלֹהִים דּוּמִיָּה נַפְשִׁי מִמֶּנּוּ יְשׁוּעָתִי׃

verses.english: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my stronghold; I will not be greatly shaken.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־הוּא צוּרִי וִישׁוּעָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי לֹא־אֶמּוֹט רַבָּה׃

verses.english: How long will you plot destruction against a man? All of you will be murdered, like a leaning wall, a fence pushed over.
verses.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה תְּהוֹתְתוּ עַל אִישׁ תְּרָצְּחוּ כֻלְּכֶם כְּקִיר נָטוּי גָּדֵר הַדְּחוּיָה׃

verses.english: Only because of his elevation they plan to overthrow him; they delight in falsehood; each blesses with his mouth, but inwardly they curse. Selah.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ מִשְּׂאֵתוֹ יָעֲצוּ לְהַדִּיחַ יִרְצוּ כָזָב בְּפִיו יְבָרֵכוּ וּבְקִרְבָּם יְקַלְלוּ־סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Wait in silence for God alone, my soul, for my hope is from Him.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֵאלֹהִים דּוֹמִּי נַפְשִׁי כִּי־מִמֶּנּוּ תִּקְוָתִי׃

verses.english: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my stronghold; I will not be shaken.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־הוּא צוּרִי וִישׁוּעָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי לֹא אֶמּוֹט׃

verses.english: Upon God rest my salvation and my glory; the rock of my strength, my refuge, is in God.
verses.hebrew: עַל־אֱלֹהִים יִשְׁעִי וּכְבוֹדִי צוּר־עֻזִּי מַחְסִי בֵּאלֹהִים׃

verses.english: Trust in Him at every time, people; pour out your heart before Him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.hebrew: בִּטְחוּ בוֹ בְכָל־עֵת עָם שִׁפְכוּ־לְפָנָיו לְבַבְכֶם אֱלֹהִים מַחֲסֶה־לָּנוּ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Only vapor are ordinary people, a lie are people of standing; when they rise upon the scales, together they are lighter than vapor.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ הֶבֶל בְּנֵי־אָדָם כָּזָב בְּנֵי אִישׁ בְּמֹאזְנַיִם לַעֲלוֹת הֵמָּה מֵהֶבֶל יָחַד׃

verses.english: Do not trust in oppression or become vain through robbery; if wealth bears fruit, do not set your heart on it.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּבְטְחוּ בְעֹשֶׁק וּבְגָזֵל אַל־תֶּהְבָּלוּ חַיִל כִּי־יָנוּב אַל־תָּשִׁיתוּ לֵב׃

verses.english: God spoke once; these two things I heard: strength belongs to God,
verses.hebrew: אַחַת דִּבֶּר אֱלֹהִים שְׁתַּיִם־זוּ שָׁמָעְתִּי כִּי עֹז לֵאלֹהִים׃

verses.english: and to You, Lord, belongs steadfast love, for You repay each person according to his deed.
verses.hebrew: וּלְךָ־אֲדֹנָי חָסֶד כִּי־אַתָּה תְשַׁלֵּם לְאִישׁ כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃

verses.english: A psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד בִּהְיוֹתוֹ בְּמִדְבַּר יְהוּדָה׃

verses.english: God, You are my God; I seek You at dawn. My soul thirsts for You; my flesh longs for You, in a dry, weary land without water.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים אֵלִי אַתָּה אֲ‍שַׁחֲרֶךָּ צָמְאָה לְךָ נַפְשִׁי כָּמַהּ לְךָ בְשָׂרִי בְּאֶרֶץ־צִיָּה וְעָיֵף בְּלִי־מָיִם׃

verses.english: So I beheld You in the sanctuary, to see Your strength and Your glory.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן בַּקֹּדֶשׁ חֲזִיתִיךָ לִרְאוֹת עֻזְּךָ וּכְבוֹדֶךָ׃

verses.english: For Your steadfast love is better than life; my lips will praise You.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־טוֹב חַסְדְּךָ מֵחַיִּים שְׂפָתַי יְשַׁבְּחוּנְךָ׃

verses.english: So I will bless You in my life; in Your name I will lift my palms.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן אֲבָרֶכְךָ בְחַיָּי בְּשִׁמְךָ אֶשָּׂא כַפָּי׃

verses.english: My soul will be satisfied as with fat and rich food; with lips of joyful cries my mouth will praise.
verses.hebrew: כְּמוֹ חֵלֶב וָדֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּע נַפְשִׁי וְשִׂפְתֵי רְנָנוֹת יְהַלֶּל־פִּי׃

verses.english: When I remember You on my beds, I meditate on You through the night watches.
verses.hebrew: אִם־זְכַרְתִּיךָ עַל־יְצוּעָי בְּאַשְׁמֻרוֹת אֶהְגֶּה־בָּךְ׃

verses.english: For You have been a help to me, and in the shadow of Your wings I will shout for joy.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הָיִיתָ עֶזְרָתָה לִּי וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן׃

verses.english: My soul clings after You; Your right hand holds me fast.
verses.hebrew: דָּבְקָה נַפְשִׁי אַחֲרֶיךָ בִּי תָּמְכָה יְמִינֶךָ׃

verses.english: But those seeking my soul for destruction will enter the depths of the earth.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵמָּה לְשׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי יָבֹאוּ בְּתַחְתִּיּוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: They will pour him out by the power of the sword; they will be a portion for foxes.
verses.hebrew: יַגִּירֻהוּ עַל־יְדֵי־חָרֶב מְנָת שֻׁעָלִים יִהְיוּ׃

verses.english: But the king will rejoice in God; everyone swearing by Him will glory, for the mouth of those speaking falsehood will be stopped.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ יִשְׂמַח בֵּאלֹהִים יִתְהַלֵּל כָּל־הַנִּשְׁבָּע בּוֹ כִּי יִסָּכֵר פִּי דוֹבְרֵי־שָׁקֶר׃

verses.english: For the director. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: Hear my voice in my complaint, God; guard my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע־אֱלֹהִים קוֹלִי בְשִׂיחִי מִפַּחַד אוֹיֵב תִּצֹּר חַיָּי׃

verses.english: Hide me from the counsel of evildoers, from the tumult of those working wrongdoing,
verses.hebrew: תַּסְתִּירֵנִי מִסּוֹד מְרֵעִים מֵרִגְשַׁת פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃

verses.english: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrow—a bitter word—
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר שָׁנְנוּ כַחֶרֶב לְשׁוֹנָם דָּרְכוּ חִצָּם דָּבָר מָר׃

verses.english: to shoot the blameless from hiding; suddenly they shoot him, and do not fear.
verses.hebrew: לִירוֹת בַּמִּסְתָּרִים תָּם פִּתְאֹם יֹרֻהוּ וְלֹא יִירָאוּ׃

verses.english: They strengthen an evil purpose for themselves; they discuss hiding snares, saying, “Who will see them?”
verses.hebrew: יְחַזְּקוּ־לָמוֹ דָּבָר רָע יְסַפְּרוּ לִטְמוֹן מוֹקְשִׁים אָמְרוּ מִי יִרְאֶה־לָּמוֹ׃

verses.english: They search out injustices: “We have completed a thoroughly searched plan!” A person's inward being and heart are deep.
verses.hebrew: יַחְפְּשׂוּ־עוֹלֹת תַּמְנוּ חֵפֶשׂ מְחֻפָּשׂ וְקֶרֶב אִישׁ וְלֵב עָמֹק׃

verses.english: God cast them down; an arrow—suddenly their wounds came.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּרֵם אֱלֹהִים חֵץ פִּתְאוֹם הָיוּ מַכּוֹתָם׃

verses.english: The stumbling they intended for him—their tongue turned it upon them; all who see them shake their heads.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכְשִׁילוּהוּ עָלֵימוֹ לְשׁוֹנָם יִתְנֹדֲדוּ כָּל־רֹאֵה בָם׃

verses.english: All humankind feared; they declared God's work and understood His deed.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּירְאוּ כָּל־אָדָם וַיַּגִּידוּ פֹּעַל אֱלֹהִים וּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ הִשְׂכִּילוּ׃

verses.english: The righteous will rejoice in YHWH and take refuge in Him; all the upright in heart will glory.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמַח צַדִּיק בַּיהוָה וְחָסָה בוֹ וְיִתְהַלְלוּ כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃

verses.english: For the director. A psalm of David. A song.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד שִׁיר׃

verses.english: Silence is praise to You, God in Zion, and to You a vow will be paid.
verses.hebrew: לְךָ דֻמִיָּה תְהִלָּה אֱלֹהִים בְּצִיּוֹן וּלְךָ יְשֻׁלַּם־נֶדֶר׃

verses.english: You who hear prayer, to You all flesh will come.
verses.hebrew: שֹׁמֵעַ תְּפִלָּה עָדֶיךָ כָּל־בָּשָׂר יָבֹאוּ׃

verses.english: Words of iniquities overwhelm me; as for our rebellions, You will atone for them.
verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי עֲוֺנֹת גָּבְרוּ מֶנִּי פְּשָׁעֵינוּ אַתָּה תְכַפְּרֵם׃

verses.english: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts. Let us be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your sanctuary.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי תִּבְחַר וּתְקָרֵב יִשְׁכֹּן חֲצֵרֶיךָ נִשְׂבְּעָה בְּטוּב בֵּיתֶךָ קְדֹשׁ הֵיכָלֶךָ׃

verses.english: With awesome deeds in righteousness You answer us, God of our salvation, the confidence of all earth's ends and those far away at sea,
verses.hebrew: נוֹרָאוֹת בְּצֶדֶק תַּעֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ מִבְטָח כָּל־קַצְוֵי־אֶרֶץ וְיָם רְחֹקִים׃

verses.english: who establishes mountains by His strength, girded with might;
verses.hebrew: מֵכִין הָרִים בְּכֹחוֹ נֶאְזָר בִּגְבוּרָה׃

verses.english: who stills the roar of seas, the roar of their waves, and the tumult of peoples.
verses.hebrew: מַשְׁבִּיחַ שְׁאוֹן יַמִּים שְׁאוֹן גַּלֵּיהֶם וַהֲמוֹן לְאֻמִּים׃

verses.english: Those dwelling at the ends fear Your signs; You make the outgoings of morning and evening shout for joy.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּירְאוּ יֹשְׁבֵי קְצָוֺת מֵאוֹתֹתֶיךָ מוֹצָאֵי־בֹקֶר וָעֶרֶב תַּרְנִין׃

verses.english: You visited the earth and watered it; You greatly enrich it. God's channel is full of water; You prepare their grain, for so You prepare the earth.
verses.hebrew: פָּקַדְתָּ הָאָרֶץ וַתְּשֹׁקְקֶהָ רַבַּת תַּעְשְׁרֶנָּה פֶּלֶג אֱלֹהִים מָלֵא מָיִם תָּכִין דְּגָנָם כִּי־כֵן תְּכִינֶהָ׃

verses.english: To saturate its furrows, to give rest to its companies, You soften it with showers; You bless its growth.
verses.hebrew: תְּלָמֶיהָ רַוֵּה נַחֵת גְּדוּדֶיהָ בִּרְבִיבִים תְּמֹגְגֶנָּה צִמְחָהּ תְּבָרֵךְ׃

verses.english: You crowned the year of Your goodness, and Your tracks drip richness.
verses.hebrew: עִטַּרְתָּ שְׁנַת טוֹבָתֶךָ וּמַעְגָּלֶיךָ יִרְעֲפוּן דָּשֶׁן׃

verses.english: The wilderness pastures drip, and hills gird themselves with joy.
verses.hebrew: יִרְעֲפוּ נְאוֹת מִדְבָּר וְגִיל גְּבָעוֹת תַּחְגֹּרְנָה׃

verses.english: Meadows clothe themselves with flocks; valleys wrap themselves in grain; they shout for joy, yes, they sing.
verses.hebrew: לָבְשׁוּ כָרִים הַצֹּאן וַעֲמָקִים יַעַטְפוּ־בָר יִתְרוֹעֲעוּ אַף־יָשִׁירוּ׃

verses.english: For the director. A song. A psalm. Shout to God, all the earth!
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהִים כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Make music to the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.
verses.hebrew: זַמְּרוּ כְבוֹד־שְׁמוֹ שִׂימוּ כָבוֹד תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! Through the abundance of Your strength, Your enemies will acknowledge their falsehood to You.
verses.hebrew: אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים מַה־נּוֹרָא מַעֲשֶׂיךָ בְּרֹב עֻזְּךָ יְכַחֲשׁוּ לְךָ אֹיְבֶיךָ׃

verses.english: All the earth will bow to You and make music to You; they will make music to Your name.” Selah.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְךָ וִיזַמְּרוּ־לָךְ יְזַמְּרוּ שִׁמְךָ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Come and see God's deeds, awesome in His action toward the children of humankind.
verses.hebrew: לְכוּ וּרְאוּ מִפְעֲלוֹת אֱלֹהִים נוֹרָא עֲלִילָה עַל־בְּנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: He turned the sea into dry ground; through the river they pass on foot. There let us rejoice in Him,
verses.hebrew: הָפַךְ יָם לְיַבָּשָׁה בַּנָּהָר יַעַבְרוּ בְרָגֶל שָׁם נִשְׂמְחָה־בּוֹ׃

verses.english: who rules by His might forever; His eyes watch the nations. Let the rebellious not exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.hebrew: מֹשֵׁל בִּגְבוּרָתוֹ עוֹלָם עֵינָיו בַּגּוֹיִם תִּצְפֶּינָה הַסּוֹרְרִים אַל־ירימו [יָרוּמוּ] לָמוֹ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Bless our God, peoples; make the sound of His praise heard,
verses.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ עַמִּים אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהַשְׁמִיעוּ קוֹל תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: who sets our soul in life and has not allowed our foot to slip.
verses.hebrew: הַשָּׂם נַפְשֵׁנוּ בַּחַיִּים וְלֹא־נָתַן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֵנוּ׃

verses.english: For You tested us, God; You refined us as silver is refined.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־בְחַנְתָּנוּ אֱלֹהִים צְרַפְתָּנוּ כִּצְרָף־כָּסֶף׃

verses.english: You brought us into a trap; You placed a restraint upon our loins.
verses.hebrew: הֲבֵאתָנוּ בַמְּצוּדָה שַׂמְתָּ מוּעָקָה בְמָתְנֵינוּ׃

verses.english: You made a human being ride over our head; we came through fire and water, and You brought us out to abundance.
verses.hebrew: הִרְכַּבְתָּ אֱנוֹשׁ לְרֹאשֵׁנוּ בָּאנוּ־בָאֵשׁ וּבַמַּיִם וַתּוֹצִיאֵנוּ לָרְוָיָה׃

verses.english: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will pay You my vows,
verses.hebrew: אָבוֹא בֵיתְךָ בְעוֹלוֹת אֲשַׁלֵּם לְךָ נְדָרָי׃

verses.english: which my lips uttered and my mouth spoke when I was in trouble.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־פָּצוּ שְׂפָתָי וְדִבֶּר־פִּי בַּצַּר־לִי׃

verses.english: I will offer You burnt offerings of fat animals, with the smoke of rams; I will prepare cattle with he-goats. Selah.
verses.hebrew: עֹלוֹת מֵחִים אַעֲלֶה־לָּךְ עִם־קְטֹרֶת אֵילִים אֶעֱשֶׂה בָקָר עִם־עַתּוּדִים סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Come, hear, all who fear God, and I will recount what He did for my soul.
verses.hebrew: לְכוּ־שִׁמְעוּ וַאֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־יִרְאֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְנַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: I called to Him with my mouth, and His exaltation was beneath my tongue.
verses.hebrew: אֵלָיו פִּי־קָרָאתִי וְרוֹמַם תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנִי׃

verses.english: If I perceived wrongdoing in my heart, the Lord does not heed it.
verses.hebrew: אָוֶן אִם־רָאִיתִי בְלִבִּי לֹא יִשְׁמַע אֲדֹנָי׃

verses.english: Yet God has indeed heard; He attended to the sound of my prayer.
verses.hebrew: אָכֵן שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים הִקְשִׁיב בְּקוֹל תְּפִלָּתִי׃

verses.english: Blessed is God, who has not turned away my prayer or His steadfast love from me.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הֵסִיר תְּפִלָּתִי וְחַסְדּוֹ מֵאִתִּי׃

verses.english: For the director. With stringed instruments. A psalm. A song.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּח בִּנְגִינֹת מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר׃

verses.english: May God be gracious to us and bless us; may He make His face shine with us. Selah.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים יְחָנֵּנוּ וִיבָרְכֵנוּ יָאֵר פָּנָיו אִתָּנוּ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: That Your way may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
verses.hebrew: לָדַעַת בָּאָרֶץ דַּרְכֶּךָ בְּכָל־גּוֹיִם יְשׁוּעָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Let peoples thank You, God; let all peoples thank You.
verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים אֱלֹהִים יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם׃

verses.english: Let nations rejoice and shout for joy, for You judge peoples with uprightness and guide nations upon the earth. Selah.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמְחוּ וִירַנְּנוּ לְאֻמִּים כִּי־תִשְׁפֹּט עַמִּים מִישׁוֹר וּלְאֻמִּים בָּאָרֶץ תַּנְחֵם סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Let peoples thank You, God; let all peoples thank You.
verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים אֱלֹהִים יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם׃

verses.english: The earth has given its yield; may God, our God, bless us.
verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ נָתְנָה יְבוּלָהּ יְבָרְכֵנוּ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

verses.english: May God bless us, and may all earth's ends fear Him.
verses.hebrew: יְבָרְכֵנוּ אֱלֹהִים וְיִירְאוּ אֹתוֹ כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: For the director. Of David. A psalm. A song.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר׃

verses.english: Let God arise; let His enemies scatter, and let those hating Him flee from His presence.
verses.hebrew: יָקוּם אֱלֹהִים יָפוּצוּ אוֹיְבָיו וְיָנוּסוּ מְשַׂנְאָיו מִפָּנָיו׃

verses.english: As smoke is driven away, You drive them away; as wax melts before fire, let the wicked perish before God.
verses.hebrew: כְּהִנְדֹּף עָשָׁן תִּנְדֹּף כְּהִמֵּס דּוֹנַג מִפְּנֵי־אֵשׁ יֹאבְדוּ רְשָׁעִים מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: Let the righteous rejoice and exult before God; let them delight with joy.
verses.hebrew: וְצַדִּיקִים יִשְׂמְחוּ יַעַלְצוּ לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים וְיָשִׂישׂוּ בְשִׂמְחָה׃

verses.english: Sing to God; make music to His name. Praise Him who rides in the heavens by His name Yah, and exult before Him.
verses.hebrew: שִׁירוּ לֵאלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ שְׁמוֹ סֹלּוּ לָרֹכֵב בָּעֲרָבוֹת בְּיָהּ שְׁמוֹ וְעִלְזוּ לְפָנָיו׃

verses.english: Father of orphans and judge of widows is God in His holy dwelling.
verses.hebrew: אֲבִי יְתוֹמִים וְדַיַּן אַלְמָנוֹת אֱלֹהִים בִּמְעוֹן קָדְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: God settles solitary people in a home, brings prisoners out at a fitting time; but the rebellious dwell in parched land.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים מוֹשִׁיב יְחִידִים בַּיְתָה מוֹצִיא אֲסִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁרוֹת אַךְ סוֹרֲרִים שָׁכְנוּ צְחִיחָה׃

verses.english: God, when You went out before Your people, when You marched through the wasteland—Selah—
verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים בְּצֵאתְךָ לִפְנֵי עַמֶּךָ בְּצַעְדְּךָ בִישִׁימוֹן סֶלָה׃

verses.english: the earth shook; indeed the heavens dripped before God; this Sinai shook before God, the God of Israel.
verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ רָעָשָׁה אַף־שָׁמַיִם נָטְפוּ מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים זֶה סִינַי מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: You shower generous rain, God; Your inheritance, when weary, You established.
verses.hebrew: גֶּשֶׁם נְדָבוֹת תָּנִיף אֱלֹהִים נַחֲלָתְךָ וְנִלְאָה אַתָּה כוֹנַנְתָּהּ׃

verses.english: Your congregation dwelt in it; in Your goodness You prepare for the poor, God.
verses.hebrew: חַיָּתְךָ יָשְׁבוּ־בָהּ תָּכִין בְּטוֹבָתְךָ לֶעָנִי אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: The Lord gives a word; the women bearing good news are a great host.
verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי יִתֶּן־אֹמֶר הַמְבַשְּׂרוֹת צָבָא רָב׃

verses.english: Kings of armies flee, they flee, and she who dwells at home divides spoil.
verses.hebrew: מַלְכֵי צְבָאוֹת יִדֹּדוּן יִדֹּדוּן וּנְוַת בַּיִת תְּחַלֵּק שָׁלָל׃

verses.english: If you lie between the borders— a dove's wings covered in silver, and its pinions in greenish gold.
verses.hebrew: אִם־תִּשְׁכְּבוּן בֵּין שְׁפַתָּיִם כַּנְפֵי יוֹנָה נֶחְפָּה בַכֶּסֶף וְאֶבְרוֹתֶיהָ בִּירַקְרַק חָרוּץ׃

verses.english: When Shaddai scatters kings in it, it snows in Zalmon.
verses.hebrew: בְּפָרֵשׂ שַׁדַּי מְלָכִים בָּהּ תַּשְׁלֵג בְּצַלְמוֹן׃

verses.english: A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; a mountain of peaks is the mountain of Bashan.
verses.hebrew: הַר־אֱלֹהִים הַר־בָּשָׁן הַר גַּבְנֻנִּים הַר־בָּשָׁן׃

verses.english: Why do you lie in wait, mountains of peaks, against the mountain God desired for His dwelling? Indeed, YHWH will dwell there forever.
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה תְּרַצְּדוּן הָרִים גַּבְנֻנִּים הָהָר חָמַד אֱלֹהִים לְשִׁבְתּוֹ אַף־יְהוָה יִשְׁכֹּן לָנֶצַח׃

verses.english: God's chariot is twice ten thousand, thousands of keen angels; the Lord is among them, Sinai in holiness.
verses.hebrew: רֶכֶב אֱלֹהִים רִבֹּתַיִם אַלְפֵי שִׁנְאָן אֲדֹנָי בָם סִינַי בַּקֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: You ascended on high; you took captivity captive; you received gifts among humankind, even rebels, so that Yah God might dwell.
verses.hebrew: עָלִיתָ לַמָּרוֹם שָׁבִיתָ שֶּׁבִי לָקַחְתָּ מַתָּנוֹת בָּאָדָם וְאַף סוֹרְרִים לִשְׁכֹּן יָהּ אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: Blessed is the Lord; day by day He loads us with salvation, the God who is our salvation. Selah.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אֲדֹנָי יוֹם יוֹם יַעֲמָס־לָנוּ הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: God is for us a God of deliverances, and to YHWH the Lord belong ways to death.
verses.hebrew: הָאֵל לָנוּ אֵל לְמוֹשָׁעוֹת וְלֵיהוִה אֲדֹנָי לַמָּוֶת תּוֹצָאוֹת׃

verses.english: Indeed, God will crush His enemies' head, the hairy crown of one walking in his guilt.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִים יִמְחַץ רֹאשׁ אֹיְבָיו קָדְקֹד שֵׂעָר מִתְהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲשָׁמָיו׃

verses.english: The Lord said, “I will bring back from Bashan; I will bring back from the depths of the sea,
verses.hebrew: אָמַר אֲדֹנָי מִבָּשָׁן אָשִׁיב אָשִׁיב מִמְּצֻלוֹת יָם׃

verses.english: so that your foot may wade in blood, and the tongue of your dogs have its portion from enemies.”
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן תִּמְחַץ רַגְלְךָ בְּדָם לְשׁוֹן כְּלָבֶיךָ מֵאֹיְבִים מִנֵּהוּ׃

verses.english: They have seen Your processions, God, the processions of my God, my King, in holiness.
verses.hebrew: רָאוּ הֲלִיכוֹתֶיךָ אֱלֹהִים הֲלִיכוֹת אֵלִי מַלְכִּי בַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: Singers went first, musicians afterward, amid young women beating tambourines.
verses.hebrew: קִדְּמוּ שָׁרִים אַחַר נֹגְנִים בְּתוֹךְ עֲלָמוֹת תּוֹפֵפוֹת׃

verses.english: In assemblies bless God, YHWH, from the fountain of Israel.
verses.hebrew: בְּמַקְהֵלוֹת בָּרְכוּ אֱלֹהִים יְהוָה מִמְּקוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them; the princes of Judah pelting them with stones, the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
verses.hebrew: שָׁם בִּנְיָמִן צָעִיר רֹדֵם שָׂרֵי יְהוּדָה רִגְמָתָם שָׂרֵי זְבֻלוּן שָׂרֵי נַפְתָּלִי׃

verses.english: Your God commanded your strength; show strength, God, in what You have worked for us.
verses.hebrew: צִוָּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עֻזֶּךָ עוּזָּה אֱלֹהִים זוּ פָּעַלְתָּ לָּנוּ׃

verses.english: From Your sanctuary above Jerusalem, kings will bring You tribute.
verses.hebrew: מֵהֵיכָלֶךָ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָם לְךָ יוֹבִילוּ מְלָכִים שָׁי׃

verses.english: Rebuke the beast of the reeds, the company of mighty bulls among the calves of peoples, submitting for pieces of silver; he scattered peoples—they delight in battles.
verses.hebrew: גְּעַר חַיַּת קָנֶה עֲדַת אַבִּירִים בְּעֶגְלֵי עַמִּים מִתְרַפֵּס בְּרַצֵּי־כָסֶף בִּזַּר עַמִּים קְרָבוֹת יֶחְפָּצוּ׃

verses.english: Gifts will come from Egypt; Cush will hasten its hands toward God.
verses.hebrew: יֶאֱתָיוּ חַשְׁמַנִּים מִנִּי מִצְרָיִם כּוּשׁ תָּרִיץ יָדָיו לֵאלֹהִים׃

verses.english: Kingdoms of the earth, sing to God; make music to the Lord. Selah.
verses.hebrew: מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ שִׁירוּ לֵאלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ אֲדֹנָי סֶלָה׃

verses.english: to Him who rides the heavens of heavens of old; look, He gives with His voice a voice of strength.
verses.hebrew: לָרֹכֵב בִּשְׁמֵי שְׁמֵי־קֶדֶם הֵן יִתֵּן בְּקוֹלוֹ קוֹל עֹז׃

verses.english: Ascribe strength to God; His majesty is over Israel, and His strength in the skies.
verses.hebrew: תְּנוּ עֹז לֵאלֹהִים עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּאֲוָתוֹ וְעֻזּוֹ בַּשְּׁחָקִים׃

verses.english: Awesome are You, God, from Your sanctuaries; the God of Israel gives strength and powers to the people. Blessed is God.
verses.hebrew: נוֹרָא אֱלֹהִים מִמִּקְדָּשֶׁיךָ אֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נֹתֵן עֹז וְתַעֲצֻמוֹת לָעָם בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: For the director. According to “Lilies.” Of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שׁוֹשַׁנִּים לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: Save me, God, for waters have reached my life.
verses.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי אֱלֹהִים כִּי בָאוּ מַיִם עַד־נָפֶשׁ׃

verses.english: I have sunk in the mire of the deep, with no place to stand; I have entered deep waters, and a torrent sweeps over me.
verses.hebrew: טָבַעְתִּי בִּיוֵן מְצוּלָה וְאֵין מָעֳמָד בָּאתִי בְמַעֲמַקֵּי־מַיִם וְשִׁבֹּלֶת שְׁטָפָתְנִי׃

verses.english: I am weary from calling; my throat is parched; my eyes fail as I wait for my God.
verses.hebrew: יָגַעְתִּי בְקָרְאִי נִחַר גְּרוֹנִי כָּלוּ עֵינַי מְיַחֵל לֵאלֹהָי׃

verses.english: More numerous than the hairs of my head are those hating me without cause; powerful are those destroying me, my enemies through falsehood. What I did not steal, I must then restore.
verses.hebrew: רַבּוּ מִשַּׂעֲרוֹת רֹאשִׁי שֹׂנְאַי חִנָּם עָצְמוּ מַצְמִיתַי אֹיְבַי שֶׁקֶר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־גָזַלְתִּי אָז אָשִׁיב׃

verses.english: God, You know my folly, and my guilty deeds are not hidden from You.
verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ לְאִוַּלְתִּי וְאַשְׁמוֹתַי מִמְּךָ לֹא־נִכְחָדוּ׃

verses.english: Let those waiting for You not be ashamed through me, Lord YHWH of hosts; let those seeking You not be disgraced through me, God of Israel.
verses.hebrew: אַל־יֵבֹשׁוּ בִי קֹוֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה צְבָאוֹת אַל־יִכָּלְמוּ בִי מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: For because of You I have borne reproach; humiliation covers my face.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עָלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי חֶרְפָּה כִּסְּתָה כְלִמָּה פָנָי׃

verses.english: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an outsider to my mother's sons.
verses.hebrew: מוּזָר הָיִיתִי לְאֶחָי וְנָכְרִי לִבְנֵי אִמִּי׃

verses.english: For envy concerning Your house has consumed me, and the reproaches of those reproaching You have fallen on me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־קִנְאַת בֵּיתְךָ אֲכָלָתְנִי וְחֶרְפּוֹת חוֹרְפֶיךָ נָפְלוּ עָלָי׃

verses.english: I wept for my soul in fasting, and it became reproach for me.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶבְכֶּה בַצּוֹם נַפְשִׁי וַתְּהִי לַחֲרָפוֹת לִי׃

verses.english: I made sackcloth my clothing, and became a byword to them.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְּנָה לְבוּשִׁי שָׂק וָאֱהִי לָהֶם לְמָשָׁל׃

verses.english: Those sitting at the gate talk about me; I am the song of those drinking strong drink.
verses.hebrew: יָשִׂיחוּ בִי יֹשְׁבֵי שָׁעַר וּנְגִינוֹת שׁוֹתֵי שֵׁכָר׃

verses.english: But as for me, my prayer is to You, YHWH, at a time of favor. God, in Your abundant steadfast love, answer me in the faithfulness of Your salvation.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּתִי־לְךָ יְהוָה עֵת רָצוֹן אֱלֹהִים בְּרָב־חַסְדֶּךָ עֲנֵנִי בֶּאֱמֶת יִשְׁעֶךָ׃

verses.english: Rescue me from mud, and let me not sink; let me be rescued from those hating me and from deep waters.
verses.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי מִטִּיט וְאַל־אֶטְבָּעָה אִנָּצְלָה מִשֹּׂנְאַי וּמִמַּעֲמַקֵּי־מָיִם׃

verses.english: Let no torrent of water sweep me away, nor the deep swallow me; let no well shut its mouth over me.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּשְׁטְפֵנִי שִׁבֹּלֶת מַיִם וְאַל־תִּבְלָעֵנִי מְצוּלָה וְאַל־תֶּאְטַר־עָלַי בְּאֵר פִּיהָ׃

verses.english: Answer me, YHWH, for Your steadfast love is good; according to Your abundant compassion, turn to me.
verses.hebrew: עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה כִּי־טוֹב חַסְדֶּךָ כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ פְּנֵה אֵלָי׃

verses.english: Do not hide Your face from Your servant; for I am in trouble, hurry to answer me.
verses.hebrew: וְאַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מֵעַבְדֶּךָ כִּי־צַר־לִי מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי׃

verses.english: Draw near to my soul and redeem it; because of my enemies, ransom me.
verses.hebrew: קָרְבָה אֶל־נַפְשִׁי גְאָלָהּ לְמַעַן אֹיְבַי פְּדֵנִי׃

verses.english: You know my reproach, shame and humiliation; all my foes are before You.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִי וּבָשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִי נֶגְדְּךָ כָּל־צוֹרְרָי׃

verses.english: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am sick; I waited for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but found none.
verses.hebrew: חֶרְפָּה שָׁבְרָה לִבִּי וָאָנוּשָׁה וָאֲקַוֶּה לָנוּד וָאַיִן וְלַמְנַחֲמִים וְלֹא מָצָאתִי׃

verses.english: They put gall in my food, and for my thirst gave me sour wine to drink.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְּבָרוּתִי רֹאשׁ וְלִצְמָאִי יַשְׁקוּנִי חֹמֶץ׃

verses.english: Let their table before them become a trap, and their hoped-for peace a snare.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי־שֻׁלְחָנָם לִפְנֵיהֶם לְפָח וְלִשְׁלוֹמִים לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃

verses.english: Let their eyes grow dark so they cannot see, and make their loins continually totter.
verses.hebrew: תֶּחְשַׁכְנָה עֵינֵיהֶם מֵרְאוֹת וּמָתְנֵיהֶם תָּמִיד הַמְעַד׃

verses.english: Pour Your indignation upon them; let Your burning anger overtake them.
verses.hebrew: שְׁפָךְ־עֲלֵיהֶם זַעְמֶךָ וַחֲרוֹן אַפְּךָ יַשִּׂיגֵם׃

verses.english: Let their encampment become desolate; let no one dwell in their tents.
verses.hebrew: תְּהִי־טִירָתָם נְשַׁמָּה בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם אַל־יְהִי יֹשֵׁב׃

verses.english: For they pursued the one You struck, and recount the pain of those You wounded.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲשֶׁר־הִכִּיתָ רָדָפוּ וְאֶל־מַכְאוֹב חֲלָלֶיךָ יְסַפֵּרוּ׃

verses.english: Add iniquity to their iniquity; let them not enter Your righteousness.
verses.hebrew: תְּנָה־עָוֺן עַל־עֲוֺנָם וְאַל־יָבֹאוּ בְּצִדְקָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Let them be erased from the book of life; let them not be written with the righteous.
verses.hebrew: יִמָּחוּ מִסֵּפֶר חַיִּים וְעִם צַדִּיקִים אַל־יִכָּתֵבוּ׃

verses.english: But I am poor and in pain; let Your salvation, God, set me on high.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְכוֹאֵב יְשׁוּעָתְךָ אֱלֹהִים תְּשַׂגְּבֵנִי׃

verses.english: I will praise God's name in song and magnify Him with thanksgiving.
verses.hebrew: אֲהַלְלָה שֵׁם־אֱלֹהִים בְּשִׁיר וַאֲגַדְּלֶנּוּ בְתוֹדָה׃

verses.english: It will please YHWH more than an ox, a bull bearing horns and divided hoofs.
verses.hebrew: וְתִיטַב לַיהוָה מִשּׁוֹר פָּר מַקְרִן מַפְרִיס׃

verses.english: The humble have seen and will rejoice; you who seek God, let your heart live.
verses.hebrew: רָאוּ עֲנָוִים יִשְׂמָחוּ דֹּרְשֵׁי אֱלֹהִים וִיחִי לְבַבְכֶם׃

verses.english: For YHWH hears the needy and has not despised His prisoners.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־שֹׁמֵעַ אֶל־אֶבְיוֹנִים יְהוָה וְאֶת־אֲסִירָיו לֹא בָזָה׃

verses.english: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything moving in them.
verses.hebrew: יְהַלְלוּהוּ שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ יַמִּים וְכָל־רֹמֵשׂ בָּם׃

verses.english: For God will save Zion and build Judah's cities; they will dwell there and possess it.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֱלֹהִים יוֹשִׁיעַ צִיּוֹן וְיִבְנֶה עָרֵי יְהוּדָה וְיָשְׁבוּ שָׁם וִירֵשׁוּהָ׃

verses.english: His servants' offspring will inherit it, and those loving His name will dwell in it.
verses.hebrew: וְזֶרַע עֲבָדָיו יִנְחָלוּהָ וְאֹהֲבֵי שְׁמוֹ יִשְׁכְּנוּ־בָהּ׃

verses.english: For the director. Of David. To bring to remembrance.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד לְהַזְכִּיר׃

verses.english: God, come to rescue me; YHWH, hurry to help me!
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים לְהַצִּילֵנִי יְהוָה לְעֶזְרָתִי חוּשָׁה׃

verses.english: Let those seeking my soul be ashamed and humiliated; let those desiring my harm retreat backward in disgrace.
verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיִכָּלְמוּ חֲפֵצֵי רָעָתִי׃

verses.english: Let those saying, “Aha! Aha!” turn back because of their shame.
verses.hebrew: יָשׁוּבוּ עַל־עֵקֶב בָּשְׁתָּם הָאֹמְרִים הֶאָח הֶאָח׃

verses.english: Let all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; let those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
verses.hebrew: יָשִׂישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְּךָ כָּל־מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים אֹהֲבֵי יְשׁוּעָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: But I am poor and needy; God, hurry to me! You are my help and my deliverer; YHWH, do not delay!
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אֱלֹהִים חוּשָׁה־לִּי עֶזְרִי וּמְפַלְטִי אַתָּה יְהוָה אַל־תְּאַחַר׃

verses.english: In You, YHWH, I have taken refuge; let me never be ashamed.
verses.hebrew: בְּךָ־יְהוָה חָסִיתִי אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: In Your righteousness rescue me and deliver me; bend Your ear toward me and save me.
verses.hebrew: בְּצִדְקָתְךָ תַּצִּילֵנִי וּתְפַלְּטֵנִי הַטֵּה־אֵלַי אָזְנְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃

verses.english: Be for me a rock of dwelling, to which I may continually come; You have commanded that I be saved, for You are my rock and my fortress.
verses.hebrew: הֱיֵה לִי לְצוּר מָעוֹן לָבוֹא תָּמִיד צִוִּיתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כִּי־סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אָתָּה׃

verses.english: My God, deliver me from the wicked person’s hand, from the grasp of the unjust person and the robber.
verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי פַּלְּטֵנִי מִיַּד רָשָׁע מִכַּף מְעַוֵּל וְחוֹמֵץ׃

verses.english: For You are my hope, Lord YHWH, my confidence from my youth.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה תִקְוָתִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה מִבְטַחִי מִנְּעוּרָי׃

verses.english: Upon You I have leaned from the womb; You brought me out from my mother’s inward parts. My praise is continually in You.
verses.hebrew: עָלֶיךָ נִסְמַכְתִּי מִבֶּטֶן מִמְּעֵי אִמִּי אַתָּה גוֹזִי בְּךָ תְהִלָּתִי תָמִיד׃

verses.english: I have become like a sign to many, but You are my strong refuge.
verses.hebrew: כְּמוֹפֵת הָיִיתִי לְרַבִּים וְאַתָּה מַחֲסִי־עֹז׃

verses.english: Let my mouth be filled with Your praise, with Your splendor all day.
verses.hebrew: יִמָּלֵא פִי תְּהִלָּתֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם תִּפְאַרְתֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Do not cast me off at the time of old age; when my strength fails, do not abandon me.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵת זִקְנָה כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחִי אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי׃

verses.english: For my enemies have spoken about me, and those watching my soul have taken counsel together,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמְרוּ אוֹיְבַי לִי וְשֹׁמְרֵי נַפְשִׁי נוֹעֲצוּ יַחְדָּו׃

verses.english: saying, “God has abandoned him! Pursue him and seize him, for there is no one to rescue!”
verses.hebrew: לֵאמֹר אֱלֹהִים עֲזָבוֹ רִדְפוּ וְתִפְשׂוּהוּ כִּי־אֵין מַצִּיל׃

verses.english: God, do not be far from me; my God, hurry to help me!
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים אַל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי אֱלֹהַי לְעֶזְרָתִי חישה [חוּשָׁה׃]

verses.english: Let the adversaries of my soul be ashamed and perish; let those seeking my harm clothe themselves in reproach and disgrace.
verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ יִכְלוּ שֹׂטְנֵי נַפְשִׁי יַעֲטוּ חֶרְפָּה וּכְלִמָּה מְבַקְשֵׁי רָעָתִי׃

verses.english: But I will always hope, and add to all Your praise.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי תָּמִיד אֲיַחֵל וְהוֹסַפְתִּי עַל־כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃

verses.english: My mouth will recount Your righteousness, Your salvation all day, for I do not know their numbers.
verses.hebrew: פִּי יְסַפֵּר צִדְקָתֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶךָ כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי סְפֹרוֹת׃

verses.english: I will enter into the mighty acts of Lord YHWH; I will recall Your righteousness, Yours alone.
verses.hebrew: אָבוֹא בִּגְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה אַזְכִּיר צִדְקָתְךָ לְבַדֶּךָ׃

verses.english: God, You have taught me from my youth, and until now I proclaim Your wonders.
verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים לִמַּדְתַּנִי מִנְּעוּרָי וְעַד־הֵנָּה אַגִּיד נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: And even to old age and gray hair, God, do not abandon me, until I declare Your arm to a generation, Your might to everyone who comes.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם עַד־זִקְנָה וְשֵׂיבָה אֱלֹהִים אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי עַד־אַגִּיד זְרוֹעֲךָ לְדוֹר לְכָל־יָבוֹא גְּבוּרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: and Your righteousness, God, reaches to the heights! You who have done great things, God, who is like You?
verses.hebrew: וְצִדְקָתְךָ אֱלֹהִים עַד־מָרוֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתָ גְדֹלוֹת אֱלֹהִים מִי כָמוֹךָ׃

verses.english: You who have shown me many and grievous troubles will again revive me; from the depths of the earth You will again bring me up.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר הראיתנו [הִרְאִיתַנִי ] צָרוֹת רַבּוֹת וְרָעוֹת תָּשׁוּב תחיינו [תְּחַיֵּינִי] וּמִתְּהֹמוֹת הָאָרֶץ תָּשׁוּב תַּעֲלֵנִי׃

verses.english: You will increase my greatness, and turning around, comfort me.
verses.hebrew: תֶּרֶב גְּדֻלָּתִי וְתִסֹּב תְּנַחֲמֵנִי׃

verses.english: I too will thank You with a harp, for Your faithfulness, my God; I will sing to You with a lyre, Holy One of Israel.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֲנִי אוֹדְךָ בִכְלִי־נֶבֶל אֲמִתְּךָ אֱלֹהָי אֲזַמְּרָה לְךָ בְכִנּוֹר קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: My lips will shout for joy when I sing to You, and my soul, which You have redeemed.
verses.hebrew: תְּרַנֵּנָּה שְׂפָתַי כִּי אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּךְ וְנַפְשִׁי אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ׃

verses.english: My tongue too will speak Your righteousness all day, for those seeking my harm have been ashamed, for they have been humiliated.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־לְשׁוֹנִי כָּל־הַיּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּה צִדְקָתֶךָ כִּי־בֹשׁוּ כִי־חָפְרוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי רָעָתִי׃

verses.english: For Solomon. God, give Your judgments to the king, and Your righteousness to the king’s son.
verses.hebrew: לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֱ‍לֹהִים מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ תֵּן וְצִדְקָתְךָ לְבֶן־מֶלֶךְ׃

verses.english: May he judge Your people with righteousness, and Your poor with justice.
verses.hebrew: יָדִין עַמְּךָ בְצֶדֶק וַעֲנִיֶּיךָ בְמִשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: May the mountains bear peace for the people, and the hills through righteousness.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂאוּ הָרִים שָׁלוֹם לָעָם וּגְבָעוֹת בִּצְדָקָה׃

verses.english: May he judge the poor of the people, save the children of the needy, and crush the oppressor.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׁפֹּט עֲ‍נִיֵּי־עָם יוֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵי אֶבְיוֹן וִידַכֵּא עוֹשֵׁק׃

verses.english: May they fear You as long as the sun endures, and before the moon, generation after generation.
verses.hebrew: יִירָאוּךָ עִם־שָׁמֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵי יָרֵחַ דּוֹר דּוֹרִים׃

verses.english: May his word descend like rain upon mown vegetation, like showers dripping upon the earth.
verses.hebrew: יֵרֵד כְּמָטָר עַל־גֵּז כִּרְבִיבִים זַרְזִיף אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: May a righteous person flourish in his days, and abundant peace until the moon is no more.
verses.hebrew: יִפְרַח־בְּיָמָיו צַדִּיק וְרֹב שָׁלוֹם עַד־בְּלִי יָרֵחַ׃

verses.english: And may he rule from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the land.
verses.hebrew: וְיֵרְדְּ מִיָּם עַד־יָם וּמִנָּהָר עַד־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Let desert-dwellers kneel before him, and let his enemies lick dust.
verses.hebrew: לְפָנָיו יִכְרְעוּ צִיִּים וְאֹיְבָיו עָפָר יְלַחֵכוּ׃

verses.english: May the kings of Tarshish and the islands return tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba bring a gift.
verses.hebrew: מַלְכֵי תַרְשִׁישׁ וְאִיִּים מִנְחָה יָשִׁיבוּ מַלְכֵי שְׁבָא וּסְבָא אֶשְׁכָּר יַקְרִיבוּ׃

verses.english: And may all kings bow before him; may all nations serve him.
verses.hebrew: וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־לוֹ כָל־מְלָכִים כָּל־גּוֹיִם יַעַבְדוּהוּ׃

verses.english: For he will rescue a needy person crying out, and a poor person who has no helper.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יַצִּיל אֶבְיוֹן מְשַׁוֵּעַ וְעָנִי וְאֵין־עֹזֵר לוֹ׃

verses.english: He will pity the weak and needy, and save the souls of the needy.
verses.hebrew: יָחֹס עַל־דַּל וְאֶבְיוֹן וְנַפְשׁוֹת אֶבְיוֹנִים יוֹשִׁיעַ׃

verses.english: From blows and violence he will redeem their soul, and their blood will be precious in his eyes.
verses.hebrew: מִתּוֹךְ וּמֵחָמָס יִגְאַל נַפְשָׁם וְיֵיקַר דָּמָם בְּעֵינָיו׃

verses.english: May he live, and may He give him some of Sheba’s gold; may He pray for him continually, and bless him all day.
verses.hebrew: וִיחִי וְיִתֶּן־לוֹ מִזְּהַב שְׁבָא וְיִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעֲדוֹ תָמִיד כָּל־הַיּוֹם יְבָרֲכֶנְהוּ׃

verses.english: May there be abundant grain in the land on the mountain tops; may its fruit rustle like Lebanon, and may people blossom from the city like the earth’s grass.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי פִסַּת־בַּר בָּאָרֶץ בְּרֹאשׁ הָרִים יִרְעַשׁ כַּלְּבָנוֹן פִּרְיוֹ וְיָצִיצוּ מֵעִיר כְּעֵשֶׂב הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: May his name endure forever; as long as the sun endures, may his name grow great. May people bless themselves by him; may all nations call him blessed.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי שְׁמוֹ לְעוֹלָם לִפְנֵי־שֶׁמֶשׁ ינין [יִנּוֹן] שְׁמוֹ וְיִתְבָּרְכוּ בוֹ כָּל־גּוֹיִם יְאַשְּׁרוּהוּ׃

verses.english: Blessed be YHWH God, the God of Israel, who alone does wonders!
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת לְבַדּוֹ׃

verses.english: And blessed be His glorious name forever; may His glory fill the whole earth. Amen and amen!
verses.hebrew: וּבָרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹדוֹ לְעוֹלָם וְיִמָּלֵא כְבוֹדוֹ אֶת־כֹּל הָאָרֶץ אָמֵן וְאָמֵן׃

verses.english: The prayers of David son of Jesse have ended.
verses.hebrew: כָּלּוּ תְפִלּוֹת דָּוִד בֶּן־יִשָׁי׃

verses.english: A psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those pure in heart.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אַךְ טוֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֱלֹהִים לְבָרֵי לֵבָב׃

verses.english: But as for me, my feet had almost turned aside; my steps had nearly been poured away.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי כִּמְעַט נטוי [נָטָיוּ] רַגְלָי כְּאַיִן שפכה [שֻׁפְּכוּ] אֲשֻׁרָי׃

verses.english: For I envied the perverse when I saw the wicked at peace.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־קִנֵּאתִי בַּהוֹלְלִים שְׁלוֹם רְשָׁעִים אֶרְאֶה׃

verses.english: For there are no fetters at their death, and their strength is sound.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵין חַרְצֻבּוֹת לְמוֹתָם וּבָרִיא אוּלָם׃

verses.english: They are not in mortals’ toil, and they are not plagued with humankind.
verses.hebrew: בַּעֲמַל אֱנוֹשׁ אֵינֵמוֹ וְעִם־אָדָם לֹא יְנֻגָּעוּ׃

verses.english: Therefore pride has become their necklace; their violence wraps their hips.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן עֲנָקַתְמוֹ גַאֲוָה יַעֲטָף־שִׁית חָמָס לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: Their eyes bulge from fat; they have surpassed their hearts’ imaginings.
verses.hebrew: יָצָא מֵחֵלֶב עֵינֵמוֹ עָבְרוּ מַשְׂכִּיּוֹת לֵבָב׃

verses.english: They wear others away and speak wickedly of oppression; they speak against the Most High.
verses.hebrew: יָמִיקוּ וִידַבְּרוּ בְרָע עֹשֶׁק מִמָּרוֹם יְדַבֵּרוּ׃

verses.english: They have set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walks through the earth.
verses.hebrew: שַׁתּוּ בַשָּׁמַיִם פִּיהֶם וּלְשׁוֹנָם תִּהֲלַךְ בָּאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Therefore His people return here, and waters of the full stream are drained out for them.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן ישיב [יָשׁוּב] עַמּוֹ הֲלֹם וּמֵי מָלֵא יִמָּצוּ לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: And they say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?
verses.hebrew: וְאָמְרוּ אֵיכָה יָדַע־אֵל וְיֵשׁ דֵּעָה בְעֶלְיוֹן׃

verses.english: Look, these are wicked, yet at ease in the world they have increased their wealth.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־אֵלֶּה רְשָׁעִים וְשַׁלְוֵי עוֹלָם הִשְׂגּוּ־חָיִל׃

verses.english: Surely in vain I purified my heart and washed my palms in innocence.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־רִיק זִכִּיתִי לְבָבִי וָאֶרְחַץ בְּנִקָּיוֹן כַּפָּי׃

verses.english: I have been plagued all day, and my correction comes every morning.”
verses.hebrew: וָאֱהִי נָגוּעַ כָּל־הַיּוֹם וְתוֹכַחְתִּי לַבְּקָרִים׃

verses.english: If I had said, “I will recount it just so,” look, I would have made Your children’s generation into traitors.
verses.hebrew: אִם־אָמַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָה כְמוֹ הִנֵּה דוֹר בָּנֶיךָ בָגָדְתִּי׃

verses.english: When I considered how to know this, it appeared injustice in my eyes,
verses.hebrew: וָאֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַעַת זֹאת עָמָל היא [הוּא] בְעֵינָי׃

verses.english: until I entered God’s sanctuaries and understood their end.
verses.hebrew: עַד־אָבוֹא אֶל־מִקְדְּשֵׁי־אֵל אָבִינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָם׃

verses.english: Surely You set them in slippery places; You cast them down to ruins.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ בַּחֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁית לָמוֹ הִפַּלְתָּם לְמַשּׁוּאוֹת׃

verses.english: How they became desolate in a moment! They came to an end, consumed by terrors.
verses.hebrew: אֵיךְ הָיוּ לְשַׁמָּה כְרָגַע סָפוּ תַמּוּ מִן־בַּלָּהוֹת׃

verses.english: Like a dream without awakening, Lord, in the city You will despise their image.
verses.hebrew: כַּחֲלוֹם מֵהָקִיץ אֲדֹנָי בָּעִיר צַלְמָם תִּבְזֶה׃

verses.english: For my heart fermented, and I was sharpened in my kidneys,
verses.hebrew: כִּי יִתְחַמֵּץ לְבָבִי וְכִלְיוֹתַי אֶשְׁתּוֹנָן׃

verses.english: and I was brutish and did not know; I was like beasts with You.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי־בַעַר וְלֹא אֵדָע בְּהֵמוֹת הָיִיתִי עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: Yet I am continually with You; You have grasped my right hand.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי תָמִיד עִמָּךְ אָחַזְתָּ בְּיַד־יְמִינִי׃

verses.english: With Your counsel You led me, and afterward You took me for glory.
verses.hebrew: בַּעֲצָתְךָ תַנְחֵנִי וְאַחַר כָּבוֹד תִּקָּחֵנִי׃

verses.english: Whom have I in heaven? With You, I have desired no one on earth.
verses.hebrew: מִי־לִי בַשָּׁמָיִם וְעִמְּךָ לֹא־חָפַצְתִּי בָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: My flesh and my heart yearn; God is the rock of my heart and my portion forever.
verses.hebrew: כָּלָה שְׁאֵרִי וּלְבָבִי צוּר־לְבָבִי וְחֶלְקִי אֱלֹהִים לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: For look, those far from You will perish; You have destroyed everyone who goes whoring away from You.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִנֵּה רְחֵקֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ הִצְמַתָּה כָּל־זוֹנֶה מִמֶּךָּ׃

verses.english: But for me, God’s nearness is good; I have set my refuge in Lord YHWH, to recount all Your messages.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי קִרֲבַת אֱלֹהִים לִי־טוֹב שַׁתִּי בַּאדֹנָי יְהֹוִה מַחְסִי לְסַפֵּר כָּל־מַלְאֲכוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: A Maskil of Asaph. Why, God, have You rejected forever? Why does Your anger smoke against the sheep of Your pasture?
verses.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאָסָף לָמָה אֱלֹהִים זָנַחְתָּ לָנֶצַח יֶעְשַׁן אַפְּךָ בְּצֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Remember Your congregation, which You acquired of old, the tribe of Your inheritance, which You redeemed, this Mount Zion, where You dwelt.
verses.hebrew: זְכֹר עֲדָתְךָ קָנִיתָ קֶּדֶם גָּאַלְתָּ שֵׁבֶט נַחֲלָתֶךָ הַר־צִיּוֹן זֶה שָׁכַנְתָּ בּוֹ׃

verses.english: Raise Your blows to bring lasting ruins, for all the evil the enemy did in the sanctuary.
verses.hebrew: הָרִימָה פְעָמֶיךָ לְמַשֻּׁאוֹת נֶצַח כָּל־הֵרַע אוֹיֵב בַּקֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: Your adversaries roared within Your meeting place; they set their signs as signs.
verses.hebrew: שָׁאֲגוּ צֹרְרֶיךָ בְּקֶרֶב מוֹעֲדֶךָ שָׂמוּ אוֹתֹתָם אֹתוֹת׃

verses.english: Let it be known as raising on high: axes in a tangle of wood.
verses.hebrew: יִוָּדַע כְּמֵבִיא לְמָעְלָה בִּסֲבָךְ־עֵץ קַרְדֻּמּוֹת׃

verses.english: and now they strike all its entrances together with hatchet and hammer.
verses.hebrew: ועת [וְעַתָּה] פִּתּוּחֶיהָ יָּחַד בְּכַשִּׁיל וְכֵילַפֹּת יַהֲלֹמוּן׃

verses.english: They sent Your sanctuary into fire; they profaned the dwelling of Your name to the ground.
verses.hebrew: שִׁלְחוּ בָאֵשׁ מִקְדָּשֶׁךָ לָאָרֶץ חִלְּלוּ מִשְׁכַּן־שְׁמֶךָ׃

verses.english: They said in their hearts, their rulers together; they burned all God’s meeting places in the land.
verses.hebrew: אָמְרוּ בְלִבָּם נִינָם יָחַד שָׂרְפוּ כָל־מוֹעֲדֵי־אֵל בָּאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: We have not seen our signs; there is no prophet any longer, and no one among us knows how long.
verses.hebrew: אוֹתֹתֵינוּ לֹא רָאִינוּ אֵין־עוֹד נָבִיא וְלֹא־אִתָּנוּ יֹדֵעַ עַד־מָה׃

verses.english: How long, God, will the adversary reproach? Will the enemy spurn Your name forever?
verses.hebrew: עַד־מָתַי אֱלֹהִים יְחָרֶף צָר יְנָאֵץ אוֹיֵב שִׁמְךָ לָנֶצַח׃

verses.english: Why do You draw back Your hand, Your right hand? Bring it out from within Your bosom!
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה תָשִׁיב יָדְךָ וִימִינֶךָ מִקֶּרֶב חוקך [חֵיקְךָ] כַלֵּה׃

verses.english: But God is my King from of old, working salvations in the midst of the earth.
verses.hebrew: וֵאלֹהִים מַלְכִּי מִקֶּדֶם פֹּעֵל יְשׁוּעוֹת בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: You crumbled the sea by Your strength; You shattered the sea monsters’ heads upon the waters.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה פוֹרַרְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ יָם שִׁבַּרְתָּ רָאשֵׁי תַנִּינִים עַל־הַמָּיִם׃

verses.english: You crushed Leviathan’s heads; You give him as food to the people in companies.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה רִצַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁי לִוְיָתָן תִּתְּנֶנּוּ מַאֲכָל לְעָם לְצִיִּים׃

verses.english: You split open fountain and torrent; You dried up mighty rivers.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה בָקַעְתָּ מַעְיָן וָנָחַל אַתָּה הוֹבַשְׁתָּ נַהֲרוֹת אֵיתָן׃

verses.english: Yours is day; Yours also is night; You established the luminary and the sun.
verses.hebrew: לְךָ יוֹם אַף־לְךָ לָיְלָה אַתָּה הֲכִינוֹתָ מָאוֹר וָשָׁמֶשׁ׃

verses.english: You set all the earth’s boundaries; summer and winter—You formed them.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה הִצַּבְתָּ כָּל־גְּבוּלוֹת אָרֶץ קַיִץ וָחֹרֶף אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּם׃

verses.english: Remember this: the enemy has reproached YHWH, and a foolish people have spurned Your name.
verses.hebrew: זְכָר־זֹאת אוֹיֵב חֵרֵף יְהוָה וְעַם נָבָל נִאֲצוּ שְׁמֶךָ׃

verses.english: Do not give Your turtledove’s soul to a troop; do not forget Your poor ones’ life forever.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתֵּן לְחַיַּת נֶפֶשׁ תּוֹרֶךָ חַיַּת עֲנִיֶּיךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח לָנֶצַח׃

verses.english: Look to the covenant, for the earth’s dark places are filled with dwellings of violence.
verses.hebrew: הַבֵּט לַבְּרִית כִּי מָלְאוּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי־אֶרֶץ נְאוֹת חָמָס׃

verses.english: Do not let the crushed person turn back disgraced; let the poor and needy praise Your name.
verses.hebrew: אַל־יָשֹׁב דַּךְ נִכְלָם עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן יְהַלְלוּ שְׁמֶךָ׃

verses.english: Arise, God, plead Your case; remember the reproach against You from a fool all day.
verses.hebrew: קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים רִיבָה רִיבֶךָ זְכֹר חֶרְפָּתְךָ מִנִּי־נָבָל כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: Do not forget Your adversaries’ voice; the uproar of those rising against You ascends continually.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח קוֹל צֹרְרֶיךָ שְׁאוֹן קָמֶיךָ עֹלֶה תָמִיד׃

verses.english: For the director. Do not destroy. A psalm of Asaph. A song.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף שִׁיר׃

verses.english: We have thanked You, God, we have thanked; Your name is near; they have recounted Your wonders.
verses.hebrew: הוֹדִינוּ לְּךָ אֱ‍לֹהִים הוֹדִינוּ וְקָרוֹב שְׁמֶךָ סִפְּרוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: When I take a festival time, I will judge uprightly.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶקַּח מוֹעֵד אֲנִי מֵישָׁרִים אֶשְׁפֹּט׃

verses.english: The earth and all its inhabitants are melting; I have set its pillars in order. Selah.
verses.hebrew: נְמֹגִים אֶרֶץ וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֶיהָ אָנֹכִי תִכַּנְתִּי עַמּוּדֶיהָ סֶּלָה׃

verses.english: I said to the perverse, “Do not act perversely,” and to the wicked, “Do not raise a horn;
verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי לַהוֹלְלִים אַל־תָּהֹלּוּ וְלָרְשָׁעִים אַל־תָּרִימוּ קָרֶן׃

verses.english: do not raise your horn on high; do not speak with an arrogant neck.”
verses.hebrew: אַל־תָּרִימוּ לַמָּרוֹם קַרְנְכֶם תְּדַבְּרוּ בְצַוָּאר עָתָק׃

verses.english: For elevation comes neither from the east nor from the west, nor from the wilderness;
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא מִמּוֹצָא וּמִמַּעֲרָב וְלֹא מִמִּדְבַּר הָרִים׃

verses.english: for God is judge: He lowers this one and raises that one.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפֵט זֶה יַשְׁפִּיל וְזֶה יָרִים׃

verses.english: For a cup is in YHWH’s hand, and strong wine, full of mixture; He pours from this, and all the earth’s wicked will drain and drink its dregs.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כוֹס בְּיַד־יְהוָה וְיַיִן חָמַר מָלֵא מֶסֶךְ וַיַּגֵּר מִזֶּה אַךְ־שְׁמָרֶיהָ יִמְצוּ יִשְׁתּוּ כֹּל רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: But I will proclaim forever; I will sing to the God of Jacob.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אַגִּיד לְעֹלָם אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: And I will cut off all the wicked’s horns; the righteous person’s horns will be raised.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־קַרְנֵי רְשָׁעִים אֲגַדֵּעַ תְּרוֹמַמְנָה קַרְנוֹת צַדִּיק׃

verses.english: For the director, with stringed instruments. A psalm of Asaph. A song.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינֹת מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף שִׁיר׃

verses.english: God is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.
verses.hebrew: נוֹדָע בִּיהוּדָה אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל גָּדוֹל שְׁמוֹ׃

verses.english: His booth came to be in Salem, and His dwelling in Zion.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְשָׁלֵם סֻכּוֹ וּמְעוֹנָתוֹ בְצִיּוֹן׃

verses.english: There He broke the bow’s flying arrows, shield and sword and war. Selah.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמָּה שִׁבַּר רִשְׁפֵי־קָשֶׁת מָגֵן וְחֶרֶב וּמִלְחָמָה סֶלָה׃

verses.english: You are destructive, mightier than mountains of prey.
verses.hebrew: נָאוֹר אַתָּה אַדִּיר מֵהַרְרֵי־טָרֶף׃

verses.english: The stouthearted became bewildered; they slept their sleep, and none of the warriors found their hands.
verses.hebrew: אֶשְׁתּוֹלְלוּ אַבִּירֵי לֵב נָמוּ שְׁנָתָם וְלֹא־מָצְאוּ כָל־אַנְשֵׁי־חַיִל יְדֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: At Your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse fell into deep sleep.
verses.hebrew: מִגַּעֲרָתְךָ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב נִרְדָּם וְרֶכֶב וָסוּס׃

verses.english: You—you are fearsome! Who can stand before You from the time of Your anger?
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה נוֹרָא אַתָּה וּמִי־יַעֲמֹד לְפָנֶיךָ מֵאָז אַפֶּךָ׃

verses.english: From heaven You caused judgment to be heard; the earth feared and became still,
verses.hebrew: מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַעְתָּ דִּין אֶרֶץ יָרְאָה וְשָׁקָטָה׃

verses.english: when God arose for judgment, to save all the earth’s humble. Selah.
verses.hebrew: בְּקוּם־לַמִּשְׁפָּט אֱלֹהִים לְהוֹשִׁיעַ כָּל־עַנְוֵי־אֶרֶץ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: For human wrath will acknowledge You; it will restrain the remainder of wrath.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־חֲמַת אָדָם תּוֹדֶךָּ שְׁאֵרִית חֵמֹת תַּחְגֹּר׃

verses.english: Make vows and fulfill them to YHWH your God; let all around Him bring a gift to the Fearsome One,
verses.hebrew: נִדֲרוּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ לַיהוָה אֱ‍לֹהֵיכֶם כָּל־סְבִיבָיו יוֹבִילוּ שַׁי לַמּוֹרָא׃

verses.english: who cuts down princes’ spirit, who is fearsome to the earth’s kings.
verses.hebrew: יִבְצֹר רוּחַ נְגִידִים נוֹרָא לְמַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: For the director, according to Jeduthun. Of Asaph. A psalm.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־ידיתון [יְדוּתוּן] לְאָסָף מִזְמוֹר׃

verses.english: My voice goes to God, and I cry out; my voice goes to God—give ear to me!
verses.hebrew: קוֹלִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִים וְאֶצְעָקָה קוֹלִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִים וְהַאֲזִין אֵלָי׃

verses.english: In the day of my distress I sought the Lord; my wound flowed at night and did not cease; my soul refused to be comforted.
verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי אֲדֹנָי דָּרָשְׁתִּי יָדִי לַיְלָה נִגְּרָה וְלֹא תָפוּג מֵאֲנָה הִנָּחֵם נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: I remember God and groan; I ponder, and my spirit grows faint. Selah.
verses.hebrew: אֶזְכְּרָה אֱלֹהִים וְאֶהֱמָיָה אָשִׂיחָה וְתִתְעַטֵּף רוּחִי סֶלָה׃

verses.english: You have held fast my eyes’ awakenings; I am troubled and cannot speak.
verses.hebrew: אָחַזְתָּ שְׁמֻרוֹת עֵינָי נִפְעַמְתִּי וְלֹא אֲדַבֵּר׃

verses.english: I considered days of old, years of ages.
verses.hebrew: חִשַּׁבְתִּי יָמִים מִקֶּדֶם שְׁנוֹת עוֹלָמִים׃

verses.english: I recall my music in the night; I ponder with my heart, and my spirit searches.
verses.hebrew: אֶזְכְּרָה נְגִינָתִי בַּלָּיְלָה עִם־לְבָבִי אָשִׂיחָה וַיְחַפֵּשׂ רוּחִי׃

verses.english: “Will the Lord reject for ages, and never again show favor?
verses.hebrew: הַלְעוֹלָמִים יִזְנַח אֲדֹנָי וְלֹא־יֹסִיף לִרְצוֹת עוֹד׃

verses.english: Has His steadfast love ceased forever? Has He settled a decree for generation after generation?
verses.hebrew: הֶאָפֵס לָנֶצַח חַסְדּוֹ גָּמַר אֹמֶר לְדֹר וָדֹר׃

verses.english: Has God forgotten to be gracious, or shut His compassion in anger?” Selah.
verses.hebrew: הֲשָׁכַח חַנּוֹת אֵל אִם־קָפַץ בְּאַף רַחֲמָיו סֶלָה׃

verses.english: And I said, “This is to make me tremble: the change of the Most High’s right hand.”
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר חַלּוֹתִי הִיא שְׁנוֹת יְמִין עֶלְיוֹן׃

verses.english: I will remember Yah’s deeds, for I will recall Your wonder from of old,
verses.hebrew: אזכיר [אֶזְכּוֹר] מַעַלְלֵי־יָהּ כִּי־אֶזְכְּרָה מִקֶּדֶם פִּלְאֶךָ׃

verses.english: and meditate on all Your work, and ponder Your deeds.
verses.hebrew: וְהָגִיתִי בְכָל־פָּעֳלֶךָ וּבַעֲלִילוֹתֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה׃

verses.english: God, Your way is in holiness; what god is great like God?
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים בַּקֹּדֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּךָ מִי־אֵל גָּדוֹל כֵּאלֹהִים׃

verses.english: You are the God who does wonders; You made Your strength known among the peoples.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה הָאֵל עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא הוֹדַעְתָּ בָעַמִּים עֻזֶּךָ׃

verses.english: With Your arm You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.hebrew: גָּאַלְתָּ בִּזְרוֹעַ עַמֶּךָ בְּנֵי־יַעֲקֹב וְיוֹסֵף סֶלָה׃

verses.english: The waters saw You, God; the waters saw You and writhed; the depths too trembled.
verses.hebrew: רָאוּךָ מַּיִם אֱ‍לֹהִים רָאוּךָ מַּיִם יָחִילוּ אַף יִרְגְּזוּ תְהֹמוֹת׃

verses.english: The skies poured streams of thick waters; the skies gave voice; Your arrows too went about.
verses.hebrew: זֹרְמוּ מַיִם עָבוֹת קוֹל נָתְנוּ שְׁחָקִים אַף־חֲצָצֶיךָ יִתְהַלָּכוּ׃

verses.english: Your thunder’s voice was like a wheel; lightning lit the world; the earth trembled and shook.
verses.hebrew: קוֹל רַעַמְךָ בַּגַּלְגַּל הֵאִירוּ בְרָקִים תֵּבֵל רָגְזָה וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Your way was in the sea, Your path in many waters, and Your footprints were not known.
verses.hebrew: בַּיָּם דַּרְכֶּךָ ושביליך [וּשְׁבִילְךָ] בְּמַיִם רַבִּים וְעִקְּבוֹתֶיךָ לֹא נֹדָעוּ׃

verses.english: You led Your people like sheep by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.hebrew: נָחִיתָ כַצֹּאן עַמֶּךָ בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

verses.english: A Maskil of Asaph. Give ear, my people, to my instruction; bend your ears to the sayings of my mouth.
verses.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאָסָף הַאֲזִינָה עַמִּי תּוֹרָתִי הַטּוּ אָזְנְכֶם לְאִמְרֵי־פִי׃

verses.english: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will pour out riddles from of old,
verses.hebrew: אֶפְתְּחָה בְמָשָׁל פִּי אַבִּיעָה חִידוֹת מִנִּי־קֶדֶם׃

verses.english: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have recounted to us.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵם וַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָנוּ׃

verses.english: We will not hide them from their sons, recounting to a coming generation YHWH’s praises, His might and the wonders He has done.
verses.hebrew: לֹא נְכַחֵד מִבְּנֵיהֶם לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן מְסַפְּרִים תְּהִלּוֹת יְהוָה וֶעֱזוּזוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃

verses.english: He established a testimony in Jacob and set instruction in Israel, which He commanded our fathers to make known to their sons,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם עֵדוּת בְּיַעֲקֹב וְתוֹרָה שָׂם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְהוֹדִיעָם לִבְנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: so that a coming generation might know, sons who would be born, who would rise and recount it to their sons,
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ דּוֹר אַחֲרוֹן בָּנִים יִוָּלֵדוּ יָקֻמוּ וִיסַפְּרוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: and set their confidence in God, not forget God’s deeds, and keep His commandments,
verses.hebrew: וְיָשִׂימוּ בֵאלֹהִים כִּסְלָם וְלֹא יִשְׁכְּחוּ מַעַלְלֵי־אֵל וּמִצְוֺתָיו יִנְצֹרוּ׃

verses.english: and not become like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that did not establish its heart, whose spirit was not faithful with God.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יִהְיוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָם דּוֹר סוֹרֵר וּמֹרֶה דּוֹר לֹא־הֵכִין לִבּוֹ וְלֹא־נֶאֶמְנָה אֶת־אֵל רוּחוֹ׃

verses.english: The sons of Ephraim, armed bow-shooters, turned back on the day of battle.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם נוֹשְׁקֵי רוֹמֵי־קָשֶׁת הָפְכוּ בְּיוֹם קְרָב׃

verses.english: They did not keep God’s covenant and refused to walk in His instruction.
verses.hebrew: לֹא שָׁמְרוּ בְּרִית אֱלֹהִים וּבְתוֹרָתוֹ מֵאֲנוּ לָלֶכֶת׃

verses.english: They forgot His deeds and the wonders He had shown them.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ עֲלִילוֹתָיו וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָם׃

verses.english: Before their fathers He did a wonder, in Egypt’s land, the field of Zoan.
verses.hebrew: נֶגֶד אֲבוֹתָם עָשָׂה פֶלֶא בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׂדֵה־צֹעַן׃

verses.english: He split the sea and brought them through; He made the waters stand like a heap.
verses.hebrew: בָּקַע יָם וַיַּעֲבִירֵם וַיַּצֶּב־מַיִם כְּמוֹ־נֵד׃

verses.english: He led them with a cloud by day, and all night with the light of fire.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּנְחֵם בֶּעָנָן יוֹמָם וְכָל־הַלַּיְלָה בְּאוֹר אֵשׁ׃

verses.english: He split rocks in the wilderness and gave drink abundantly, as from the depths.
verses.hebrew: יְבַקַּע צֻרִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיַּשְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמוֹת רַבָּה׃

verses.english: He brought flowing waters from a crag and made waters descend like rivers.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִא נוֹזְלִים מִסָּלַע וַיּוֹרֶד כַּנְּהָרוֹת מָיִם׃

verses.english: But they continued still to sin against Him, to rebel against the Most High in the dry land.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹסִיפוּ עוֹד לַחֲטֹא־לוֹ לַמְרוֹת עֶלְיוֹן בַּצִּיָּה׃

verses.english: They tested God in their heart, asking food for their appetite.
verses.hebrew: וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵל בִּלְבָבָם לִשְׁאָל־אֹכֶל לְנַפְשָׁם׃

verses.english: They spoke against God; they said, “Can God arrange a table in the wilderness?
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ בֵּאלֹהִים אָמְרוּ הֲיוּכַל אֵל לַעֲרֹךְ שֻׁלְחָן בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

verses.english: Look, He struck a rock and waters flowed, and torrents overflowed; can He also give bread, or prepare flesh for His people?”
verses.hebrew: הֵן הִכָּה־צוּר וַיָּזוּבוּ מַיִם וּנְחָלִים יִשְׁטֹפוּ הֲגַם־לֶחֶם יוּכַל תֵּת אִם־יָכִין שְׁאֵר לְעַמּוֹ׃

verses.english: Therefore YHWH heard and grew wrathful; fire was kindled in Jacob, and anger also rose against Israel,
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן שָׁמַע יְהוָה וַיִּתְעַבָּר וְאֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָה בְיַעֲקֹב וְגַם־אַף עָלָה בְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: because they did not believe in God and did not trust His salvation.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִים וְלֹא בָטְחוּ בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ׃

verses.english: He commanded the skies above and opened heaven’s doors.
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו שְׁחָקִים מִמָּעַל וְדַלְתֵי שָׁמַיִם פָּתָח׃

verses.english: He rained manna upon them to eat and gave them heaven’s grain.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם מָן לֶאֱכֹל וּדְגַן־שָׁמַיִם נָתַן לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: A human ate the bread of mighty ones; He sent them provision to satisfaction.
verses.hebrew: לֶחֶם אַבִּירִים אָכַל אִישׁ צֵידָה שָׁלַח לָהֶם לָשֹׂבַע׃

verses.english: He set the east wind moving in heaven, and led the south wind by His strength.
verses.hebrew: יַסַּע קָדִים בַּשָּׁמָיִם וַיְנַהֵג בְּעֻזּוֹ תֵימָן׃

verses.english: He rained flesh upon them like dust, and winged birds like the sands of seas.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם כֶּעָפָר שְׁאֵר וּכְחוֹל יַמִּים עוֹף כָּנָף׃

verses.english: He made it fall within his camp, around his dwellings.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּפֵּל בְּקֶרֶב מַחֲנֵהוּ סָבִיב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָיו׃

verses.english: They ate and were greatly satisfied; He brought them their desire.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׂבְּעוּ מְאֹד וְתַאֲוָתָם יָבִא לָהֶם׃

verses.english: They were not estranged from their desire; while their food was still in their mouth,
verses.hebrew: לֹא־זָרוּ מִתַּאֲוָתָם עוֹד אָכְלָם בְּפִיהֶם׃

verses.english: God’s anger rose against them; He killed among their stout ones and brought Israel’s chosen men to their knees.
verses.hebrew: וְאַף אֱלֹהִים עָלָה בָהֶם וַיַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶם וּבַחוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִכְרִיעַ׃

verses.english: Through all this they sinned still and did not believe in His wonders.
verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־זֹאת חָטְאוּ־עוֹד וְלֹא־הֶאֱמִינוּ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: He ended their days in vapor, and their years in terror.
verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל־בַּהֶבֶל יְמֵיהֶם וּשְׁנוֹתָם בַּבֶּהָלָה׃

verses.english: When He killed them, they sought Him; they returned and sought God early.
verses.hebrew: אִם־הֲרָגָם וּדְרָשׁוּהוּ וְשָׁבוּ וְשִׁחֲרוּ־אֵל׃

verses.english: They remembered that God was their rock, and God Most High their redeemer.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְכְּרוּ כִּי־אֱלֹהִים צוּרָם וְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָם׃

verses.english: They enticed Him with their mouth, and lied to Him with their tongue.
verses.hebrew: וַיְפַתּוּהוּ בְּפִיהֶם וּבִלְשׁוֹנָם יְכַזְּבוּ־לוֹ׃

verses.english: Their heart was not steadfast with Him, and they were not faithful in His covenant.
verses.hebrew: וְלִבָּם לֹא־נָכוֹן עִמּוֹ וְלֹא נֶאֶמְנוּ בִּבְרִיתוֹ׃

verses.english: Yet He is compassionate; He atones for iniquity and does not destroy. He repeatedly turns back His anger and does not stir all His wrath.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא רַחוּם יְכַפֵּר עָוֺן וְלֹא־יַשְׁחִית וְהִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ וְלֹא־יָעִיר כָּל־חֲמָתוֹ׃

verses.english: He remembered that they were flesh, a spirit that goes away and does not return.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְכֹּר כִּי־בָשָׂר הֵמָּה רוּחַ הוֹלֵךְ וְלֹא יָשׁוּב׃

verses.english: How often they rebelled against Him in the wilderness, and grieved Him in the wasteland!
verses.hebrew: כַּמָּה יַמְרוּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּר יַעֲצִיבוּהוּ בִּישִׁימוֹן׃

verses.english: They turned again and tested God, and sought a sign from the Holy One of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁוּבוּ וַיְנַסּוּ אֵל וּקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הִתְווּ׃

verses.english: They did not remember His hand, the day He redeemed them from an adversary,
verses.hebrew: לֹא־זָכְרוּ אֶת־יָדוֹ יוֹם אֲ‍שֶׁר־פָּדָם מִנִּי־צָר׃

verses.english: when He set His signs in Egypt and His wonders in the field of Zoan.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם בְּמִצְרַיִם אֹתוֹתָיו וּמוֹפְתָיו בִּשְׂדֵה־צֹעַן׃

verses.english: He turned their Nile channels to blood, and their flowing waters they could not drink.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ לְדָם יְאֹרֵיהֶם וְנֹזְלֵיהֶם בַּל־יִשְׁתָּיוּן׃

verses.english: He sent a mixed swarm among them, and it devoured them, and frogs, and they destroyed them.
verses.hebrew: יְשַׁלַּח בָּהֶם עָרֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵם וּצְפַרְדֵּעַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵם׃

verses.english: He gave their yield to the devouring locust, and their toil to the locust swarm.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לֶחָסִיל יְבוּלָם וִיגִיעָם לָאַרְבֶּה׃

verses.english: He killed their vines with hail, and their sycamores with locusts.
verses.hebrew: יַהֲרֹג בַּבָּרָד גַּפְנָם וְשִׁקְמוֹתָם בַּחֲנָמַל׃

verses.english: He handed their animals over to hail, and their livestock to fiery bolts.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּסְגֵּר לַבָּרָד בְּעִירָם וּמִקְנֵיהֶם לָרְשָׁפִים׃

verses.english: He sent upon them His burning anger, wrath, fury and distress, a dispatch of evil messengers.
