verses.hebrew: יְשַׁלַּח־בָּם חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ עֶבְרָה וָזַעַם וְצָרָה מִשְׁלַחַת מַלְאֲכֵי רָעִים׃

verses.english: He leveled a path for His anger; He did not spare their soul from death, and handed their body over to pestilence.
verses.hebrew: יְפַלֵּס נָתִיב לְאַפּוֹ לֹא־חָשַׂךְ מִמָּוֶת נַפְשָׁם וְחַיָּתָם לַדֶּבֶר הִסְגִּיר׃

verses.english: He struck every firstborn in Egypt, the first of strength in Ham’s tents.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ כָּל־בְּכוֹר בְּמִצְרָיִם רֵאשִׁית אוֹנִים בְּאָהֳלֵי־חָם׃

verses.english: He set His people moving like sheep, and guided them like a flock in the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּסַּע כַּצֹּאן עַמּוֹ וַיְנַהֲגֵם כַּעֵדֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

verses.english: He led them securely, and they did not fear; the sea covered their enemies.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּנְחֵם לָבֶטַח וְלֹא פָחָדוּ וְאֶת־אוֹיְבֵיהֶם כִּסָּה הַיָּם׃

verses.english: He brought them to His holy territory, this mountain His right hand acquired.
verses.hebrew: וַיְבִיאֵם אֶל־גְּבוּל קָדְשׁוֹ הַר־זֶה קָנְתָה יְמִינוֹ׃

verses.english: He drove nations out before them, allotted them by a measuring line of inheritance, and settled Israel’s tribes in their tents.
verses.hebrew: וַיְגָרֶשׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶם גּוֹיִם וַיַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶבֶל נַחֲלָה וַיַּשְׁכֵּן בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Yet they tested and rebelled against God Most High and did not keep His testimonies.
verses.hebrew: וַיְנַסּוּ וַיַּמְרוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים עֶלְיוֹן וְעֵדוֹתָיו לֹא שָׁמָרוּ׃

verses.english: They turned back and acted faithlessly like their fathers; they turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסֹּגוּ וַיִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָם נֶהְפְּכוּ כְּקֶשֶׁת רְמִיָּה׃

verses.english: They angered Him with their high places and made Him jealous with their carved images.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכְעִיסוּהוּ בְּבָמוֹתָם וּבִפְסִילֵיהֶם יַקְנִיאוּהוּ׃

verses.english: God heard and grew wrathful, and utterly rejected Israel.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים וַיִּתְעַבָּר וַיִּמְאַס מְאֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: He abandoned Shiloh’s dwelling, the tent He had caused to dwell among humans.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּטֹּשׁ מִשְׁכַּן שִׁלוֹ אֹהֶל שִׁכֵּן בָּאָדָם׃

verses.english: He gave His strength into captivity, and His splendor into an adversary’s hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לַשְּׁבִי עֻזּוֹ וְתִפְאַרְתּוֹ בְיַד־צָר׃

verses.english: He handed His people over to the sword and raged against His inheritance.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּסְגֵּר לַחֶרֶב עַמּוֹ וּבְנַחֲלָתוֹ הִתְעַבָּר׃

verses.english: Fire consumed his young men, and his virgins had no wedding praise.
verses.hebrew: בַּחוּרָיו אָכְלָה־אֵשׁ וּבְתוּלֹתָיו לֹא הוּלָּלוּ׃

verses.english: His priests fell by the sword, and his widows did not weep.
verses.hebrew: כֹּהֲנָיו בַּחֶרֶב נָפָלוּ וְאַלְמְנֹתָיו לֹא תִבְכֶּינָה׃

verses.english: Then the Lord awoke like a sleeper, like a warrior shouting from wine.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַץ כְּיָשֵׁן אֲדֹנָי כְּגִבּוֹר מִתְרוֹנֵן מִיָּיִן׃

verses.english: He struck His adversaries in the rear; He gave them everlasting reproach.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ־צָרָיו אָחוֹר חֶרְפַּת עוֹלָם נָתַן לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: He rejected Joseph’s tent, and did not choose Ephraim’s tribe.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְאַס בְּאֹהֶל יוֹסֵף וּבְשֵׁבֶט אֶפְרַיִם לֹא בָחָר׃

verses.english: He chose Judah’s tribe, Mount Zion, which He loved.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְחַר אֶת־שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה אֶת־הַר צִיּוֹן אֲשֶׁר אָהֵב׃

verses.english: He built His sanctuary like the heights, like the earth He founded forever.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן כְּמוֹ־רָמִים מִקְדָּשׁוֹ כְּאֶרֶץ יְסָדָהּ לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: He chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְחַר בְּדָוִד עַבְדּוֹ וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מִמִּכְלְאֹת צֹאן׃

verses.english: From following nursing ewes He brought him to shepherd Jacob His people and Israel His inheritance.
verses.hebrew: מֵאַחַר עָלוֹת הֱבִיאוֹ לִרְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹב עַמּוֹ וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

verses.english: He shepherded them with his heart’s integrity, and guided them with his hands’ skill.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְעֵם כְּתֹם לְבָבוֹ וּבִתְבוּנוֹת כַּפָּיו יַנְחֵם׃

verses.english: A psalm of Asaph. God, nations have entered Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple; they have made Jerusalem into heaps.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֱ‍לֹהִים בָּאוּ גוֹיִם בְּנַחֲלָתֶךָ טִמְּאוּ אֶת־הֵיכַל קָדְשֶׁךָ שָׂמוּ אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם לְעִיִּים׃

verses.english: They have given the corpses of Your servants as food to the birds of heaven, the flesh of Your faithful ones to the beasts of the earth.
verses.hebrew: נָתְנוּ אֶת־נִבְלַת עֲבָדֶיךָ מַאֲכָל לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם בְּשַׂר חֲסִידֶיךָ לְחַיְתוֹ־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: They poured out their blood like water around Jerusalem, and there was no one to bury them.
verses.hebrew: שָׁפְכוּ דָמָם כַּמַּיִם סְבִיבוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם וְאֵין קוֹבֵר׃

verses.english: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, mockery and derision to those around us.
verses.hebrew: הָיִינוּ חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ לַעַג וָקֶלֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵינוּ׃

verses.english: How long, YHWH? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
verses.hebrew: עַד־מָה יְהוָה תֶּאֱנַף לָנֶצַח תִּבְעַר כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ קִנְאָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Pour out Your wrath upon the nations that do not know You, and upon kingdoms that have not called on Your name.
verses.hebrew: שְׁפֹךְ חֲמָתְךָ אֶל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יְדָעוּךָ וְעַל מַמְלָכוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּשִׁמְךָ לֹא קָרָאוּ׃

verses.english: For he has devoured Jacob, and they have devastated his dwelling.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אָכַל אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וְאֶת־נָוֵהוּ הֵשַׁמּוּ׃

verses.english: Do not remember against us the iniquities of those before us; let Your mercies quickly meet us, for we have become very low.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּזְכָּר־לָנוּ עֲוֺנֹת רִאשֹׁנִים מַהֵר יְקַדְּמוּנוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ כִּי דַלּוֹנוּ מְאֹד׃

verses.english: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; rescue us and atone for our sins for Your name's sake.
verses.hebrew: עָזְרֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ עַל־דְּבַר כְּבוֹד־שְׁמֶךָ וְהַצִּילֵנוּ וְכַפֵּר עַל־חַטֹּאתֵינוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ׃

verses.english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let vengeance for the poured-out blood of Your servants be known among the nations before our eyes.
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה אֱ‍לֹהֵיהֶם יִוָּדַע בגיים [בַּגּוֹיִם] לְעֵינֵינוּ נִקְמַת דַּם־עֲבָדֶיךָ הַשָּׁפוּךְ׃

verses.english: Let the prisoner's groaning come before You; according to the greatness of Your arm, release the sons of death.
verses.hebrew: תָּבוֹא לְפָנֶיךָ אֶנְקַת אָסִיר כְּגֹדֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ הוֹתֵר בְּנֵי תְמוּתָה׃

verses.english: Return to our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom the reproach with which they reproached You, Lord.
verses.hebrew: וְהָשֵׁב לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ שִׁבְעָתַיִם אֶל־חֵיקָם חֶרְפָּתָם אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּךָ אֲדֹנָי׃

verses.english: But we, Your people and the sheep of Your pasture, will thank You forever; from generation to generation we will recount Your praise.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנַחְנוּ עַמְּךָ וְצֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ נוֹדֶה לְּךָ לְעוֹלָם לְדֹר וָדֹר נְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃

verses.english: For the director; concerning Lilies. A testimony of Asaph. A psalm.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אֶל־שֹׁשַׁנִּים עֵדוּת לְאָסָף מִזְמוֹר׃

verses.english: Shepherd of Israel, listen, You who lead Joseph like sheep; You who sit upon the cherubim, shine forth.
verses.hebrew: רֹעֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל הַאֲזִינָה נֹהֵג כַּצֹּאן יוֹסֵף יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרוּבִים הוֹפִיעָה׃

verses.english: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, rouse Your might; it is for You to save us.
verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם וּבִנְיָמִן וּמְנַשֶּׁה עוֹרְרָה אֶת־גְּבוּרָתֶךָ וּלְכָה לִישֻׁעָתָה לָּנוּ׃

verses.english: God, restore us; make Your face shine, and we shall be saved.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ וְהָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה׃

verses.english: YHWH, God of hosts, how long have You smoked in anger against the prayer of Your people?
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת עַד־מָתַי עָשַׁנְתָּ בִּתְפִלַּת עַמֶּךָ׃

verses.english: You fed them bread of tears and gave them tears to drink by the shalish.
verses.hebrew: הֶאֱכַלְתָּם לֶחֶם דִּמְעָה וַתַּשְׁקֵמוֹ בִּדְמָעוֹת שָׁלִישׁ׃

verses.english: You make us an object of strife for our neighbors, and our enemies mock them.
verses.hebrew: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ מָדוֹן לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ וְאֹיְבֵינוּ יִלְעֲגוּ־לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: God of hosts, restore us; make Your face shine, and we shall be saved.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ וְהָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה׃

verses.english: You uprooted a vine from Egypt; You drove out nations and planted her.
verses.hebrew: גֶּפֶן מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּסִּיעַ תְּגָרֵשׁ גּוֹיִם וַתִּטָּעֶהָ׃

verses.english: You cleared a place before her and caused her roots to take root, and she filled the land.
verses.hebrew: פִּנִּיתָ לְפָנֶיהָ וַתַּשְׁרֵשׁ שָׁרָשֶׁיהָ וַתְּמַלֵּא־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Mountains were covered by her shadow, and her branches were like God's cedars.
verses.hebrew: כָּסּוּ הָרִים צִלָּהּ וַעֲנָפֶיהָ אַרְזֵי־אֵל׃

verses.english: She sent out her branches as far as the sea, and her shoots as far as the River.
verses.hebrew: תְּשַׁלַּח קְצִירֶהָ עַד־יָם וְאֶל־נָהָר יוֹנְקוֹתֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Why have You breached her fences, so that all who pass along the road pluck her?
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה פָּרַצְתָּ גְדֵרֶיהָ וְאָרוּהָ כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ׃

verses.english: A boar from the forest gnaws her, and the creeping thing of the field grazes her down.
verses.hebrew: יְכַרְסְמֶנָּה חֲזִיר מִיָּעַר וְזִיז שָׂדַי יִרְעֶנָּה׃

verses.english: God of hosts, please return; look from heaven and see, and attend to this vine,
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שׁוּב־נָא הַבֵּט מִשָּׁמַיִם וּרְאֵה וּפְקֹד גֶּפֶן זֹאת׃

verses.english: and the plant which Your right hand planted, and over the son whom You strengthened for Yourself.
verses.hebrew: וְכַנָּה אֲשֶׁר־נָטְעָה יְמִינֶךָ וְעַל־בֵּן אִמַּצְתָּה לָּךְ׃

verses.english: Burned by fire, cut down— at the rebuke of Your face they perish.
verses.hebrew: שְׂרֻפָה בָאֵשׁ כְּסוּחָה מִגַּעֲרַת פָּנֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ׃

verses.english: Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand, upon the son of man whom You strengthened for Yourself.
verses.hebrew: תְּהִי־יָדְךָ עַל־אִישׁ יְמִינֶךָ עַל־בֶּן־אָדָם אִמַּצְתָּ לָּךְ׃

verses.english: And we will not turn away from You; give us life, and we will call on Your name.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־נָסוֹג מִמֶּךָּ תְּחַיֵּנוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא׃

verses.english: YHWH, God of hosts, restore us; make Your face shine, and we shall be saved.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ הָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה׃

verses.english: For the director; upon the Gittith. Of Asaph.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־הַגִּתִּית לְאָסָף׃

verses.english: Sing joyfully to God our strength; raise a shout to the God of Jacob.
verses.hebrew: הַרְנִינוּ לֵאלֹהִים עוּזֵּנוּ הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: Raise a song and sound the tambourine, the pleasant lyre together with the harp.
verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ־זִמְרָה וּתְנוּ־תֹף כִּנּוֹר נָעִים עִם־נָבֶל׃

verses.english: Blow the horn at the new moon, at the appointed time for our feast day.
verses.hebrew: תִּקְעוּ בַחֹדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר בַּכֵּסֶה לְיוֹם חַגֵּנוּ׃

verses.english: For it is a statute for Israel, a judgment of the God of Jacob.
verses.hebrew: כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: He established it as a testimony in Jehoseph, when he went out over the land of Egypt; a language I did not know, I hear.
verses.hebrew: עֵדוּת בִּיהוֹסֵף שָׂמוֹ בְּצֵאתוֹ עַל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם שְׂפַת לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי אֶשְׁמָע׃

verses.english: I removed his shoulder from the burden; his palms passed away from the cooking pot.
verses.hebrew: הֲסִירוֹתִי מִסֵּבֶל שִׁכְמוֹ כַּפָּיו מִדּוּד תַּעֲבֹרְנָה׃

verses.english: In distress you called, and I rescued you; I answered you in the hiding place of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
verses.hebrew: בַּצָּרָה קָרָאתָ וָאֲחַלְּצֶךָּ אֶעֶנְךָ בְּסֵתֶר רַעַם אֶבְחָנְךָ עַל־מֵי מְרִיבָה סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Hear, My people, and I will testify against you; Israel, if you would listen to Me!
verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע עַמִּי וְאָעִידָה בָּךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אִם־תִּשְׁמַע־לִי׃

verses.english: There shall be no strange god among you; you shall not bow down to a foreign god.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִהְיֶה בְךָ אֵל זָר וְלֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְאֵל נֵכָר׃

verses.english: I am YHWH your God, who brought you up from the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַמַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם הַרְחֶב־פִּיךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵהוּ׃

verses.english: But My people did not listen to My voice, and Israel was not willing to follow Me.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע עַמִּי לְקוֹלִי וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־אָבָה לִי׃

verses.english: So I sent him away in the fancies of their heart; let them walk in their own counsels.
verses.hebrew: וָאֲשַׁלְּחֵהוּ בִּשְׁרִירוּת לִבָּם יֵלְכוּ בְּמוֹעֲצוֹתֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: If only My people would listen to Me, if Israel would walk in My ways,
verses.hebrew: לוּ עַמִּי שֹׁמֵעַ לִי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּדְרָכַי יְהַלֵּכוּ׃

verses.english: I would soon subdue their enemies and turn My hand against their adversaries.
verses.hebrew: כִּמְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶם אַכְנִיעַ וְעַל צָרֵיהֶם אָשִׁיב יָדִי׃

verses.english: Those who hate YHWH would lie to Him, and their time would be forever.
verses.hebrew: מְשַׂנְאֵי יְהוָה יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לוֹ וִיהִי עִתָּם לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: And He fed him with the finest wheat; with honey from the rock I will satisfy you.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּאֲכִילֵהוּ מֵחֵלֶב חִטָּה וּמִצּוּר דְּבַשׁ אַשְׂבִּיעֶךָ׃

verses.english: A psalm of Asaph. God stands in the assembly of God; amid the gods He judges.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֱ‍לֹהִים נִצָּב בַּעֲדַת־אֵל בְּקֶרֶב אֱלֹהִים יִשְׁפֹּט׃

verses.english: “How long will you judge unjustly and favor the wicked? Selah.
verses.hebrew: עַד־מָתַי תִּשְׁפְּטוּ־עָוֶל וּפְנֵי רְשָׁעִים תִּשְׂאוּ־סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Judge for the poor and the fatherless; vindicate the afflicted and the destitute.
verses.hebrew: שִׁפְטוּ־דַל וְיָתוֹם עָנִי וָרָשׁ הַצְדִּיקוּ׃

verses.english: Deliver the poor and the needy; rescue them from the hand of the wicked.”
verses.hebrew: פַּלְּטוּ־דַל וְאֶבְיוֹן מִיַּד רְשָׁעִים הַצִּילוּ׃

verses.english: They do not know and do not understand; they walk about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth totter.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יָדְעוּ וְלֹא יָבִינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָה יִתְהַלָּכוּ יִמּוֹטוּ כָּל־מוֹסְדֵי אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: “I said, ‘You are gods, and all of you sons of the Most High.’
verses.hebrew: אֲ‍נִי־אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִים אַתֶּם וּבְנֵי עֶלְיוֹן כֻּלְּכֶם׃

verses.english: Yet like Adam you will die, and like one of the princes you will fall.”
verses.hebrew: אָכֵן כְּאָדָם תְּמוּתוּן וּכְאַחַד הַשָּׂרִים תִּפֹּלוּ׃

verses.english: Arise, God, judge the earth, for You will inherit among all the nations.
verses.hebrew: קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים שָׁפְטָה הָאָרֶץ כִּי־אַתָּה תִנְחַל בְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: A song. A psalm of Asaph.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף׃

verses.english: God, let there be no silence with You; do not be deaf or remain still, God.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים אַל־דֳּמִי־לָךְ אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ וְאַל־תִּשְׁקֹט אֵל׃

verses.english: For look, Your enemies are in uproar, and those who hate You have lifted their head.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִנֵּה אוֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָיוּן וּמְשַׂנְאֶיךָ נָשְׂאוּ רֹאשׁ׃

verses.english: Against Your people they cunningly devise a secret plan; they consult together against Your sheltered ones.
verses.hebrew: עַל־עַמְּךָ יַעֲרִימוּ סוֹד וְיִתְיָעֲצוּ עַל־צְפוּנֶיךָ׃

verses.english: They said, “Come, let us wipe them out as a nation, so that Israel's name will be remembered no more.”
verses.hebrew: אָמְרוּ לְכוּ וְנַכְחִידֵם מִגּוֹי וְלֹא־יִזָּכֵר שֵׁם־יִשְׂרָאֵל עוֹד׃

verses.english: For they have taken counsel with one heart; against You they make a covenant:
verses.hebrew: כִּי נוֹעֲצוּ לֵב יַחְדָּו עָלֶיךָ בְּרִית יִכְרֹתוּ׃

verses.english: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,
verses.hebrew: אָהֳלֵי אֱדוֹם וְיִשְׁמְעֵאלִים מוֹאָב וְהַגְרִים׃

verses.english: Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre.
verses.hebrew: גְּבָל וְעַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵק פְּלֶשֶׁת עִם־יֹשְׁבֵי צוֹר׃

verses.english: Assyria too has joined them; they have become an arm for the sons of Lot. Selah.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־אַשּׁוּר נִלְוָה עִמָּם הָיוּ זְרוֹעַ לִבְנֵי־לוֹט סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Do to them as to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin at the torrent Kishon,
verses.hebrew: עֲשֵׂה־לָהֶם כְּמִדְיָן כְּסִיסְרָא כְיָבִין בְּנַחַל קִישׁוֹן׃

verses.english: who were destroyed at En-dor and became dung for the ground.
verses.hebrew: נִשְׁמְדוּ בְעֵין־דֹּאר הָיוּ דֹּמֶן לָאֲדָמָה׃

verses.english: Make them—their nobles—like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
verses.hebrew: שִׁיתֵמוֹ נְדִיבֵמוֹ כְּעֹרֵב וְכִזְאֵב וּכְזֶבַח וּכְצַלְמֻנָּע כָּל־נְסִיכֵמוֹ׃

verses.english: who said, “Let us take possession for ourselves of God's dwelling places.”
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ נִירֲשָׁה לָּנוּ אֵת נְאוֹת אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: My God, make them like whirling thistle heads, like stubble before the wind.
verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי שִׁיתֵמוֹ כַגַּלְגַּל כְּקַשׁ לִפְנֵי־רוּחַ׃

verses.english: As fire burns a forest, and as flame sets mountains ablaze,
verses.hebrew: כְּאֵשׁ תִּבְעַר־יָעַר וּכְלֶהָבָה תְּלַהֵט הָרִים׃

verses.english: so pursue them with Your storm and terrify them with Your whirlwind.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן תִּרְדְּפֵם בְּסַעֲרֶךָ וּבְסוּפָתְךָ תְבַהֲלֵם׃

verses.english: Fill their faces with dishonor, so that they may seek Your name, YHWH.
verses.hebrew: מַלֵּא פְנֵיהֶם קָלוֹן וִיבַקְשׁוּ שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Let them be ashamed and terrified forever; let them be abashed and perish.
verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲלוּ עֲדֵי־עַד וְיַחְפְּרוּ וְיֹאבֵדוּ׃

verses.english: Let them know that You—Your name is YHWH— You alone are Most High over all the earth.
verses.hebrew: וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־אַתָּה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה לְבַדֶּךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: For the director; upon the Gittith. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־הַגִּתִּית לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר׃

verses.english: How beloved are Your dwelling places, YHWH of hosts!
verses.hebrew: מַה־יְּדִידוֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת׃

verses.english: My soul longs, indeed pines, for the courts of YHWH; my heart and my flesh cry out to the living God.
verses.hebrew: נִכְסְפָה וְגַם־כָּלְתָה נַפְשִׁי לְחַצְרוֹת יְהוָה לִבִּי וּבְשָׂרִי יְרַנְּנוּ אֶל אֵל־חָי׃

verses.english: Even a bird has found a house, and a swallow a nest for herself, where she has placed her young— Your altars, YHWH of hosts, my King and my God.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־צִפּוֹר מָצְאָה בַיִת וּדְרוֹר קֵן לָהּ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁתָה אֶפְרֹחֶיהָ אֶת־מִזְבְּחוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת מַלְכִּי וֵאלֹהָי׃

verses.english: Happy are those who dwell in Your house; they will yet praise You. Selah.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה׃

verses.english: Happy is the person whose strength is in You, with highways in their heart.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם עוֹז־לוֹ בָךְ מְסִלּוֹת בִּלְבָבָם׃

verses.english: Those passing through the Valley of Baca make it a spring; the teacher also is robed in blessings.
verses.hebrew: עֹבְרֵי בְּעֵמֶק הַבָּכָא מַעְיָן יְשִׁיתוּהוּ גַּם־בְּרָכוֹת יַעְטֶה מוֹרֶה׃

verses.english: They go from strength to strength; he will appear before God in Zion.
verses.hebrew: יֵלְכוּ מֵחַיִל אֶל־חָיִל יֵרָאֶה אֶל־אֱלֹהִים בְּצִיּוֹן׃

verses.english: YHWH, God of hosts, hear my prayer; listen, God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃

verses.english: See our shield, God; look upon the face of Your anointed.
verses.hebrew: מָגִנֵּנוּ רְאֵה אֱלֹהִים וְהַבֵּט פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃

verses.english: For a day in Your courts is better than a thousand; I choose to remain at the threshold in the house of my God rather than dwell in tents of wickedness.
verses.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב־יוֹם בַּחֲצֵרֶיךָ מֵאָלֶף בָּחַרְתִּי הִסְתּוֹפֵף בְּבֵית אֱלֹהַי מִדּוּר בְּאָהֳלֵי־רֶשַׁע׃

verses.english: For YHWH God is a sun and a shield; YHWH gives favor and glory; He withholds no good from those who walk in integrity.
verses.hebrew: כִּי שֶׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים חֵן וְכָבוֹד יִתֵּן יְהוָה לֹא יִמְנַע־טוֹב לַהֹלְכִים בְּתָמִים׃

verses.english: YHWH of hosts, happy is the person who trusts in You.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵחַ בָּךְ׃

verses.english: For the director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר׃

verses.english: You favored Your land, YHWH; You restored Jacob's captivity.
verses.hebrew: רָצִיתָ יְהוָה אַרְצֶךָ שַׁבְתָּ שבות [שְׁבִית] יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: You lifted away Your people's guilt; You covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.hebrew: נָשָׂאתָ עֲוֺן עַמֶּךָ כִּסִּיתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָם סֶלָה׃

verses.english: You gathered away all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.
verses.hebrew: אָסַפְתָּ כָל־עֶבְרָתֶךָ הֱשִׁיבוֹתָ מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Restore us, God of our salvation; break off Your anger toward us.
verses.hebrew: שׁוּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ וְהָפֵר כַּעַסְךָ עִמָּנוּ׃

verses.english: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You stretch Your anger from generation to generation?
verses.hebrew: הַלְעוֹלָם תֶּאֱנַף־בָּנוּ תִּמְשֹׁךְ אַפְּךָ לְדֹר וָדֹר׃

verses.english: Will You not return and give us life, so that Your people may rejoice in You?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־אַתָּה תָּשׁוּב תְּחַיֵּנוּ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂמְחוּ־בָךְ׃

verses.english: Show us Your steadfast love, YHWH, and give us Your salvation.
verses.hebrew: הַרְאֵנוּ יְהוָה חַסְדֶּךָ וְיֶשְׁעֲךָ תִּתֶּן־לָנוּ׃

verses.english: Let me hear what God, YHWH, will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and His faithful ones; but let them not return to folly.
verses.hebrew: אֶשְׁמְעָה מַה־יְדַבֵּר הָאֵל יְהוָה כִּי יְדַבֵּר שָׁלוֹם אֶל־עַמּוֹ וְאֶל־חֲסִידָיו וְאַל־יָשׁוּבוּ לְכִסְלָה׃

verses.english: Surely His salvation is near those who fear Him, so that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ קָרוֹב לִירֵאָיו יִשְׁעוֹ לִשְׁכֹּן כָּבוֹד בְּאַרְצֵנוּ׃

verses.english: Steadfast love and truth have met; righteousness and peace have kissed.
verses.hebrew: חֶסֶד־וֶאֱמֶת נִפְגָּשׁוּ צֶדֶק וְשָׁלוֹם נָשָׁקוּ׃

verses.english: Truth will spring from the earth, and righteousness has looked down from heaven.
verses.hebrew: אֱמֶת מֵאֶרֶץ תִּצְמָח וְצֶדֶק מִשָּׁמַיִם נִשְׁקָף׃

verses.english: YHWH also will give what is good, and our land will give its produce.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־יְהוָה יִתֵּן הַטּוֹב וְאַרְצֵנוּ תִּתֵּן יְבוּלָהּ׃

verses.english: Righteousness will go before Him, and He will place it in the way of His footsteps.
verses.hebrew: צֶדֶק לְפָנָיו יְהַלֵּךְ וְיָשֵׂם לְדֶרֶךְ פְּעָמָיו׃

verses.english: A prayer of David. Incline Your ear, YHWH; answer me, for I am afflicted and needy.
verses.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לְדָוִד הַטֵּה־יְהוָה אָזְנְךָ עֲנֵנִי כִּי־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָנִי׃

verses.english: Guard my soul, for I am faithful; save Your servant—You, my God— who trusts in You.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי כִּי־חָסִיד אָנִי הוֹשַׁע עַבְדְּךָ אַתָּה אֱלֹהַי הַבּוֹטֵחַ אֵלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Be gracious to me, Lord, for I call to You all day.
verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי אֲדֹנָי כִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶקְרָא כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: Gladden the soul of Your servant, for to You, Lord, I lift my soul.
verses.hebrew: שַׂמֵּחַ נֶפֶשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּׂא׃

verses.english: For You, Lord, are good and forgiving, abundant in steadfast love to all who call on You.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב־חֶסֶד לְכָל־קֹרְאֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Listen, YHWH, to my prayer; attend to the voice of my pleas for grace.
verses.hebrew: הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה תְּפִלָּתִי וְהַקְשִׁיבָה בְּקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָי׃

verses.english: On the day of my distress I will call to You, for You will answer me.
verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי אֶקְרָאֶךָּ כִּי תַעֲנֵנִי׃

verses.english: There is none like You among the gods, Lord, and there are no works like Yours.
verses.hebrew: אֵין־כָּמוֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי וְאֵין כְּמַעֲשֶׂיךָ׃

verses.english: All the nations You have made will come and bow down before You, Lord, and glorify Your name.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־גּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ יָבוֹאוּ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי וִיכַבְּדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ׃

verses.english: For You are great and do wonders; You alone are God.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־גָדוֹל אַתָּה וְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Teach me Your way, YHWH; I will walk in Your truth. Unite my heart to fear Your name.
verses.hebrew: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ אֲהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּךָ יַחֵד לְבָבִי לְיִרְאָה שְׁמֶךָ׃

verses.english: I will thank You, Lord my God, with all my heart, and glorify Your name forever,
verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהַי בְּכָל־לְבָבִי וַאֲכַבְּדָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: for Your steadfast love toward me is great, and You rescued my soul from lowest Sheol.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־חַסְדְּךָ גָּדוֹל עָלָי וְהִצַּלְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׁאוֹל תַּחְתִּיָּה׃

verses.english: God, presumptuous people have risen against me, and an assembly of ruthless men has sought my soul; they have not set You before them.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים זֵדִים קָמוּ־עָלַי וַעֲדַת עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי וְלֹא שָׂמוּךָ לְנֶגְדָּם׃

verses.english: But You, Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger and abundant in steadfast love and truth.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אֲדֹנָי אֵל־רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃

verses.english: Turn toward me and be gracious to me; give Your strength to Your servant and save the son of Your maidservant.
verses.hebrew: פְּנֵה אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי תְּנָה־עֻזְּךָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעָה לְבֶן־אֲמָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Work a sign for good with me; let those who hate me see and be ashamed, for You, YHWH, have helped and comforted me.
verses.hebrew: עֲשֵׂה־עִמִּי אוֹת לְטוֹבָה וְיִרְאוּ שֹׂנְאַי וְיֵבֹשׁוּ כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה עֲזַרְתַּנִי וְנִחַמְתָּנִי׃

verses.english: Of the sons of Korah. A psalm. A song. Its foundation is in holy mountains.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר יְסוּדָתוֹ בְּהַרְרֵי־קֹדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: YHWH loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwelling places of Jacob.
verses.hebrew: אֹהֵב יְהוָה שַׁעֲרֵי צִיּוֹן מִכֹּל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: Glorious things are spoken of you, city of God. Selah.
verses.hebrew: נִכְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּר בָּךְ עִיר הָאֱלֹהִים סֶלָה׃

verses.english: I will mention Rahab and Babylon to those who know me. Look: Philistia and Tyre, with Cush— “This one was born there.”
verses.hebrew: אַזְכִּיר רַהַב וּבָבֶל לְיֹדְעָי הִנֵּה פְלֶשֶׁת וְצוֹר עִם־כּוּשׁ זֶה יֻלַּד־שָׁם׃

verses.english: And of Zion it will be said, “This man and that man were born in her,” and the Most High Himself will establish her.
verses.hebrew: וּלֲצִיּוֹן יֵאָמַר אִישׁ וְאִישׁ יֻלַּד־בָּהּ וְהוּא יְכוֹנְנֶהָ עֶלְיוֹן׃

verses.english: YHWH will count when He records the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יִסְפֹּר בִּכְתוֹב עַמִּים זֶה יֻלַּד־שָׁם סֶלָה׃

verses.english: And singers, like dancers: “All my springs are in you.”
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁרִים כְּחֹלְלִים כָּל־מַעְיָנַי בָּךְ׃

verses.english: A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah. For the director; upon Mahalath Leannoth. A maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לִבְנֵי קֹרַח לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מָחֲלַת לְעַנּוֹת מַשְׂכִּיל לְהֵימָן הָאֶזְרָחִי׃

verses.english: YHWH, God of my salvation, by day I cry out, at night before You.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יְשׁוּעָתִי יוֹם־צָעַקְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה נֶגְדֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Let my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.
verses.hebrew: תָּבוֹא לְפָנֶיךָ תְּפִלָּתִי הַטֵּה־אָזְנְךָ לְרִנָּתִי׃

verses.english: For my soul is sated with troubles, and my life has reached Sheol.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־שָׂבְעָה בְרָעוֹת נַפְשִׁי וְחַיַּי לִשְׁאוֹל הִגִּיעוּ׃

verses.english: I am counted with those who go down to the pit; I have become like a man without strength,
verses.hebrew: נֶחְשַׁבְתִּי עִם־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר הָיִיתִי כְּגֶבֶר אֵין־אֱיָל׃

verses.english: free among the dead, like the slain lying in a grave, whom You remember no more, and who are cut off from Your hand.
verses.hebrew: בַּמֵּתִים חָפְשִׁי כְּמוֹ חֲלָלִים שֹׁכְבֵי קֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר לֹא זְכַרְתָּם עוֹד וְהֵמָּה מִיָּדְךָ נִגְזָרוּ׃

verses.english: You put me in the lowest pit, in dark places, in depths.
verses.hebrew: שַׁתַּנִי בְּבוֹר תַּחְתִּיּוֹת בְּמַחֲשַׁכִּים בִּמְצֹלוֹת׃

verses.english: Your wrath has rested heavily on me; with all Your breakers You have afflicted me. Selah.
verses.hebrew: עָלַי סָמְכָה חֲמָתֶךָ וְכָל־מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ עִנִּיתָ סֶּלָה׃

verses.english: You have put my acquaintances far from me; You have made me an object of abomination to them. I am shut in and cannot go out.
verses.hebrew: הִרְחַקְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַי מִמֶּנִּי שַׁתַּנִי תוֹעֵבוֹת לָמוֹ כָּלֻא וְלֹא אֵצֵא׃

verses.english: My eye wastes away from affliction. I call to You, YHWH, every day; I spread my palms toward You.
verses.hebrew: עֵינִי דָאֲבָה מִנִּי עֹנִי קְרָאתִיךָ יְהוָה בְּכָל־יוֹם שִׁטַּחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ כַפָּי׃

verses.english: Will You work a wonder for the dead? Will the shades rise and thank You? Selah.
verses.hebrew: הֲלַמֵּתִים תַּעֲשֶׂה־פֶּלֶא אִם־רְפָאִים יָקוּמוּ יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה׃

verses.english: Will Your steadfast love be recounted in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon?
verses.hebrew: הַיְסֻפַּר בַּקֶּבֶר חַסְדֶּךָ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בָּאֲבַדּוֹן׃

verses.english: Will Your wonder be known in darkness, and Your righteousness in a land of forgetfulness?
verses.hebrew: הֲיִוָּדַע בַּחֹשֶׁךְ פִּלְאֶךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ בְּאֶרֶץ נְשִׁיָּה׃

verses.english: But I have cried to You for help, YHWH; in the morning my prayer will meet You.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה שִׁוַּעְתִּי וּבַבֹּקֶר תְּפִלָּתִי תְקַדְּמֶךָּ׃

verses.english: Why, YHWH, do You reject my soul and hide Your face from me?
verses.hebrew: לָמָה יְהוָה תִּזְנַח נַפְשִׁי תַּסְתִּיר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: I am afflicted and dying from youth; I have borne Your terrors; I am bewildered.
verses.hebrew: עָנִי אֲנִי וְגֹוֵעַ מִנֹּעַר נָשָׂאתִי אֵמֶיךָ אָפוּנָה׃

verses.english: Your burning angers passed over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.
verses.hebrew: עָלַי עָבְרוּ חֲרוֹנֶיךָ בִּעוּתֶיךָ צִמְּתוּתֻנִי׃

verses.english: They surrounded me like water all day; together they encircled me.
verses.hebrew: סַבּוּנִי כַמַּיִם כָּל־הַיּוֹם הִקִּיפוּ עָלַי יָחַד׃

verses.english: You have put lover and companion far from me; my acquaintances are darkness.
verses.hebrew: הִרְחַקְתָּ מִמֶּנִּי אֹהֵב וָרֵעַ מְיֻדָּעַי מַחְשָׁךְ׃

verses.english: A maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite.
verses.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאֵיתָן הָאֶזְרָחִי׃

verses.english: I will sing of YHWH's acts of steadfast love forever; from generation to generation I will make Your faithfulness known with my mouth.
verses.hebrew: חַסְדֵי יְהוָה עוֹלָם אָשִׁירָה לְדֹר וָדֹר אוֹדִיעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בְּפִי׃

verses.english: For I said, “Steadfast love will be built forever; in the heavens You will establish Your faithfulness.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמַרְתִּי עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה שָׁמַיִם תָּכִן אֱמוּנָתְךָ בָהֶם׃

verses.english: “I have made a covenant with My chosen one; I have sworn to David My servant:
verses.hebrew: כָּרַתִּי בְרִית לִבְחִירִי נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְדָוִד עַבְדִּי׃

verses.english: ‘I will establish your seed forever and build your throne from generation to generation.’” Selah.
verses.hebrew: עַד־עוֹלָם אָכִין זַרְעֶךָ וּבָנִיתִי לְדֹר־וָדוֹר כִּסְאֲךָ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: The heavens will thank You for Your wonder, YHWH, and for Your faithfulness in the assembly of holy ones.
verses.hebrew: וְיוֹדוּ שָׁמַיִם פִּלְאֲךָ יְהוָה אַף־אֱמוּנָתְךָ בִּקְהַל קְדֹשִׁים׃

verses.english: For who in the sky can be compared with YHWH? Who among the sons of gods is like YHWH?
verses.hebrew: כִּי מִי בַשַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹךְ לַיהוָה יִדְמֶה לַיהוָה בִּבְנֵי אֵלִים׃

verses.english: God is held in awe in the great council of holy ones, and feared above all who surround Him.
verses.hebrew: אֵל נַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד־קְדֹשִׁים רַבָּה וְנוֹרָא עַל־כָּל־סְבִיבָיו׃

verses.english: YHWH, God of hosts, who is mighty like You, Yah? Your faithfulness surrounds You.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת מִי־כָמוֹךָ חֲסִין יָהּ וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ סְבִיבוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: You rule the sea's proud swelling; when its waves rise, You still them.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה מוֹשֵׁל בְּגֵאוּת הַיָּם בְּשׂוֹא גַלָּיו אַתָּה תְשַׁבְּחֵם׃

verses.english: You crushed Rahab like one slain; with Your strong arm You scattered Your enemies.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה דִכִּאתָ כֶחָלָל רָהַב בִּזְרוֹעַ עֻזְּךָ פִּזַּרְתָּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ׃

verses.english: The heavens are Yours; the earth also is Yours; the world and its fullness—You founded them.
verses.hebrew: לְךָ שָׁמַיִם אַף־לְךָ אָרֶץ תֵּבֵל וּמְלֹאָהּ אַתָּה יְסַדְתָּם׃

verses.english: The north and the south—You created them; Tabor and Hermon shout joyfully in Your name.
verses.hebrew: צָפוֹן וְיָמִין אַתָּה בְרָאתָם תָּבוֹר וְחֶרְמוֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ׃

verses.english: Yours is an arm with might; Your hand is strong; Your right hand is raised.
verses.hebrew: לְךָ זְרוֹעַ עִם־גְּבוּרָה תָּעֹז יָדְךָ תָּרוּם יְמִינֶךָ׃

verses.english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; steadfast love and truth go before Your face.
verses.hebrew: צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאֶךָ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יְקַדְּמוּ פָנֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Happy are the people who know the shout; YHWH, they walk in the light of Your face.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם יוֹדְעֵי תְרוּעָה יְהוָה בְּאוֹר־פָּנֶיךָ יְהַלֵּכוּן׃

verses.english: In Your name they rejoice all day, and through Your righteousness they are raised up.
verses.hebrew: בְּשִׁמְךָ יְגִילוּן כָּל־הַיּוֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ יָרוּמוּ׃

verses.english: For You are the splendor of their strength, and by Your favor our horn will rise.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תִפְאֶרֶת עֻזָּמוֹ אָתָּה וּבִרְצֹנְךָ תרים [תָּרוּם] קַרְנֵנוּ׃

verses.english: For our shield belongs to YHWH, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לַיהוָה מָגִנֵּנוּ וְלִקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְכֵּנוּ׃

verses.english: Then You spoke in a vision to Your faithful ones and said: “I have placed help upon a mighty man; I have raised a chosen one from the people.
verses.hebrew: אָז דִּבַּרְתָּ־בְחָזוֹן לַחֲסִידֶיךָ וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁוִּיתִי עֵזֶר עַל־גִּבּוֹר הֲרִימוֹתִי בָחוּר מֵעָם׃

verses.english: I have found David My servant; with My holy oil I have anointed him,
verses.hebrew: מָצָאתִי דָּוִד עַבְדִּי בְּשֶׁמֶן קָדְשִׁי מְשַׁחְתִּיו׃

verses.english: with whom My hand will be established; My arm also will strengthen him.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר יָדִי תִּכּוֹן עִמּוֹ אַף־זְרוֹעִי תְאַמְּצֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: No enemy will exact from him, and no son of injustice will afflict him.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַשִּׁא אוֹיֵב בּוֹ וּבֶן־עַוְלָה לֹא יְעַנֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: I will crush his adversaries before him and strike those who hate him.
verses.hebrew: וְכַתּוֹתִי מִפָּנָיו צָרָיו וּמְשַׂנְאָיו אֶגּוֹף׃

verses.english: My faithfulness and My steadfast love will be with him, and in My name his horn will rise.
verses.hebrew: וֶאֶמוּנָתִי וְחַסְדִּי עִמּוֹ וּבִשְׁמִי תָּרוּם קַרְנוֹ׃

verses.english: I will set his hand on the sea and his right hand on rivers.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי בַיָּם יָדוֹ וּבַנְּהָרוֹת יְמִינוֹ׃

verses.english: He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God and the rock of my salvation.’
verses.hebrew: הוּא יִקְרָאֵנִי אָבִי אָתָּה אֵלִי וְצוּר יְשׁוּעָתִי׃

verses.english: I too will make him firstborn, highest among the kings of the earth.
verses.hebrew: אַף־אָנִי בְּכוֹר אֶתְּנֵהוּ עֶלְיוֹן לְמַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Forever I will keep My steadfast love for him, and My covenant will be faithful to him.
verses.hebrew: לְעוֹלָם אשמור־[אֶשְׁמָר־] לוֹ חַסְדִּי וּבְרִיתִי נֶאֱמֶנֶת לוֹ׃

verses.english: I will establish his seed forever and his throne like the days of heaven.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי לָעַד זַרְעוֹ וְכִסְאוֹ כִּימֵי שָׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: If his sons forsake My instruction and do not walk in My judgments,
verses.hebrew: אִם־יַעַזְבוּ בָנָיו תּוֹרָתִי וּבְמִשְׁפָּטַי לֹא יֵלֵכוּן׃

verses.english: if they profane My statutes and do not keep My commandments,
verses.hebrew: אִם־חֻקֹּתַי יְחַלֵּלוּ וּמִצְוֺתַי לֹא יִשְׁמֹרוּ׃

verses.english: I will visit their rebellion with a rod and their guilt with blows.
verses.hebrew: וּפָקַדְתִּי בְשֵׁבֶט פִּשְׁעָם וּבִנְגָעִים עֲוֺנָם׃

verses.english: But I will not withdraw My steadfast love from him, and I will not be false to My faithfulness.
verses.hebrew: וְחַסְדִּי לֹא־אָפִיר מֵעִמּוֹ וְלֹא־אֲשַׁקֵּר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִי׃

verses.english: I will not profane My covenant or change what has gone out from My lips.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־אֲחַלֵּל בְּרִיתִי וּמוֹצָא שְׂפָתַי לֹא אֲשַׁנֶּה׃

verses.english: Once I swore by My holiness: I will not fail David.
verses.hebrew: אַחַת נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי בְקָדְשִׁי אִם־לְדָוִד אֲכַזֵּב׃

verses.english: His seed will exist forever, and his throne will be like the sun before Me.
verses.hebrew: זַרְעוֹ לְעוֹלָם יִהְיֶה וְכִסְאוֹ כַשֶּׁמֶשׁ נֶגְדִּי׃

verses.english: Like the moon it will be established forever; and a witness in the sky is faithful.” Selah.
verses.hebrew: כְּיָרֵחַ יִכּוֹן עוֹלָם וְעֵד בַּשַּׁחַק נֶאֱמָן סֶלָה׃

verses.english: But You have rejected and despised; You have been furious with Your anointed.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה זָנַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָס הִתְעַבַּרְתָּ עִם־מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃

verses.english: You have repudiated Your servant's covenant; You have profaned his crown to the ground.
verses.hebrew: נֵאַרְתָּה בְּרִית עַבְדֶּךָ חִלַּלְתָּ לָאָרֶץ נִזְרוֹ׃

verses.english: You have breached all his fences; You have made his strongholds a ruin.
verses.hebrew: פָּרַצְתָּ כָל־גְּדֵרֹתָיו שַׂמְתָּ מִבְצָרָיו מְחִתָּה׃

verses.english: All who pass along the road plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
verses.hebrew: שַׁסֻּהוּ כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ הָיָה חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנָיו׃

verses.english: You have raised the right hand of his adversaries; You have made all his enemies rejoice.
verses.hebrew: הֲרִימוֹתָ יְמִין צָרָיו הִשְׂמַחְתָּ כָּל־אוֹיְבָיו׃

verses.english: You have even turned back the edge of his sword and have not upheld him in battle.
verses.hebrew: אַף־תָּשִׁיב צוּר חַרְבּוֹ וְלֹא הֲקֵימֹתוֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: You have brought his splendor to an end; You have cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּתָּ מִטְּהָרוֹ וְכִסְאוֹ לָאָרֶץ מִגַּרְתָּה׃

verses.english: You have shortened the days of his youth; You have clothed him in shame. Selah.
verses.hebrew: הִקְצַרְתָּ יְמֵי עֲלוּמָיו הֶעֱטִיתָ עָלָיו בּוּשָׁה סֶלָה׃

verses.english: How long, YHWH? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath burn like fire?
verses.hebrew: עַד־מָה יְהוָה תִּסָּתֵר לָנֶצַח תִּבְעַר כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ חֲמָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Remember: what lifetime have I? For what futility have You created all the sons of Adam?
verses.hebrew: זְכָר־אֲנִי מֶה־חָלֶד עַל־מַה־שָּׁוְא בָּרָאתָ כָל־בְּנֵי־אָדָם׃

verses.english: What man can live and not see death, can rescue his soul from the hand of Sheol? Selah.
verses.hebrew: מִי גֶבֶר יִחְיֶה וְלֹא יִרְאֶה־מָּוֶת יְמַלֵּט נַפְשׁוֹ מִיַּד־שְׁאוֹל סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Where are Your former acts of steadfast love, Lord, which You swore to David in Your faithfulness?
verses.hebrew: אַיֵּה חֲסָדֶיךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲדֹנָי נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לְדָוִד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Remember, Lord, the reproach of Your servants; I bear in my bosom the burden of all the many peoples,
verses.hebrew: זְכֹר אֲדֹנָי חֶרְפַּת עֲבָדֶיךָ שְׂאֵתִי בְחֵיקִי כָּל־רַבִּים עַמִּים׃

verses.english: with which Your enemies reproached, YHWH, with which they reproached the footsteps of Your anointed.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ עִקְּבוֹת מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃

verses.english: Blessed be YHWH forever. Amen and amen.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם אָמֵן וְאָמֵן׃

verses.english: A prayer of Moses, the man of God. Lord, You have been our dwelling place through every generation.
verses.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לְמֹשֶׁה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲ‍דֹנָי מָעוֹן אַתָּה הָיִיתָ לָּנוּ בְּדֹר וָדֹר׃

verses.english: Before the mountains were born, and You brought forth earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
verses.hebrew: בְּטֶרֶם הָרִים יֻלָּדוּ וַתְּחוֹלֵל אֶרֶץ וְתֵבֵל וּמֵעוֹלָם עַד־עוֹלָם אַתָּה אֵל׃

verses.english: You turn mortals back to crushing, and say, Return, children of humankind.
verses.hebrew: תָּשֵׁב אֱנוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּא וַתֹּאמֶר שׁוּבוּ בְנֵי־אָדָם׃

verses.english: For a thousand years in Your eyes are like yesterday when it passes, like a watch in the night.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶלֶף שָׁנִים בְּעֵינֶיךָ כְּיוֹם אֶתְמוֹל כִּי יַעֲבֹר וְאַשְׁמוּרָה בַלָּיְלָה׃

verses.english: You sweep them away; they become a sleep. In the morning, like grass, it springs up.
verses.hebrew: זְרַמְתָּם שֵׁנָה יִהְיוּ בַּבֹּקֶר כֶּחָצִיר יַחֲלֹף׃

verses.english: In the morning it blossoms and springs up; by evening it is cut down and dries up.
verses.hebrew: בַּבֹּקֶר יָצִיץ וְחָלָף לָעֶרֶב יְמוֹלֵל וְיָבֵשׁ׃

verses.english: For we are consumed by Your anger, and terrified by Your wrath.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־כָלִינוּ בְאַפֶּךָ וּבַחֲמָתְךָ נִבְהָלְנוּ׃

verses.english: You have set our iniquities before You, our hidden things in the light of Your face.
verses.hebrew: שת [שַׁתָּה] עֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּךָ עֲלֻמֵנוּ לִמְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ׃

verses.english: For all our days pass away under Your fury; we finish our years like a sigh.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כָל־יָמֵינוּ פָּנוּ בְעֶבְרָתֶךָ כִּלִּינוּ שָׁנֵינוּ כְמוֹ־הֶגֶה׃

verses.english: The days of our years are seventy years, or, with strength, eighty years; their pride is toil and trouble, for it passes swiftly, and we fly away.
verses.hebrew: יְמֵי־שְׁנוֹתֵינוּ בָהֶם שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וְאִם בִּגְבוּרֹת שְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה וְרָהְבָּם עָמָל וָאָוֶן כִּי־גָז חִישׁ וַנָּעֻפָה׃

verses.english: Who knows the strength of Your anger, and Your fury according to the fear due You?
verses.hebrew: מִי־יוֹדֵעַ עֹז אַפֶּךָ וּכְיִרְאָתְךָ עֶבְרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: So teach us to number our days, that we may bring in a heart of wisdom.
verses.hebrew: לִמְנוֹת יָמֵינוּ כֵּן הוֹדַע וְנָבִא לְבַב חָכְמָה׃

verses.english: Return, YHWH—how long? Relent concerning Your servants.
verses.hebrew: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה עַד־מָתָי וְהִנָּחֵם עַל־עֲבָדֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Satisfy us in the morning with Your steadfast love, that we may sing joyfully and rejoice all our days.
verses.hebrew: שַׂבְּעֵנוּ בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וּנְרַנְּנָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בְּכָל־יָמֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Make us glad according to the days You afflicted us, the years when we saw evil.
verses.hebrew: שַׂמְּחֵנוּ כִּימוֹת עִנִּיתָנוּ שְׁנוֹת רָאִינוּ רָעָה׃

verses.english: Let Your work appear to Your servants, and Your splendor upon their children.
verses.hebrew: יֵרָאֶה אֶל־עֲבָדֶיךָ פָעֳלֶךָ וַהֲדָרְךָ עַל־בְּנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us; establish the work of our hands for us— yes, establish the work of our hands.
verses.hebrew: וִיהִי נֹעַם אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵינוּ עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָה עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנֵהוּ׃

verses.english: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of Shaddai.
verses.hebrew: יֹשֵׁב בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָן׃

verses.english: I say to YHWH, My refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.
verses.hebrew: אֹמַר לַיהוָה מַחְסִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אֱלֹהַי אֶבְטַח־בּוֹ׃

verses.english: For He will rescue you from the birdcatcher’s snare and from deadly pestilence.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הוּא יַצִּילְךָ מִפַּח יָקוּשׁ מִדֶּבֶר הַוּוֹת׃

verses.english: With His pinions He will cover you; under His wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is shield and buckler.
verses.hebrew: בְּאֶבְרָתוֹ יָסֶךְ לָךְ וְתַחַת־כְּנָפָיו תֶּחְסֶה צִנָּה וְסֹחֵרָה אֲמִתּוֹ׃

verses.english: You will not fear the terror of night, the arrow that flies by day,
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תִירָא מִפַּחַד לָיְלָה מֵחֵץ יָעוּף יוֹמָם׃

verses.english: the pestilence that walks in darkness, the destruction that ravages at noon.
verses.hebrew: מִדֶּבֶר בָּאֹפֶל יַהֲלֹךְ מִקֶּטֶב יָשׁוּד צָהֳרָיִם׃

verses.english: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not approach you.
verses.hebrew: יִפֹּל מִצִּדְּךָ אֶלֶף וּרְבָבָה מִימִינֶךָ אֵלֶיךָ לֹא יִגָּשׁ׃

verses.english: You will only look with your eyes and see the recompense of the wicked.
verses.hebrew: רַק בְּעֵינֶיךָ תַבִּיט וְשִׁלֻּמַת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה׃

verses.english: For You, YHWH, are my refuge. You have made the Most High your dwelling place.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה מַחְסִי עֶלְיוֹן שַׂמְתָּ מְעוֹנֶךָ׃

verses.english: No evil will befall you, no plague will come near your tent.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תְאֻנֶּה אֵלֶיךָ רָעָה וְנֶגַע לֹא־יִקְרַב בְּאָהֳלֶךָ׃

verses.english: For He will command His angels concerning you, to guard you in all your ways.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מַלְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה־לָּךְ לִשְׁמָרְךָ בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶיךָ׃

verses.english: They will carry you in their hands, so that you do not strike your foot against a stone.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כַּפַּיִם יִשָּׂאוּנְךָ פֶּן־תִּגֹּף בָּאֶבֶן רַגְלֶךָ׃

verses.english: You will tread on a lion and a cobra; you will trample a young lion and a dragon.
verses.hebrew: עַל־שַׁחַל וָפֶתֶן תִּדְרֹךְ תִּרְמֹס כְּפִיר וְתַנִּין׃

verses.english: Because he clings to Me, I will deliver him; I will set him on high, because he knows My name.
verses.hebrew: כִּי בִי חָשַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵהוּ אֲשַׂגְּבֵהוּ כִּי־יָדַע שְׁמִי׃

verses.english: He will call Me, and I will answer him; I am with him in distress; I will free him and honor him.
verses.hebrew: יִקְרָאֵנִי וְאֶעֱנֵהוּ עִמּוֹ־אָנֹכִי בְצָרָה אֲחַלְּצֵהוּ וַאֲכַבְּדֵהוּ׃

verses.english: With length of days I will satisfy him and let him see My salvation.
verses.hebrew: אֹרֶךְ יָמִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵהוּ וְאַרְאֵהוּ בִּישׁוּעָתִי׃

verses.english: A psalm, a song for the Sabbath day.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר לְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת׃

verses.english: It is good to thank YHWH and make music to Your name, Most High,
verses.hebrew: טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַיהוָה וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן׃

verses.english: to declare Your steadfast love in the morning and Your faithfulness through the nights,
verses.hebrew: לְהַגִּיד בַּבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ בַּלֵּילוֹת׃

verses.english: on a ten-stringed instrument and on a harp, with resonant music on a lyre.
verses.hebrew: עֲ‍לֵי־עָשׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי־נָבֶל עֲלֵי הִגָּיוֹן בְּכִנּוֹר׃

verses.english: For You have gladdened me, YHWH, by Your work; at the works of Your hands I sing joyfully.
verses.hebrew: כִּי שִׂמַּחְתַּנִי יְהוָה בְּפָעֳלֶךָ בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן׃

verses.english: How great are Your works, YHWH; Your thoughts are very deep.
verses.hebrew: מַה־גָּדְלוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְהוָה מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: A brutish person does not know, and a fool does not understand this:
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־בַּעַר לֹא יֵדָע וּכְסִיל לֹא־יָבִין אֶת־זֹאת׃

verses.english: when the wicked sprout like grass and all evildoers blossom, it is so that they may be destroyed forever.
verses.hebrew: בִּפְרֹחַ רְשָׁעִים כְּמוֹ עֵשֶׂב וַיָּצִיצוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן לְהִשָּׁמְדָם עֲדֵי־עַד׃

verses.english: But You are on high forever, YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה מָרוֹם לְעֹלָם יְהוָה׃

verses.english: For look, Your enemies, YHWH— for look, Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּי־הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ יִתְפָּרְדוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃

verses.english: You have raised my horn like a wild ox’s; I am bathed in fresh oil.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּרֶם כִּרְאֵים קַרְנִי בַּלֹּתִי בְּשֶׁמֶן רַעֲנָן׃

verses.english: My eye looks on those watching me; my ears hear of evildoers rising against me.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּבֵּט עֵינִי בְּשׁוּרָי בַּקָּמִים עָלַי מְרֵעִים תִּשְׁמַעְנָה אָזְנָי׃

verses.english: The righteous will blossom like a palm tree; like a cedar in Lebanon he will grow tall.
verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יִשְׂגֶּה׃

verses.english: Planted in YHWH’s house, they will blossom in the courts of our God.
verses.hebrew: שְׁתוּלִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה בְּחַצְרוֹת אֱלֹהֵינוּ יַפְרִיחוּ׃

verses.english: They will still bear fruit in old age; they will be vigorous and fresh,
verses.hebrew: עוֹד יְנוּבוּן בְּשֵׂיבָה דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים יִהְיוּ׃

verses.english: to declare that YHWH is upright, my Rock, and there is no injustice in Him.
verses.hebrew: לְהַגִּיד כִּי־יָשָׁר יְהוָה צוּרִי וְלֹא־עלתה [עַוְלָתָה] בּוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH reigns, clothed in majesty; YHWH is clothed in strength and has girded Himself. Indeed, the world is established; it will not totter.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְהוָה עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט׃

verses.english: Your throne is established from of old; You are from everlasting.
verses.hebrew: נָכוֹן כִּסְאֲךָ מֵאָז מֵעוֹלָם אָתָּה׃

verses.english: The rivers have lifted up, YHWH; the rivers have lifted up their voice; the rivers lift up their pounding.
verses.hebrew: נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת יְהוָה נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת קוֹלָם יִשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת דָּכְיָם׃

verses.english: Above the voices of many waters, mighty breakers of the sea, YHWH on high is mighty.
verses.hebrew: מִקֹּלוֹת מַיִם רַבִּים אַדִּירִים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־יָם אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Your testimonies are very sure; holiness befits Your house, YHWH, for length of days.
verses.hebrew: עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶאֶמְנוּ מְאֹד לְבֵיתְךָ נַאֲוָה־קֹדֶשׁ יְהוָה לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים׃

verses.english: God of vengeance, YHWH, God of vengeance, shine forth!
verses.hebrew: אֵל־נְקָמוֹת יְהוָה אֵל נְקָמוֹת הוֹפִיַע׃

verses.english: Rise up, Judge of the earth; return recompense upon the proud.
verses.hebrew: הִנָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵט הָאָרֶץ הָשֵׁב גְּמוּל עַל־גֵּאִים׃

verses.english: How long, YHWH, will the wicked— how long will the wicked exult?
verses.hebrew: עַד־מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יְהוָה עַד־מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יַעֲלֹזוּ׃

verses.english: They pour forth, they speak arrogance; all evildoers boast.
verses.hebrew: יַבִּיעוּ יְדַבְּרוּ עָתָק יִתְאַמְּרוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃

verses.english: They crush Your people, YHWH, and afflict Your inheritance.
verses.hebrew: עַמְּךָ יְהוָה יְדַכְּאוּ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ יְעַנּוּ׃

verses.english: They kill the widow and resident foreigner and murder orphans.
verses.hebrew: אַלְמָנָה וְגֵר יַהֲרֹגוּ וִיתוֹמִים יְרַצֵּחוּ׃

verses.english: They say, Yah does not see; the God of Jacob does not understand.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא יִרְאֶה־יָּהּ וְלֹא־יָבִין אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: Understand, you brutish among the people; you fools, when will you become wise?
verses.hebrew: בִּינוּ בֹּעֲרִים בָּעָם וּכְסִילִים מָתַי תַּשְׂכִּילוּ׃

verses.english: Will the One who planted the ear not hear? Will the One who formed the eye not see?
verses.hebrew: הֲנֹטַע אֹזֶן הֲלֹא יִשְׁמָע אִם־יֹצֵר עַיִן הֲלֹא יַבִּיט׃

verses.english: Will the One who disciplines nations not rebuke— the One who teaches humankind knowledge?
verses.hebrew: הֲיֹסֵר גּוֹיִם הֲלֹא יוֹכִיחַ הַמְלַמֵּד אָדָם דָּעַת׃

verses.english: YHWH knows human thoughts, that they are a breath.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יֹדֵעַ מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָדָם כִּי־הֵמָּה הָבֶל׃

verses.english: Happy the man You discipline, Yah, whom You teach from Your instruction,
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר־תְּיַסְּרֶנּוּ יָּהּ וּמִתּוֹרָתְךָ תְלַמְּדֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: to grant him quiet from evil days, until a pit is dug for the wicked.
verses.hebrew: לְהַשְׁקִיט לוֹ מִימֵי רָע עַד יִכָּרֶה לָרָשָׁע שָׁחַת׃

verses.english: For YHWH will not abandon His people, nor forsake His inheritance.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־יִטֹּשׁ יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וְנַחֲלָתוֹ לֹא יַעֲזֹב׃

verses.english: For judgment will return to righteousness, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עַד־צֶדֶק יָשׁוּב מִשְׁפָּט וְאַחֲרָיו כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃

verses.english: Who will rise for me against evildoers? Who will take a stand for me against workers of evil?
verses.hebrew: מִי־יָקוּם לִי עִם־מְרֵעִים מִי־יִתְיַצֵּב לִי עִם־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃

verses.english: Had YHWH not been my help, my soul would soon have dwelt in silence.
verses.hebrew: לוּלֵי יְהוָה עֶזְרָתָה לִּי כִּמְעַט שָׁכְנָה דוּמָה נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: When I said, My foot is slipping, Your steadfast love, YHWH, supported me.
verses.hebrew: אִם־אָמַרְתִּי מָטָה רַגְלִי חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה יִסְעָדֵנִי׃

verses.english: When my anxious thoughts multiply within me, Your consolations delight my soul.
verses.hebrew: בְּרֹב שַׂרְעַפַּי בְּקִרְבִּי תַּנְחוּמֶיךָ יְשַׁעַשְׁעוּ נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: Can a throne of destruction be allied with You, one that frames trouble by statute?
verses.hebrew: הַיְחָבְרְךָ כִּסֵּא הַוּוֹת יֹצֵר עָמָל עֲלֵי־חֹק׃

verses.english: They band together against a righteous person’s life and condemn innocent blood.
verses.hebrew: יָגוֹדּוּ עַל־נֶפֶשׁ צַדִּיק וְדָם נָקִי יַרְשִׁיעוּ׃

verses.english: But YHWH became my high stronghold, and my God the Rock of my refuge.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְהוָה לִי לְמִשְׂגָּב וֵאלֹהַי לְצוּר מַחְסִי׃

verses.english: He will return their evil upon them and destroy them in their wickedness; YHWH our God will destroy them.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־אוֹנָם וּבְרָעָתָם יַצְמִיתֵם יַצְמִיתֵם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Come, let us sing joyfully to YHWH; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation.
verses.hebrew: לְכוּ נְרַנְּנָה לַיהוָה נָרִיעָה לְצוּר יִשְׁעֵנוּ׃

verses.english: Let us come before His face with thanksgiving; with songs let us shout to Him.
verses.hebrew: נְקַדְּמָה פָנָיו בְּתוֹדָה בִּזְמִרוֹת נָרִיעַ לוֹ׃

verses.english: For YHWH is a great God, a great King above all gods.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵל גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: In His hand are the earth’s depths; the mountain heights are His.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־אָרֶץ וְתוֹעֲפוֹת הָרִים לוֹ׃

verses.english: The sea is His, and He made it; His hands formed the dry land.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ הַיָּם וְהוּא עָשָׂהוּ וְיַבֶּשֶׁת יָדָיו יָצָרוּ׃

verses.english: Come, let us bow down and bend low; let us kneel before YHWH our Maker.
verses.hebrew: בֹּאוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנִכְרָעָה נִבְרְכָה לִפְנֵי־יְהוָה עֹשֵׂנוּ׃

verses.english: For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture and the sheep of His hand. Today, if you hear His voice,
verses.hebrew: כִּי הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ עַם מַרְעִיתוֹ וְצֹאן יָדוֹ הַיּוֹם אִם־בְּקֹלוֹ תִשְׁמָעוּ׃

verses.english: do not harden your hearts as at Meribah, as on the day of Massah in the wilderness,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּקְשׁוּ לְבַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָה כְּיוֹם מַסָּה בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

verses.english: where your ancestors tested Me, put Me to the proof, though they had seen My work.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר נִסּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּחָנוּנִי גַּם־רָאוּ פָעֳלִי׃

verses.english: For forty years I loathed a generation and said, They are a people straying in heart, and they have not known My ways.
verses.hebrew: אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אָקוּט בְּדוֹר וָאֹמַר עַם תֹּעֵי לֵבָב הֵם וְהֵם לֹא־יָדְעוּ דְרָכָי׃

verses.english: so I swore in My anger, They shall not enter My rest.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי בְאַפִּי אִם־יְבֹאוּן אֶל־מְנוּחָתִי׃

verses.english: Sing to YHWH a new song; sing to YHWH, all the earth.
verses.hebrew: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Sing to YHWH; bless His name. Announce His salvation from day to day.
verses.hebrew: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמוֹ בַּשְּׂרוּ מִיּוֹם־לְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָתוֹ׃

verses.english: Tell of His glory among the nations, His wonders among all the peoples.
verses.hebrew: סַפְּרוּ בַגּוֹיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ בְּכָל־הָעַמִּים נִפְלְאוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: For great is YHWH and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.hebrew: כִּי גָדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד נוֹרָא הוּא עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: For all the gods of the peoples are worthless idols, but YHWH made the heavens.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כָּל־אֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֱלִילִים וַיהוָה שָׁמַיִם עָשָׂה׃

verses.english: Majesty and splendor are before Him; strength and beauty are in His sanctuary.
verses.hebrew: הוֹד־וְהָדָר לְפָנָיו עֹז וְתִפְאֶרֶת בְּמִקְדָּשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: Ascribe to YHWH, families of peoples; ascribe to YHWH glory and strength.
verses.hebrew: הָבוּ לַיהוָה מִשְׁפְּחוֹת עַמִּים הָבוּ לַיהוָה כָּבוֹד וָעֹז׃

verses.english: Ascribe to YHWH the glory of His name; carry an offering and enter His courts.
verses.hebrew: הָבוּ לַיהוָה כְּבוֹד שְׁמוֹ שְׂאוּ־מִנְחָה וּבֹאוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: Bow down to YHWH in holy splendor; tremble before Him, all the earth.
verses.hebrew: הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהוָה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹדֶשׁ חִילוּ מִפָּנָיו כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Say among the nations, “YHWH reigns!” Indeed, the world stands firm; it will not totter. He will judge peoples with equity.
verses.hebrew: אִמְרוּ בַגּוֹיִם יְהוָה מָלָךְ אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט יָדִין עַמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃

verses.english: Let the heavens rejoice and the earth exult; let the sea roar, and all that fills it.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמְחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵל הָאָרֶץ יִרְעַם הַיָּם וּמְלֹאוֹ׃

verses.english: Let the field rejoice, and all that is in it; then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
verses.hebrew: יַעֲלֹז שָׂדַי וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ אָז יְרַנְּנוּ כָּל־עֲצֵי־יָעַר׃

verses.english: before YHWH, for He is coming, for He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and peoples with His faithfulness.
verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי יְהוָה כִּי בָא כִּי בָא לִשְׁפֹּט הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק וְעַמִּים בֶּאֱמוּנָתוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH reigns! Let the earth exult; let the many islands rejoice.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מָלָךְ תָּגֵל הָאָרֶץ יִשְׂמְחוּ אִיִּים רַבִּים׃

verses.english: Cloud and thick darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.
verses.hebrew: עָנָן וַעֲרָפֶל סְבִיבָיו צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאוֹ׃

verses.english: Fire goes before Him and burns up His adversaries all around.
verses.hebrew: אֵשׁ לְפָנָיו תֵּלֵךְ וּתְלַהֵט סָבִיב צָרָיו׃

verses.english: His lightning flashes lit up the world; the earth saw and trembled.
verses.hebrew: הֵאִירוּ בְרָקָיו תֵּבֵל רָאֲתָה וַתָּחֵל הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Mountains melted like wax before YHWH, before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.hebrew: הָרִים כַּדּוֹנַג נָמַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה מִלִּפְנֵי אֲדוֹן כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: The heavens declared His righteousness, and all the peoples saw His glory.
verses.hebrew: הִגִּידוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם צִדְקוֹ וְרָאוּ כָל־הָעַמִּים כְּבוֹדוֹ׃

verses.english: Let all who serve a carved image be ashamed, those who boast in worthless idols. Bow down to Him, all gods!
verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ כָּל־עֹבְדֵי פֶסֶל הַמִּתְהַלְלִים בָּאֱלִילִים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־לוֹ כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: Zion heard and rejoiced, and the daughters of Judah exulted because of Your judgments, YHWH.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמְעָה וַתִּשְׂמַח צִיּוֹן וַתָּגֵלְנָה בְּנוֹת יְהוּדָה לְמַעַן מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: For You, YHWH, are Most High over all the earth; You are greatly exalted above all gods.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ מְאֹד נַעֲלֵיתָ עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: You who love YHWH, hate evil! He guards the lives of His faithful ones; He rescues them from the hand of the wicked.
verses.hebrew: אֹהֲבֵי יְהוָה שִׂנְאוּ רָע שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹת חֲסִידָיו מִיַּד רְשָׁעִים יַצִּילֵם׃

verses.english: Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart.
verses.hebrew: אוֹר זָרֻעַ לַצַּדִּיק וּלְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵב שִׂמְחָה׃

verses.english: Rejoice in YHWH, you righteous, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holiness.
verses.hebrew: שִׂמְחוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּיהוָה וְהוֹדוּ לְזֵכֶר קָדְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: A psalm. Sing to YHWH a new song, for He has done wonders. His right hand and His holy arm have won salvation for Him.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ כִּי־נִפְלָאוֹת עָשָׂה הוֹשִׁיעָה־לּוֹ יְמִינוֹ וּזְרוֹעַ קָדְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH made His salvation known; before the eyes of the nations He revealed His righteousness.
verses.hebrew: הוֹדִיעַ יְהוָה יְשׁוּעָתוֹ לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם גִּלָּה צִדְקָתוֹ׃

verses.english: He remembered His steadfast love and His faithfulness to the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth saw the salvation of our God.
verses.hebrew: זָכַר חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמוּנָתוֹ לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאוּ כָל־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ אֵת יְשׁוּעַת אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Shout to YHWH, all the earth; burst forth, sing for joy, and make music.
verses.hebrew: הָרִיעוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ פִּצְחוּ וְרַנְּנוּ וְזַמֵּרוּ׃

verses.english: Make music to YHWH with the lyre, with the lyre and the sound of song.
verses.hebrew: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה בְּכִנּוֹר בְּכִנּוֹר וְקוֹל זִמְרָה׃

verses.english: With trumpets and the sound of a horn, shout before the King, YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר הָרִיעוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Let the sea roar, and all that fills it, the world and those who inhabit it.
verses.hebrew: יִרְעַם הַיָּם וּמְלֹאוֹ תֵּבֵל וְיֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃

verses.english: Let rivers clap their hands; let mountains sing for joy together
verses.hebrew: נְהָרוֹת יִמְחֲאוּ־כָף יַחַד הָרִים יְרַנֵּנוּ׃

verses.english: before YHWH, for He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and peoples with equity.
verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי־יְהוָה כִּי בָא לִשְׁפֹּט הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק וְעַמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃

verses.english: YHWH reigns! Let peoples tremble. He sits enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth quake.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מָלָךְ יִרְגְּזוּ עַמִּים יֹשֵׁב כְּרוּבִים תָּנוּט הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: YHWH is great in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן גָּדוֹל וְרָם הוּא עַל־כָּל־הָעַמִּים׃

verses.english: Let them thank Your name, great and fearsome; holy is He.
verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּ שִׁמְךָ גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָא קָדוֹשׁ הוּא׃

verses.english: The King's strength loves justice. You established equity; justice and righteousness in Jacob You have done.
verses.hebrew: וְעֹז מֶלֶךְ מִשְׁפָּט אָהֵב אַתָּה כּוֹנַנְתָּ מֵישָׁרִים מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה בְּיַעֲקֹב אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ׃

verses.english: Exalt YHWH our God and bow down at His footstool; holy is He.
verses.hebrew: רוֹמְמוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו קָדוֹשׁ הוּא׃

verses.english: Moses and Aaron were among His priests, and Samuel among those who call on His name. They called to YHWH, and He would answer them.
verses.hebrew: מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן בְּכֹהֲנָיו וּשְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵי שְׁמוֹ קֹרִאים אֶל־יְהוָה וְהוּא יַעֲנֵם׃

verses.english: In a pillar of cloud He would speak to them. They kept His testimonies and the statute He gave them.
verses.hebrew: בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן יְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם שָׁמְרוּ עֵדֹתָיו וְחֹק נָתַן־לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH our God, You answered them; You were a forgiving God to them, yet One who took vengeance for their deeds.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אַתָּה עֲנִיתָם אֵל נֹשֵׂא הָיִיתָ לָהֶם וְנֹקֵם עַל־עֲלִילוֹתָם׃

verses.english: Exalt YHWH our God and bow down toward His holy mountain, for holy is YHWH our God.
verses.hebrew: רוֹמְמוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַר קָדְשׁוֹ כִּי־קָדוֹשׁ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

verses.english: A psalm for thanksgiving. Shout to YHWH, all the earth.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְתוֹדָה הָרִיעוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Serve YHWH with gladness; come before Him with joyful singing.
verses.hebrew: עִבְדוּ אֶת־יְהוָה בְּשִׂמְחָה בֹּאוּ לְפָנָיו בִּרְנָנָה׃

verses.english: Know that YHWH—He is God. He made us, and not we; His people and the flock of His pasture.
verses.hebrew: דְּעוּ כִּי־יְהוָה הוּא אֱלֹהִים הוּא־עָשָׂנוּ ולא [וְלוֹ] אֲנַחְנוּ עַמּוֹ וְצֹאן מַרְעִיתוֹ׃

verses.english: Enter His gates with thanksgiving, His courts with praise. Give thanks to Him; bless His name.
verses.hebrew: בֹּאוּ שְׁעָרָיו בְּתוֹדָה חֲצֵרֹתָיו בִּתְהִלָּה הוֹדוּ־לוֹ בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמוֹ׃

verses.english: For YHWH is good; His steadfast love is forever, and His faithfulness through generation after generation.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־טוֹב יְהֹוָה לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ וְעַד־דֹּר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתוֹ׃

verses.english: Of David. A psalm. I will sing of steadfast love and justice; to You, YHWH, I will make music.
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר חֶסֶד־וּמִשְׁפָּט אָשִׁירָה לְךָ יְהוָה אֲזַמֵּרָה׃

verses.english: I will attend wisely to a blameless way. When will You come to me? I will walk with integrity of heart within my house.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׂכִּילָה בְּדֶרֶךְ תָּמִים מָתַי תָּבוֹא אֵלָי אֶתְהַלֵּךְ בְּתָם־לְבָבִי בְּקֶרֶב בֵּיתִי׃

verses.english: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the doing of those who turn aside; it will not cling to me.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־אָשִׁית לְנֶגֶד עֵינַי דְּבַר־בְּלִיָּעַל עֲשֹׂה־סֵטִים שָׂנֵאתִי לֹא יִדְבַּק בִּי׃

verses.english: A twisted heart will turn away from me; I will not know evil.
verses.hebrew: לֵבָב עִקֵּשׁ יָסוּר מִמֶּנִּי רָע לֹא אֵדָע׃

verses.english: The one secretly slandering his neighbor I will destroy; one with lofty eyes and a broad heart I cannot bear.
verses.hebrew: מלושני [מְלָשְׁנִי] בַסֵּתֶר רֵעֵהוּ אוֹתוֹ אַצְמִית גְּבַהּ־עֵינַיִם וּרְחַב לֵבָב אֹתוֹ לֹא אוּכָל׃

verses.english: My eyes are on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; the one who walks in a blameless way will serve me.
verses.hebrew: עֵינַי בְּנֶאֶמְנֵי־אֶרֶץ לָשֶׁבֶת עִמָּדִי הֹלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ תָּמִים הוּא יְשָׁרְתֵנִי׃

verses.english: One practicing deceit will not dwell within my house; one speaking lies will not stand firm before my eyes.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יֵשֵׁב בְּקֶרֶב בֵּיתִי עֹשֵׂה רְמִיָּה דֹּבֵר שְׁקָרִים לֹא־יִכּוֹן לְנֶגֶד עֵינָי׃

verses.english: Morning by morning I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off from YHWH's city all who do iniquity.
verses.hebrew: לַבְּקָרִים אַצְמִית כָּל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ לְהַכְרִית מֵעִיר־יְהוָה כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃

verses.english: A prayer of an afflicted person when he grows faint and pours out his complaint before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לְעָנִי כִי־יַעֲטֹף וְלִפְנֵי יְהוָה יִשְׁפֹּךְ שִׂיחוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH, hear my prayer, and let my cry for help come to You.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי אֵלֶיךָ תָבוֹא׃

verses.english: Do not hide Your face from me on the day of my distress. Incline Your ear to me; on the day I call, answer me quickly.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי בְּיוֹם צַר לִי הַטֵּה־אֵלַי אָזְנֶךָ בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי׃

verses.english: For my days vanish in smoke, and my bones are charred like a hearth.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־כָלוּ בְעָשָׁן יָמָי וְעַצְמוֹתַי כְּמוֹ־קֵד נִחָרוּ׃

verses.english: My heart is struck and withers like grass, for I have forgotten to eat my bread.
verses.hebrew: הוּכָּה־כָעֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַשׁ לִבִּי כִּי־שָׁכַחְתִּי מֵאֲכֹל לַחְמִי׃

verses.english: From the sound of my groaning, my bone clings to my flesh.
verses.hebrew: מִקּוֹל אַנְחָתִי דָּבְקָה עַצְמִי לִבְשָׂרִי׃

verses.english: I resemble a pelican of the wilderness; I have become like an owl of ruined places.
verses.hebrew: דָּמִיתִי לִקְאַת מִדְבָּר הָיִיתִי כְּכוֹס חֳרָבוֹת׃

verses.english: I lie awake and have become like a bird alone on a roof.
verses.hebrew: שָׁקַדְתִּי וָאֶהְיֶה כְּצִפּוֹר בּוֹדֵד עַל־גָּג׃

verses.english: All day my enemies reproach me; those raging against me swear by me.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַיּוֹם חֵרְפוּנִי אוֹיְבָי מְהוֹלָלַי בִּי נִשְׁבָּעוּ׃

verses.english: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with weeping,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֵפֶר כַּלֶּחֶם אָכָלְתִּי וְשִׁקֻּוַי בִּבְכִי מָסָכְתִּי׃

verses.english: because of Your indignation and wrath, for You lifted me up and cast me away.
verses.hebrew: מִפְּנֵי־זַעַמְךָ וְקִצְפֶּךָ כִּי נְשָׂאתַנִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי׃

verses.english: My days are like a lengthening shadow, and I wither like grass.
verses.hebrew: יָמַי כְּצֵל נָטוּי וַאֲנִי כָּעֵשֶׂב אִיבָשׁ׃

verses.english: But You, YHWH, sit enthroned forever, and Your remembrance is from generation to generation.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תֵּשֵׁב וְזִכְרְךָ לְדֹר וָדֹר׃

verses.english: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to favor her; the appointed time has come.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה תָקוּם תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן כִּי־עֵת לְחֶנְנָהּ כִּי־בָא מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: For Your servants delight in her stones and show favor to her dust.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־רָצוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת־אֲבָנֶיהָ וְאֶת־עֲפָרָהּ יְחֹנֵנוּ׃

verses.english: Nations will fear YHWH's name, and all the kings of the earth Your glory.
verses.hebrew: וְיִירְאוּ גוֹיִם אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה וְכָל־מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֶת־כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃

verses.english: For YHWH has built Zion; He has appeared in His glory.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־בָנָה יְהוָה צִיּוֹן נִרְאָה בִּכְבוֹדוֹ׃

verses.english: He has turned toward the prayer of the destitute and has not despised their prayer.
verses.hebrew: פָּנָה אֶל־תְּפִלַּת הָעַרְעָר וְלֹא־בָזָה אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם׃

verses.english: Let this be written for a later generation, and a people to be created will praise Yah.
verses.hebrew: תִּכָּתֶב זֹאת לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן וְעַם נִבְרָא יְהַלֶּל־יָהּ׃

verses.english: For He looked down from His holy height; YHWH gazed from the heavens to the earth,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִשְׁקִיף מִמְּרוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ יְהוָה מִשָּׁמַיִם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הִבִּיט׃

verses.english: to hear the prisoner's groaning, to release those appointed to death,
verses.hebrew: לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַת אָסִיר לְפַתֵּחַ בְּנֵי תְמוּתָה׃

verses.english: to recount YHWH's name in Zion and His praise in Jerusalem,
verses.hebrew: לְסַפֵּר בְּצִיּוֹן שֵׁם יְהוָה וּתְהִלָּתוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: when peoples gather together, and kingdoms, to serve YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בְּהִקָּבֵץ עַמִּים יַחְדָּו וּמַמְלָכוֹת לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: He weakened his strength on the way; He shortened my days.
verses.hebrew: עִנָּה בַדֶּרֶךְ כחו [כֹּחִי] קִצַּר יָמָי׃

verses.english: I say, My God, do not take me up in the midst of my days; Your years extend through generations of generations.
verses.hebrew: אֹמַר אֵלִי אַל־תַּעֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִי יָמָי בְּדוֹר דּוֹרִים שְׁנוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Long ago You founded the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
verses.hebrew: לְפָנִים הָאָרֶץ יָסַדְתָּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ שָׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: They will perish, but You will stand; all of them will wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will pass away.
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה יֹאבֵדוּ וְאַתָּה תַעֲמֹד וְכֻלָּם כַּבֶּגֶד יִבְלוּ כַּלְּבוּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵם וְיַחֲלֹפוּ׃

verses.english: But You are He, and Your years will not come to an end.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה־הוּא וּשְׁנוֹתֶיךָ לֹא יִתָּמּוּ׃

verses.english: The children of Your servants will dwell, and their offspring will be established before You.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־עֲבָדֶיךָ יִשְׁכּוֹנוּ וְזַרְעָם לְפָנֶיךָ יִכּוֹן׃

verses.english: Of David. Bless YHWH, my soul, and all that is within me, His holy name.
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה וְכָל־קְרָבַי אֶת־שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: Bless YHWH, my soul, and do not forget all His benefits:
verses.hebrew: בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה וְאַל־תִּשְׁכְּחִי כָּל־גְּמוּלָיו׃

verses.english: who forgives all your iniquities, who heals all your diseases;
verses.hebrew: הַסֹּלֵחַ לְכָל־עֲוֺנֵכִי הָרֹפֵא לְכָל־תַּחֲלֻאָיְכִי׃

verses.english: who redeems your life from the Pit, who crowns you with steadfast love and compassion;
verses.hebrew: הַגּוֹאֵל מִשַּׁחַת חַיָּיְכִי הַמְעַטְּרֵכִי חֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים׃

verses.english: who satisfies your adornment with good, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's.
verses.hebrew: הַמַּשְׂבִּיַע בַּטּוֹב עֶדְיֵךְ תִּתְחַדֵּשׁ כַּנֶּשֶׁר נְעוּרָיְכִי׃

verses.english: YHWH does righteous deeds and judgments for all the oppressed.
verses.hebrew: עֹשֵׂה צְדָקוֹת יְהוָה וּמִשְׁפָּטִים לְכָל־עֲשׁוּקִים׃

verses.english: He made His ways known to Moses, His deeds to the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: יוֹדִיעַ דְּרָכָיו לְמֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: YHWH is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger and abundant in steadfast love.
verses.hebrew: רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן יְהוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חָסֶד׃

verses.english: He will not contend forever, nor keep anger perpetually.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־לָנֶצַח יָרִיב וְלֹא לְעוֹלָם יִטּוֹר׃

verses.english: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us according to our iniquities.
verses.hebrew: לֹא כַחֲטָאֵינוּ עָשָׂה לָנוּ וְלֹא כַעֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ גָּמַל עָלֵינוּ׃

verses.english: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, His steadfast love is strong over those who fear Him.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כִגְבֹהַּ שָׁמַיִם עַל־הָאָרֶץ גָּבַר חַסְדּוֹ עַל־יְרֵאָיו׃

verses.english: As far as east is from west, He has removed our rebellions from us.
verses.hebrew: כִּרְחֹק מִזְרָח מִמַּעֲרָב הִרְחִיק מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת־פְּשָׁעֵינוּ׃

verses.english: As a father has compassion on children, YHWH has compassion on those who fear Him.
verses.hebrew: כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל־בָּנִים רִחַם יְהוָה עַל־יְרֵאָיו׃

verses.english: For He knows our formation; He remembers that we are dust.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הוּא יָדַע יִצְרֵנוּ זָכוּר כִּי־עָפָר אֲנָחְנוּ׃

verses.english: A human's days are like grass; like a flower of the field, so he flowers.
verses.hebrew: אֱנוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִיר יָמָיו כְּצִיץ הַשָּׂדֶה כֵּן יָצִיץ׃

verses.english: For a wind passes over it, and it is gone; its place recognizes it no more.
verses.hebrew: כִּי רוּחַ עָבְרָה־בּוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ וְלֹא־יַכִּירֶנּוּ עוֹד מְקוֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: But YHWH's steadfast love is from eternity to eternity over those who fear Him, and His righteousness to children's children,
verses.hebrew: וְחֶסֶד יְהוָה מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד־עוֹלָם עַל־יְרֵאָיו וְצִדְקָתוֹ לִבְנֵי בָנִים׃

verses.english: to those who keep His covenant and remember His precepts to do them.
verses.hebrew: לְשֹׁמְרֵי בְרִיתוֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵי פִקֻּדָיו לַעֲשׂוֹתָם׃

verses.english: YHWH has established His throne in the heavens, and His kingdom rules over all.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בַּשָּׁמַיִם הֵכִין כִּסְאוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָׁלָה׃

verses.english: Bless YHWH, His messengers, mighty in strength, doing His word, heeding the voice of His word.
verses.hebrew: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה מַלְאָכָיו גִּבֹּרֵי כֹחַ עֹשֵׂי דְבָרוֹ לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל דְּבָרוֹ׃

verses.english: Bless YHWH, all His hosts, His ministers who do His will.
verses.hebrew: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה כָּל־צְבָאָיו מְשָׁרְתָיו עֹשֵׂי רְצוֹנוֹ׃

verses.english: Bless YHWH, all His works, in all the places of His dominion. Bless YHWH, my soul.
verses.hebrew: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו בְּכָל־מְקֹמוֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Bless YHWH, my soul. YHWH my God, You are very great; You have clothed Yourself in majesty and splendor.
verses.hebrew: בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי גָּדַלְתָּ מְּאֹד הוֹד וְהָדָר לָבָשְׁתָּ׃

verses.english: He wraps Himself in light like a garment, stretching out the heavens like a tent curtain.
verses.hebrew: עֹטֶה־אוֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָה נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם כַּיְרִיעָה׃

verses.english: He lays the beams of His upper chambers in the waters, makes clouds His chariot, and walks on the wings of the wind.
verses.hebrew: הַמְקָרֶה בַמַּיִם עֲ‍לִיּוֹתָיו הַשָּׂם־עָבִים רְכוּבוֹ הַמְהַלֵּךְ עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רוּחַ׃

verses.english: He makes His messengers winds, His ministers a flaming fire.
verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה מַלְאָכָיו רוּחוֹת מְשָׁרְתָיו אֵשׁ לֹהֵט׃

verses.english: He founded the earth on its bases; it will never be moved, forever and ever.
verses.hebrew: יָסַד־אֶרֶץ עַל־מְכוֹנֶיהָ בַּל־תִּמּוֹט עוֹלָם וָעֶד׃

verses.english: You covered it with the deep as with a garment; waters stood above the mountains.
verses.hebrew: תְּהוֹם כַּלְּבוּשׁ כִּסִּיתוֹ עַל־הָרִים יַעַמְדוּ־מָיִם׃

verses.english: At Your rebuke they flee; at the voice of Your thunder they hurry away.
verses.hebrew: מִן־גַּעֲרָתְךָ יְנוּסוּן מִן־קוֹל רַעַמְךָ יֵחָפֵזוּן׃

verses.english: Mountains rise, valleys descend, to the place You established for them.
verses.hebrew: יַעֲלוּ הָרִים יֵרְדוּ בְקָעוֹת אֶל־מְקוֹם זֶה יָסַדְתָּ לָהֶם׃

verses.english: You set a boundary they will not cross; they will not return to cover the earth.
verses.hebrew: גְּבוּל־שַׂמְתָּ בַּל־יַעֲבֹרוּן בַּל־יְשׁוּבוּן לְכַסּוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: He sends springs into the ravines; they flow between the mountains.
verses.hebrew: הַמְשַׁלֵּחַ מַעְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִים בֵּין הָרִים יְהַלֵּכוּן׃

verses.english: They give drink to every beast of the field; wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.hebrew: יַשְׁקוּ כָּל־חַיְתוֹ שָׂדָי יִשְׁבְּרוּ פְרָאִים צְמָאָם׃

verses.english: Beside them the birds of the heavens dwell; from among the branches they give voice.
verses.hebrew: עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹף־הַשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׁכּוֹן מִבֵּין עֳפָאיִם יִתְּנוּ־קוֹל׃

verses.english: He waters mountains from His upper chambers; the earth is satisfied with the fruit of Your works.
verses.hebrew: מַשְׁקֶה הָרִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָיו מִפְּרִי מַעֲשֶׂיךָ תִּשְׂבַּע הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: He makes grass grow for livestock and plants for human labor, to bring bread out of the earth,
verses.hebrew: מַצְמִיחַ חָצִיר לַבְּהֵמָה וְעֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַת הָאָדָם לְהוֹצִיא לֶחֶם מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: and wine gladdens the human heart, to make the face shine with oil, and bread sustains the human heart.
verses.hebrew: וְיַיִן יְשַׂמַּח לְבַב־אֱנוֹשׁ לְהַצְהִיל פָּנִים מִשָּׁמֶן וְלֶחֶם לְבַב־אֱנוֹשׁ יִסְעָד׃

verses.english: YHWH's trees are satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵי יְהוָה אַרְזֵי לְבָנוֹן אֲשֶׁר נָטָע׃

verses.english: where birds make their nests; as for the stork, cypresses are her home.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם צִפֳּרִים יְקַנֵּנוּ חֲסִידָה בְּרוֹשִׁים בֵּיתָהּ׃

verses.english: The high mountains are for wild goats; the rocks are a refuge for hyraxes.
verses.hebrew: הָרִים הַגְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִים סְלָעִים מַחְסֶה לַשְׁפַנִּים׃

verses.english: He made the moon for appointed times; the sun knows its setting.
verses.hebrew: עָשָׂה יָרֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִים שֶׁמֶשׁ יָדַע מְבוֹאוֹ׃

verses.english: You set darkness, and it becomes night; in it every beast of the forest creeps about.
verses.hebrew: תָּשֶׁת־חֹשֶׁךְ וִיהִי לָיְלָה בּוֹ־תִרְמֹשׂ כָּל־חַיְתוֹ־יָעַר׃

verses.english: the young lions roaring for prey and seeking their food from God.
verses.hebrew: הַכְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִים לַטָּרֶף וּלְבַקֵּשׁ מֵאֵל אָכְלָם׃

verses.english: The sun rises; they gather away and lie down in their dens.
verses.hebrew: תִּזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפוּן וְאֶל־מְעוֹנֹתָם יִרְבָּצוּן׃

verses.english: A human goes out to his work and to his labor until evening.
verses.hebrew: יֵצֵא אָדָם לְפָעֳלוֹ וְלַעֲבֹדָתוֹ עֲדֵי־עָרֶב׃

verses.english: How many are Your works, YHWH! You made them all in wisdom; the earth is full of Your possessions.
verses.hebrew: מָה־רַבּוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְהוָה כֻּלָּם בְּחָכְמָה עָשִׂיתָ מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ קִנְיָנֶךָ׃

verses.english: Here is the sea, great and broad on both sides; there are creeping things without number, living creatures small and great.
