verses.hebrew: זֶה הַיָּם גָּדוֹל וּרְחַב יָדָיִם שָׁם־רֶמֶשׂ וְאֵין מִסְפָּר חַיּוֹת קְטַנּוֹת עִם־גְּדֹלוֹת׃

verses.english: There ships travel, and Leviathan, which You formed to play in it.
verses.hebrew: שָׁם אֳנִיּוֹת יְהַלֵּכוּן לִוְיָתָן זֶה־יָצַרְתָּ לְשַׂחֶק־בּוֹ׃

verses.english: All of them wait for You to give their food in its time.
verses.hebrew: כֻּלָּם אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּן לָתֵת אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ׃

verses.english: You give to them; they gather. You open Your hand; they are satisfied with good.
verses.hebrew: תִּתֵּן לָהֶם יִלְקֹטוּן תִּפְתַּח יָדְךָ יִשְׂבְּעוּן טוֹב׃

verses.english: You hide Your face; they are terrified. You gather their breath; they expire and return to their dust.
verses.hebrew: תַּסְתִּיר פָּנֶיךָ יִבָּהֵלוּן תֹּסֵף רוּחָם יִגְוָעוּן וְאֶל־עֲפָרָם יְשׁוּבוּן׃

verses.english: You send Your spirit; they are created, and You renew the face of the ground.
verses.hebrew: תְּשַׁלַּח רוּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵאוּן וּתְחַדֵּשׁ פְּנֵי אֲדָמָה׃

verses.english: May YHWH's glory be forever; may YHWH rejoice in His works.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי כְבוֹד יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם יִשְׂמַח יְהוָה בְּמַעֲשָׂיו׃

verses.english: He looks at the earth, and it trembles; He touches mountains, and they smoke.
verses.hebrew: הַמַּבִּיט לָאָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָד יִגַּע בֶּהָרִים וְיֶעֱשָׁנוּ׃

verses.english: I will sing to YHWH throughout my life; I will make music to my God as long as I exist.
verses.hebrew: אָשִׁירָה לַיהוָה בְּחַיָּי אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהַי בְּעוֹדִי׃

verses.english: May my meditation be pleasing to Him; I will rejoice in YHWH.
verses.hebrew: יֶעֱרַב עָלָיו שִׂיחִי אָנֹכִי אֶשְׂמַח בַּיהוָה׃

verses.english: May sinners come to an end from the earth, and may the wicked be no more. Bless YHWH, my soul. Praise Yah!
verses.hebrew: יִתַּמּוּ חַטָּאִים מִן־הָאָרֶץ וּרְשָׁעִים עוֹד אֵינָם בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃

verses.english: Give thanks to YHWH; call upon His name; make His deeds known among the peoples.
verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה קִרְאוּ בִּשְׁמוֹ הוֹדִיעוּ בָעַמִּים עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: Sing to Him; make music to Him; speak of all His wonders.
verses.hebrew: שִׁירוּ־לוֹ זַמְּרוּ־לוֹ שִׂיחוּ בְּכָל־נִפְלְאוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: Glory in His holy name; let the heart of those seeking YHWH rejoice.
verses.hebrew: הִתְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ יִשְׂמַח לֵב מְבַקְשֵׁי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Seek YHWH and His strength; seek His face continually.
verses.hebrew: דִּרְשׁוּ יְהוָה וְעֻזּוֹ בַּקְּשׁוּ פָנָיו תָּמִיד׃

verses.english: Remember His wonders that He has done, His signs and the judgments of His mouth,
verses.hebrew: זִכְרוּ נִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מֹפְתָיו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִיו׃

verses.english: offspring of Abraham His servant, sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.hebrew: זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם עַבְדּוֹ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב בְּחִירָיו׃

verses.english: He is YHWH our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.hebrew: הוּא יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָיו׃

verses.english: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He commanded for a thousand generations,
verses.hebrew: זָכַר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ דָּבָר צִוָּה לְאֶלֶף דּוֹר׃

verses.english: which He cut with Abraham, and His oath to Isaac.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת־אַבְרָהָם וּשְׁבוּעָתוֹ לְיִשְׂחָק׃

verses.english: He established it for Jacob as a statute, for Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמִידֶהָ לְיַעֲקֹב לְחֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִית עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: saying, To you I will give the land of Canaan, the measured portion of your inheritance,
verses.hebrew: לֵאמֹר לְךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת־אֶרֶץ־כְּנָעַן חֶבֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶם׃

verses.english: when they were few in number, very few, and sojourners in it.
verses.hebrew: בִּהְיוֹתָם מְתֵי מִסְפָּר כִּמְעַט וְגָרִים בָּהּ׃

verses.english: They wandered from nation to nation, from a kingdom to another people.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּוֹי אֶל־גּוֹי מִמַּמְלָכָה אֶל־עַם אַחֵר׃

verses.english: He allowed no one to oppress them and rebuked kings on their behalf:
verses.hebrew: לֹא־הִנִּיחַ אָדָם לְעָשְׁקָם וַיּוֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶם מְלָכִים׃

verses.english: Do not touch My anointed ones; do not harm My prophets.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּגְּעוּ בִמְשִׁיחָי וְלִנְבִיאַי אַל־תָּרֵעוּ׃

verses.english: He called a famine upon the land; He broke every staff of bread.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא רָעָב עַל־הָאָרֶץ כָּל־מַטֵּה־לֶחֶם שָׁבָר׃

verses.english: He sent a man before them: Joseph was sold as a slave.
verses.hebrew: שָׁלַח לִפְנֵיהֶם אִישׁ לְעֶבֶד נִמְכַּר יוֹסֵף׃

verses.english: They afflicted his feet with fetters; his very self entered iron,
verses.hebrew: עִנּוּ בַכֶּבֶל רגליו [רַגְלוֹ] בַּרְזֶל בָּאָה נַפְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: until the time his word came; YHWH's utterance refined him.
verses.hebrew: עַד־עֵת בֹּא־דְבָרוֹ אִמְרַת יְהוָה צְרָפָתְהוּ׃

verses.english: A king sent and released him; a ruler of peoples set him free.
verses.hebrew: שָׁלַח מֶלֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵהוּ מֹשֵׁל עַמִּים וַיְפַתְּחֵהוּ׃

verses.english: He made him lord over his house and ruler over all his possessions,
verses.hebrew: שָׂמוֹ אָדוֹן לְבֵיתוֹ וּמֹשֵׁל בְּכָל־קִנְיָנוֹ׃

verses.english: to bind his princes at his will and teach his elders wisdom.
verses.hebrew: לֶאְסֹר שָׂרָיו בְּנַפְשׁוֹ וּזְקֵנָיו יְחַכֵּם׃

verses.english: Israel came into Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יִשְׂרָאֵל מִצְרָיִם וְיַעֲקֹב גָּר בְּאֶרֶץ־חָם׃

verses.english: He made His people very fruitful and stronger than their adversaries.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּפֶר אֶת־עַמּוֹ מְאֹד וַיַּעֲצִמֵהוּ מִצָּרָיו׃

verses.english: He turned their heart to hate His people, to deal craftily with His servants.
verses.hebrew: הָפַךְ לִבָּם לִשְׂנֹא עַמּוֹ לְהִתְנַכֵּל בַּעֲבָדָיו׃

verses.english: He sent Moses His servant, Aaron whom He had chosen.
verses.hebrew: שָׁלַח מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ אַהֲרֹן אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בּוֹ׃

verses.english: They set among them the words of His signs and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.hebrew: שָׂמוּ־בָם דִּבְרֵי אֹתוֹתָיו וּמֹפְתִים בְּאֶרֶץ חָם׃

verses.english: He sent darkness and made it dark; they did not rebel against His words.
verses.hebrew: שָׁלַח חֹשֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁךְ וְלֹא־מָרוּ אֶת־דברוו [דְּבָרוֹ׃]

verses.english: He turned their waters to blood and killed their fish.
verses.hebrew: הָפַךְ אֶת־מֵימֵיהֶם לְדָם וַיָּמֶת אֶת־דְּגָתָם׃

verses.english: Their land swarmed with frogs, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.hebrew: שָׁרַץ אַרְצָם צְפַרְדְּעִים בְּחַדְרֵי מַלְכֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: He spoke, and swarms came, gnats throughout their territory.
verses.hebrew: אָמַר וַיָּבֹא עָרֹב כִּנִּים בְּכָל־גְּבוּלָם׃

verses.english: He gave hail for their rains, flaming fire in their land.
verses.hebrew: נָתַן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶם בָּרָד אֵשׁ לֶהָבוֹת בְּאַרְצָם׃

verses.english: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their territory.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ גַּפְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָם וַיְשַׁבֵּר עֵץ גְּבוּלָם׃

verses.english: He spoke, and locusts came, and crawling locusts without number.
verses.hebrew: אָמַר וַיָּבֹא אַרְבֶּה וְיֶלֶק וְאֵין מִסְפָּר׃

verses.english: They ate every plant in their land and ate the fruit of their soil.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאכַל כָּל־עֵשֶׂב בְּאַרְצָם וַיֹּאכַל פְּרִי אַדְמָתָם׃

verses.english: He struck every firstborn in their land, the first of all their vigor.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ כָּל־בְּכוֹר בְּאַרְצָם רֵאשִׁית לְכָל־אוֹנָם׃

verses.english: He brought them out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶסֶף וְזָהָב וְאֵין בִּשְׁבָטָיו כּוֹשֵׁל׃

verses.english: Egypt rejoiced at their departure, for fear of them had fallen upon them.
verses.hebrew: שָׂמַח מִצְרַיִם בְּצֵאתָם כִּי־נָפַל פַּחְדָּם עֲלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: He spread a cloud for a covering and fire to light the night.
verses.hebrew: פָּרַשׂ עָנָן לְמָסָךְ וְאֵשׁ לְהָאִיר לָיְלָה׃

verses.english: He asked, and He brought quail; He satisfied them with bread from heaven.
verses.hebrew: שָׁאַל וַיָּבֵא שְׂלָו וְלֶחֶם שָׁמַיִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵם׃

verses.english: He opened a rock, and waters flowed; they ran as a river through dry places.
verses.hebrew: פָּתַח צוּר וַיָּזוּבוּ מָיִם הָלְכוּ בַּצִּיּוֹת נָהָר׃

verses.english: For He remembered His holy word, and Abraham His servant.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־זָכַר אֶת־דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ אֶת־אַבְרָהָם עַבְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: He brought His people out with joy, His chosen ones with a ringing cry.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִא עַמּוֹ בְשָׂשׂוֹן בְּרִנָּה אֶת־בְּחִירָיו׃

verses.english: He gave them lands of nations, and they inherited the labor of peoples,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אַרְצוֹת גּוֹיִם וַעֲמַל לְאֻמִּים יִירָשׁוּ׃

verses.english: so that they might keep His statutes and guard His instructions. Praise Yah!
verses.hebrew: בַּעֲבוּר יִשְׁמְרוּ חֻקָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָיו יִנְצֹרוּ הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃

verses.english: Praise Yah! Give thanks to YHWH, for He is good; His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּיָהּ הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: Who can utter YHWH's mighty deeds, make all His praise heard?
verses.hebrew: מִי יְמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֹת יְהוָה יַשְׁמִיעַ כָּל־תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: Blessed are those who keep justice, one who does righteousness at every time.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁפָּט עֹשֵׂה צְדָקָה בְכָל־עֵת׃

verses.english: Remember me, YHWH, with the favor You show Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
verses.hebrew: זָכְרֵנִי יְהוָה בִּרְצוֹן עַמֶּךָ פָּקְדֵנִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: that I may see the good of Your chosen ones, rejoice in the joy of Your nation, and glory with Your inheritance.
verses.hebrew: לִרְאוֹת בְּטוֹבַת בְּחִירֶיךָ לִשְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַת גּוֹיֶךָ לְהִתְהַלֵּל עִם־נַחֲלָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: We have sinned with our fathers; we have acted perversely and wickedly.
verses.hebrew: חָטָאנוּ עִם־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ הֶעֱוִינוּ הִרְשָׁעְנוּ׃

verses.english: Our fathers in Egypt did not understand Your wonders; they did not remember Your abundant acts of steadfast love, and they rebelled by the sea, at the Sea of Reeds.
verses.hebrew: אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְמִצְרַיִם לֹא־הִשְׂכִּילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ לֹא זָכְרוּ אֶת־רֹב חֲסָדֶיךָ וַיַּמְרוּ עַל־יָם בְּיַם־סוּף׃

verses.english: Yet He saved them for His name's sake, to make His might known.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ לְהוֹדִיעַ אֶת־גְּבוּרָתוֹ׃

verses.english: He rebuked the Sea of Reeds, and it dried up; He led them through the deeps as through a wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְעַר בְּיַם־סוּף וַיֶּחֱרָב וַיּוֹלִיכֵם בַּתְּהֹמוֹת כַּמִּדְבָּר׃

verses.english: He saved them from the hand of the hater and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּד שׂוֹנֵא וַיִּגְאָלֵם מִיַּד אוֹיֵב׃

verses.english: Waters covered their adversaries; not one of them remained.
verses.hebrew: וַיְכַסּוּ־מַיִם צָרֵיהֶם אֶחָד מֵהֶם לֹא נוֹתָר׃

verses.english: They believed His words and sang His praise.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּאֲמִינוּ בִדְבָרָיו יָשִׁירוּ תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: They quickly forgot His works; they did not wait for His counsel.
verses.hebrew: מִהֲרוּ שָׁכְחוּ מַעֲשָׂיו לֹא־חִכּוּ לַעֲצָתוֹ׃

verses.english: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the wasteland.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְאַוּוּ תַאֲוָה בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵל בִּישִׁימוֹן׃

verses.english: He gave them their request but sent wasting into their lives.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָם וַיְשַׁלַּח רָזוֹן בְּנַפְשָׁם׃

verses.english: They envied Moses in the camp, and Aaron, YHWH's holy one.
verses.hebrew: וַיְקַנְאוּ לְמֹשֶׁה בַּמַּחֲנֶה לְאַהֲרֹן קְדוֹשׁ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The earth opened and swallowed Dathan and covered Abiram's assembly.
verses.hebrew: תִּפְתַּח־אֶרֶץ וַתִּבְלַע דָּתָן וַתְּכַס עַל־עֲדַת אֲבִירָם׃

verses.english: Fire burned in their assembly; a flame blazed against the wicked.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּבְעַר־אֵשׁ בַּעֲדָתָם לֶהָבָה תְּלַהֵט רְשָׁעִים׃

verses.english: They made a calf at Horeb and bowed down to a cast image.
verses.hebrew: יַעֲשׂוּ־עֵגֶל בְּחֹרֵב וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְמַסֵּכָה׃

verses.english: They exchanged their glory for the form of an ox that eats grass.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמִירוּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדָם בְּתַבְנִית שׁוֹר אֹכֵל עֵשֶׂב׃

verses.english: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,
verses.hebrew: שָׁכְחוּ אֵל מוֹשִׁיעָם עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת בְּמִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: wonders in the land of Ham, awesome things by the Sea of Reeds.
verses.hebrew: נִפְלָאוֹת בְּאֶרֶץ חָם נוֹרָאוֹת עַל־יַם־סוּף׃

verses.english: He said He would destroy them, had not Moses His chosen one stood in the breach before Him, to turn His wrath back from destroying.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַשְׁמִידָם לוּלֵי מֹשֶׁה בְחִירוֹ עָמַד בַּפֶּרֶץ לְפָנָיו לְהָשִׁיב חֲמָתוֹ מֵהַשְׁחִית׃

verses.english: They despised the desirable land; they did not believe His word.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְאֲסוּ בְּאֶרֶץ חֶמְדָּה לֹא־הֶאֱמִינוּ לִדְבָרוֹ׃

verses.english: They grumbled in their tents; they did not heed YHWH's voice.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָגְנוּ בְאָהֳלֵיהֶם לֹא שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה׃

verses.english: He lifted His hand to them, to make them fall in the wilderness,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא יָדוֹ לָהֶם לְהַפִּיל אוֹתָם בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

verses.english: and to make their offspring fall among the nations, and scatter them among the lands.
verses.hebrew: וּלְהַפִּיל זַרְעָם בַּגּוֹיִם וּלְזָרוֹתָם בָּאֲרָצוֹת׃

verses.english: They yoked themselves to Baal-peor and ate sacrifices of the dead.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּצָּמְדוּ לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר וַיֹּאכְלוּ זִבְחֵי מֵתִים׃

verses.english: They provoked Him with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכְעִיסוּ בְּמַעַלְלֵיהֶם וַתִּפְרָץ־בָּם מַגֵּפָה׃

verses.english: Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was stopped.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד פִּינְחָס וַיְפַלֵּל וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה׃

verses.english: It was reckoned to him as righteousness, from generation to generation forever.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּחָשֶׁב לוֹ לִצְדָקָה לְדֹר וָדֹר עַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: They provoked wrath at the waters of Meribah, and it went badly for Moses because of them,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְצִיפוּ עַל־מֵי מְרִיבָה וַיֵּרַע לְמֹשֶׁה בַּעֲבוּרָם׃

verses.english: for they embittered his spirit, and he spoke rashly with his lips.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִמְרוּ אֶת־רוּחוֹ וַיְבַטֵּא בִּשְׂפָתָיו׃

verses.english: They did not destroy the peoples about whom YHWH had spoken to them.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־הִשְׁמִידוּ אֶת־הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהוָה לָהֶם׃

verses.english: They mixed with the nations and learned their practices.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְעָרְבוּ בַגּוֹיִם וַיִּלְמְדוּ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם׃

verses.english: They served their idols, and these became a snare to them.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וַיִּהְיוּ לָהֶם לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃

verses.english: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבְּחוּ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם לַשֵּׁדִים׃

verses.english: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters whom they sacrificed to Canaan's idols; the land was polluted with blood.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ דָם נָקִי דַּם־בְּנֵיהֶם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר זִבְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּי כְנָעַן וַתֶּחֱנַף הָאָרֶץ בַּדָּמִים׃

verses.english: They became unclean through their works and prostituted themselves through their deeds.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּטְמְאוּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם וַיִּזְנוּ בְּמַעַלְלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH's anger burned against His people, and He abhorred His inheritance.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בְּעַמּוֹ וַיְתָעֵב אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

verses.english: He gave them into the hand of nations, and their haters ruled over them.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־גּוֹיִם וַיִּמְשְׁלוּ בָהֶם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Their enemies oppressed them, and they were subdued under their hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְחָצוּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶם וַיִּכָּנְעוּ תַּחַת יָדָם׃

verses.english: Many times He rescued them, but they rebelled in their counsel and sank low through their iniquity.
verses.hebrew: פְּעָמִים רַבּוֹת יַצִּילֵם וְהֵמָּה יַמְרוּ בַעֲצָתָם וַיָּמֹכּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָם׃

verses.english: He looked upon their distress when He heard their cry.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא בַּצַּר לָהֶם בְּשָׁמְעוֹ אֶת־רִנָּתָם׃

verses.english: He remembered His covenant for them and relented according to His abundant steadfast love.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְכֹּר לָהֶם בְּרִיתוֹ וַיִּנָּחֵם כְּרֹב חסדו [חֲסָדָיו׃]

verses.english: He granted them compassion before all their captors.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אוֹתָם לְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי כָּל־שׁוֹבֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Save us, YHWH our God, and gather us from the nations, to give thanks to Your holy name and glory in Your praise.
verses.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ מִן־הַגּוֹיִם לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם קָדְשֶׁךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּחַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Blessed be YHWH, the God of Israel, from eternity to eternity. Let all the people say, Amen! Praise Yah!
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם וְאָמַר כָּל־הָעָם אָמֵן הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃

verses.english: Give thanks to YHWH, for He is good; His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: הֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: Let YHWH's redeemed say so, those He redeemed from the adversary's hand,
verses.hebrew: יֹאמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר גְּאָלָם מִיַּד־צָר׃

verses.english: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and the sea.
verses.hebrew: וּמֵאֲרָצוֹת קִבְּצָם מִמִּזְרָח וּמִמַּעֲרָב מִצָּפוֹן וּמִיָּם׃

verses.english: They wandered in a wilderness, on a wasteland road; they found no inhabited city.
verses.hebrew: תָּעוּ בַמִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימוֹן דָּרֶךְ עִיר מוֹשָׁב לֹא מָצָאוּ׃

verses.english: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted within them.
verses.hebrew: רְעֵבִים גַּם־צְמֵאִים נַפְשָׁם בָּהֶם תִּתְעַטָּף׃

verses.english: They cried to YHWH in their distress; He rescued them from their straits.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצוּקוֹתֵיהֶם יַצִּילֵם׃

verses.english: He led them by a straight way to go to an inhabited city.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶרֶךְ יְשָׁרָה לָלֶכֶת אֶל־עִיר מוֹשָׁב׃

verses.english: Let them thank YHWH for His steadfast love and His wonders for the children of humankind.
verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: For He satisfied a longing soul and filled a hungry soul with good.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִשְׂבִּיעַ נֶפֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָה וְנֶפֶשׁ רְעֵבָה מִלֵּא־טוֹב׃

verses.english: Those dwelling in darkness and death's shadow, bound in affliction and iron,
verses.hebrew: יֹשְׁבֵי חֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת אֲסִירֵי עֳנִי וּבַרְזֶל׃

verses.english: because they rebelled against God's sayings and despised the Most High's counsel,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִמְרוּ אִמְרֵי־אֵל וַעֲצַת עֶלְיוֹן נָאָצוּ׃

verses.english: He humbled their heart with toil; they stumbled, and there was no helper.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכְנַע בֶּעָמָל לִבָּם כָּשְׁלוּ וְאֵין עֹזֵר׃

verses.english: They cried to YHWH in their distress; He saved them from their straits.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצֻקוֹתֵיהֶם יוֹשִׁיעֵם׃

verses.english: He brought them out of darkness and death's shadow and tore their bonds apart.
verses.hebrew: יוֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת וּמוֹסְרוֹתֵיהֶם יְנַתֵּק׃

verses.english: Let them thank YHWH for His steadfast love and His wonders for the children of humankind.
verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: For He shattered bronze doors and cut through iron bars.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־שִׁבַּר דַּלְתוֹת נְחֹשֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵי בַרְזֶל גִּדֵּעַ׃

verses.english: Fools, because of their rebellious way and their iniquities, were afflicted.
verses.hebrew: אֱוִלִים מִדֶּרֶךְ פִּשְׁעָם וּמֵעֲוֺנֹתֵיהֶם יִתְעַנּוּ׃

verses.english: Their soul abhorred every food, and they reached the gates of death.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־אֹכֶל תְּתַעֵב נַפְשָׁם וַיַּגִּיעוּ עַד־שַׁעֲרֵי מָוֶת׃

verses.english: They cried to YHWH in their distress; He saved them from their straits.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצֻקוֹתֵיהֶם יוֹשִׁיעֵם׃

verses.english: He sent His word and healed them and delivered them from their pits.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח דְּבָרוֹ וְיִרְפָּאֵם וִימַלֵּט מִשְּׁחִיתוֹתָם׃

verses.english: Let them thank YHWH for His steadfast love and His wonders for the children of humankind.
verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: Let them sacrifice thanksgiving sacrifices and recount His works with a ringing cry.
verses.hebrew: וְיִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵי תוֹדָה וִיסַפְּרוּ מַעֲשָׂיו בְּרִנָּה׃

verses.english: Those going down to the sea in ships, doing work on great waters,
verses.hebrew: יוֹרְדֵי הַיָּם בָּאֳנִיּוֹת עֹשֵׂי מְלָאכָה בְּמַיִם רַבִּים׃

verses.english: they saw YHWH's works and His wonders in the deep.
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה רָאוּ מַעֲשֵׂי יְהוָה וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו בִּמְצוּלָה׃

verses.english: He spoke and raised a storm wind, and it lifted its waves.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר וַיַּעֲמֵד רוּחַ סְעָרָה וַתְּרוֹמֵם גַּלָּיו׃

verses.english: They rise to the heavens, descend to the deeps; their soul melts in trouble.
verses.hebrew: יַעֲלוּ שָׁמַיִם יֵרְדוּ תְהוֹמוֹת נַפְשָׁם בְּרָעָה תִתְמוֹגָג׃

verses.english: They reel and stagger like a drunkard; all their wisdom is swallowed up.
verses.hebrew: יָחוֹגּוּ וְיָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּוֹר וְכָל־חָכְמָתָם תִּתְבַּלָּע׃

verses.english: They cried to YHWH in their distress, and He brought them out of their straits.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם וּמִמְּצוּקֹתֵיהֶם יוֹצִיאֵם׃

verses.english: He made the storm a stillness, and their waves were hushed.
verses.hebrew: יָקֵם סְעָרָה לִדְמָמָה וַיֶּחֱשׁוּ גַּלֵּיהֶם׃

verses.english: They rejoiced because they were quiet, and He guided them to their desired haven.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂמְחוּ כִי־יִשְׁתֹּקוּ וַיַּנְחֵם אֶל־מְחוֹז חֶפְצָם׃

verses.english: Let them thank YHWH for His steadfast love and His wonders for the children of humankind.
verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: Let them exalt Him in the people's assembly and praise Him in the elders' council.
verses.hebrew: וִירֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל־עָם וּבְמוֹשַׁב זְקֵנִים יְהַלְלוּהוּ׃

verses.english: He makes rivers a wilderness and springs of water a thirsty land,
verses.hebrew: יָשֵׂם נְהָרוֹת לְמִדְבָּר וּמֹצָאֵי מַיִם לְצִמָּאוֹן׃

verses.english: a fruitful land a salt waste, because of the wickedness of those dwelling in it.
verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ פְּרִי לִמְלֵחָה מֵרָעַת יֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃

verses.english: He makes a wilderness a pool of water and dry land springs of water.
verses.hebrew: יָשֵׂם מִדְבָּר לַאֲגַם־מַיִם וְאֶרֶץ צִיָּה לְמֹצָאֵי מָיִם׃

verses.english: He settles the hungry there, and they establish an inhabited city.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹשֶׁב שָׁם רְעֵבִים וַיְכוֹנְנוּ עִיר מוֹשָׁב׃

verses.english: They sow fields and plant vineyards and produce fruitful yield.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְרְעוּ שָׂדוֹת וַיִּטְּעוּ כְרָמִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ פְּרִי תְבוּאָה׃

verses.english: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not diminish their livestock.
verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרֲכֵם וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד וּבְהֶמְתָּם לֹא יַמְעִיט׃

verses.english: Then they diminish and are brought low through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְעֲטוּ וַיָּשֹׁחוּ מֵעֹצֶר רָעָה וְיָגוֹן׃

verses.english: He pours contempt on nobles and makes them wander in a pathless waste.
verses.hebrew: שֹׁפֵךְ בּוּז עַל־נְדִיבִים וַיַּתְעֵם בְּתֹהוּ לֹא־דָרֶךְ׃

verses.english: But He sets the needy high above affliction and makes families like a flock.
verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׂגֵּב אֶבְיוֹן מֵעוֹנִי וַיָּשֶׂם כַּצֹּאן מִשְׁפָּחוֹת׃

verses.english: The upright see and rejoice, and all injustice shuts its mouth.
verses.hebrew: יִרְאוּ יְשָׁרִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ וְכָל־עַוְלָה קָפְצָה פִּיהָ׃

verses.english: Who is wise and will attend to these things? Let them discern YHWH's acts of steadfast love.
verses.hebrew: מִי־חָכָם וְיִשְׁמָר־אֵלֶּה וְיִתְבּוֹנְנוּ חַסְדֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: A song. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: My heart is steadfast, God; I will sing and make music, even with my glory.
verses.hebrew: נָכוֹן לִבִּי אֱלֹהִים אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּרָה אַף־כְּבוֹדִי׃

verses.english: Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
verses.hebrew: עוּרָה הַנֵּבֶל וְכִנּוֹר אָעִירָה שָּׁחַר׃

verses.english: I will thank You among the peoples, YHWH; I will make music to You among the nations.
verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ בָעַמִּים יְהוָה וַאֲזַמֶּרְךָ בַּל־אֻמִּים׃

verses.english: For Your steadfast love is great above the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches the clouds.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־גָדוֹל מֵעַל־שָׁמַיִם חַסְדֶּךָ וְעַד־שְׁחָקִים אֲמִתֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Be exalted above the heavens, God, and Your glory over all the earth.
verses.hebrew: רוּמָה עַל־שָׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים וְעַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃

verses.english: So that Your beloved ones may be delivered, save with Your right hand and answer me.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי׃

verses.english: God spoke in His holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem and measure out the valley of Succoth.
verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים דִּבֶּר בְּקָדְשׁוֹ אֶעְלֹזָה אֲחַלְּקָה שְׁכֶם וְעֵמֶק סֻכּוֹת אֲמַדֵּד׃

verses.english: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the stronghold of my head; Judah is my lawgiver.
verses.hebrew: לִי גִלְעָד לִי מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרַיִם מָעוֹז רֹאשִׁי יְהוּדָה מְחֹקְקִי׃

verses.english: Moab is my washing basin; upon Edom I will cast my sandal; over Philistia I will shout in triumph.
verses.hebrew: מוֹאָב סִיר רַחְצִי עַל־אֱדוֹם אַשְׁלִיךְ נַעֲלִי עֲלֵי־פְלֶשֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָע׃

verses.english: Who will bring me to a fortified city? Who has guided me as far as Edom?
verses.hebrew: מִי יֹבִלֵנִי עִיר מִבְצָר מִי נָחַנִי עַד־אֱדוֹם׃

verses.english: Have You not rejected us, God? You do not go out, God, with our armies.
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ וְלֹא־תֵצֵא אֱלֹהִים בְּצִבְאֹתֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Give us help against the adversary, for human salvation is worthless.
verses.hebrew: הָבָה־לָּנוּ עֶזְרָת מִצָּר וְשָׁוְא תְּשׁוּעַת אָדָם׃

verses.english: With God we will act valiantly; He will trample our adversaries.
verses.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים נַעֲשֶׂה־חָיִל וְהוּא יָבוּס צָרֵינוּ׃

verses.english: For the director. Of David. A psalm. God of my praise, do not be silent.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר אֱלֹהֵי תְהִלָּתִי אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ׃

verses.english: For a wicked mouth and a deceitful mouth have opened against me; they speak with me with a lying tongue.
verses.hebrew: כִּי פִי רָשָׁע וּפִי־מִרְמָה עָלַי פָּתָחוּ דִּבְּרוּ אִתִּי לְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר׃

verses.english: They surround me with words of hatred and fight me without cause.
verses.hebrew: וְדִבְרֵי שִׂנְאָה סְבָבוּנִי וַיִּלָּחֲמוּנִי חִנָּם׃

verses.english: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am prayer.
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת־אַהֲבָתִי יִשְׂטְנוּנִי וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּה׃

verses.english: They repay me evil for good and hatred for my love.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלַי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה וְשִׂנְאָה תַּחַת אַהֲבָתִי׃

verses.english: Appoint a wicked man over him; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
verses.hebrew: הַפְקֵד עָלָיו רָשָׁע וְשָׂטָן יַעֲמֹד עַל־יְמִינוֹ׃

verses.english: When he is judged, let him come out guilty; let his prayer become sin.
verses.hebrew: בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ יֵצֵא רָשָׁע וּתְפִלָּתוֹ תִּהְיֶה לַחֲטָאָה׃

verses.english: Let his days be few; let another take his office.
verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ־יָמָיו מְעַטִּים פְּקֻדָּתוֹ יִקַּח אַחֵר׃

verses.english: Let his children be orphans and his wife a widow.
verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ־בָנָיו יְתוֹמִים וְאִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָה׃

verses.english: Let his children wander continually and beg, and seek from their ruined dwellings.
verses.hebrew: וְנוֹעַ יָנוּעוּ בָנָיו וְשִׁאֵלוּ וְדָרְשׁוּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Let a creditor ensnare all he has, and let strangers plunder his toil.
verses.hebrew: יְנַקֵּשׁ נוֹשֶׁה לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְיָבֹזּוּ זָרִים יְגִיעוֹ׃

verses.english: Let no one extend steadfast love to him, and let no one show favor to his orphans.
verses.hebrew: אַל־יְהִי־לוֹ מֹשֵׁךְ חָסֶד וְאַל־יְהִי חוֹנֵן לִיתוֹמָיו׃

verses.english: Let his posterity be cut off; in a following generation let their name be erased.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי־אַחֲרִיתוֹ לְהַכְרִית בְּדוֹר אַחֵר יִמַּח שְׁמָם׃

verses.english: Let his fathers' iniquity be remembered before YHWH, and let his mother's sin not be erased.
verses.hebrew: יִזָּכֵר עֲוֺן אֲבֹתָיו אֶל־יְהוָה וְחַטַּאת אִמּוֹ אַל־תִּמָּח׃

verses.english: Let them be before YHWH continually, and let Him cut their memory off from the earth,
verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ נֶגֶד־יְהוָה תָּמִיד וְיַכְרֵת מֵאֶרֶץ זִכְרָם׃

verses.english: because he did not remember to show steadfast love but pursued the afflicted and needy man, and the brokenhearted, to put him to death.
verses.hebrew: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא זָכַר עֲשׂוֹת חָסֶד וַיִּרְדֹּף אִישׁ־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵה לֵבָב לְמוֹתֵת׃

verses.english: He loved cursing, and it came upon him; he did not delight in blessing, and it stayed far from him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱהַב קְלָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵהוּ וְלֹא־חָפֵץ בִּבְרָכָה וַתִּרְחַק מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: He put on cursing as his garment; it entered his inward parts like water and his bones like oil.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְבַּשׁ קְלָלָה כְּמַדּוֹ וַתָּבֹא כַמַּיִם בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְכַשֶּׁמֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: Let it be to him like a garment he wraps around himself and a belt he wears continually.
verses.hebrew: תְּהִי־לוֹ כְּבֶגֶד יַעְטֶה וּלְמֵזַח תָּמִיד יַחְגְּרֶהָ׃

verses.english: Let this be my accusers' payment from YHWH, and that of those speaking evil against my life.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת פְּעֻלַּת שֹׂטְנַי מֵאֵת יְהוָה וְהַדֹּבְרִים רָע עַל־נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: But You, YHWH my Lord, act for me for Your name's sake; for Your steadfast love is good, rescue me.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוִה אֲדֹנָי עֲ‍שֵׂה־אִתִּי לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ כִּי־טוֹב חַסְדְּךָ הַצִּילֵנִי׃

verses.english: For I am afflicted and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָנֹכִי וְלִבִּי חָלַל בְּקִרְבִּי׃

verses.english: Like a shadow as it lengthens, I pass away; I am shaken off like a locust.
verses.hebrew: כְּצֵל־כִּנְטוֹתוֹ נֶהֱלָכְתִּי נִנְעַרְתִּי כָּאַרְבֶּה׃

verses.english: My knees stumble from fasting, and my flesh has grown lean for lack of fat.
verses.hebrew: בִּרְכַּי כָּשְׁלוּ מִצּוֹם וּבְשָׂרִי כָּחַשׁ מִשָּׁמֶן׃

verses.english: I have become a reproach to them; they see me and shake their heads.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי חֶרְפָּה לָהֶם יִרְאוּנִי יְנִיעוּן רֹאשָׁם׃

verses.english: Help me, YHWH my God; save me according to Your steadfast love.
verses.hebrew: עָזְרֵנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כְחַסְדֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, YHWH, have done it.
verses.hebrew: וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־יָדְךָ זֹּאת אַתָּה יְהוָה עֲשִׂיתָהּ׃

verses.english: Let them curse, but You bless; they rise up and are ashamed, but Your servant will rejoice.
verses.hebrew: יְקַלְלוּ־הֵמָּה וְאַתָּה תְבָרֵךְ קָמוּ וַיֵּבֹשׁוּ וְעַבְדְּךָ יִשְׂמָח׃

verses.english: Let my accusers wear disgrace and wrap themselves in their shame like a robe.
verses.hebrew: יִלְבְּשׁוּ שׂוֹטְנַי כְּלִמָּה וְיַעֲטוּ כַמְעִיל בָּשְׁתָּם׃

verses.english: I will greatly thank YHWH with my mouth, and praise Him among many,
verses.hebrew: אוֹדֶה יְהוָה מְאֹד בְּפִי וּבְתוֹךְ רַבִּים אֲהַלְלֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: for He stands at the needy person's right hand, to save him from those judging his life.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יַעֲמֹד לִימִין אֶבְיוֹן לְהוֹשִׁיעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵי נַפְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: Of David. A psalm. YHWH's declaration to my lord: Sit at My right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר נְאֻם יְהוָה לַאדֹנִי שֵׁב לִימִינִי עַד־אָשִׁית אֹיְבֶיךָ הֲדֹם לְרַגְלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: YHWH will send the scepter of your strength from Zion; rule in the midst of your enemies.
verses.hebrew: מַטֵּה־עֻזְּךָ יִשְׁלַח יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן רְדֵה בְּקֶרֶב אֹיְבֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Your people are willing offerings on the day of your force, in holy splendors; from the womb of dawn, the dew of your youth is yours.
verses.hebrew: עַמְּךָ נְדָבֹת בְּיוֹם חֵילֶךָ בְּהַדְרֵי־קֹדֶשׁ מֵרֶחֶם מִשְׁחָר לְךָ טַל יַלְדֻתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: YHWH has sworn and will not relent: You are a priest forever, according to the manner of Melchizedek.
verses.hebrew: נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה וְלֹא יִנָּחֵם אַתָּה־כֹהֵן לְעוֹלָם עַל־דִּבְרָתִי מַלְכִּי־צֶדֶק׃

verses.english: The Lord at your right hand crushed kings on the day of His anger.
verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי עַל־יְמִינְךָ מָחַץ בְּיוֹם־אַפּוֹ מְלָכִים׃

verses.english: He will judge among the nations, filling the field with corpses; He crushed a head over a broad land.
verses.hebrew: יָדִין בַּגּוֹיִם מָלֵא גְוִיּוֹת מָחַץ רֹאשׁ עַל־אֶרֶץ רַבָּה׃

verses.english: He will drink from a torrent on the way; therefore he will lift his head.
verses.hebrew: מִנַּחַל בַּדֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּה עַל־כֵּן יָרִים רֹאשׁ׃

verses.english: Praise Yah! I will thank YHWH with a whole heart, in the council of the upright and the assembly.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ אוֹדֶה יְהוָה בְּכָל־לֵבָב בְּסוֹד יְשָׁרִים וְעֵדָה׃

verses.english: Great are the works of YHWH, sought out by all who delight in them.
verses.hebrew: גְּדֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂי יְהוָה דְּרוּשִׁים לְכָל־חֶפְצֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Majesty and splendor are His work, and His righteousness endures forever.
verses.hebrew: הוֹד־וְהָדָר פָּעֳלוֹ וְצִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד׃

verses.english: He made a memorial for His wonders; YHWH is gracious and compassionate.
verses.hebrew: זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָיו חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהוָה׃

verses.english: He gave food to those who fear Him; He will remember His covenant forever.
verses.hebrew: טֶרֶף נָתַן לִירֵאָיו יִזְכֹּר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ׃

verses.english: He declared the power of His works to His people, to give them the inheritance of nations.
verses.hebrew: כֹּחַ מַעֲשָׂיו הִגִּיד לְעַמּוֹ לָתֵת לָהֶם נַחֲלַת גּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are faithful,
verses.hebrew: מַעֲשֵׂי יָדָיו אֱמֶת וּמִשְׁפָּט נֶאֱמָנִים כָּל־פִּקּוּדָיו׃

verses.english: established forever and ever, made in truth and uprightness.
verses.hebrew: סְמוּכִים לָעַד לְעוֹלָם עֲשׂוּיִם בֶּאֱמֶת וְיָשָׁר׃

verses.english: He sent redemption to His people; He commanded His covenant forever; holy and fearsome is His name.
verses.hebrew: פְּדוּת שָׁלַח לְעַמּוֹ צִוָּה־לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ קָדוֹשׁ וְנוֹרָא שְׁמוֹ׃

verses.english: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of YHWH; good understanding belongs to all who practice them. His praise endures forever.
verses.hebrew: רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה שֵׂכֶל טוֹב לְכָל־עֹשֵׂיהֶם תְּהִלָּתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד׃

verses.english: Praise Yah! Happy is the man who fears YHWH, who greatly delights in His commandments.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ אַשְׁרֵי־אִישׁ יָרֵא אֶת־יְהוָה בְּמִצְוֺתָיו חָפֵץ מְאֹד׃

verses.english: His seed will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.hebrew: גִּבּוֹר בָּאָרֶץ יִהְיֶה זַרְעוֹ דּוֹר יְשָׁרִים יְבֹרָךְ׃

verses.english: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.
verses.hebrew: הוֹן־וָעֹשֶׁר בְּבֵיתוֹ וְצִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד׃

verses.english: Light has risen in darkness for the upright— gracious, compassionate and righteous.
verses.hebrew: זָרַח בַּחֹשֶׁךְ אוֹר לַיְשָׁרִים חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם וְצַדִּיק׃

verses.english: Good is the man who is gracious and lends; he manages his affairs with judgment.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב־אִישׁ חוֹנֵן וּמַלְוֶה יְכַלְכֵּל דְּבָרָיו בְּמִשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: For he will never totter; the righteous person will be remembered forever.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־לְעוֹלָם לֹא־יִמּוֹט לְזֵכֶר עוֹלָם יִהְיֶה צַדִּיק׃

verses.english: He will not fear an evil report; his heart is firm, trusting in YHWH.
verses.hebrew: מִשְּׁמוּעָה רָעָה לֹא יִירָא נָכוֹן לִבּוֹ בָּטֻחַ בַּיהוָה׃

verses.english: His heart is supported; he will not fear, until he looks upon his adversaries.
verses.hebrew: סָמוּךְ לִבּוֹ לֹא יִירָא עַד אֲשֶׁר־יִרְאֶה בְצָרָיו׃

verses.english: He scattered gifts; he gave to the needy. His righteousness endures forever; his horn will rise in glory.
verses.hebrew: פִּזַּר נָתַן לָאֶבְיוֹנִים צִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד קַרְנוֹ תָּרוּם בְּכָבוֹד׃

verses.english: A wicked man will see and be angry; he will gnash his teeth and melt away; the desire of the wicked will perish.
verses.hebrew: רָשָׁע יִרְאֶה וְכָעָס שִׁנָּיו יַחֲרֹק וְנָמָס תַּאֲוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד׃

verses.english: Praise Yah! Praise, servants of YHWH; praise the name of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ עַבְדֵי יְהוָה הַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה׃

verses.english: May the name of YHWH be blessed from now and forever.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי שֵׁם יְהוָה מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: From the sun's rising to its setting, the name of YHWH is praised.
verses.hebrew: מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד־מְבוֹאוֹ מְהֻלָּל שֵׁם יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH is high above all nations; His glory is above the heavens.
verses.hebrew: רָם עַל־כָּל־גּוֹיִם יְהוָה עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ׃

verses.english: Who is like YHWH our God, who sits on high,
verses.hebrew: מִי כַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַמַּגְבִּיהִי לָשָׁבֶת׃

verses.english: who stoops to look in the heavens and on the earth?
verses.hebrew: הַמַּשְׁפִּילִי לִרְאוֹת בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: He raises the poor from dust; from the dung heap He lifts the needy,
verses.hebrew: מְקִימִי מֵעָפָר דָּל מֵאַשְׁפֹּת יָרִים אֶבְיוֹן׃

verses.english: to seat him with nobles, with the nobles of His people.
verses.hebrew: לְהוֹשִׁיבִי עִם־נְדִיבִים עִם נְדִיבֵי עַמּוֹ׃

verses.english: He seats the barren woman of the house as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!
verses.hebrew: מוֹשִׁיבִי עֲקֶרֶת הַבַּיִת אֵם־הַבָּנִים שְׂמֵחָה הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃

verses.english: When Israel went out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign speech,
verses.hebrew: בְּצֵאת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם בֵּית יַעֲקֹב מֵעַם לֹעֵז׃

verses.english: Judah became His sanctuary, Israel His dominions.
verses.hebrew: הָיְתָה יְהוּדָה לְקָדְשׁוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַמְשְׁלוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: The sea saw and fled; the Jordan turned back.
verses.hebrew: הַיָּם רָאָה וַיָּנֹס הַיַּרְדֵּן יִסֹּב לְאָחוֹר׃

verses.english: The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like young sheep.
verses.hebrew: הֶהָרִים רָקְדוּ כְאֵילִים גְּבָעוֹת כִּבְנֵי־צֹאן׃

verses.english: What is it with you, sea, that you flee, Jordan, that you turn back?
verses.hebrew: מַה־לְּךָ הַיָּם כִּי תָנוּס הַיַּרְדֵּן תִּסֹּב לְאָחוֹר׃

verses.english: Mountains, that you skip like rams, hills, like young sheep?
verses.hebrew: הֶהָרִים תִּרְקְדוּ כְאֵילִים גְּבָעוֹת כִּבְנֵי־צֹאן׃

verses.english: Before the Lord, writhe, earth; before the God of Jacob,
verses.hebrew: מִלִּפְנֵי אָדוֹן חוּלִי אָרֶץ מִלִּפְנֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: who turns the rock into a pool of water, flint into a spring of water.
verses.hebrew: הַהֹפְכִי הַצּוּר אֲגַם־מָיִם חַלָּמִישׁ לְמַעְיְנוֹ־מָיִם׃

verses.english: Not to us, YHWH, not to us, but to Your name give glory, because of Your steadfast love, because of Your faithfulness.
verses.hebrew: לֹא לָנוּ יְהוָה לֹא לָנוּ כִּי־לְשִׁמְךָ תֵּן כָּבוֹד עַל־חַסְדְּךָ עַל־אֲמִתֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Why should the nations say, “Where, now, is their God?”
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה־נָא אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: But our God is in the heavens; everything He delighted in, He has done.
verses.hebrew: וֵאלֹהֵינוּ בַשָּׁמָיִם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵץ עָשָׂה׃

verses.english: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
verses.hebrew: עֲ‍צַבֵּיהֶם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: They have a mouth, but do not speak; they have eyes, but do not see.
verses.hebrew: פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ׃

verses.english: They have ears, but do not hear; they have a nose, but do not smell.
verses.hebrew: אָזְנַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִשְׁמָעוּ אַף לָהֶם וְלֹא יְרִיחוּן׃

verses.english: Their hands do not feel; their feet do not walk; they make no sound in their throat.
verses.hebrew: יְדֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְמִישׁוּן רַגְלֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְהַלֵּכוּ לֹא־יֶהְגּוּ בִּגְרוֹנָם׃

verses.english: May those who make them become like them— everyone who trusts in them.
verses.hebrew: כְּמוֹהֶם יִהְיוּ עֹשֵׂיהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֶם׃

verses.english: Israel, trust in YHWH; He is their help and their shield.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּטַח בַּיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא׃

verses.english: House of Aaron, trust in YHWH; He is their help and their shield.
verses.hebrew: בֵּית אַהֲרֹן בִּטְחוּ בַיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא׃

verses.english: You who fear YHWH, trust in YHWH; He is their help and their shield.
verses.hebrew: יִרְאֵי יְהוָה בִּטְחוּ בַיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא׃

verses.english: YHWH has remembered us; He will bless; He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה זְכָרָנוּ יְבָרֵךְ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית אַהֲרֹן׃

verses.english: He will bless those who fear YHWH, the small together with the great.
verses.hebrew: יְבָרֵךְ יִרְאֵי יְהוָה הַקְּטַנִּים עִם־הַגְּדֹלִים׃

verses.english: May YHWH add to you, to you and to your children.
verses.hebrew: יֹסֵף יְהוָה עֲלֵיכֶם עֲלֵיכֶם וְעַל־בְּנֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You are blessed by YHWH, Maker of heavens and earth.
verses.hebrew: בְּרוּכִים אַתֶּם לַיהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: The heavens are YHWH’s heavens, but the earth He has given to humankind.
verses.hebrew: הַשָּׁמַיִם שָׁמַיִם לַיהוָה וְהָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִבְנֵי־אָדָם׃

verses.english: The dead do not praise Yah, nor any who descend into silence.
verses.hebrew: לֹא הַמֵּתִים יְהַלְלוּ־יָהּ וְלֹא כָּל־יֹרְדֵי דוּמָה׃

verses.english: But we will bless Yah from now and forever. Praise Yah!
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃

verses.english: I love, for YHWH hears my voice, my pleas for favor.
verses.hebrew: אָהַבְתִּי כִּי־יִשְׁמַע יְהוָה אֶת־קוֹלִי תַּחֲנוּנָי׃

verses.english: For He inclined His ear to me, and in my days I will call.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִטָּה אָזְנוֹ לִי וּבְיָמַי אֶקְרָא׃

verses.english: The cords of death surrounded me; the straits of Sheol found me; I found distress and sorrow.
verses.hebrew: אֲפָפוּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָוֶת וּמְצָרֵי שְׁאוֹל מְצָאוּנִי צָרָה וְיָגוֹן אֶמְצָא׃

verses.english: And I call on the name of YHWH: “Please, YHWH, deliver my life!”
verses.hebrew: וּבְשֵׁם־יְהוָה אֶקְרָא אָנָּה יְהוָה מַלְּטָה נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: Gracious is YHWH, and righteous; our God has compassion.
verses.hebrew: חַנּוּן יְהֹוָה וְצַדִּיק וֵאלֹהֵינוּ מְרַחֵם׃

verses.english: YHWH keeps the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.
verses.hebrew: שֹׁמֵר פְּתָאיִם יְהֹוָה דַּלּוֹתִי וְלִי יְהוֹשִׁיעַ׃

verses.english: Return, my soul, to your rest, for YHWH has dealt bountifully with you.
verses.hebrew: שׁוּבִי נַפְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָיְכִי כִּי־יְהוָה גָּמַל עָלָיְכִי׃

verses.english: For You have freed my life from death, my eye from tears, my foot from stumbling.
verses.hebrew: כִּי חִלַּצְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִמָּוֶת אֶת־עֵינִי מִן־דִּמְעָה אֶת־רַגְלִי מִדֶּחִי׃

verses.english: I will walk before YHWH in the lands of the living.
verses.hebrew: אֶתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה בְּאַרְצוֹת הַחַיִּים׃

verses.english: I believed, even when I spoke: “I am greatly afflicted.”
verses.hebrew: הֶאֱמַנְתִּי כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אֲנִי עָנִיתִי מְאֹד׃

verses.english: I said in my haste, “Every human being is false.”
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְחָפְזִי כָּל־הָאָדָם כֹּזֵב׃

verses.english: What shall I return to YHWH for all His benefits toward me?
verses.hebrew: מָה־אָשִׁיב לַיהוָה כָּל־תַּגְמוּלוֹהִי עָלָי׃

verses.english: I will lift the cup of salvations and call on the name of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כּוֹס־יְשׁוּעוֹת אֶשָּׂא וּבְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֶקְרָא׃

verses.english: Costly in the eyes of YHWH is the death of His faithful ones.
verses.hebrew: יָקָר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה הַמָּוְתָה לַחֲסִידָיו׃

verses.english: Please, YHWH, for I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant. You have loosened my bonds.
verses.hebrew: אָנָּה יְהוָה כִּי־אֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ אֲ‍נִי־עַבְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶךָ פִּתַּחְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָי׃

verses.english: To You I will sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and I will call on the name of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לְךָ־אֶזְבַּח זֶבַח תּוֹדָה וּבְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֶקְרָא׃

verses.english: I will fulfill my vows to YHWH, now in the presence of all His people,
verses.hebrew: נְדָרַי לַיהוָה אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגְדָה־נָּא לְכָל־עַמּוֹ׃

verses.english: in the courts of YHWH’s house, in your midst, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
verses.hebrew: בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהוָה בְּתוֹכֵכִי יְרוּשָׁלִָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃

verses.english: Praise YHWH, all nations; laud Him, all peoples!
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְהוָה כָּל־גּוֹיִם שַׁבְּחוּהוּ כָּל־הָאֻמִּים׃

verses.english: For His steadfast love has prevailed over us, and YHWH’s faithfulness is forever. Praise Yah!
verses.hebrew: כִּי גָבַר עָלֵינוּ חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמֶת־יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃

verses.english: Give thanks to YHWH, for He is good, for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: Let Israel now say, “For His steadfast love is forever.”
verses.hebrew: יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: Let the house of Aaron now say, “For His steadfast love is forever.”
verses.hebrew: יֹאמְרוּ־נָא בֵית־אַהֲרֹן כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: Let those who fear YHWH now say, “For His steadfast love is forever.”
verses.hebrew: יֹאמְרוּ־נָא יִרְאֵי יְהוָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: From the narrow place I called to Yah; Yah answered me in a broad place.
verses.hebrew: מִן־הַמֵּצַר קָרָאתִי יָּהּ עָנָנִי בַמֶּרְחָב יָהּ׃

verses.english: YHWH is for me; I will not fear. What can a human being do to me?
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה לִי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה לִי אָדָם׃

verses.english: YHWH is for me among my helpers, and I will look upon those who hate me.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה לִי בְּעֹזְרָי וַאֲנִי אֶרְאֶה בְשֹׂנְאָי׃

verses.english: Better to take refuge in YHWH than to trust in a human being.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב לַחֲסוֹת בַּיהוָה מִבְּטֹחַ בָּאָדָם׃

verses.english: Better to take refuge in YHWH than to trust in nobles.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב לַחֲסוֹת בַּיהוָה מִבְּטֹחַ בִּנְדִיבִים׃

verses.english: All nations surrounded me; in the name of YHWH I will surely cut them off.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־גּוֹיִם סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַם׃

verses.english: They surrounded me, yes, surrounded me; in the name of YHWH I will surely cut them off.
verses.hebrew: סַבּוּנִי גַם־סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַם׃

verses.english: They surrounded me like bees; they were quenched like a fire of thorns; in the name of YHWH I will surely cut them off.
verses.hebrew: סַבּוּנִי כִדְבוֹרִים דֹּעֲכוּ כְּאֵשׁ קוֹצִים בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַם׃

verses.english: You pushed me hard to make me fall, but YHWH helped me.
verses.hebrew: דַּחֹה דְחִיתַנִי לִנְפֹּל וַיהוָה עֲזָרָנִי׃

verses.english: Yah is my strength and song; He has become my salvation.
verses.hebrew: עָזִּי וְזִמְרָת יָהּ וַיְהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה׃

verses.english: A voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: “YHWH’s right hand does mighty deeds!
verses.hebrew: קוֹל רִנָּה וִישׁוּעָה בְּאָהֳלֵי צַדִּיקִים יְמִין יְהוָה עֹשָׂה חָיִל׃

verses.english: YHWH’s right hand is exalted; YHWH’s right hand does mighty deeds!”
verses.hebrew: יְמִין יְהוָה רוֹמֵמָה יְמִין יְהוָה עֹשָׂה חָיִל׃

verses.english: I will not die, but live, and recount the deeds of Yah.
verses.hebrew: לֹא אָמוּת כִּי־אֶחְיֶה וַאֲסַפֵּר מַעֲשֵׂי יָהּ׃

verses.english: Yah disciplined me severely, but did not give me over to death.
verses.hebrew: יַסֹּר יִסְּרַנִּי יָּהּ וְלַמָּוֶת לֹא נְתָנָנִי׃

verses.english: Open for me the gates of righteousness; I will enter through them and give thanks to Yah.
verses.hebrew: פִּתְחוּ־לִי שַׁעֲרֵי־צֶדֶק אָבֹא־בָם אוֹדֶה יָהּ׃

verses.english: This is the gate of YHWH; the righteous will enter through it.
verses.hebrew: זֶה־הַשַּׁעַר לַיהוָה צַדִּיקִים יָבֹאוּ בוֹ׃

verses.english: I will thank You, for You answered me and became my salvation.
verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ כִּי עֲנִיתָנִי וַתְּהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה׃

verses.english: The stone the builders rejected has become the head of the corner.
verses.hebrew: אֶבֶן מָאֲסוּ הַבּוֹנִים הָיְתָה לְרֹאשׁ פִּנָּה׃

verses.english: This has come from YHWH; it is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.hebrew: מֵאֵת יְהוָה הָיְתָה זֹּאת הִיא נִפְלָאת בְּעֵינֵינוּ׃

verses.english: This is the day YHWH has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.hebrew: זֶה־הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה יְהוָה נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בוֹ׃

verses.english: Please, YHWH, save now! Please, YHWH, grant success now!
verses.hebrew: אָנָּא יְהוָה הוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא אָנָּא יְהוָה הַצְלִיחָה נָּא׃

verses.english: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of YHWH. We bless you from the house of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ הַבָּא בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה בֵּרַכְנוּכֶם מִבֵּית יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH is God, and He has given us light. Bind the festival sacrifice with cords, up to the horns of the altar.
verses.hebrew: אֵל יְהוָה וַיָּאֶר לָנוּ אִסְרוּ־חַג בַּעֲבֹתִים עַד־קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

verses.english: You are my God, and I will thank You; my God, I will exalt You.
verses.hebrew: אֵלִי אַתָּה וְאוֹדֶךָּ אֱלֹהַי אֲרוֹמְמֶךָּ׃

verses.english: Give thanks to YHWH, for He is good, for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in YHWH’s instruction.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי תְמִימֵי־דָרֶךְ הַהֹלְכִים בְּתוֹרַת יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Blessed are those who guard His testimonies, who seek Him with their whole heart.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵי עֵדֹתָיו בְּכָל־לֵב יִדְרְשׁוּהוּ׃

verses.english: They also do no wrong; they walk in His ways.
verses.hebrew: אַף לֹא־פָעֲלוּ עַוְלָה בִּדְרָכָיו הָלָכוּ׃

verses.english: You commanded Your precepts to be kept diligently.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה צִוִּיתָה פִקֻּדֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר מְאֹד׃

verses.english: If only my ways were established to keep Your statutes!
verses.hebrew: אַחֲלַי יִכֹּנוּ דְרָכָי לִשְׁמֹר חֻקֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: Then I will not be ashamed, when I look upon all Your commandments.
verses.hebrew: אָז לֹא־אֵבוֹשׁ בְּהַבִּיטִי אֶל־כָּל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: I will thank You with uprightness of heart, when I learn Your righteous judgments.
verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ בְּיֹשֶׁר לֵבָב בְּלָמְדִי מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃

verses.english: I will keep Your statutes; do not forsake me utterly.
verses.hebrew: אֶת־חֻקֶּיךָ אֶשְׁמֹר אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי עַד־מְאֹד׃

verses.english: By what can a young man cleanse his path? By keeping it according to Your word.
verses.hebrew: בַּמֶּה יְזַכֶּה־נַּעַר אֶת־אָרְחוֹ לִשְׁמֹר כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃

verses.english: With my whole heart I sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־לִבִּי דְרַשְׁתִּיךָ אַל־תַּשְׁגֵּנִי מִמִּצְוֺתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: In my heart I stored up Your saying, so that I might not sin against You.
verses.hebrew: בְּלִבִּי צָפַנְתִּי אִמְרָתֶךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֶחֱטָא־לָךְ׃

verses.english: Blessed are You, YHWH; teach me Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהוָה לַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: With my lips I recounted all the judgments of Your mouth.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׂפָתַי סִפַּרְתִּי כֹּל מִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִיךָ׃

verses.english: I rejoiced in the way of Your testimonies as over all wealth.
verses.hebrew: בְּדֶרֶךְ עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ שַׂשְׂתִּי כְּעַל כָּל־הוֹן׃

verses.english: I will meditate on Your precepts and look upon Your paths.
verses.hebrew: בְּפִקֻּדֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה וְאַבִּיטָה אֹרְחֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
verses.hebrew: בְּחֻקֹּתֶיךָ אֶשְׁתַּעֲשָׁע לֹא אֶשְׁכַּח דְּבָרֶךָ׃

verses.english: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
verses.hebrew: גְּמֹל עַל־עַבְדְּךָ אֶחְיֶה וְאֶשְׁמְרָה דְבָרֶךָ׃

verses.english: Uncover my eyes, that I may see wondrous things from Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: גַּל־עֵינַי וְאַבִּיטָה נִפְלָאוֹת מִתּוֹרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: I am a sojourner on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.
verses.hebrew: גֵּר אָנֹכִי בָאָרֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּר מִמֶּנִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: My soul is crushed with longing for Your judgments at every time.
verses.hebrew: גָּרְסָה נַפְשִׁי לְתַאֲבָה אֶל־מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ בְכָל־עֵת׃

verses.english: You rebuked the arrogant, the accursed, who stray from Your commandments.
verses.hebrew: גָּעַרְתָּ זֵדִים אֲרוּרִים הַשֹּׁגִים מִמִּצְוֺתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Roll reproach and contempt away from me, for I have guarded Your testimonies.
verses.hebrew: גַּל מֵעָלַי חֶרְפָּה וָבוּז כִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי׃

verses.english: Even though rulers sat and spoke against me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: גַּם יָשְׁבוּ שָׂרִים בִּי נִדְבָּרוּ עַבְדְּךָ יָשִׂיחַ בְּחֻקֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: Your testimonies are also my delights, my counselors.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־עֵדֹתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי אַנְשֵׁי עֲצָתִי׃

verses.english: My soul clings to the dust; give me life according to Your word.
verses.hebrew: דָּבְקָה לֶעָפָר נַפְשִׁי חַיֵּנִי כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃

verses.english: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: דְּרָכַי סִפַּרְתִּי וַתַּעֲנֵנִי לַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: Make me understand the way of Your precepts, and I will meditate on Your wonders.
verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ־פִּקּוּדֶיךָ הֲבִינֵנִי וְאָשִׂיחָה בְּנִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: My soul drips away from grief; establish me according to Your word.
verses.hebrew: דָּלְפָה נַפְשִׁי מִתּוּגָה קַיְּמֵנִי כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃

verses.english: Remove the way of falsehood from me, and graciously grant me Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ־שֶׁקֶר הָסֵר מִמֶּנִּי וְתוֹרָתְךָ חָנֵּנִי׃

verses.english: I chose the way of faithfulness; I set Your judgments before me.
verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ־אֱמוּנָה בָחָרְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ שִׁוִּיתִי׃

verses.english: I cling to Your testimonies; YHWH, do not put me to shame.
verses.hebrew: דָּבַקְתִּי בְעֵדְוֺתֶיךָ יְהוָה אַל־תְּבִישֵׁנִי׃

verses.english: I will run in the way of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.
verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אָרוּץ כִּי תַרְחִיב לִבִּי׃

verses.english: Teach me, YHWH, the way of Your statutes, and I will guard it to the end.
verses.hebrew: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ חֻקֶּיךָ וְאֶצְּרֶנָּה עֵקֶב׃

verses.english: Give me understanding, that I may guard Your instruction and keep it with my whole heart.
verses.hebrew: הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶצְּרָה תוֹרָתֶךָ וְאֶשְׁמְרֶנָּה בְכָל־לֵב׃

verses.english: Lead me in the track of Your commandments, for in it I delight.
verses.hebrew: הַדְרִיכֵנִי בִּנְתִיב מִצְוֺתֶיךָ כִּי־בוֹ חָפָצְתִּי׃

verses.english: Incline my heart to Your testimonies, and not to dishonest gain.
verses.hebrew: הַט־לִבִּי אֶל־עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ וְאַל אֶל־בָּצַע׃

verses.english: Turn my eyes away from seeing worthlessness; give me life in Your ways.
verses.hebrew: הַעֲבֵר עֵינַי מֵרְאוֹת שָׁוְא בִּדְרָכֶךָ חַיֵּנִי׃

verses.english: Establish for Your servant Your saying, which is for the fear of You.
verses.hebrew: הָקֵם לְעַבְדְּךָ אִמְרָתֶךָ אֲשֶׁר לְיִרְאָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Turn away my reproach, which I dread, for Your judgments are good.
verses.hebrew: הַעֲבֵר חֶרְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתִּי כִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ טוֹבִים׃

verses.english: Look, I long for Your precepts; give me life in Your righteousness.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה תָּאַבְתִּי לְפִקֻּדֶיךָ בְּצִדְקָתְךָ חַיֵּנִי׃

verses.english: May Your acts of loyal love come to me, YHWH, Your salvation according to Your saying.
verses.hebrew: וִיבֹאֻנִי חֲסָדֶךָ יְהוָה תְּשׁוּעָתְךָ כְּאִמְרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Then I will answer my reproacher with a word, for I trust in Your word.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶעֱנֶה חֹרְפִי דָבָר כִּי־בָטַחְתִּי בִּדְבָרֶךָ׃

verses.english: Do not utterly snatch the word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.
verses.hebrew: וְאַל־תַּצֵּל מִפִּי דְבַר־אֱמֶת עַד־מְאֹד כִּי לְמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃

verses.english: I will keep Your instruction continually, forever and ever.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶשְׁמְרָה תוֹרָתְךָ תָמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃

verses.english: I will walk in a broad place, for I have sought Your precepts.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶתְהַלְּכָה בָרְחָבָה כִּי פִקֻּדֶיךָ דָרָשְׁתִּי׃

verses.english: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings and will not be ashamed.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲדַבְּרָה בְעֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶגֶד מְלָכִים וְלֹא אֵבוֹשׁ׃

verses.english: I will delight in Your commandments, which I love.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶשְׁתַּעֲשַׁע בְּמִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָבְתִּי׃

verses.english: I will lift up my palms to Your commandments, which I love, and meditate on Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶשָּׂא־כַפַּי אֶל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָבְתִּי וְאָשִׂיחָה בְחֻקֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: Remember the word to Your servant, upon which You made me hope.
verses.hebrew: זְכֹר־דָּבָר לְעַבְדֶּךָ עַל אֲשֶׁר יִחַלְתָּנִי׃

verses.english: This is my comfort in my affliction, that Your saying has given me life.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת נֶחָמָתִי בְעָנְיִי כִּי אִמְרָתְךָ חִיָּתְנִי׃

verses.english: The arrogant mocked me utterly; I did not turn away from Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: זֵדִים הֱלִיצֻנִי עַד־מְאֹד מִתּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי׃

verses.english: I remembered Your judgments from of old, YHWH, and I was comforted.
verses.hebrew: זָכַרְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ מֵעוֹלָם יְהוָה וָאֶתְנֶחָם׃

verses.english: Burning indignation seized me because of the wicked, those who forsake Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: זַלְעָפָה אֲחָזַתְנִי מֵרְשָׁעִים עֹזְבֵי תּוֹרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Your statutes became songs for me in the house of my sojourning.
verses.hebrew: זְמִרוֹת הָיוּ־לִי חֻקֶּיךָ בְּבֵית מְגוּרָי׃

verses.english: I remembered Your name in the night, YHWH, and kept Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: זָכַרְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה וָאֶשְׁמְרָה תּוֹרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: This has become mine, because I guarded Your precepts.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת הָיְתָה־לִּי כִּי פִקֻּדֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי׃

verses.english: YHWH is my portion; I said I would keep Your words.
verses.hebrew: חֶלְקִי יְהוָה אָמַרְתִּי לִשְׁמֹר דְּבָרֶיךָ׃

verses.english: I entreated Your face with my whole heart; be gracious to me according to Your saying.
verses.hebrew: חִלִּיתִי פָנֶיךָ בְכָל־לֵב חָנֵּנִי כְּאִמְרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: I considered my ways and turned my feet toward Your testimonies.
verses.hebrew: חִשַּׁבְתִּי דְרָכָי וָאָשִׁיבָה רַגְלַי אֶל־עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: I hurried and did not delay to keep Your commandments.
verses.hebrew: חַשְׁתִּי וְלֹא הִתְמַהְמָהְתִּי לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: The cords of the wicked entangled me; I did not forget Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: חֶבְלֵי רְשָׁעִים עִוְּדֻנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃

verses.english: At midnight I rise to thank You for Your righteous judgments.
verses.hebrew: חֲצוֹת־לַיְלָה אָקוּם לְהוֹדוֹת לָךְ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃

verses.english: I am a companion to all who fear You and to those who keep Your precepts.
verses.hebrew: חָבֵר אָנִי לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר יְרֵאוּךָ וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃

verses.english: The earth is filled with Your loyal love, YHWH; teach me Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ חֻקֶּיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃

verses.english: You have done good to Your servant, YHWH, according to Your word.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב עָשִׂיתָ עִם־עַבְדְּךָ יְהוָה כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃

verses.english: Teach me good discernment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.
verses.hebrew: טוּב טַעַם וָדַעַת לַמְּדֵנִי כִּי בְמִצְוֺתֶיךָ הֶאֱמָנְתִּי׃

verses.english: Before I was afflicted, I was straying; but now I keep Your saying.
verses.hebrew: טֶרֶם אֶעֱנֶה אֲנִי שֹׁגֵג וְעַתָּה אִמְרָתְךָ שָׁמָרְתִּי׃

verses.english: You are good and do good; teach me Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב־אַתָּה וּמֵטִיב לַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: The arrogant smeared a lie upon me; I will guard Your precepts with my whole heart.
verses.hebrew: טָפְלוּ עָלַי שֶׁקֶר זֵדִים אֲנִי בְּכָל־לֵב אֱצֹּר פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Their heart is unfeeling like fat; I delight in Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: טָפַשׁ כַּחֵלֶב לִבָּם אֲנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ שִׁעֲשָׁעְתִּי׃

verses.english: It is good for me that I was afflicted, so that I might learn Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב־לִי כִי־עֻנֵּיתִי לְמַעַן אֶלְמַד חֻקֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: The instruction of Your mouth is better for me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב־לִי תוֹרַת־פִּיךָ מֵאַלְפֵי זָהָב וָכָסֶף׃

verses.english: Your hands made me and established me; give me understanding, that I may learn Your commandments.
verses.hebrew: יָדֶיךָ עָשׂוּנִי וַיְכוֹנְנוּנִי הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶלְמְדָה מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Those who fear You will see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.
verses.hebrew: יְרֵאֶיךָ יִרְאוּנִי וְיִשְׂמָחוּ כִּי לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃

verses.english: I know, YHWH, that Your judgments are righteous, and in faithfulness You afflicted me.
verses.hebrew: יָדַעְתִּי יְהוָה כִּי־צֶדֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ וֶאֱמוּנָה עִנִּיתָנִי׃

verses.english: Please let Your loyal love comfort me, according to Your saying to Your servant.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי־נָא חַסְדְּךָ לְנַחֲמֵנִי כְּאִמְרָתְךָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ׃

verses.english: May Your mercies come to me, that I may live, for Your instruction is my delight.
verses.hebrew: יְבֹאוּנִי רַחֲמֶיךָ וְאֶחְיֶה כִּי־תוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי׃

verses.english: May the arrogant be ashamed, for they wronged me with falsehood; I will meditate on Your precepts.
verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ זֵדִים כִּי־שֶׁקֶר עִוְּתוּנִי אֲנִי אָשִׂיחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶיךָ׃

verses.english: May those who fear You turn to me, and those who know Your testimonies.
verses.hebrew: יָשׁוּבוּ לִי יְרֵאֶיךָ וידעו [וְיֹדְעֵי] עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, so that I may not be ashamed.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי־לִבִּי תָמִים בְּחֻקֶּיךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֵבוֹשׁ׃

verses.english: My soul fails with longing for Your salvation; I hope in Your word.
verses.hebrew: כָּלְתָה לִתְשׁוּעָתְךָ נַפְשִׁי לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃

verses.english: My eyes fail with longing for Your saying, saying, “When will You comfort me?”
verses.hebrew: כָּלוּ עֵינַי לְאִמְרָתֶךָ לֵאמֹר מָתַי תְּנַחֲמֵנִי׃

verses.english: For I have become like a wineskin in smoke; I have not forgotten Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הָיִיתִי כְּנֹאד בְּקִיטוֹר חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃

verses.english: How many are Your servant’s days? When will You execute judgment upon my pursuers?
verses.hebrew: כַּמָּה יְמֵי־עַבְדֶּךָ מָתַי תַּעֲשֶׂה בְרֹדְפַי מִשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: The arrogant dug pits for me, those who do not act according to Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: כָּרוּ־לִי זֵדִים שִׁיחוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא כְתוֹרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: All Your commandments are faithfulness; they pursue me with falsehood—help me!
verses.hebrew: כָּל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֱמוּנָה שֶׁקֶר רְדָפוּנִי עָזְרֵנִי׃

verses.english: They nearly finished me off on the earth; but I did not forsake Your precepts.
verses.hebrew: כִּמְעַט כִּלּוּנִי בָאָרֶץ וַאֲנִי לֹא־עָזַבְתִּי פִקֻּודֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Give me life according to Your loyal love, and I will keep the testimony of Your mouth.
verses.hebrew: כְּחַסְדְּךָ חַיֵּנִי וְאֶשְׁמְרָה עֵדוּת פִּיךָ׃

verses.english: Forever, YHWH, Your word stands firm in the heavens.
verses.hebrew: לְעוֹלָם יְהוָה דְּבָרְךָ נִצָּב בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: Your faithfulness is for generation after generation; You established the earth, and it stands.
verses.hebrew: לְדֹר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתֶךָ כּוֹנַנְתָּ אֶרֶץ וַתַּעֲמֹד׃

verses.english: They stand today according to Your judgments, for all things are Your servants.
verses.hebrew: לְמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְדוּ הַיּוֹם כִּי הַכֹּל עֲבָדֶיךָ׃

verses.english: If Your instruction had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.hebrew: לוּלֵי תוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי אָז אָבַדְתִּי בְעָנְיִי׃

verses.english: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have given me life.
verses.hebrew: לְעוֹלָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּח פִּקּוּדֶיךָ כִּי בָם חִיִּיתָנִי׃

verses.english: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
verses.hebrew: לְךָ־אֲנִי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ דָרָשְׁתִּי׃

verses.english: The wicked waited for me, to destroy me; I will consider Your testimonies.
verses.hebrew: לִי קִוּוּ רְשָׁעִים לְאַבְּדֵנִי עֵדֹתֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן׃

verses.english: I have seen an end to every perfection; Your commandment is exceedingly broad.
verses.hebrew: לְכָל תִּכְלָה רָאִיתִי קֵץ רְחָבָה מִצְוָתְךָ מְאֹד׃

verses.english: How I love Your instruction! It is my meditation all the day.
verses.hebrew: מָה־אָהַבְתִּי תוֹרָתֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם הִיא שִׂיחָתִי׃

verses.english: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for this is mine forever.
verses.hebrew: מֵאֹיְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵנִי מִצְוֺתֶךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם הִיא־לִי׃

verses.english: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.hebrew: מִכָּל־מְלַמְּדַי הִשְׂכַּלְתִּי כִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ שִׂיחָה לִי׃

verses.english: I have more understanding than elders, for I have guarded Your precepts.
verses.hebrew: מִזְּקֵנִים אֶתְבּוֹנָן כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי׃

verses.english: I restrained my feet from every evil path, so that I might keep Your word.
verses.hebrew: מִכָּל־אֹרַח רָע כָּלִאתִי רַגְלָי לְמַעַן אֶשְׁמֹר דְּבָרֶךָ׃

verses.english: I have not turned aside from Your judgments, for You Yourself instructed me.
verses.hebrew: מִמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לֹא־סָרְתִּי כִּי־אַתָּה הוֹרֵתָנִי׃

verses.english: How sweet Your saying is to my palate, more than honey to my mouth!
verses.hebrew: מַה־נִּמְלְצוּ לְחִכִּי אִמְרָתֶךָ מִדְּבַשׁ לְפִי׃

verses.english: From Your precepts I gain understanding; therefore I hate every path of falsehood.
verses.hebrew: מִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן עַל־כֵּן שָׂנֵאתִי כָּל־אֹרַח שָׁקֶר׃

verses.english: Your word is a lamp for my foot and a light for my path.
verses.hebrew: נֵר־לְרַגְלִי דְבָרֶךָ וְאוֹר לִנְתִיבָתִי׃

verses.english: I swore and confirmed it, to keep Your righteous judgments.
verses.hebrew: נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי וָאֲקַיֵּמָה לִשְׁמֹר מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃

verses.english: I am utterly afflicted; YHWH, give me life according to Your word.
verses.hebrew: נַעֲנֵיתִי עַד־מְאֹד יְהוָה חַיֵּנִי כִדְבָרֶךָ׃

verses.english: Please accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, YHWH, and teach me Your judgments.
verses.hebrew: נִדְבוֹת פִּי רְצֵה־נָא יְהוָה וּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃

verses.english: My soul is continually in my palm, yet I have not forgotten Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: נַפְשִׁי בְכַפִּי תָמִיד וְתוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃

verses.english: The wicked laid a trap for me, yet I have not strayed from Your precepts.
verses.hebrew: נָתְנוּ רְשָׁעִים פַּח לִי וּמִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ לֹא תָעִיתִי׃

verses.english: I have inherited Your testimonies forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
verses.hebrew: נָחַלְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי־שְׂשׂוֹן לִבִּי הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: I inclined my heart to perform Your statutes forever, to the end.
verses.hebrew: נָטִיתִי לִבִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת חֻקֶּיךָ לְעוֹלָם עֵקֶב׃

verses.english: I hate the divided in heart, but I love Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: סֵעֲפִים שָׂנֵאתִי וְתוֹרָתְךָ אָהָבְתִּי׃

verses.english: You are my hiding place and my shield; I hope in Your word.
verses.hebrew: סִתְרִי וּמָגִנִּי אָתָּה לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃

verses.english: Depart from me, evildoers, that I may guard my God’s commandments.
verses.hebrew: סוּרוּ־מִמֶּנִּי מְרֵעִים וְאֶצְּרָה מִצְוֺת אֱלֹהָי׃

verses.english: Uphold me according to Your saying, that I may live; do not put me to shame in my hope.
verses.hebrew: סָמְכֵנִי כְאִמְרָתְךָ וְאֶחְיֶה וְאַל־תְּבִישֵׁנִי מִשִּׂבְרִי׃

verses.english: Support me, that I may be saved, and I will continually look to Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: סְעָדֵנִי וְאִוָּשֵׁעָה וְאֶשְׁעָה בְחֻקֶּיךָ תָמִיד׃

verses.english: You spurn all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceit is falsehood.
verses.hebrew: סָלִיתָ כָּל־שׁוֹגִים מֵחֻקֶּיךָ כִּי־שֶׁקֶר תַּרְמִיתָם׃

verses.english: You remove all the wicked of the earth like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
verses.hebrew: סִגִים הִשְׁבַּתָּ כָל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ לָכֵן אָהַבְתִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: My flesh bristles from dread of You, and I fear Your judgments.
verses.hebrew: סָמַר מִפַּחְדְּךָ בְשָׂרִי וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יָרֵאתִי׃

verses.english: I have done justice and righteousness; do not leave me to my oppressors.
verses.hebrew: עָשִׂיתִי מִשְׁפָּט וָצֶדֶק בַּל־תַּנִּיחֵנִי לְעֹשְׁקָי׃

verses.english: Be guarantor for Your servant for good; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
verses.hebrew: עֲרֹב עַבְדְּךָ לְטוֹב אַל־יַעַשְׁקֻנִי זֵדִים׃

verses.english: My eyes fail with longing for Your salvation and for Your righteous saying.
verses.hebrew: עֵינַי כָּלוּ לִישׁוּעָתֶךָ וּלְאִמְרַת צִדְקֶךָ׃

verses.english: Deal with Your servant according to Your loyal love, and teach me Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: עֲשֵׂה עִם־עַבְדְּךָ כְחַסְדֶּךָ וְחֻקֶּיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃

verses.english: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
verses.hebrew: עַבְדְּךָ־אָנִי הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֵדְעָה עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: It is time for YHWH to act; they have broken Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: עֵת לַעֲשׂוֹת לַיהוָה הֵפֵרוּ תּוֹרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, more than fine gold.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן אָהַבְתִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ מִזָּהָב וּמִפָּז׃

verses.english: Therefore I hold all precepts concerning everything to be right; I hate every path of falsehood.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן כָּל־פִּקּוּדֵי כֹל יִשָּׁרְתִּי כָּל־אֹרַח שֶׁקֶר שָׂנֵאתִי׃

verses.english: Your testimonies are wonders; therefore my soul guards them.
verses.hebrew: פְּלָאוֹת עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ עַל־כֵּן נְצָרָתַם נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: The opening of Your words gives light, giving understanding to the simple.
verses.hebrew: פֵּתַח דְּבָרֶיךָ יָאִיר מֵבִין פְּתָיִים׃

verses.english: I opened my mouth and panted, for I longed for Your commandments.
verses.hebrew: פִּי־פָעַרְתִּי וָאֶשְׁאָפָה כִּי לְמִצְוֺתֶיךָ יָאָבְתִּי׃

verses.english: Turn to me and be gracious to me, as is fitting for those who love Your name.
verses.hebrew: פְּנֵה־אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי כְּמִשְׁפָּט לְאֹהֲבֵי שְׁמֶךָ׃

verses.english: Establish my steps in Your saying, and do not let any iniquity rule over me.
verses.hebrew: פְּעָמַי הָכֵן בְּאִמְרָתֶךָ וְאַל־תַּשְׁלֶט־בִּי כָל־אָוֶן׃

verses.english: Redeem me from human oppression, and I will keep Your precepts.
verses.hebrew: פְּדֵנִי מֵעֹשֶׁק אָדָם וְאֶשְׁמְרָה פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: פָּנֶיךָ הָאֵר בְּעַבְדֶּךָ וְלַמְּדֵנִי אֶת־חֻקֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: My eyes ran down streams of water, because they did not keep Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: פַּלְגֵי־מַיִם יָרְדוּ עֵינָי עַל לֹא־שָׁמְרוּ תוֹרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: You are righteous, YHWH, and Your judgments are upright.
verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק אַתָּה יְהוָה וְיָשָׁר מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ׃

verses.english: You commanded Your testimonies in righteousness and exceeding faithfulness.
verses.hebrew: צִוִּיתָ צֶדֶק עֵדֹתֶיךָ וֶאֱמוּנָה מְאֹד׃

verses.english: My zeal consumed me, for my adversaries forgot Your words.
verses.hebrew: צִמְּתַתְנִי קִנְאָתִי כִּי־שָׁכְחוּ דְבָרֶיךָ צָרָי׃

verses.english: Your saying is thoroughly refined, and Your servant loves it.
verses.hebrew: צְרוּפָה אִמְרָתְךָ מְאֹד וְעַבְדְּךָ אֲהֵבָהּ׃

verses.english: I am small and despised, yet I have not forgotten Your precepts.
verses.hebrew: צָעִיר אָנֹכִי וְנִבְזֶה פִּקֻּדֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃

verses.english: Your righteousness is righteousness forever, and Your instruction is truth.
verses.hebrew: צִדְקָתְךָ צֶדֶק לְעוֹלָם וְתוֹרָתְךָ אֱמֶת׃

verses.english: Distress and anguish found me; Your commandments are my delights.
verses.hebrew: צַר־וּמָצוֹק מְצָאוּנִי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי׃

verses.english: Your testimonies are righteous forever; give me understanding, that I may live.
verses.hebrew: צֶדֶק עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶחְיֶה׃

verses.english: I called with my whole heart; answer me, YHWH; I will guard Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: קָרָאתִי בְכָל־לֵב עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה חֻקֶּיךָ אֶצֹּרָה׃

verses.english: I called to You; save me, and I will keep Your testimonies.
verses.hebrew: קְרָאתִיךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי וְאֶשְׁמְרָה עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: I rose early in the twilight and cried for help; I hoped in Your word.
verses.hebrew: קִדַּמְתִּי בַנֶּשֶׁף וָאֲשַׁוֵּעָה לדבריך [לִדְבָרְךָ] יִחָלְתִּי׃

verses.english: My eyes are awake before the watches, to meditate on Your saying.
verses.hebrew: קִדְּמוּ עֵינַי אַשְׁמֻרוֹת לָשִׂיחַ בְּאִמְרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Hear my voice according to Your loyal love; YHWH, give me life according to Your judgments.
verses.hebrew: קוֹלִי שִׁמְעָה כְחַסְדֶּךָ יְהוָה כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ חַיֵּנִי׃

verses.english: Those pursuing wicked schemes draw near; they are far from Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: קָרְבוּ רֹדְפֵי זִמָּה מִתּוֹרָתְךָ רָחָקוּ׃

verses.english: You are near, YHWH, and all Your commandments are truth.
verses.hebrew: קָרוֹב אַתָּה יְהוָה וְכָל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֱמֶת׃

verses.english: Long ago I knew from Your testimonies that You founded them forever.
verses.hebrew: קֶדֶם יָדַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם יְסַדְתָּם׃

verses.english: See my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה־עָנְיִי וְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי־תוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃

verses.english: Plead my case and redeem me; give me life according to Your saying.
verses.hebrew: רִיבָה רִיבִי וּגְאָלֵנִי לְאִמְרָתְךָ חַיֵּנִי׃

verses.english: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they have not sought Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: רָחוֹק מֵרְשָׁעִים יְשׁוּעָה כִּי־חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא דָרָשׁוּ׃

verses.english: Your mercies are many, YHWH; give me life according to Your judgments.
verses.hebrew: רַחֲמֶיךָ רַבִּים יְהוָה כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ חַיֵּנִי׃

verses.english: My pursuers and adversaries are many; I have not turned away from Your testimonies.
verses.hebrew: רַבִּים רֹדְפַי וְצָרָי מֵעֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי׃

verses.english: I saw the treacherous and felt loathing, because they did not keep Your saying.
verses.hebrew: רָאִיתִי בֹגְדִים וָאֶתְקוֹטָטָה אֲשֶׁר אִמְרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁמָרוּ׃

verses.english: See that I love Your precepts; YHWH, give me life according to Your loyal love.
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה כִּי־פִקּוּדֶיךָ אָהָבְתִּי יְהוָה כְּחַסְדְּךָ חַיֵּנִי׃

verses.english: The sum of Your word is truth, and every righteous judgment of Yours is forever.
verses.hebrew: רֹאשׁ־דְּבָרְךָ אֱמֶת וּלְעוֹלָם כָּל־מִשְׁפַּט צִדְקֶךָ׃

verses.english: Rulers pursued me without cause, but my heart trembled at Your word.
verses.hebrew: שָׂרִים רְדָפוּנִי חִנָּם ומדבריך [וּמִדְּבָרְךָ] פָּחַד לִבִּי׃

verses.english: I rejoice over Your saying like one who finds much spoil.
verses.hebrew: שָׂשׂ אָנֹכִי עַל־אִמְרָתֶךָ כְּמוֹצֵא שָׁלָל רָב׃

verses.english: I hate and abhor falsehood; I love Your instruction.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁקֶר שָׂנֵאתִי וַאֲתַעֵבָה תּוֹרָתְךָ אָהָבְתִּי׃

verses.english: Seven times in the day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁבַע בַּיּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּיךָ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃

verses.english: Great peace belongs to those who love Your instruction, and there is no stumbling block for them.
verses.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם רָב לְאֹהֲבֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ וְאֵין־לָמוֹ מִכְשׁוֹל׃

verses.english: I hope for Your salvation, YHWH, and I perform Your commandments.
verses.hebrew: שִׂבַּרְתִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ יְהוָה וּמִצְוֺתֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי׃

verses.english: My soul keeps Your testimonies, and I love them exceedingly.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי עֵדֹתֶיךָ וָאֹהֲבֵם מְאֹד׃

verses.english: I keep Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמַרְתִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי כָל־דְּרָכַי נֶגְדֶּךָ׃

verses.english: May my cry draw near before You, YHWH; give me understanding according to Your word.
verses.hebrew: תִּקְרַב רִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּדְבָרְךָ הֲבִינֵנִי׃

verses.english: May my plea come before You; deliver me according to Your saying.
verses.hebrew: תָּבוֹא תְּחִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ כְּאִמְרָתְךָ הַצִּילֵנִי׃

verses.english: May my lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
verses.hebrew: תַּבַּעְנָה שְׂפָתַי תְּהִלָּה כִּי תְלַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: May my tongue answer with Your saying, for all Your commandments are righteousness.
verses.hebrew: תַּעַן לְשׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶךָ כִּי כָל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ צֶּדֶק׃

verses.english: May Your hand be there to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
verses.hebrew: תְּהִי־יָדְךָ לְעָזְרֵנִי כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ בָחָרְתִּי׃

verses.english: I long for Your salvation, YHWH, and Your instruction is my delight.
verses.hebrew: תָּאַבְתִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ יְהוָה וְתוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי׃

verses.english: May my soul live and praise You, and may Your judgments help me.
verses.hebrew: תְּחִי־נַפְשִׁי וּתְהַלְלֶךָּ וּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ יַעֲזְרֻנִי׃

verses.english: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.
verses.hebrew: תָּעִיתִי כְּשֶׂה אֹבֵד בַּקֵּשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃

verses.english: A song of ascents. To YHWH, when I was in distress, I called, and He answered me.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצָּרָתָה לִּי קָרָאתִי וַיַּעֲנֵנִי׃

verses.english: YHWH, rescue my life from a lying lip, from a deceitful tongue.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה הַצִּילָה נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׂפַת־שֶׁקֶר מִלָּשׁוֹן רְמִיָּה׃

verses.english: What will He give you, and what will He add to you, deceitful tongue?
verses.hebrew: מַה־יִּתֵּן לְךָ וּמַה־יֹּסִיף לָךְ לָשׁוֹן רְמִיָּה׃

verses.english: A warrior’s sharpened arrows, with coals of broom wood.
verses.hebrew: חִצֵּי גִבּוֹר שְׁנוּנִים עִם גַּחֲלֵי רְתָמִים׃

verses.english: Woe to me, for I have sojourned in Meshech; I have dwelt among the tents of Kedar.
verses.hebrew: אוֹיָה־לִי כִּי־גַרְתִּי מֶשֶׁךְ שָׁכַנְתִּי עִם־אָהֳלֵי קֵדָר׃

verses.english: Too long my soul has dwelt with one who hates peace.
verses.hebrew: רַבַּת שָׁכְנָה־לָּהּ נַפְשִׁי עִם שׂוֹנֵא שָׁלוֹם׃

verses.english: I am peace; but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.hebrew: אֲ‍נִי־שָׁלוֹם וְכִי אֲדַבֵּר הֵמָּה לַמִּלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: A song for the ascents. I lift my eyes to the mountains. From where will my help come?
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר לַמַּעֲלוֹת אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִים מֵאַיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִי׃

verses.english: My help is from YHWH, Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.hebrew: עֶזְרִי מֵעִם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: May He not let your foot slip; may your Keeper not slumber.
verses.hebrew: אַל־יִתֵּן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֶךָ אַל־יָנוּם שֹׁמְרֶךָ׃

verses.english: Look, the Keeper of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה לֹא־יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: YHWH is your Keeper; YHWH is your shade at your right hand.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה שֹׁמְרֶךָ יְהוָה צִלְּךָ עַל־יַד יְמִינֶךָ׃

verses.english: By day the sun will not strike you, nor the moon by night.
