verses.hebrew: יוֹמָם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לֹא־יַכֶּכָּה וְיָרֵחַ בַּלָּיְלָה׃

verses.english: YHWH will keep you from all evil; He will keep your life.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יִשְׁמָרְךָ מִכָּל־רָע יִשְׁמֹר אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

verses.english: YHWH will keep your going out and your coming in, from now and forever.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יִשְׁמָר־צֵאתְךָ וּבוֹאֶךָ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: A song of the ascents. Of David. I rejoiced with those saying to me, “Let us go to YHWH’s house.”
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד שָׂמַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִים לִי בֵּית יְהוָה נֵלֵךְ׃

verses.english: Our feet were standing within your gates, Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: עֹמְדוֹת הָיוּ רַגְלֵינוּ בִּשְׁעָרַיִךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Jerusalem, built as a city joined together,
verses.hebrew: יְרוּשָׁלִַם הַבְּנוּיָה כְּעִיר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה־לָּהּ יַחְדָּו׃

verses.english: where the tribes went up, the tribes of Yah—a testimony for Israel— to give thanks to YHWH’s name.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁשָּׁם עָלוּ שְׁבָטִים שִׁבְטֵי־יָהּ עֵדוּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה׃

verses.english: For there thrones sat for judgment, thrones for David’s house.
verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁמָּה יָשְׁבוּ כִסְאוֹת לְמִשְׁפָּט כִּסְאוֹת לְבֵית דָּוִיד׃

verses.english: Ask for Jerusalem’s peace; may those who love you be at ease.
verses.hebrew: שַׁאֲלוּ שְׁלוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָם יִשְׁלָיוּ אֹהֲבָיִךְ׃

verses.english: May there be peace within your rampart, ease within your palaces.
verses.hebrew: יְהִי־שָׁלוֹם בְּחֵילֵךְ שַׁלְוָה בְּאַרְמְנוֹתָיִךְ׃

verses.english: For the sake of my brothers and companions, let me say, “Peace within you.”
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן אַחַי וְרֵעָי אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּא שָׁלוֹם בָּךְ׃

verses.english: For the sake of the house of YHWH our God, I will seek your good.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן בֵּית־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁה טוֹב לָךְ׃

verses.english: A song of the ascents. To You I lifted my eyes, You who are seated in heaven.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אֵלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי אֶת־עֵינַי הַיֹּשְׁבִי בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: Look, as slaves’ eyes turn to their masters’ hand, as a slave woman’s eyes turn to her mistress’s hand, so our eyes turn to YHWH our God, until He shows us favor.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה כְעֵינֵי עֲבָדִים אֶל־יַד אֲ‍דוֹנֵיהֶם כְּעֵינֵי שִׁפְחָה אֶל־יַד גְּבִרְתָּהּ כֵּן עֵינֵינוּ אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַד שֶׁיְּחָנֵּנוּ׃

verses.english: Show us favor, YHWH, show us favor, for we have had far more than enough contempt.
verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנוּ יְהוָה חָנֵּנוּ כִּי־רַב שָׂבַעְנוּ בוּז׃

verses.english: Our very selves have had far more than enough of the mockery of those at ease, of the contempt of the proud.
verses.hebrew: רַבַּת שָׂבְעָה־לָּהּ נַפְשֵׁנוּ הַלַּעַג הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּים הַבּוּז לִגְאֵיוֹנִים׃

verses.english: A song of the ascents. Of David. Had YHWH not been for us— let Israel now say—
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד לוּלֵי יְהוָה שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: had YHWH not been for us when humankind rose against us,
verses.hebrew: לוּלֵי יְהוָה שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ בְּקוּם עָלֵינוּ אָדָם׃

verses.english: then they would have swallowed us alive when their anger burned against us.
verses.hebrew: אֲזַי חַיִּים בְּלָעוּנוּ בַּחֲרוֹת אַפָּם בָּנוּ׃

verses.english: Then the waters would have swept us away; a torrent would have passed over our lives.
verses.hebrew: אֲזַי הַמַּיִם שְׁטָפוּנוּ נַחְלָה עָבַר עַל־נַפְשֵׁנוּ׃

verses.english: Then over our lives would have passed the raging waters.
verses.hebrew: אֲזַי עָבַר עַל־נַפְשֵׁנוּ הַמַּיִם הַזֵּידוֹנִים׃

verses.english: Blessed be YHWH, who did not give us as prey to their teeth.
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה שֶׁלֹּא נְתָנָנוּ טֶרֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶם׃

verses.english: Our life escaped like a bird from the snare of trappers; the snare broke, and we escaped.
verses.hebrew: נַפְשֵׁנוּ כְּצִפּוֹר נִמְלְטָה מִפַּח יוֹקְשִׁים הַפַּח נִשְׁבָּר וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִמְלָטְנוּ׃

verses.english: Our help is in YHWH’s name, Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.hebrew: עֶזְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: A song of the ascents. Those trusting in YHWH are like Mount Zion, which does not totter but abides forever.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת הַבֹּטְחִים בַּיהוָה כְּהַר־צִיּוֹן לֹא־יִמּוֹט לְעוֹלָם יֵשֵׁב׃

verses.english: Jerusalem—mountains are around her, and YHWH is around His people, from now and forever.
verses.hebrew: יְרוּשָׁלִַם הָרִים סָבִיב לָהּ וַיהוָה סָבִיב לְעַמּוֹ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: For the scepter of wickedness will not rest on the lot of the righteous, so that the righteous will not stretch out their hands to injustice.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יָנוּחַ שֵׁבֶט הָרֶשַׁע עַל גּוֹרַל הַצַּדִּיקִים לְמַעַן לֹא־יִשְׁלְחוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים בְּעַוְלָתָה יְדֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Do good, YHWH, to the good and to those upright in their hearts.
verses.hebrew: הֵיטִיבָה יְהוָה לַטּוֹבִים וְלִישָׁרִים בְּלִבּוֹתָם׃

verses.english: But those turning toward their crooked ways— YHWH will lead them away with workers of iniquity. Peace upon Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמַּטִּים עַקַלְקַלּוֹתָם יוֹלִיכֵם יְהוָה אֶת־פֹּעֲלֵי הָאָוֶן שָׁלוֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: A song of the ascents. When YHWH restored Zion’s fortunes, we were like dreamers.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת בְּשׁוּב יְהוָה אֶת־שִׁיבַת צִיּוֹן הָיִינוּ כְּחֹלְמִים׃

verses.english: Then our mouth was filled with laughter and our tongue with a shout of joy. Then they said among the nations, “YHWH has done great things with these.”
verses.hebrew: אָז יִמָּלֵא שְׂחוֹק פִּינוּ וּלְשׁוֹנֵנוּ רִנָּה אָז יֹאמְרוּ בַגּוֹיִם הִגְדִּיל יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת עִם־אֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: YHWH has done great things with us; we were glad.
verses.hebrew: הִגְדִּיל יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת עִמָּנוּ הָיִינוּ שְׂמֵחִים׃

verses.english: Restore our fortunes, YHWH, like streambeds in the Negev.
verses.hebrew: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה אֶת־שבותנו [שְׁבִיתֵנוּ] כַּאֲפִיקִים בַּנֶּגֶב׃

verses.english: Those sowing in tears will reap with a shout of joy.
verses.hebrew: הַזֹּרְעִים בְּדִמְעָה בְּרִנָּה יִקְצֹרוּ׃

verses.english: He goes on his way weeping, carrying the seed supply; he will surely come with a shout of joy, carrying his sheaves.
verses.hebrew: הָלוֹךְ יֵלֵךְ וּבָכֹה נֹשֵׂא מֶשֶׁךְ־הַזָּרַע בֹּא־יָבוֹא בְרִנָּה נֹשֵׂא אֲלֻמֹּתָיו׃

verses.english: A song of the ascents. Of Solomon. Unless YHWH builds a house, its builders labor on it in vain. Unless YHWH guards a city, the watchman keeps awake in vain.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לִשְׁלֹמֹה אִם־יְהוָה לֹא־יִבְנֶה בַיִת שָׁוְא עָמְלוּ בוֹנָיו בּוֹ אִם־יְהוָה לֹא־יִשְׁמָר־עִיר שָׁוְא שָׁקַד שׁוֹמֵר׃

verses.english: It is vain for you to rise early, to sit down late, eating the bread of painful toil; so He gives sleep to His beloved.
verses.hebrew: שָׁוְא לָכֶם מַשְׁכִּימֵי קוּם מְאַחֲרֵי־שֶׁבֶת אֹכְלֵי לֶחֶם הָעֲצָבִים כֵּן יִתֵּן לִידִידוֹ שֵׁנָא׃

verses.english: Look, sons are an inheritance from YHWH; the fruit of the womb is a reward.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה נַחֲלַת יְהוָה בָּנִים שָׂכָר פְּרִי הַבָּטֶן׃

verses.english: Like arrows in a warrior’s hand, so are sons of one’s youth.
verses.hebrew: כְּחִצִּים בְּיַד־גִּבּוֹר כֵּן בְּנֵי הַנְּעוּרִים׃

verses.english: Happy is the man who has filled his quiver with them. They will not be ashamed when they speak with enemies at the gate.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא אֶת־אַשְׁפָּתוֹ מֵהֶם לֹא־יֵבֹשׁוּ כִּי־יְדַבְּרוּ אֶת־אוֹיְבִים בַּשָּׁעַר׃

verses.english: A song of the ascents. Happy is everyone who fears YHWH, who walks in His ways.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אַשְׁרֵי כָּל־יְרֵא יְהוָה הַהֹלֵךְ בִּדְרָכָיו׃

verses.english: When you eat the labor of your hands, happy are you, and good will be yours.
verses.hebrew: יְגִיעַ כַּפֶּיךָ כִּי תֹאכֵל אַשְׁרֶיךָ וְטוֹב לָךְ׃

verses.english: Your wife is like a fruitful vine in the inner parts of your house; your sons are like olive shoots around your table.
verses.hebrew: אֶשְׁתְּךָ כְּגֶפֶן פֹּרִיָּה בְּיַרְכְּתֵי בֵיתֶךָ בָּנֶיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵי זֵיתִים סָבִיב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶךָ׃

verses.english: Look, thus is the man blessed who fears YHWH.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה כִי־כֵן יְבֹרַךְ גָּבֶר יְרֵא יְהוָה׃

verses.english: May YHWH bless you from Zion, and may you see Jerusalem’s good all the days of your life.
verses.hebrew: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן וּרְאֵה בְּטוּב יְרוּשָׁלִָם כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: And may you see sons of your sons. Peace upon Israel.
verses.hebrew: וּרְאֵה־בָנִים לְבָנֶיךָ שָׁלוֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: A song of the ascents. Much have they afflicted me from my youth— let Israel now say—
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת רַבַּת צְרָרוּנִי מִנְּעוּרַי יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: much have they afflicted me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed over me.
verses.hebrew: רַבַּת צְרָרוּנִי מִנְּעוּרָי גַּם לֹא־יָכְלוּ לִי׃

verses.english: On my back plowers plowed; they lengthened their furrows.
verses.hebrew: עַל־גַּבִּי חָרְשׁוּ חֹרְשִׁים הֶאֱרִיכוּ למענותם [לְמַעֲנִיתָם׃]

verses.english: YHWH is righteous; He cut the cords of the wicked.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה צַדִּיק קִצֵּץ עֲבוֹת רְשָׁעִים׃

verses.english: May all who hate Zion be ashamed and turn backward.
verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר כֹּל שֹׂנְאֵי צִיּוֹן׃

verses.english: May they be like grass on roofs, which dries up before it is pulled out,
verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ כַּחֲצִיר גַּגּוֹת שֶׁקַּדְמַת שָׁלַף יָבֵשׁ׃

verses.english: with which no reaper has filled his hand, nor a sheaf-binder his lap.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁלֹּא מִלֵּא כַפּוֹ קוֹצֵר וְחִצְנוֹ מְעַמֵּר׃

verses.english: And passersby have not said, “YHWH’s blessing be upon you; we bless you in YHWH’s name.”
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אָמְרוּ הָעֹבְרִים בִּרְכַּת־יְהוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בֵּרַכְנוּ אֶתְכֶם בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה׃

verses.english: A song of the ascents. From the depths I called You, YHWH.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת מִמַּעֲמַקִּים קְרָאתִיךָ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to the voice of my pleas for favor.
verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי שִׁמְעָה בְקוֹלִי תִּהְיֶינָה אָזְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁבוֹת לְקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָי׃

verses.english: If You keep account of iniquities, Yah, Lord, who can stand?
verses.hebrew: אִם־עֲוֺנוֹת תִּשְׁמָר־יָהּ אֲדֹנָי מִי יַעֲמֹד׃

verses.english: For with You is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עִמְּךָ הַסְּלִיחָה לְמַעַן תִּוָּרֵא׃

verses.english: I wait for YHWH; my soul waits, and for His word I hope.
verses.hebrew: קִוִּיתִי יְהוָה קִוְּתָה נַפְשִׁי וְלִדְבָרוֹ הוֹחָלְתִּי׃

verses.english: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen for the morning, watchmen for the morning.
verses.hebrew: נַפְשִׁי לַאדֹנָי מִשֹּׁמְרִים לַבֹּקֶר שֹׁמְרִים לַבֹּקֶר׃

verses.english: Let Israel hope in YHWH, for with YHWH is steadfast love, and with Him is abundant redemption.
verses.hebrew: יַחֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה כִּי־עִם־יְהוָה הַחֶסֶד וְהַרְבֵּה עִמּוֹ פְדוּת׃

verses.english: And He will redeem Israel from all its iniquities.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא יִפְדֶּה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל עֲוֺנֹתָיו׃

verses.english: A song of the ascents. Of David. YHWH, my heart was not lofty, and my eyes were not raised high; I did not walk among great things or things too wondrous for me.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד יְהוָה לֹא־גָבַהּ לִבִּי וְלֹא־רָמוּ עֵינַי וְלֹא־הִלַּכְתִּי בִּגְדֹלוֹת וּבְנִפְלָאוֹת מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: Surely I have calmed and quieted my soul. Like a weaned child with its mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא שִׁוִּיתִי וְדוֹמַמְתִּי נַפְשִׁי כְּגָמֻל עֲלֵי אִמּוֹ כַּגָּמֻל עָלַי נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: Let Israel hope in YHWH, from now and forever.
verses.hebrew: יַחֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: A song of the ascents. Remember for David, YHWH, all his affliction,
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת זְכוֹר־יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֵת כָּל־עֻנּוֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: how he swore to YHWH, vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַיהוָה נָדַר לַאֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: “I will not enter the tent of my house, nor climb onto my bed’s couch;
verses.hebrew: אִם־אָבֹא בְּאֹהֶל בֵּיתִי אִם־אֶעֱלֶה עַל־עֶרֶשׂ יְצוּעָי׃

verses.english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, slumber to my eyelids,
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶתֵּן שְׁנַת לְעֵינָי לְעַפְעַפַּי תְּנוּמָה׃

verses.english: until I find a place for YHWH, dwelling places for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
verses.hebrew: עַד־אֶמְצָא מָקוֹם לַיהוָה מִשְׁכָּנוֹת לַאֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: Look, we heard of her in Ephrathah; we found her in the fields of the wood.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־שְׁמַעֲנוּהָ בְאֶפְרָתָה מְצָאנוּהָ בִּשְׂדֵי־יָעַר׃

verses.english: Let us enter His dwelling places; let us bow at His footstool.
verses.hebrew: נָבוֹאָה לְמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָיו נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו׃

verses.english: Rise, YHWH, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
verses.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה לִמְנוּחָתֶךָ אַתָּה וַאֲרוֹן עֻזֶּךָ׃

verses.english: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and may Your faithful ones shout for joy.
verses.hebrew: כֹּהֲנֶיךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ־צֶדֶק וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ׃

verses.english: For the sake of David Your servant, do not turn away the face of Your anointed.
verses.hebrew: בַּעֲבוּר דָּוִד עַבְדֶּךָ אַל־תָּשֵׁב פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃

verses.english: YHWH swore truth to David; He will not turn back from it: “From the fruit of your body I will set one on your throne.
verses.hebrew: נִשְׁבַּע־יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֱמֶת לֹא־יָשׁוּב מִמֶּנָּה מִפְּרִי בִטְנְךָ אָשִׁית לְכִסֵּא־לָךְ׃

verses.english: If your sons keep My covenant and My testimony that I will teach them, their sons too will sit forever on your throne.”
verses.hebrew: אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ בָנֶיךָ בְּרִיתִי וְעֵדֹתִי זוֹ אֲלַמְּדֵם גַּם־בְּנֵיהֶם עֲדֵי־עַד יֵשְׁבוּ לְכִסֵּא־לָךְ׃

verses.english: For YHWH chose Zion; He desired her as His dwelling:
verses.hebrew: כִּי־בָחַר יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן אִוָּהּ לְמוֹשָׁב לוֹ׃

verses.english: “This is My resting place forever; here I will dwell, for I have desired her.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת־מְנוּחָתִי עֲדֵי־עַד פֹּה־אֵשֵׁב כִּי אִוִּתִיהָ׃

verses.english: I will surely bless her provisions; I will satisfy her needy with bread.
verses.hebrew: צֵידָהּ בָּרֵךְ אֲבָרֵךְ אֶבְיוֹנֶיהָ אַשְׂבִּיעַ לָחֶם׃

verses.english: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her faithful ones will surely shout for joy.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹהֲנֶיהָ אַלְבִּישׁ יֶשַׁע וַחֲסִידֶיהָ רַנֵּן יְרַנֵּנוּ׃

verses.english: There I will make a horn sprout for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed.
verses.hebrew: שָׁם אַצְמִיחַ קֶרֶן לְדָוִד עָרַכְתִּי נֵר לִמְשִׁיחִי׃

verses.english: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but upon him his crown will blossom.”
verses.hebrew: אוֹיְבָיו אַלְבִּישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וְעָלָיו יָצִיץ נִזְרוֹ׃

verses.english: A song of the ascents. Of David. Look, how good and how pleasant for brothers to dwell together!
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד הִנֵּה מַה־טּוֹב וּמַה־נָּעִים שֶׁבֶת אַחִים גַּם־יָחַד׃

verses.english: Like the good oil upon the head, descending upon the beard, Aaron’s beard, which descends upon the opening of his garments;
verses.hebrew: כַּשֶּׁמֶן הַטּוֹב עַל־הָרֹאשׁ יֹרֵד עַל־הַזָּקָן זְקַן־אַהֲרֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד עַל־פִּי מִדּוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: like Hermon’s dew descending upon Zion’s mountains. For there YHWH commanded the blessing— life forever.
verses.hebrew: כְּטַל־חֶרְמוֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד עַל־הַרְרֵי צִיּוֹן כִּי שָׁם צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָה חַיִּים עַד־הָעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: A song of the ascents. Look, bless YHWH, all servants of YHWH, who stand in YHWH’s house by night.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת הִנֵּה בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה כָּל־עַבְדֵי יְהוָה הָעֹמְדִים בְּבֵית־יְהוָה בַּלֵּילוֹת׃

verses.english: Lift your hands toward the sanctuary and bless YHWH.
verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ־יְדֵכֶם קֹדֶשׁ וּבָרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: May YHWH bless you from Zion, Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.hebrew: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Praise Yah! Praise YHWH’s name; praise, servants of YHWH,
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה הַלְלוּ עַבְדֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: you who stand in YHWH’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁעֹמְדִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Praise Yah, for YHWH is good; make music to His name, for it is pleasant.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ־יָהּ כִּי־טוֹב יְהוָה זַמְּרוּ לִשְׁמוֹ כִּי נָעִים׃

verses.english: For Yah chose Jacob for Himself, Israel as His treasured possession.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יַעֲקֹב בָּחַר לוֹ יָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִסְגֻלָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: For I know that YHWH is great, and our Lord is above all gods.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־גָדוֹל יְהוָה וַאֲדֹנֵינוּ מִכָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: Whatever YHWH desired, He did, in heaven and on earth, in the seas and all the depths.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵץ יְהוָה עָשָׂה בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ בַּיַּמִּים וְכָל־תְּהוֹמוֹת׃

verses.english: He brings clouds up from the earth’s end; He made lightning for the rain; He brings wind out of His storehouses.
verses.hebrew: מַעֲלֶה נְשִׂאִים מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ בְּרָקִים לַמָּטָר עָשָׂה מוֹצֵא־רוּחַ מֵאוֹצְרוֹתָיו׃

verses.english: He struck Egypt’s firstborn, from human to beast.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁהִכָּה בְּכוֹרֵי מִצְרָיִם מֵאָדָם עַד־בְּהֵמָה׃

verses.english: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, upon Pharaoh and all his servants.
verses.hebrew: שָׁלַח אֹתוֹת וּמֹפְתִים בְּתוֹכֵכִי מִצְרָיִם בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְכָל־עֲבָדָיו׃

verses.english: He struck many nations and killed mighty kings,
verses.hebrew: שֶׁהִכָּה גּוֹיִם רַבִּים וְהָרַג מְלָכִים עֲצוּמִים׃

verses.english: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all Canaan’s kingdoms.
verses.hebrew: לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וּלְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וּלְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת כְּנָעַן׃

verses.english: He gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel His people.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן אַרְצָם נַחֲלָה נַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH, Your name is forever; YHWH, Your remembrance is from generation to generation.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם יְהוָה זִכְרְךָ לְדֹר־וָדֹר׃

verses.english: For YHWH will judge His people and relent concerning His servants.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יָדִין יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וְעַל־עֲבָדָיו יִתְנֶחָם׃

verses.english: The nations’ idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
verses.hebrew: עֲצַבֵּי הַגּוֹיִם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: They have a mouth but do not speak; they have eyes but do not see.
verses.hebrew: פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ׃

verses.english: They have ears but do not listen; indeed, there is no breath in their mouth.
verses.hebrew: אָזְנַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יַאֲזִינוּ אַף אֵין־יֶשׁ־רוּחַ בְּפִיהֶם׃

verses.english: May those who make them become like them, everyone who trusts in them.
verses.hebrew: כְּמוֹהֶם יִהְיוּ עֹשֵׂיהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֶם׃

verses.english: House of Israel, bless YHWH; house of Aaron, bless YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה בֵּית אַהֲרֹן בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: House of Levi, bless YHWH; you who fear YHWH, bless YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בֵּית הַלֵּוִי בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה יִרְאֵי יְהוָה בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Blessed be YHWH from Zion, He who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן שֹׁכֵן יְרוּשָׁלִָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃

verses.english: Give thanks to YHWH, for He is good; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: Give thanks to the God of gods; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לֵאלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: Give thanks to the Lord of lords; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַאֲדֹנֵי הָאֲדֹנִים כִּי לְעֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: To Him who alone does great wonders; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: לְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת לְבַדּוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: To Him who made the heavens with understanding; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: לְעֹשֵׂה הַשָּׁמַיִם בִּתְבוּנָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: To Him who spread the earth upon the waters; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: לְרֹקַע הָאָרֶץ עַל־הַמָּיִם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: To Him who made great lights; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: לְעֹשֵׂה אוֹרִים גְּדֹלִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: the sun for rule by day; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: אֶת־הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶׁלֶת בַּיּוֹם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: the moon and stars for rule by night; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: אֶת־הַיָּרֵחַ וְכוֹכָבִים לְמֶמְשְׁלוֹת בַּלָּיְלָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: To Him who struck Egypt in its firstborn; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: לְמַכֵּה מִצְרַיִם בִּבְכוֹרֵיהֶם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: And He brought Israel out from their midst; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצֵא יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: with a strong hand and an outstretched arm; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: To Him who cut the Sea of Reeds into parts; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: לְגֹזֵר יַם־סוּף לִגְזָרִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: And He brought Israel through its midst; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱבִיר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתוֹכוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: And He shook Pharaoh and his army into the Sea of Reeds; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: וְנִעֵר פַּרְעֹה וְחֵילוֹ בְיַם־סוּף כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: To Him who led His people through the wilderness; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: לְמוֹלִיךְ עַמּוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: To Him who struck great kings; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: לְמַכֵּה מְלָכִים גְּדֹלִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: And He killed mighty kings; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּהֲרֹג מְלָכִים אַדִּירִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: Sihon king of the Amorites; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: and Og king of Bashan; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: וּלְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: And He gave their land as an inheritance; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן אַרְצָם לְנַחֲלָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: an inheritance to Israel His servant; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: נַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: Who remembered us in our low estate; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁבְּשִׁפְלֵנוּ זָכַר לָנוּ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: And He tore us free from our adversaries; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְרְקֵנוּ מִצָּרֵינוּ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: He gives bread to all flesh; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: נֹתֵן לֶחֶם לְכָל־בָּשָׂר כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: Give thanks to the God of heaven; for His steadfast love is forever.
verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לְאֵל הַשָּׁמָיִם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: By Babylon’s rivers, there we sat; we also wept when we remembered Zion.
verses.hebrew: עַל נַהֲרוֹת בָּבֶל שָׁם יָשַׁבְנוּ גַּם־בָּכִינוּ בְּזָכְרֵנוּ אֶת־צִיּוֹן׃

verses.english: Upon the willows in her midst we hung our lyres.
verses.hebrew: עַל־עֲרָבִים בְּתוֹכָהּ תָּלִינוּ כִּנֹּרוֹתֵינוּ׃

verses.english: For there our captors asked us for words of song, and our tormentors for joy: “Sing us one of Zion’s songs.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁם שְׁאֵלוּנוּ שׁוֹבֵינוּ דִּבְרֵי־שִׁיר וְתוֹלָלֵינוּ שִׂמְחָה שִׁירוּ לָנוּ מִשִּׁיר צִיּוֹן׃

verses.english: How can we sing YHWH’s song on foreign soil?
verses.hebrew: אֵיךְ נָשִׁיר אֶת־שִׁיר־יְהוָה עַל אַדְמַת נֵכָר׃

verses.english: If I forget you, Jerusalem, may my right hand forget.
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶשְׁכָּחֵךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָם תִּשְׁכַּח יְמִינִי׃

verses.english: May my tongue cling to my palate if I do not remember you, if I do not raise Jerusalem above my highest joy.
verses.hebrew: תִּדְבַּק־לְשׁוֹנִי לְחִכִּי אִם־לֹא אֶזְכְּרֵכִי אִם־לֹא אַעֲלֶה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם עַל רֹאשׁ שִׂמְחָתִי׃

verses.english: Remember against Edom’s sons, YHWH, the day of Jerusalem, those saying, “Strip her, strip her, down to her foundation!”
verses.hebrew: זְכֹר יְהוָה לִבְנֵי אֱדוֹם אֵת יוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָם הָאֹמְרִים עָרוּ עָרוּ עַד הַיְסוֹד בָּהּ׃

verses.english: Daughter Babylon, devastated one, happy is the one who repays you the treatment you dealt us.
verses.hebrew: בַּת־בָּבֶל הַשְּׁדוּדָה אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁיְשַׁלֶּם־לָךְ אֶת־גְּמוּלֵךְ שֶׁגָּמַלְתְּ לָנוּ׃

verses.english: Happy is the one who seizes your little children and dashes them against the rock.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁיֹּאחֵז וְנִפֵּץ אֶת־עֹלָלַיִךְ אֶל־הַסָּלַע׃

verses.english: Of David. I will thank You with all my heart; before gods I will make music to You.
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד אוֹדְךָ בְכָל־לִבִּי נֶגֶד אֱלֹהִים אֲזַמְּרֶךָּ׃

verses.english: I will bow toward Your holy temple and thank Your name for Your steadfast love and Your faithfulness, for You have magnified Your utterance above all Your name.
verses.hebrew: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל־הֵיכַל קָדְשְׁךָ וְאוֹדֶה אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ עַל־חַסְדְּךָ וְעַל־אֲמִתֶּךָ כִּי־הִגְדַּלְתָּ עַל־כָּל־שִׁמְךָ אִמְרָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me with strength in my soul.
verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם קָרָאתִי וַתַּעֲנֵנִי תַּרְהִבֵנִי בְנַפְשִׁי עֹז׃

verses.english: Let all earth’s kings thank You, YHWH, for they have heard the utterances of Your mouth.
verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּךָ יְהוָה כָּל־מַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ כִּי שָׁמְעוּ אִמְרֵי־פִיךָ׃

verses.english: And let them sing of YHWH’s ways, for great is YHWH’s glory.
verses.hebrew: וְיָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵי יְהוָה כִּי גָדוֹל כְּבוֹד יְהוָה׃

verses.english: For YHWH is high, yet He sees the lowly; the lofty He knows from afar.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־רָם יְהוָה וְשָׁפָל יִרְאֶה וְגָבֹהַּ מִמֶּרְחָק יְיֵדָע׃

verses.english: If I walk amid distress, You will keep me alive; against my enemies’ anger You will stretch out Your hand, and Your right hand will save me.
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֵלֵךְ בְּקֶרֶב צָרָה תְּחַיֵּנִי עַל אַף אֹיְבַי תִּשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ וְתוֹשִׁיעֵנִי יְמִינֶךָ׃

verses.english: YHWH will bring it to completion for me. YHWH, Your steadfast love is forever; do not abandon the works of Your hands.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יִגְמֹר בַּעֲדִי יְהוָה חַסְדְּךָ לְעוֹלָם מַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אַל־תֶּרֶף׃

verses.english: For the music director. Of David. A psalm. YHWH, You searched me and knew me.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר יְהוָה חֲקַרְתַּנִי וַתֵּדָע׃

verses.english: You know my sitting and my rising; You discern my thought from afar.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּי וְקוּמִי בַּנְתָּה לְרֵעִי מֵרָחוֹק׃

verses.english: You sifted my path and my lying down; You are familiar with all my ways.
verses.hebrew: אָרְחִי וְרִבְעִי זֵרִיתָ וְכָל־דְּרָכַי הִסְכַּנְתָּה׃

verses.english: For there is not a word on my tongue— look, YHWH, You know it all.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵין מִלָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִי הֵן יְהוָה יָדַעְתָּ כֻלָּהּ׃

verses.english: Behind and before You hemmed me in, and placed Your palm upon me.
verses.hebrew: אָחוֹר וָקֶדֶם צַרְתָּנִי וַתָּשֶׁת עָלַי כַּפֶּכָה׃

verses.english: Knowledge is too wondrous for me; it is too high—I cannot attain it.
verses.hebrew: פלאיה [פְּלִיאָה] דַעַת מִמֶּנִּי נִשְׂגְּבָה לֹא־אוּכַל לָהּ׃

verses.english: Where can I go from Your spirit, and where can I flee from Your face?
verses.hebrew: אָנָה אֵלֵךְ מֵרוּחֶךָ וְאָנָה מִפָּנֶיךָ אֶבְרָח׃

verses.english: If I ascend to heaven, You are there; if I spread my bed in Sheol, look, You are there.
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶסַּק שָׁמַיִם שָׁם אָתָּה וְאַצִּיעָה שְּׁאוֹל הִנֶּךָּ׃

verses.english: If I take the wings of dawn and settle at the sea’s farthest edge,
verses.hebrew: אֶשָּׂא כַנְפֵי־שָׁחַר אֶשְׁכְּנָה בְּאַחֲרִית יָם׃

verses.english: even there Your hand will lead me, and Your right hand will hold me.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־שָׁם יָדְךָ תַנְחֵנִי וְתֹאחֲזֵנִי יְמִינֶךָ׃

verses.english: And I said, “Surely darkness will overwhelm me, and night will be light around me.”
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אַךְ־חֹשֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵנִי וְלַיְלָה אוֹר בַּעֲדֵנִי׃

verses.english: Even darkness is not dark to You; night shines like day, darkness and light alike.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־חֹשֶׁךְ לֹא־יַחְשִׁיךְ מִמֶּךָ וְלַיְלָה כַּיּוֹם יָאִיר כַּחֲשֵׁיכָה כָּאוֹרָה׃

verses.english: For You acquired my kidneys; You wove me together in my mother’s womb.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה קָנִיתָ כִלְיֹתָי תְּסֻכֵּנִי בְּבֶטֶן אִמִּי׃

verses.english: I thank You, for I was fearfully distinguished; wondrous are Your works, and my soul knows very well.
verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ עַל כִּי נוֹרָאוֹת נִפְלֵיתִי נִפְלָאִים מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְנַפְשִׁי יֹדַעַת מְאֹד׃

verses.english: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, woven in earth’s depths.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־נִכְחַד עָצְמִי מִמֶּךָּ אֲשֶׁר־עֻשֵּׂיתִי בַסֵּתֶר רֻקַּמְתִּי בְּתַחְתִּיּוֹת אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Your eyes saw my unformed substance; in Your book all of them would be written— days were formed, and not one among them.
verses.hebrew: גָּלְמִי רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ וְעַל־סִפְרְךָ כֻּלָּם יִכָּתֵבוּ יָמִים יֻצָּרוּ ולא [וְלוֹ] אֶחָד בָּהֶם׃

verses.english: How precious to me are Your thoughts, God; how vast are their sums!
verses.hebrew: וְלִי מַה־יָּקְרוּ רֵעֶיךָ אֵל מֶה עָצְמוּ רָאשֵׁיהֶם׃

verses.english: If I count them, they outnumber the sand; I awake, and I am still with You.
verses.hebrew: אֶסְפְּרֵם מֵחוֹל יִרְבּוּן הֱקִיצֹתִי וְעוֹדִי עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: If only You would kill the wicked, God! Men of blood, turn away from me,
verses.hebrew: אִם־תִּקְטֹל אֱלוֹהַּ רָשָׁע וְאַנְשֵׁי דָמִים סוּרוּ מֶנִּי׃

verses.english: who speak of You with scheming; Your adversaries lift up [Your name] in vain.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר יֹאמְרֻךָ לִמְזִמָּה נָשֻׂא לַשָּׁוְא עָרֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Do I not hate those who hate You, YHWH, and loathe those who rise against You?
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא־מְשַׂנְאֶיךָ יְהוָה אֶשְׂנָא וּבִתְקוֹמְמֶיךָ אֶתְקוֹטָט׃

verses.english: I hate them with complete hatred; they have become my enemies.
verses.hebrew: תַּכְלִית שִׂנְאָה שְׂנֵאתִים לְאוֹיְבִים הָיוּ לִי׃

verses.english: Search me, God, and know my heart; test me and know my anxious thoughts.
verses.hebrew: חָקְרֵנִי אֵל וְדַע לְבָבִי בְּחָנֵנִי וְדַע שַׂרְעַפָּי׃

verses.english: See whether a way of pain is in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
verses.hebrew: וּרְאֵה אִם־דֶּרֶךְ־עֹצֶב בִּי וּנְחֵנִי בְּדֶרֶךְ עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: For the music director. A psalm of David.
verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃

verses.english: Pull me free, YHWH, from an evil person; guard me from a violent man,
verses.hebrew: חַלְּצֵנִי יְהוָה מֵאָדָם רָע מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תִּנְצְרֵנִי׃

verses.english: who devise evils in their heart and gather for wars all day.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר חָשְׁבוּ רָעוֹת בְּלֵב כָּל־יוֹם יָגוּרוּ מִלְחָמוֹת׃

verses.english: They sharpened their tongue like a serpent; viper venom is beneath their lips. Selah.
verses.hebrew: שָׁנֲנוּ לְשׁוֹנָם כְּמוֹ־נָחָשׁ חֲמַת עַכְשׁוּב תַּחַת שְׂפָתֵימוֹ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Keep me, YHWH, from wicked hands; guard me from the violent man, those who devise ways to push aside my steps.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמְרֵנִי יְהוָה מִידֵי רָשָׁע מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תִּנְצְרֵנִי אֲשֶׁר חָשְׁבוּ לִדְחוֹת פְּעָמָי׃

verses.english: The proud hid a trap for me, and cords; they spread a net beside the track; they set snares for me. Selah.
verses.hebrew: טָמְנוּ־גֵאִים פַּח לִי וַחֲבָלִים פָּרְשׂוּ רֶשֶׁת לְיַד־מַעְגָּל מֹקְשִׁים שָׁתוּ־לִי סֶלָה׃

verses.english: I said to YHWH, “You are my God.” Listen, YHWH, to the voice of my pleas for favor.
verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי לַיהוָה אֵלִי אָתָּה הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָי׃

verses.english: YHWH, my Lord, strength of my salvation, You sheltered my head on the day of weapons.
verses.hebrew: יְהֹוִה אֲדֹנָי עֹז יְשׁוּעָתִי סַכֹּתָה לְרֹאשִׁי בְּיוֹם נָשֶׁק׃

verses.english: Do not grant the wicked man’s desires, YHWH; do not advance his scheme—they would rise high. Selah.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתֵּן יְהוָה מַאֲוַיֵּי רָשָׁע זְמָמוֹ אַל־תָּפֵק יָרוּמוּ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: The head of those surrounding me— may the trouble of their lips cover them.
verses.hebrew: רֹאשׁ מְסִבָּי עֲמַל שְׂפָתֵימוֹ יכסומו [יְכַסֵּמוֹ׃]

verses.english: May coals fall upon them; may He cast them into fire, into deep pits, so they do not rise.
verses.hebrew: ימיטו [יִמּוֹטוּ] עֲלֵיהֶם גֶּחָלִים בָּאֵשׁ יַפִּלֵם בְּמַהֲמֹרוֹת בַּל־יָקוּמוּ׃

verses.english: May a man of malicious speech not be established in the land; may evil hunt the violent man, thrusting him down.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ לָשׁוֹן בַּל־יִכּוֹן בָּאָרֶץ אִישׁ־חָמָס רָע יְצוּדֶנּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹת׃

verses.english: I know that YHWH will act for the afflicted person’s cause, for justice for the needy.
verses.hebrew: ידעת [יָדַעְתִּי] כִּי־יַעֲשֶׂה יְהוָה דִּין עָנִי מִשְׁפַּט אֶבְיֹנִים׃

verses.english: Surely the righteous will thank Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ צַדִּיקִים יוֹדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ יֵשְׁבוּ יְשָׁרִים אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ׃

verses.english: A psalm of David. YHWH, I called You; hurry to me. Listen to my voice when I call You.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהוָה קְרָאתִיךָ חוּשָׁה לִּי הַאֲזִינָה קוֹלִי בְּקָרְאִי־לָךְ׃

verses.english: Let my prayer be set as incense before You, the lifting of my palms as an evening offering.
verses.hebrew: תִּכּוֹן תְּפִלָּתִי קְטֹרֶת לְפָנֶיךָ מַשְׂאַת כַּפַּי מִנְחַת־עָרֶב׃

verses.english: Set a guard, YHWH, for my mouth, a watch over the door of my lips.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיתָה יְהוָה שָׁמְרָה לְפִי נִצְּרָה עַל־דַּל שְׂפָתָי׃

verses.english: Do not incline my heart toward an evil matter, to practice wicked deeds with people who work iniquity; let me not eat of their delicacies.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּט־לִבִּי לְדָבָר רָע לְהִתְעוֹלֵל עֲלִלוֹת בְּרֶשַׁע אֶת־אִישִׁים פֹּעֲלֵי־אָוֶן וּבַל־אֶלְחַם בְּמַנְעַמֵּיהֶם׃

verses.english: Let a righteous man strike me—it is kindness; let him correct me. It is oil for the head; let my head not refuse it. For still my prayer is amid their evils.
verses.hebrew: יֶהֶלְמֵנִי־צַדִּיק חֶסֶד וְיוֹכִיחֵנִי שֶׁמֶן רֹאשׁ אַל־יָנִי רֹאשִׁי כִּי־עוֹד וּתְפִלָּתִי בְּרָעוֹתֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Their judges slipped down the sides of a rock, and they will hear my sayings, for they are pleasant.
verses.hebrew: נִשְׁמְטוּ בִידֵי־סֶלַע שֹׁפְטֵיהֶם וְשָׁמְעוּ אֲמָרַי כִּי נָעֵמוּ׃

verses.english: As when one plows and splits the earth, our bones were scattered at Sheol’s mouth.
verses.hebrew: כְּמוֹ פֹלֵחַ וּבֹקֵעַ בָּאָרֶץ נִפְזְרוּ עֲצָמֵינוּ לְפִי שְׁאוֹל׃

verses.english: For my eyes are toward You, YHWH, my Lord; in You I take refuge—do not pour out my life.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוִה אֲדֹנָי עֵינָי בְּכָה חָסִיתִי אַל־תְּעַר נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: Keep me from the trap’s grasp that they laid for me, and from the snares of workers of iniquity.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמְרֵנִי מִידֵי פַח יָקְשׁוּ לִי וּמֹקְשׁוֹת פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃

verses.english: Let the wicked fall together into his nets, while I pass by.
verses.hebrew: יִפְּלוּ בְמַכְמֹרָיו רְשָׁעִים יַחַד אָנֹכִי עַד־אֶעֱבוֹר׃

verses.english: A maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.
verses.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד בִּהְיוֹתוֹ בַמְּעָרָה תְפִלָּה׃

verses.english: With my voice I cry to YHWH; with my voice I plead with YHWH.
verses.hebrew: קוֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָה אֶזְעָק קוֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָה אֶתְחַנָּן׃

verses.english: I pour out my complaint before Him; I declare my distress before Him.
verses.hebrew: אֶשְׁפֹּךְ לְפָנָיו שִׂיחִי צָרָתִי לְפָנָיו אַגִּיד׃

verses.english: When my spirit grows faint within me, You know my path. On this way where I walk, they have hidden a trap for me.
verses.hebrew: בְּהִתְעַטֵּף עָלַי רוּחִי וְאַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ נְתִיבָתִי בְּאֹרַח־זוּ אֲהַלֵּךְ טָמְנוּ פַח לִי׃

verses.english: Look to the right and see: no one acknowledges me. Escape has vanished from me; no one cares for my soul.
verses.hebrew: הַבֵּיט יָמִין וּרְאֵה וְאֵין־לִי מַכִּיר אָבַד מָנוֹס מִמֶּנִּי אֵין דּוֹרֵשׁ לְנַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: I cry to You, YHWH; I say, You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.
verses.hebrew: זָעַקְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה אָמַרְתִּי אַתָּה מַחְסִי חֶלְקִי בְּאֶרֶץ הַחַיִּים׃

verses.english: Attend to my cry, for I am brought very low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are stronger than I.
verses.hebrew: הַקְשִׁיבָה אֶל־רִנָּתִי כִּי־דַלּוֹתִי מְאֹד הַצִּילֵנִי מֵרֹדְפַי כִּי אָמְצוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: Bring my soul out of confinement, that I may thank Your name. The righteous will gather around me, for You will deal generously with me.
verses.hebrew: הוֹצִיאָה מִמַּסְגֵּר נַפְשִׁי לְהוֹדוֹת אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ בִּי יַכְתִּרוּ צַדִּיקִים כִּי תִגְמֹל עָלָי׃

verses.english: A psalm of David. YHWH, hear my prayer; give ear to my pleas. In Your faithfulness answer me, in Your righteousness.
verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהוָה שְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֶל־תַּחֲנוּנַי בֶּאֱמֻנָתְךָ עֲנֵנִי בְּצִדְקָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Do not enter into judgment with Your servant, for no one living will be righteous before You.
verses.hebrew: וְאַל־תָּבוֹא בְמִשְׁפָּט אֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי לֹא־יִצְדַּק לְפָנֶיךָ כָל־חָי׃

verses.english: For an enemy has pursued my soul, crushed my life to the ground, made me sit in dark places like those long dead.
verses.hebrew: כִּי רָדַף אוֹיֵב נַפְשִׁי דִּכָּא לָאָרֶץ חַיָּתִי הוֹשִׁיבַנִי בְמַחֲשַׁכִּים כְּמֵתֵי עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: My spirit grows faint within me; within me my heart is appalled.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּתְעַטֵּף עָלַי רוּחִי בְּתוֹכִי יִשְׁתּוֹמֵם לִבִּי׃

verses.english: I remember days of old; I meditate on all Your work; I ponder the works of Your hands.
verses.hebrew: זָכַרְתִּי יָמִים מִקֶּדֶם הָגִיתִי בְכָל־פָּעֳלֶךָ בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ אֲשׂוֹחֵחַ׃

verses.english: I spread out my hands to You; my soul is like a weary land for You. Selah.
verses.hebrew: פֵּרַשְׂתִּי יָדַי אֵלֶיךָ נַפְשִׁי כְּאֶרֶץ־עֲיֵפָה לְךָ סֶלָה׃

verses.english: Hurry, answer me, YHWH; my spirit is spent. Do not hide Your face from me, lest I become like those descending to the pit.
verses.hebrew: מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה כָּלְתָה רוּחִי אַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי וְנִמְשַׁלְתִּי עִם־יֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃

verses.english: Let me hear Your steadfast love in the morning, for I trust in You. Make known to me the way I should walk, for to You I lift my soul.
verses.hebrew: הַשְׁמִיעֵנִי בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ כִּי־בְךָ בָטָחְתִּי הוֹדִיעֵנִי דֶּרֶךְ־זוּ אֵלֵךְ כִּי־אֵלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: Rescue me from my enemies, YHWH; to You I have hidden myself.
verses.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבַי יְהוָה אֵלֶיךָ כִסִּתִי׃

verses.english: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. Your good Spirit— may He lead me on level ground.
verses.hebrew: לַמְּדֵנִי לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלוֹהָי רוּחֲךָ טוֹבָה תַּנְחֵנִי בְּאֶרֶץ מִישׁוֹר׃

verses.english: For Your name’s sake, YHWH, keep me alive; in Your righteousness bring my soul out of distress.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן־שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה תְּחַיֵּנִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ תוֹצִיא מִצָּרָה נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: In Your steadfast love put an end to my enemies, and destroy all who distress my soul, for I am Your servant.
verses.hebrew: וּבְחַסְדְּךָ תַּצְמִית אֹיְבָי וְהַאֲבַדְתָּ כָּל־צֹרֲרֵי נַפְשִׁי כִּי אֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Of David. Blessed is YHWH, my Rock, who trains my hands for battle, my fingers for war.
verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה צוּרִי הַמְלַמֵּד יָדַי לַקְרָב אֶצְבְּעוֹתַי לַמִּלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: My steadfast love and my fortress, my high stronghold and my Deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people beneath me.
verses.hebrew: חַסְדִּי וּמְצוּדָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי וּמְפַלְטִי לִי מָגִנִּי וּבוֹ חָסִיתִי הָרוֹדֵד עַמִּי תַחְתָּי׃

verses.english: YHWH, what is a human, that You know him, a son of humankind, that You take account of him?
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מָה־אָדָם וַתֵּדָעֵהוּ בֶּן־אֱנוֹשׁ וַתְּחַשְּׁבֵהוּ׃

verses.english: A human resembles a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.
verses.hebrew: אָדָם לַהֶבֶל דָּמָה יָמָיו כְּצֵל עוֹבֵר׃

verses.english: YHWH, bend Your heavens and descend; touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה הַט־שָׁמֶיךָ וְתֵרֵד גַּע בֶּהָרִים וְיֶעֱשָׁנוּ׃

verses.english: Flash lightning and scatter them; send Your arrows and throw them into confusion.
verses.hebrew: בְּרוֹק בָּרָק וּתְפִיצֵם שְׁלַח חִצֶּיךָ וּתְהֻמֵּם׃

verses.english: Send Your hands from on high; free me and rescue me from many waters, from the hand of foreigners.
verses.hebrew: שְׁלַח יָדֶיךָ מִמָּרוֹם פְּצֵנִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּים מִיַּד בְּנֵי נֵכָר׃

verses.english: Whose mouth speaks emptiness, and whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר פִּיהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁוְא וִימִינָם יְמִין שָׁקֶר׃

verses.english: God, I will sing a new song to You; on a ten-stringed harp I will make music to You.
verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים שִׁיר חָדָשׁ אָשִׁירָה לָּךְ בְּנֵבֶל עָשׂוֹר אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּךְ׃

verses.english: Who gives salvation to kings, who frees David His servant from an evil sword.
verses.hebrew: הַנּוֹתֵן תְּשׁוּעָה לַמְּלָכִים הַפּוֹצֶה אֶת־דָּוִד עַבְדּוֹ מֵחֶרֶב רָעָה׃

verses.english: Free me and rescue me from the hand of foreigners, whose mouth speaks emptiness and whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.hebrew: פְּצֵנִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי מִיַּד בְּנֵי־נֵכָר אֲשֶׁר פִּיהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁוְא וִימִינָם יְמִין שָׁקֶר׃

verses.english: That our sons may be like plants grown tall in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars, carved in the pattern of a palace.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר בָּנֵינוּ כִּנְטִעִים מְגֻדָּלִים בִּנְעוּרֵיהֶם בְּנוֹתֵינוּ כְזָוִיֹּת מְחֻטָּבוֹת תַּבְנִית הֵיכָל׃

verses.english: Our storehouses full, bringing forth one kind after another; our flocks multiplying by thousands, by ten thousands, in our open places.
verses.hebrew: מְזָוֵינוּ מְלֵאִים מְפִיקִים מִזַּן אֶל־זַן צֹאונֵנוּ מַאֲלִיפוֹת מְרֻבָּבוֹת בְּחוּצוֹתֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Our oxen heavily laden; no breach and no going out, no outcry in our squares.
verses.hebrew: אַלּוּפֵינוּ מְסֻבָּלִים אֵין־פֶּרֶץ וְאֵין יוֹצֵאת וְאֵין צְוָחָה בִּרְחֹבֹתֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Happy the people for whom it is so; happy the people whose God is YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיֲהוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃

verses.english: A praise of David. I will exalt You, my God, the King, and bless Your name forever and ever.
verses.hebrew: תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲבָרֲכָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃

verses.english: Every day I will bless You and praise Your name forever and ever.
verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־יוֹם אֲבָרֲכֶךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃

verses.english: Great is YHWH and greatly to be praised; His greatness is beyond searching out.
verses.hebrew: גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד וְלִגְדֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵקֶר׃

verses.english: Generation to generation will commend Your works, and they will declare Your mighty deeds.
verses.hebrew: דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וּגְבוּרֹתֶיךָ יַגִּידוּ׃

verses.english: The splendor of the glory of Your majesty, and the accounts of Your wonders, I will ponder.
verses.hebrew: הֲדַר כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶךָ וְדִבְרֵי נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה׃

verses.english: They will speak of the might of Your fearsome acts, and I will recount Your greatness.
verses.hebrew: וֶעֱזוּז נוֹרְאֹתֶיךָ יֹאמֵרוּ וגדולתיך [וּגְדוּלָּתְךָ] אֲסַפְּרֶנָּה׃

verses.english: They will pour forth remembrance of Your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of Your righteousness.
verses.hebrew: זֵכֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ יַבִּיעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ׃

verses.english: Gracious and compassionate is YHWH, slow to anger and great in steadfast love.
verses.hebrew: חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וּגְדָל־חָסֶד׃

verses.english: YHWH is good to all, and His compassion is over all His works.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב־יְהוָה לַכֹּל וְרַחֲמָיו עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו׃

verses.english: All Your works will thank You, YHWH, and Your faithful ones will bless You.
verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּךָ יְהוָה כָּל־מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְבָרֲכוּכָה׃

verses.english: They will speak of the glory of Your kingdom and tell of Your might,
verses.hebrew: כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ יֹאמֵרוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ יְדַבֵּרוּ׃

verses.english: to make known to humankind His mighty deeds and the glory of the splendor of His kingdom.
verses.hebrew: לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו וּכְבוֹד הֲדַר מַלְכוּתוֹ׃

verses.english: Your kingdom is a kingdom of all ages, and Your dominion endures through every generation.
verses.hebrew: מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל־עֹלָמִים וּמֶמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ בְּכָל־דּוֹר וָדוֹר׃

verses.note: Greek-only line (the nun line of the acrostic: "Faithful is the Lord in His words, and holy in all His works"). The Masoretic Text of Psalm 145 has no counterpart, so there is no Hebrew to render; the empty Hebrew cell is correct.

verses.english: YHWH supports all who are falling and straightens all who are bowed down.
verses.hebrew: סוֹמֵךְ יְהוָה לְכָל־הַנֹּפְלִים וְזוֹקֵף לְכָל־הַכְּפוּפִים׃

verses.english: The eyes of all wait expectantly for You, and You give them their food in its season.
verses.hebrew: עֵינֵי־כֹל אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּ וְאַתָּה נוֹתֵן־לָהֶם אֶת־אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ׃

verses.english: You open Your hand and satisfy every living thing with favor.
verses.hebrew: פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת־יָדֶךָ וּמַשְׂבִּיעַ לְכָל־חַי רָצוֹן׃

verses.english: YHWH is righteous in all His ways and faithful in all His works.
verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק יְהוָה בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו וְחָסִיד בְּכָל־מַעֲשָׂיו׃

verses.english: YHWH is near to all who call on Him, to all who call on Him in truth.
verses.hebrew: קָרוֹב יְהוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָיו לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻהוּ בֶאֱמֶת׃

verses.english: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear Him; He will hear their cry and save them.
verses.hebrew: רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָיו יַעֲשֶׂה וְאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָם יִשְׁמַע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם׃

verses.english: YHWH guards all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
verses.hebrew: שׁוֹמֵר יְהוָה אֶת־כָּל־אֹהֲבָיו וְאֵת כָּל־הָרְשָׁעִים יַשְׁמִיד׃

verses.english: My mouth will speak YHWH’s praise, and let all flesh bless His holy name forever and ever.
verses.hebrew: תְּהִלַּת יְהוָה יְדַבֶּר־פִּי וִיבָרֵךְ כָּל־בָּשָׂר שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃

verses.english: Praise Yah! Praise YHWH, my soul.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ־יָהּ הַלְלִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: I will praise YHWH throughout my life; I will make music to my God as long as I exist.
verses.hebrew: אֲהַלְלָה יְהוָה בְּחַיָּי אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהַי בְּעוֹדִי׃

verses.english: Do not trust in nobles, in a son of humankind who has no salvation.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּבְטְחוּ בִנְדִיבִים בְּבֶן־אָדָם שֶׁאֵין לוֹ תְשׁוּעָה׃

verses.english: His spirit goes out; he returns to his soil. On that day his plans perish.
verses.hebrew: תֵּצֵא רוּחוֹ יָשֻׁב לְאַדְמָתוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אָבְדוּ עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָיו׃

verses.english: Happy the one whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in YHWH his God,
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁאֵל יַעֲקֹב בְּעֶזְרוֹ שִׂבְרוֹ עַל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃

verses.english: Maker of heaven and earth, the sea and all that is in them, who keeps faithfulness forever,
verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ אֶת־הַיָּם וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּם הַשֹּׁמֵר אֱמֶת לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: who does justice for the oppressed, who gives bread to the hungry. YHWH releases prisoners.
verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט לָעֲשׁוּקִים נֹתֵן לֶחֶם לָרְעֵבִים יְהוָה מַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים׃

verses.english: YHWH opens the eyes of the blind; YHWH straightens those bowed down; YHWH loves the righteous.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה פֹּקֵחַ עִוְרִים יְהוָה זֹקֵף כְּפוּפִים יְהוָה אֹהֵב צַדִּיקִים׃

verses.english: YHWH guards resident foreigners; He upholds the orphan and widow, but He twists the way of the wicked.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה שֹׁמֵר אֶת־גֵּרִים יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה יְעוֹדֵד וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים יְעַוֵּת׃

verses.english: YHWH will reign forever, your God, Zion, through every generation. Praise Yah!
verses.hebrew: יִמְלֹךְ יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃

verses.english: Praise Yah! For it is good to make music to our God; for it is pleasant—praise is fitting.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ כִּי־טוֹב זַמְּרָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כִּי־נָעִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּה׃

verses.english: YHWH builds Jerusalem; He gathers the outcasts of Israel.
verses.hebrew: בּוֹנֵה יְרוּשָׁלִַם יְהוָה נִדְחֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יְכַנֵּס׃

verses.english: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verses.hebrew: הָרֹפֵא לִשְׁבוּרֵי לֵב וּמְחַבֵּשׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָם׃

verses.english: He counts the number of the stars; He calls them all by names.
verses.hebrew: מוֹנֶה מִסְפָּר לַכּוֹכָבִים לְכֻלָּם שֵׁמוֹת יִקְרָא׃

verses.english: Great is our Lord and abundant in power; His understanding is beyond number.
verses.hebrew: גָּדוֹל אֲדוֹנֵינוּ וְרַב־כֹּחַ לִתְבוּנָתוֹ אֵין מִסְפָּר׃

verses.english: YHWH upholds the humble; He brings the wicked low to the ground.
verses.hebrew: מְעוֹדֵד עֲנָוִים יְהוָה מַשְׁפִּיל רְשָׁעִים עֲדֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Respond to YHWH with thanksgiving; make music to our God with a lyre,
verses.hebrew: עֱנוּ לַיהוָה בְּתוֹדָה זַמְּרוּ לֵאלֹהֵינוּ בְכִנּוֹר׃

verses.english: who covers heaven with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass sprout on the mountains,
verses.hebrew: הַמְכַסֶּה שָׁמַיִם בְּעָבִים הַמֵּכִין לָאָרֶץ מָטָר הַמַּצְמִיחַ הָרִים חָצִיר׃

verses.english: who gives the cattle their bread, to young ravens when they cry.
verses.hebrew: נוֹתֵן לִבְהֵמָה לַחְמָהּ לִבְנֵי עֹרֵב אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאוּ׃

verses.english: He does not delight in the horse’s strength; He does not take pleasure in a man’s legs.
verses.hebrew: לֹא בִגְבוּרַת הַסּוּס יֶחְפָּץ לֹא־בְשׁוֹקֵי הָאִישׁ יִרְצֶה׃

verses.english: YHWH takes pleasure in those who fear Him, in those who wait for His steadfast love.
verses.hebrew: רוֹצֶה יְהוָה אֶת־יְרֵאָיו אֶת־הַמְיַחֲלִים לְחַסְדּוֹ׃

verses.english: Commend YHWH, Jerusalem; praise your God, Zion.
verses.hebrew: שַׁבְּחִי יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֶת־יְהוָה הַלְלִי אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן׃

verses.english: For He has strengthened the bars of your gates; He has blessed your children within you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־חִזַּק בְּרִיחֵי שְׁעָרָיִךְ בֵּרַךְ בָּנַיִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּךְ׃

verses.english: He makes your border peaceful; He satisfies you with the finest wheat.
verses.hebrew: הַשָּׂם־גְּבוּלֵךְ שָׁלוֹם חֵלֶב חִטִּים יַשְׂבִּיעֵךְ׃

verses.english: He sends His utterance to the earth; His word runs swiftly.
verses.hebrew: הַשֹּׁלֵחַ אִמְרָתוֹ אָרֶץ עַד־מְהֵרָה יָרוּץ דְּבָרוֹ׃

verses.english: He gives snow like wool; He scatters frost like ashes.
verses.hebrew: הַנֹּתֵן שֶׁלֶג כַּצָּמֶר כְּפוֹר כָּאֵפֶר יְפַזֵּר׃

verses.english: He throws His ice like morsels; who can stand before His cold?
verses.hebrew: מַשְׁלִיךְ קַרְחוֹ כְפִתִּים לִפְנֵי קָרָתוֹ מִי יַעֲמֹד׃

verses.english: He sends His word and melts them; He makes His wind blow, and waters flow.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח דְּבָרוֹ וְיַמְסֵם יַשֵּׁב רוּחוֹ יִזְּלוּ־מָיִם׃

verses.english: He declares His words to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.
verses.hebrew: מַגִּיד דברו [דְּבָרָיו] לְיַעֲקֹב חֻקָּיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: He has not done so for any nation; as for judgments, they do not know them. Praise Yah!
verses.hebrew: לֹא עָשָׂה כֵן לְכָל־גּוֹי וּמִשְׁפָּטִים בַּל־יְדָעוּם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃

verses.english: Praise Yah! Praise YHWH from the heavens; praise Him in the heights.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְהוָה מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם הַלְלוּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִים׃

verses.english: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His hosts.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ כָל־מַלְאָכָיו הַלְלוּהוּ כָּל־צבאו [צְבָאָיו׃]

verses.english: Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, all shining stars.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ שֶׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵחַ הַלְלוּהוּ כָּל־כּוֹכְבֵי אוֹר׃

verses.english: Praise Him, heavens of heavens, and waters above the heavens.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ שְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְהַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר מֵעַל הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: Let them praise YHWH’s name, for He commanded, and they were created.
verses.hebrew: יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי הוּא צִוָּה וְנִבְרָאוּ׃

verses.english: He established them forever and ever; He gave a decree, and it will not pass away.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמִידֵם לָעַד לְעוֹלָם חָק־נָתַן וְלֹא יַעֲבוֹר׃

verses.english: Praise YHWH from the earth, sea monsters and all depths,
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְהוָה מִן־הָאָרֶץ תַּנִּינִים וְכָל־תְּהֹמוֹת׃

verses.english: fire and hail, snow and vapor, storm wind fulfilling His word,
verses.hebrew: אֵשׁ וּבָרָד שֶׁלֶג וְקִיטוֹר רוּחַ סְעָרָה עֹשָׂה דְבָרוֹ׃

verses.english: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
verses.hebrew: הֶהָרִים וְכָל־גְּבָעוֹת עֵץ פְּרִי וְכָל־אֲרָזִים׃

verses.english: wild animals and all cattle, creeping things and winged birds,
verses.hebrew: הַחַיָּה וְכָל־בְּהֵמָה רֶמֶשׂ וְצִפּוֹר כָּנָף׃

verses.english: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,
verses.hebrew: מַלְכֵי־אֶרֶץ וְכָל־לְאֻמִּים שָׂרִים וְכָל־שֹׁפְטֵי אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: young men and also young women, old people with the young.
verses.hebrew: בַּחוּרִים וְגַם־בְּתוּלוֹת זְקֵנִים עִם־נְעָרִים׃

verses.english: Let them praise YHWH’s name, for His name alone is exalted; His majesty is above earth and heaven.
verses.hebrew: יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי־נִשְׂגָּב שְׁמוֹ לְבַדּוֹ הוֹדוֹ עַל־אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: He has raised a horn for His people— praise for all His faithful ones, for the children of Israel, the people near Him. Praise Yah!
verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֶם קֶרֶן לְעַמּוֹ תְּהִלָּה לְכָל־חֲסִידָיו לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַם־קְרֹבוֹ הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃

verses.english: Praise Yah! Sing a new song to YHWH, His praise in the assembly of faithful ones.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ תְּהִלָּתוֹ בִּקְהַל חֲסִידִים׃

verses.english: Let Israel rejoice in its Maker; let Zion’s children exult in their King.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֹשָׂיו בְּנֵי־צִיּוֹן יָגִילוּ בְמַלְכָּם׃

verses.english: Let them praise His name with dancing; with tambourine and lyre let them make music to Him.
verses.hebrew: יְהַלְלוּ שְׁמוֹ בְמָחוֹל בְּתֹף וְכִנּוֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־לוֹ׃

verses.english: For YHWH takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the humble with salvation.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־רוֹצֶה יְהוָה בְּעַמּוֹ יְפָאֵר עֲנָוִים בִּישׁוּעָה׃

verses.english: Let faithful ones exult in glory; let them sing joyfully on their beds.
verses.hebrew: יַעְלְזוּ חֲסִידִים בְּכָבוֹד יְרַנְּנוּ עַל־מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָם׃

verses.english: Exaltations of God in their throats, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
verses.hebrew: רוֹמְמוֹת אֵל בִּגְרוֹנָם וְחֶרֶב פִּיפִיּוֹת בְּיָדָם׃

verses.english: to execute vengeance among the nations, punishments among the peoples,
verses.hebrew: לַעֲשׂוֹת נְקָמָה בַּגּוֹיִם תּוֹכֵחֹת בַּל־אֻמִּים׃

verses.english: to bind their kings in fetters and their nobles in iron chains,
verses.hebrew: לֶאְסֹר מַלְכֵיהֶם בְּזִקִּים וְנִכְבְּדֵיהֶם בְּכַבְלֵי בַרְזֶל׃

verses.english: to execute upon them the written judgment. This is splendor for all His faithful ones. Praise Yah!
verses.hebrew: לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּהֶם מִשְׁפָּט כָּתוּב הָדָר הוּא לְכָל־חֲסִידָיו הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃

verses.english: Praise Yah! Praise God in His sanctuary; praise Him in the firmament of His strength.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ־אֵל בְּקָדְשׁוֹ הַלְלוּהוּ בִּרְקִיעַ עֻזּוֹ׃

verses.english: Praise Him for His mighty deeds; praise Him according to His abundant greatness.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ בִגְבוּרֹתָיו הַלְלוּהוּ כְּרֹב גֻּדְלוֹ׃

verses.english: Praise Him with the blast of a horn; praise Him with harp and lyre.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ בְּתֵקַע שׁוֹפָר הַלְלוּהוּ בְּנֵבֶל וְכִנּוֹר׃

verses.english: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and pipe.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ בְתֹף וּמָחוֹל הַלְלוּהוּ בְּמִנִּים וְעוּגָב׃

verses.english: Praise Him with resounding cymbals; praise Him with clashing cymbals.
verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ בְצִלְצְלֵי־שָׁמַע הַלְלוּהוּ בְּצִלְצְלֵי תְרוּעָה׃

verses.english: Let everything that breathes praise Yah. Praise Yah!
verses.hebrew: כֹּל הַנְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּל יָהּ הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
